text: Pahayag sini, ginsugo niya nga magkoordinar gid ang mga opisina kag makadul-ong sang relief goods sa apektado nga mga residente.
english: He said he ordered the offices to coordinate and deliver relief goods to the affected residents.

text: “I gave the instructions for them to work and coordinate to ensure that all our kababayans are out of harm’s way, and that the relief goods are ready to be delivered,” suno sa punong ehekutibo.
english: “I gave the instructions for them to work and coordinate to ensure that all our kababayans are out of harm’s way, and that the relief goods are ready to be delivered,” the chief executive said.

text: Ginatumod sini ang Office of Civil Defense kag ang Departments of Transportation, Health, Science and Technology, Social Welfare and Development, Energy, Public Works and Highways kag ang Interior and Local Government.
english: It refers to the Office of Civil Defense and the Departments of Transportation, Health, Science and Technology, Social Welfare and Development, Energy, Public Works and Highways and the Interior and Local Government.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ini nga dapat yara gid ang medical teams sa kada may distribusyon sang relief goods, kag dapat nga padayon ang suplay sang tubig kag kuryente.
english: He also reminded that medical teams should be present whenever there is a distribution of relief goods, and that the supply of water and electricity should be continuous.

text: “Ang mga relief goods ay nakahanda na, idine-deliver na doon sa mga area na nangangailangan.
english: “The relief goods are ready, being delivered to the areas in need.

text: Yung mga medical team kasabay na rin no’ng ating mga relief goods at tinitiyak natin na mayroong transportasyon,” kabahin pa sang iya video message.
english: The medical teams are also with our relief goods and we are making sure that there is transportation,” he said in his video message.

text:
“At siyempre ay tinitiyak natin na may sapat na supply ng tubig, sapat na supply ng kuryente at lahat ito ay para sa pangangailangan ng mga naging biktima nitong pagbaha at at malakas na ulan.”

Sa iya pa mensahe, nagpangabay man ang chief executive sa publiko nga sundon ang mga abiso sang local government units kag sang national government.
english:
“And of course we are making sure that there is enough water supply, enough electricity supply and all this is for the needs of the victims of this flood and heavy rain.”

In his message, the chief executive also urged the public to follow the advice of the local government units and the national government.

text: “Pakisundan lang po para naman matiyak natin na hindi kayo malalagay sa alanganin,” dugang sini.
english: “Please follow up so we can make sure you are not put in danger,” he added.

text: “Nandito kami lagi upang magbigay ng lahat ng serbisyo na kailangan sa harap ng hamon ng climate change.
english: “We are always here to provide all the services needed in the face of the challenge of climate change.

text: Siguraduhin natin mas lalo pang mapapalakas ang kakayahan ng pamahalaan na tumugon sa ganitong klaseng sitwasyon.”#
english: Let us ensure that the government's ability to respond to this kind of situation is further strengthened.”#

text: Nagsugtanay sanday United States President Joe Biden kag anay President Donald Trump nga mag-atubangay sa duha ka televised presidential debates nga nakatalana sa bulan sang Hunyo kag Septyembre subong nga tuig.
english: United States President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump have agreed to face each other in two televised presidential debates scheduled for June and September this year.

text: Naka-schedule ang una sa Hunyo 27 sa swing state sang Georgia; samtang sa Septyembre 10 naman ang ikaduha nga debate kag natalana pa nga ipaguwa ang detalye.
english: The first is scheduled for June 27 in the swing state of Georgia; while the second debate will be held on September 10 and details are scheduled to be released.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang election-year presidential debates ang kinaandan nga ginawaragwag sa nagkalain-lain nga US networks kun sa diin at least 73 million ka Americans ang naglantaw sang una nga debate sang 2020 sa tunga nanday Trump kag Biden.
english: It is known that the election-year presidential debates are usually broadcast on various US networks where at least 73 million Americans watched the first debate in 2020 between Trump and Biden.

text: Magamo man ang napilian nga schedule subong nga tuig bangud sa Hunyo 27 nga una nga match-up, ginalauman nga matapos na ang criminal hush money trial ni Trump sa New York; may mga byahe si Biden sa France kag Italy sa tunga-tunga sang Hunyo; kag matapos naman ang term sang Korte Suprema nga buot silingon, may ruling na kun bala immune si Trump sa federal prosecution kaangot sa Enero 6 nga Capitol insurrection.Ang ikaduha naman nga debate ang matabo antes ang pagsugod gid sang early voting sang kalabanan nga states.#
english: This year's schedule is also chaotic because with the June 27 first match-up, Trump's criminal hush money trial in New York is expected to end; Biden had trips to France and Italy in mid-June; and the end of the Supreme Court's term, which means that there will be a ruling on whether Trump is immune from federal prosecution in connection with the January 6 Capitol insurrection. The second debate will take place before the start of early voting in most states.

text: Pareho nga may posibilidad nga mangin bagyo ang duha ka low pressure areas (LPAs) nga lunsay yara sa sulod sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: Both low pressure areas (LPAs) are within the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) and have the potential to become typhoons.

text: Suno sa state weather bureau, ang isa ka LPA ang may mataas na nga potensyal nga mangin tropical depression sa masunod nga 24 oras.
english: According to the state weather bureau, an LPA has a high potential to become a tropical depression in the next 24 hours.

text: Ulihi ini nakit-an sa kalayuon nga 1,175 km nasidlangan sang Central Luzon.
english: It was last spotted 1,175 km east of Central Luzon.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, may medium chance naman nga mangin bagyo man ang LPA nga nasiplatan sa kalayuon nga 385 km nasidlangan sang Calayan, Cagayan.
english: Meanwhile, the LPA, which was spotted 385 km east of Calayan, Cagayan, has a medium chance of becoming a typhoon.

text: Padayon nga nagapaandam ang weather bureau nga magadala sang pag-ulan ang Southwest Monsoon ukon ang Habagat sa madamo nga parte sang Pilipinas.
english: The weather bureau continues to warn that the Southwest Monsoon will bring rains to many parts of the Philippines.

text: Mangin magal-umon sa Visayas kag may lapta-lapta nga pag-ulan kag thunderstorms suno pa sa update sang PAGASA.
english: It will be cloudy in the Visayas with patchy rain and thunderstorms, according to the PAGASA update.

text: Sa anunsyo naman ni Mayor Raisa Treñas kagab-i, maga-resume na ang klase sa Iloilo City subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 22.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas announced last night that classes will resume in Iloilo City today, July 22.

text: Sa probinsya naman, kanselado ang face-to-face classes sa banwa sang Oton subong nga adlaw sa tanan nga lebel sa pampubliko kag pribado nga eskwelahan.
english: In the province, face-to-face classes in Oton town were canceled today at all levels in public and private schools.

text: Sandig sa local government, ginpaiway ang klase bangud sa malain nga tyempo dala sang Habagat kag nagapabilin nga ginabaha ang pila ka mga dalan sa banwa.#
english: According to the local government, classes were canceled due to bad weather brought by the Habagat and some roads in the town remained flooded.

text: Mahigpit na inatasan ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr ang lahat ng mga government agencies na tiyakin ang kaligtasan ng publiko.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has strictly instructed all government agencies to ensure the safety of the public.

text: Kasunod ito sa mga nararanasang pagbaha sa Metro Manila at ilang mga probinsiya sa bansa.
english: This follows the flooding experienced in Metro Manila and some provinces in the country.

text: Pinasisiguro din ng Pangulo ang agarang pagbibigay ng tulong sa mga biktima ng baha.
english: The President also assured the immediate provision of assistance to the flood victims.

text: Sinabi nito na bago pa man ito magtungo sa US para paunlakan ang imbitasyon ni President Donald Trump ay nakausap niya ang mga namumuno sa iba’t-ibang ahensiya.
english: He said that before he went to the US to accept President Donald Trump's invitation, he spoke with the heads of various agencies.

text: Ilan sa mga ahensiya na kaniyang tinukoy ay ang Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG), Dept.
english: Some of the agencies he mentioned are the Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG), Dept.

text: of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), Department of Transportation (DOTr); Office of the Civil Defense (OCD), Department of Health (DOH); Department of Energy (DOE), at Dept.
english: of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), Department of Transportation (DOTr); Office of the Civil Defense (OCD), Department of Health (DOH); Department of Energy (DOE), and Dept.

text: of Social Welfare ang Development (DSWD).
english: of Social Welfare the Development (DSWD).

text: Pinayuhan din ng pangulo ang publiko na sumunod sa mga kautusan ng mga namamahala lalo na tuwing sila ay pinapalikas.
english: The President also advised the public to follow the orders of the authorities especially when they are being evacuated.

text: Nabutang sa ital-ital ang kabuhi sang prime minister sang Slovakia nga si Robert Fico matapos ini ginluthang sa pampubliko nga lugar kasunod sang political meeting sa Handlova.
english: Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico's life was in danger after he was shot in a public place following a political meeting in Handlova.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, arestado na ang 71-anyos nga gunman apang indi pa klaro kun ano ang motibo sini sa krimen.
english: According to initial information, the 71-year-old gunman has been arrested but the motive of the crime is still unclear.

text: Ginpahayag nga isa ka writer kag poet halin sa Levice ang suspek.
english: The suspect is said to be a writer and poet from Levice.

text: Gindalagan naman ang 59-anyos nga biktima sa ospital sa regional capital nga Banska Bystrica.
english: The 59-year-old victim was rushed to the hospital in the regional capital Banska Bystrica.

text: Oktubre lang sang nagligad nga tuig sang nagbalik si Fico, isa populist politician, bilang prime minister sa pungsod sa ikaapat na nga tion.
english: It was only in October last year that Fico, a populist politician, returned as prime minister of the country for the fourth time.

text: Ini nga insidente ang nagkibot gid sa Slovakia nga isa ka gamay nga central European nation nga may malaka lamang nga political violence.
english: The incident shocked Slovakia, a small central European nation with little political violence.

text: Nagasunod-sunod subong sa pag-abot ang mga mensahe sang partners sini sa European Union kag North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) nga nagakondena sa pag-atake.
english: Messages from its partners in the European Union and North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) condemning the attack have been pouring in.

text: Arestado ang 12 ka Korean nationals nga ginaalegar nagatrabaho sa isa ka ginapasuni scamming hub sa Angeles City, Pampanga.
english: Twelve Korean nationals were arrested for allegedly working in an alleged scamming hub in Angeles City, Pampanga.

text: Suno sa Bureau of Immigration (BI), natabo ang raid sang Pebrero 25 nga nag-resulta sa pag-aresto sa 33-anyos nga si Yu Jaemin.
english: According to the Bureau of Immigration (BI), the raid took place on February 25 which resulted in the arrest of 33-year-old Yu Jaemin.

text: Pahayag sang BI, nag-ugat ang operasyon sa intelligence information nga nabaton nga nagapahayag nga involved ang amo nga indibidwal sa pag-operate sang suspected scam hub kun sa diin ang ginapuntariya amo ang kaangay sini nga Korean nationals kag posible nga iban pa nga foreigners.
english: The BI said the operation was based on intelligence information received that the individual was involved in operating a suspected scam hub targeting such Korean nationals and possibly other foreigners.

text: Sandig pa sa report sang ahensya, nadiskubrehan naman ang 11 ka iban pa nga foreigners nga nagatrabaho sa opisina sa Poinsettia Street sa Angeles City kun sa diin naka-estasyon sila sa individual work areas kag amo ang aktibo nga nagapangamot sa operational equipment.
english: According to the agency's report, 11 other foreigners were discovered working in the office on Poinsettia Street in Angeles City where they were stationed in individual work areas and were actively working on operational equipment.

text: “The individuals were found engaged in work-related activities at the time of enforcement, prompting immediate verification of their identities and immigration status,” suno pa sa ahensya.
english: “The individuals were found engaged in work-related activities at the time of enforcement, prompting immediate verification of their identities and immigration status,” the agency said.

text: Natukiban man sang BI nga pugante ang tatlo sa foreign nationals kag may yara sang existing derogatory records.
english: The BI also discovered that the three foreign nationals are fugitives and have existing derogatory records.

text: Ang iban naman sa mga arestado ang natukiban man nga naga-overstay na sa pungsod nga isa ka paglapas sa Philippine Immigration Act of 1940 (as amended).
english: Some of the arrested were also found to be overstaying in the country in violation of the Philippine Immigration Act of 1940 (as amended).

text: Sa amo nga operasyon, isa pa ka Korean ang nag-abot sa premises kag nag-claim nga lessor siya ukon manager sang propiedad.
english: During the operation, another Korean arrived at the premises and claimed to be a lessor or manager of the property.

text: Ginpahayag nga nagpasilabot ini kag nag-claim nga ginpadala siya sang Korean authorities.
english: He reportedly intervened and claimed he was sent by the Korean authorities.

text: Sang gin-verify sa Korean government, nakumpirma nga wala ini sang kaangtanan sa awtoridad.
english: When verified with the Korean government, it was confirmed that it had nothing to do with the authorities.

text: Ginbyahe ang mga arestado sa Manila para sa booking kag documentation, kag nagapabilin subong sa BI Warden’s facility samtang ginapangatubang ang deportation cases.#
english: The arrested were flown to Manila for booking and documentation, and are currently remaining at the BI Warden's facility while facing deportation cases.

text: Ginaduso sang Association of Taxi Operators of Panay (ATOP) kaupod ang iban pa nga mga grupo sang taxi operators nga madugangan sang P5 tubtob P10 ang flagdown rate sa mga taxi bangud sa pagtaas sang presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: The Association of Taxi Operators of Panay (ATOP) along with other groups of taxi operators are proposing that the flagdown rate for taxis be increased by P5 to P10 due to the increase in the price of petroleum products.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Perfecto Yap, Presidente sang ATOP, iya ginpahayag nga nalakip ang mga taxi drivers kag operators sa naapektuhan sang tuman nga pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Perfecto Yap, President of ATOP, said taxi drivers and operators are among those affected by the sharp increase in fuel prices.

text: Suno kay Yap, direkta sila nga magapresentar sang ila ginaduso nga pagpataas sang flagdown sa Central Office sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) agud nga madasig nga maaprubahan kag mapatuman ang ila ginaduso nga pagpataas flagdown rate.
english: Yap said they will directly present their proposed flagdown increase to the Central Office of the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) so that their proposed flagdown rate increase can be quickly approved and implemented.

text: Ginpahayag man niya nga kun saligan lang ang fuel subsidy nga igahatag sang gobyerno, mabudlayan gid ang mga taxi drives kag operators bangud temporaryo lang ini nga solusyon.
english: He also said that if the government relies on the fuel subsidy, it will be very difficult for taxi drivers and operators because it is only a temporary solution.

text: Dugang pa ni Yap, mangin dako gid nga bulig sa ila kun maaprubahan ang ila ginaduso nga pagpasaka sang flagdown rate sa mga taxi.
english: Yap said it would be a big help to them if their proposed increase in the flagdown rate for taxis is approved.

text: Nakakaon ka na bala sang bilog nga puti, mahumok nga buha sang lubi?
english: Have you ever eaten a whole white, soft coconut shell?

text: Nahibaluan niyo bala nga ang buha sang lubi ang mas masustansya kun ipaanggid sa coconut juice?
english: Did you know that coconut juice is more nutritious than coconut juice?

text: Suno kay Rabya Jamshed, researcher sa “Marham” Health Care Team sa Pakistan, ang pagkaon sang hilaw nga buha ang may madamo sang health benefits.
english: According to Rabya Jamshed, researcher at the “Marham” Health Care Team in Pakistan, eating raw buha has many health benefits.

text: Yari ang pila ka maayo nga benepisyo sa pagkaon ang buha sang lubi:
english: Here are some good benefits of eating coconut shell:

text: Kun sa Pilipinas, naandan na ang pagpalupok sang lebentador kag paghiwat sang fireworks display kun nagasug-alaw sang bag-ong tuig.
english: In the Philippines, it is customary to blow up elevators and hold fireworks displays to welcome the new year.

text: Tuman ka pinasahi naman kun paano sug-alawon sang mga tawo didto sa Georgia ang nagahilapit nga bag-ong tuig.
english: The way people in Georgia welcome the upcoming new year is very special.

text: May palukpon man sila, apang indi ini trianggulo kag indi man kamara.
english: They also have a wing, but it is neither a triangle nor a chamber.

text: Agud indi ka na magpalibog, ihambal ko nalang ah.
english: So you don't have to worry, I'll just say it.

text: Building ang ila palukpon.
english: Building they will demolish.

text: Huo, building.
english: Yes, building.

text: Didto ini sa Macon-Bibb County.
english: It’s in Macon-Bibb County.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, ginbakal sang lokal nga gobyerno ang hotel sa balor nga $4.5 million sa isa ka federal bankruptcy proceeding.
english: Last year, the local government bought the hotel for $4.5 million in a federal bankruptcy proceeding.

text: Sang damlag lang, ginkasugtan nila nga mag-hire sang demolition firm agud palukpon ang building sa balor nga $2.6 million.
english: Recently, they agreed to hire a demolition firm to bring the building down for $2.6 million.

text: Suno kay Macon Mayor Lester Miller,1970 pa sang gintukod ang building apang kaangay nga wala gid nangin madinalag-on ang operasyon sini.
english: According to Macon Mayor Lester Miller, the building was constructed in 1970 but it seems that its operation has never been successful.

text: Dugang niya, nangin eyesore naman ini sa bilog nga komunidad rason nga gub-on nalang nila ini.
english: He added that it has become an eyesore for the entire community so they will demolish it.

text: Sa subong, ginaplano na sang mayo ang demolisyon kag istoryahon man ang mga malapit nga property owners agud maprotektahan man ang mga ini sa tion nga palukpon na ang building agud sug-alawon ang bag-ong tuig.
english: Currently, the demolition is being planned and nearby property owners will be discussed to protect them when the building is demolished to welcome the new year.

text: Nagsabat ang Malacañang sa matunog nga panawagan nga magpa-hair follicle drug test si Presidente Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Malacañang has responded to a loud call for President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. to undergo a hair follicle drug test.

text: kasunod sang liwat nga paggwa sang issue kaangot sa “polvoron video”.
english: following the re-emergence of the issue regarding the “polvoron video”.

text: Ang nasambit nga video ang napamatud-an na nga peke sa diin nagapakita sang isa ka tawo nga nagaanggid sa Presidente kag ginapahayag nagagamit sang cocaine.
english: The video has been proven to be fake and shows a man who looks like the President and is allegedly using cocaine.

text: Gin-usisa ni Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro ang motibo kag legal nga basehan sang mga nagamando sang drug test, lakip na ang mga netizens, bloggers, kag former Presidential spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque.
english: Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro the motive and legal basis of those ordering the drug test, including netizens, bloggers, and former Presidential spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque.

text: “Ano ang batayan ng pag-hiling ng hair follicle test kay Pangulong Marcos?
english: “What is the basis for asking President Marcos for a hair follicle test?

text: Ito ba ay batay sa isang akusasyon na siya ay gumagamit ng ilegal na droga?” pag-usisa ni Castro.
english: Is it based on an accusation that he uses illegal drugs?” Castro interrogated.

text:
“Kung may akusasyon, ang nag-aakusa ang may obligasyon na magpatunay.”

Dugang pa ni Castro, “Sa mga nagdedemanda ng test kay Pangulong Marcos, kailangang patunayan ninyo muna na siya ay gumagawa ng mali.”

Ang naglapta nga video, nga una nga ginpagwa sa isa ka Maisug rally sa Los Angeles sang 2024, ang ginkumpirma sang Philippine National Police (PNP) kag mga independent nga fact-checkers nga peke kag ginbag-o gamit ang artificial intelligence (AI) agud mangin kaangid ni Marcos.
english:
“If there is an accusation, the accuser has the obligation to prove it.”

Castro added, “To those who demand a test against President Marcos, you must first prove that he is doing wrong.”

The viral video, first released at a Maisug rally in Los Angeles in 2024, was confirmed by the Philippine National Police (PNP) and independent fact-checkers to be fake and altered using artificial intelligence (AI) to resemble Marcos.

text: Apang liwat nga nagtunog ang isyu sang ini ang nagwa kasunod sang testimonya sang vlogger nga si Vincent “Pebbles” Cunanan sa isa ka House Tri-Committee hearing kaangot sa fake news.
english: But the issue resurfaced when it came out following the testimony of vlogger Vincent “Pebbles” Cunanan in a House Tri-Committee hearing on fake news.

text: Suno kay Cunanan, si Roque ang utok sa pagpalapta sang video, nga ginapahayag ginapabugal pa sini sa isa ka pribado nga pagtililipon sa Hong Kong nga eksperto siya sa pagpatumba sang mga gobyerno.
english: According to Cunanan, Roque was the mastermind behind the spread of the video, which he reportedly boasted in a private gathering in Hong Kong that he was an expert in overthrowing governments.

text: Hugot naman nga ginpanginwala ni Roque ang akusasyon kag gintawag nga “scripted show” ang hearing, kag ginlaragway man nga wala sang pulos ang affidavit ni Cunanan.
english: Roque strongly denied the accusation and called the hearing a “scripted show”, and also described Cunanan's affidavit as useless.

text: “Wala akong kapangyarihan na pabagsakin ang gobyerno,” pahayag ni Roque.
english: “I have no power to overthrow the government,” Roque said.

text:
“Ang kapalaran ni Pangulong Marcos ay nasa mga kamay ng sambayanang Pilipino, hindi sa akin.”

Dugang pa ni Roque, ang video ang mahimo naghalin lang sa isa ka tawo nga malapit sa Presidente, bangud sa indi pagsanto sang pahayag ni Cunanan kaangot sa source kag una nga nagpalapta sang video.
english:
"The fate of President Marcos is in the hands of the Filipino people, not in me."

Roque added that the video may have come from someone close to the President, due to the inconsistency of Cunanan's statement regarding the source who first spread the video.

text: INDI mabudlay sa aton ang magpati nga may kabuhi nga ispirituhanon bisan pa indi naton ini sila makita.
english: IT IS not hard for us to believe in spirit life even though we cannot see it.

text: Ang una gani nga mga tawo sa kalibutan naka-realisar na sini nga kamatuoran.
english: Even the first people in the world realized this fact.

text: Nahibal-an nila nga wala sila sing ikasarang nga mangin kabangdanan sang ila pagkatawo kag, tungod sini,  matudlo gid lang nila ini sa mas gamhanan nga kabuhi.
english: They know that they do not have the ability to be the cause of their birth and, because of this, they can only point it to a more powerful life.

text: Kag diri na nagsugod ang ila pagpati sa liwan nga kabuhi nga mas gamhanan pa sa tawo kag sang iban pa nga mga bagay nga nagaluntad diri sa kalibutan.
english: And this is where they began to believe in another life that is more powerful than man and other things that exist here on earth.

text: Tungod indi sila makita sang tawo, ginkilala nila ini bilang mga ispiritu (spirit).
english: Because they were invisible to human eyes, they recognized them as spirits.

text: Samtang, padayon man nila ginahibalo kon ano gid ining mga ispiritu nga ini.
english: Meanwhile, they continue to find out what these spirits really are.

text: Ining pagpanikasug nila ugaling nag-resulta sa nagakalain-lain nga pagkilala sa sining mga ispiritu – kon ano gid ang ila kaangtanan  sa tawo kag kon ano gid ang bagay nga pagpakita sang respeto kag pagyaub sa ila kagamhanan.
english: These efforts, however, resulted in different understandings of these spirits – what their relationship was to humans and what was appropriate to show respect and bow to their power.

text: Sa karon, ang pagkilala sang mga Kristiyano, nga sobra isa ka bilyon ang kadamo, sa ispiritu nga labaw gid sa tanan sa gahum amo ang Tagtuga (Creator) sang tanan nga makita kag indi makita nga mga tinuga, nga ginatawag man naton nga Diyos.
english: Today, Christians, who number over a billion, recognize the almighty spirit as the Creator of all visible and invisible beings, whom we also call God.

text: Sa Bibliya sang mga Kristiyano, kaupod sining Tagtuga sa ginsuguran ang mga ispirituhanon nga mga anghel nga halin mismo sa Iya ispirituhanon nga kaugalingon.
english: In the Christian Bible, this Creator was originally accompanied by spirit angels from His own spiritual self.

text: Ang iban ugaling nag-rebelde batok sa Diyos.
english: Others, however, rebelled against God.

text: Gani ginsikway Niya ini sila kag gintapok sa Impyerno, although gintugtan man sila nga tentaron ang tawo agud ma-testingan ang ila lealtad sa Diyos.
english: So He rejected them and threw them into Hell, although they were also allowed to tempt man to test their loyalty to God.

text: In fact, ang tawo mismo may pagka-ispirituhanon man.
english: In fact, man himself is also spiritual.

text: Ina tungod upod naton sa aton materyal nga lawas (matter) ang aton ispiritu, nga pwede man magbulagay kon bagay, katulad kon patay na ang lawas kag magbulag na ang kalag.
english: That's because our spirit is with us in our material body (matter), which can also separate if necessary, such as when the body dies and the soul separates.

text: Mabudlay mahangpan ining pag-isa sang lawas kag ispiritu sa sugid lang.
english: It is difficult to understand this union of body and spirit in a mere story.

text: Pero, pwede seguro kon mapaathag ini sa isa ka kahalimbawa nga hitabo.
english: However, it is possible to explain it with an example.

text: Pwede naton ini maathagan bisan paano paagi sa nadiskubrihan ni Albert Einstein nga formula, ang e=mc2.
english: We can explain it somehow with Albert Einstein’s discovered formula, e=mc2.

text: Sa sini nga formula, ginpakita ni Einstein nga ang materyal (matter) nga bagay, katulad sang uranium-235, indi basta matter lang, kundi may kasul-ob gali nga daku nga enerhiya (energy), nga kon tublagon mo (paagi sa nuclear fission)  makilala mo gid man ini lakip na ang iya pwersa, nga nagapadumdum sa aton sa atomic bomb nga ginhulog sadto sa Hiroshima, Japan.
english: In this formula, Einstein showed that matter, such as uranium-235, is not just matter, but contains a lot of energy, which if you disturb it (through nuclear fission) you can recognize it and its force, which reminds us of the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima, Japan.

text: Nagpatay ini sang mga 80,000 nga kabuhi sa isa lang ka lupok.
english: It killed about 80,000 lives with a single shot.

text: Sa ina nga “inseparable” nga pag-isa sang “matter and energy” tubtub magbulagay, masiling naton nga ang tawo indi lang gali dutan-on nga tinuga, kundi may kapid ini nga liwan nga kabuhi nga mas gamhanan pa sa iya dutan-on nga kinaiya.
english: In that “inseparable” unification of “matter and energy” until separation, we can say that man is not only an earthly creature, but he has a second life that is more powerful than his earthly nature.

text: Amo ini ang ispiritu, nga amo gid ang nagadala sang luyag kag indi luyag himuon sang tawo.
english: It is the spirit, which really brings about what man wants and does not want to do.

text: Kag, sa pagtaliwan sang lawas,  isahanon ini nga maga-atubang agud husgaran sang Hukmanan sang Langit.
english: And, when the body passes away, it will appear alone to be judged by the Court of Heaven.

text:
***

Time na seguro nga magtutok kita sa ginplano naton nga istorya ni Lolo Teban kag sang biyuda nga tamawo nga nasaysay na naton sa Part 1 sang aton kolum nga ginbalhag sadtong Hunyo 1, 2022 diri sa Panay News.
english:
***

It's time for us to focus on the story we planned of Lolo Teban and the widow tamawo that we told in Part 1 of our column published on June 1, 2022 here in Panay News.

text: Wala kita nagasiling nga matuod ining istorya ni Lolo Teban, bisan pa ginpatihan ini sang iya malapit nga pamilya sadtong buhi pa siya kaupod si Lola Felin kag 11 nila ka mga kabataan, kag pila man nga mga kaapohan.
english: We are not saying that this story of Lolo Teban is true, although his immediate family believed it when he was alive with Lola Felin and their 11 children, and several grandchildren.

text: Kon ginapatihan man nila ini, ina tungod kilala nila nga indi butigon si Lolo Teban kag, bisan sa edad sadto nga mga 70 anyos, nagapabilin nga maayo gihapon ang iya pamensaron.
english: If they believe this, it is because they know that Lolo Teban is not a liar and, even at the age of about 70 years, he still remains sane.

text: Wala kita personal nakakita sining mga tamawo, ukon makasaksi sang ano man nga ebidensya parti sining istorya ni Lolo Teban.
english: We have not personally seen these tamawo, nor have we witnessed any evidence of this story of Lolo Teban.

text: Gani indi pa kita makasiling kon matuod man ini ukon indi, ukon bisan posible man lang nga matuod ini.
english: So we can't say whether it's true or not, or even if it's possible that it's true.

text: Tricky kon kis-a ang  “perception” sang tawo sa iya nakita ukon nabatian nga pwede makahatag sing lain nga paghangop kon indi gid naton matul-id.
english: It's tricky sometimes a person's perception of what they see or hear can give a different understanding if we don't correct it.

text: Tungod sini, kamo na nga aton bumalasa ang maghusga kon mapatihan ukon indi ining istorya ni Lolo Teban kag sang biyuda nga tamawo.
english: Therefore, it is up to you, our readers, to judge whether or not to believe this story of Lolo Teban and the widow.

text: Bastante na seguro nga mabulong naton ang inyo “curiosity” sa ining istorya ni Lolo Teban nga tapuson na naton sa Part 3 sang pagsaysay naton sa Hunyo 15 nga isyu sang Panay News.
english: That's enough to cure your curiosity with this story of Lolo Teban that we will finish in Part 3 of our story in the June 15 issue of Panay News.

text: PAVIA, ILOILO – Bukas na ang Fab Cafe sa ground floor sang Plazuela Tres sa Pavia, Iloilo kasunod sang opening subong nga adlaw.
english: PAVIA, ILOILO – Fab Cafe on the ground floor of Plazuela Tres in Pavia, Iloilo is now open following the opening today.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joyce Gustilo Bernadas, tag-iya sang Fab Cafe, iya ginpahayag nga ang nasambit nga negosyo ang ginpatukod nila nga magpamilya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joyce Gustilo Bernadas, owner of Fab Cafe, said the business was started by their family.

text: Suno kay Bernadas, affordable ukon barato ang presyo sang ila ginabaligya nga hot and cold coffee, frappe, rice and silog meals, milk tea, pizza, siomai, siopao, nacho and tacos kag iban pa nga pagkaon.
english: According to Bernadas, the prices of hot and cold coffee, frappe, rice and silog meals, milk tea, pizza, siomai, siopao, nacho and tacos and other foods are affordable.

text:
Ginpahayag ni Bernadas nga bukas sa tagsa ka adlaw ang Fab Cafe humalin 9:00 sa aga tubtub 7:00 sa gab-i.

Ginpili sang natungdan nga magpahamtang sang negosyo sa Plazuela Tres bangud sa safe, maayo kag matinlo nga palibot.
english:
Bernadas said the Fab Cafe is open daily from 9:00 am to 7:00 pm.

He chose to set up his business in Plazuela Tres because of the safe, good and clean environment.

text: Ginsaysay sang isa ka Ilonggo nga former fire personnel ang iya nasaksihan nga trahedya sa Vancouver, Canada kadungan sang pagtilipon sang mga Pinoy para sa Lapu Lapu Day Festival.
english: An Ilonggo former fire personnel narrated the tragedy he witnessed in Vancouver, Canada during the gathering of Filipinos for the Lapu Lapu Day Festival.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Kenneth John Benedicto Leo, tumandok sang Pototan, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga tuman ka dasig sang mga hitabo kun sa diin nakabati sila sang pagsigabong nga amo na gali ang nagahagunos nga salakyan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Kenneth John Benedicto Leo, a native of Pototan, Iloilo, said the incident happened very quickly when they heard a burning sound that turned out to be a burning vehicle.

text: Madasig man nga naglinupad ang mga lawas sang mga tawo kag tanan nga nabungguan sang SUV sa lugar.
english: The bodies of the people and all those hit by the SUV also quickly flew to the scene.

text: Pahayag sini, natabuan nga nagkadto siya sa food truck pagkatapos sa last act sa concert sa festival, apang sang nakit-an sini ang tuman ka dasig nga salakyan, gilayon siya nga nakapahigad.
english: He said he happened to go to the food truck after the last act of the concert at the festival, but when he saw the speeding vehicle, he immediately pulled over.

text: Pananglitan ginkabos siya sang bisan tres segundos lang suno kay Leo, mahimo nga isa man siya sa nangin casualties.
english: If he had been poor for even three seconds, Leo said, he might have been one of the casualties.

text: Bangud sa iya training sa pagresponde sang miyembro pa ini sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) diri sa Pilipinas, nagbulig man ini sa area kun sa diin gin-abisuhan sini ang mga kaupod nga indi pag-guyudon ang mga biktima bangud sa posible bali sa ila lawas.
english: Due to his training in responding when he was a member of the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) here in the Philippines, he also helped in the area where he advised his colleagues not to drag the victims because of possible injuries to their bodies.

text: Wala siya sang dala nga first aid kit, gani nagbulig na lang ini kag iban nga mga Pilipino nga istoryahon ang mga biktima agud indi madulaan sang animo, i-stabilize ang liog, mag-check sang pulso, kag magtawag sa emergency number nga 911.
english: He did not bring a first aid kit, so he and other Filipinos helped talk to the victims so that they would not lose consciousness, stabilize their necks, check their pulses, and call the emergency number 911.

text: Pahayag sini, bisan nakaluwas siya, tuman ka traumatic ang amo nga insidente, kag madamo pa subong sa mga Pilipino ang yara gihapon sa state of shock.
english: He said that although he survived, the incident was very traumatic, and many Filipinos are still in a state of shock.

text: Base sa latest data sang pulis sa Vancouver, 11 ang patay kag masobra 20 ang pilason sa amo nga insidente.
english: According to the latest data from Vancouver police, 11 people were killed and more than 20 injured in the incident.

text: Nahingadlan naman ang 30-anyos nga suspek, napasakaan na sang murder charges, kag ginpahayag sang pulis nga may history sang mental health issues.
english: The 30-year-old suspect has been named, has been charged with murder, and police said he has a history of mental health issues.

text: Gin-athag sang awtoridad nga wala ini ginakabig nga isa ka akto sang terorismo.#
english: The authorities clarified that this is not considered an act of terrorism.

text: Iloilo City – Wala sang pinoy nga naulamid sa natabo nga massacre sa Star Ballroom dance studio sa Monterey Park sa California sa Amerika kadungan sang pagselebrar sang Lunar New Year.
english: ILOILO CITY – No Filipinos were involved in the massacre at the Star Ballroom dance studio in Monterey Park in California in the United States during the celebration of the Lunar New Year.

text: Ang suspek amo si i Huu Can Tran, 72, nga isa ka Asian-American National.
english: The suspect was identified as Huu Can Tran, 72, who is an Asian-American National.

text: Suno kay Bombo Charlie Badoles, International Correspondent sa California, 10 ang napatay on the spot, apang sa subong nagsaka na ini sa 11.
english: According to Bombo Charlie Badoles, International Correspondent in California, 10 people died on the spot, but now it has risen to 11.

text: Ginapahayag nga nakapalagyo ang gunman matapos ang krimen kag nagsulod pa gid sa ikaduha nga dance hall bag-o na-dis-armahan.
english: The gunman reportedly fled the scene after the crime and entered a second dance hall before being disarmed.

text: Nasapwan naman ang gunman nga wala na sang kabuhi sa sulod sang van sa Torrance, masobra 30 milya nga kalayuon nagikan sa Monterey Park.
english: The gunman was found dead inside a van in Torrance, more than 30 miles from Monterey Park.

text: Narekober ang lawas sang shooter sa isa ka wite van nga iya ginmaneho sa Torrance, kaiping nga lugar sang Monterey Park.
english: The shooter's body was recovered from a white van he was driving in Torrance, a neighboring area of ​​Monterey Park.

text: Ginakabig sang Californian police nga worst mass murders ang natabo nga insidente.
english: Californian police consider the incident the worst mass murders.

text: ILOILO CITY-Bukas na ang Pinkwork Spa and Salon sa ikaduha nga panalgan sang Plazuela Tres sa Plazuela de Iloilo sa Pavia, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO CITY-Pinkwork Spa and Salon is now open on the second floor of Plazuela Tres in Plazuela de Iloilo in Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Sharyn Berondo, Manager sang Pink Work, iya ginpahayag nga bukas sila umpisa las 10:00 sang aga tubtubtub las 7:00 sang gabi humalin Lunes tubtub Dominggo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Sharyn Berondo, Manager of Pink Work, said they are open from 10:00 am to 7:00 pm from Monday to Sunday.

text: Lakip sa ila serbisyo amo ang Hair services, Facial Treatment and Masks, Slimming, Eyebrow Tattoo ukon Microblading, Lip Tattoo, Eyelashes, BB Cream Semi Permanent, Laser Hair Removal, Underarm whitening, Nail services kag Gluthatione.
english: Their services include Hair services, Facial Treatment and Masks, Slimming, Eyebrow Tattoo or Microblading, Lip Tattoo, Eyelashes, BB Cream Semi Permanent, Laser Hair Removal, Underarm whitening, Nail services and Gluthatione.

text: Suno kay Berondo, magahatag sila sang 30 percent nga discount tubtub sa Enero 30, 2020 sa tanan nga mga services.
english: According to Berondo, they will give 30 percent discount until January 30, 2020 on all services.

text: ILOILO CITY- Strikto nga ipatuman sang Iloilo City Government pinaagi sa Business Permit and Licensing Office (BPLO) ang ultimatum nga gin- set sang alkalde sang syudad para sa renewal sang business permits.
english: ILOILO CITY- The Iloilo City Government through the Business Permit and Licensing Office (BPLO) will strictly implement the ultimatum set by the city mayor for the renewal of business permits.

text: Nahibaluan nga  tubtob sa Enero 20 ang ginhatag nga deadline para sa renewal sang business permits sa diin  naga-overtime pa ang nasambit nga talatapan kag bukas man kun Sabado kag Domingo.
english: The deadline for the renewal of business permits is January 20, where the office is still working overtime and is also open on Saturdays and Sundays.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga  wala sang extensions sang business permit renewals nga matabo bangud nga ginhatagan na sang bastante nga panahon  ang tanan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas said there will be no extensions of business permit renewals because everyone has been given enough time.

text: Sa tion nga maglampas na sa  ultimatum , ginpahayag sang alkalde nga  personal niya nga libuton ang tanan nga mga establishments kag negosyo  sa syudad kag lantawon niya kun compliant ang tanan agud indi bna masulit ang ginhimo sang Malabanan Siphoning Services nga naga-operate sa syudad nga wala sang business permit .
english: Once the ultimatum is exceeded, the mayor said he will personally visit all establishments and businesses in the city and see if everyone is compliant so that the actions of Malabanan Siphoning Services operating in the city without a business permit will not be repeated.

text: Sa tion nga may makita ini nga establishments nga wala nakapa- renew sang ila mga business permits, gilayon niya ini nga ipasirado.
english: When he finds establishments that have not renewed their business permits, he will immediately close them.

text: Nahimo nga trahedya ang isa kuntani ka malipayon nga graduation celebration matapos naaksidente ang bus sa Subang, Indonesia nga ginkamatay sang 11 ka mga tawo lakip na sang siyam ka mga estudyante.
english: A happy graduation celebration turned into a tragedy after a bus crashed in Subang, Indonesia, killing 11 people, including nine students.

text: Suno kay Bombo Ginavella Limpin Cumla, magluwas sa mga estudyante, may isa man ka maestra kag isa ka motorista nga napatay samtang pilason naman ang iban sa ila nga kaupdanan.
english: According to Bombo Ginavella Limpin Cumla, besides the students, a teacher and a motorist were also killed while others were injured.

text: Ini nga bus nga may 61 ka mga pasahero ang naghalin sa isa ka resort area sa Bandung kag pabalik na kuntani sa Depok, West Java suno sa otoridad.
english: The bus, which was carrying 61 passengers, was coming from a resort area in Bandung and was heading back to Depok, West Java, authorities said.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa rason sang insidente, apang sandig sa inisyal nga pagpangusisa sang West Java police, nadulaan sang kontrol ang amo nga bus sa dulhugon nga bahin sang area, sunod pa gid nga nagbunggo sa iban nga mga kotse kag motorsiklo antes pa ini nagbunggo sa isa pa gid ka poste.
english: The cause of the incident is still being investigated, but based on the initial investigation of the West Java police, the bus lost control in the bumpy part of the area, then collided with other cars and motorcycles before hitting another pole.

text: Pahayag pa sang West Java police commissioner, 18 ka mga operasyon ang ginpatigayon sa seryoso nga mga samad nga naangkon sang iban nga mga biktima.
english: The West Java police commissioner said 18 operations were conducted on the serious injuries sustained by other victims.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Mayo-Hunyo amo masami ang tion sa paghiwat sang end-of-school year activities kag ini nga trip sang highschool students ang kabahin sang ila nga farewell/celebration event.#
english: It is known that May-June is usually the time to hold end-of-school year activities and this trip of highschool students is part of their farewell/celebration event.

text: Nagsumiter na sang ila mga counter-affidavit sa National Police Commission (Napolcom) ang 12 ka aktibo nga miyembro sang Philippine National Police (PNP) nga ginaalegar nga may kaangtanan sa kontrobersyal nga kaso sang mga nadula nga manugbulang nga ginapahayag ginpangtagbong sa Taal Lake.
english: Twelve active members of the Philippine National Police (PNP) allegedly involved in the controversial case of missing fishermen who were allegedly thrown into Taal Lake have submitted their counter-affidavits to the National Police Commission (Napolcom).

text: Ini nga mga dokumento ginpasaka bilang sabat sa administratibo nga reklamo nga gin-file ni Julie Patidongan, nga mas kilala sa alyas nga “Totoy”, nga amo ang nagbulgar sang insidente.
english: These documents were filed in response to an administrative complaint filed by Julie Patidongan, better known by the alias “Totoy”, who exposed the incident.

text: Suno sa Napolcom, sang Hulyo 15, ginpatawag sang Inspection, Monitoring and Investigation Service (IMIS) ang mga ginatudlo nga pulis kag ginmanduan nga magsumiter sang ila sabat sulod sang lima ka adlaw.
english: According to Napolcom, on July 15, the Inspection, Monitoring and Investigation Service (IMIS) summoned the alleged police officers and ordered them to submit their response within five days.

text: Suno kay Napolcom Vice Chairman and Executive Officer Rafael Vicente Calinisan, pagatun-an na sang IMIS ang mga ginpasaka nga reklamo upod ang mga counter-affidavit sang mga respondent agud ma-assess ang kabug-usan nga kaso.
english: Napolcom Vice Chairman and Executive Officer Rafael Vicente Calinisan said the IMIS will study the complaints filed along with the counter-affidavits of the respondents to assess the overall case.

text: Wala pa sang ginpaguwa nga dugang nga detalye si Calinisan angot sa kaundan sang mga affidavit, apang iya ginpahayag nga ang kabug-usan sini lunsay mga pagpanginwala sang mga pulis nga naangot sa insidente.
english: Calinisan did not release further details on the contents of the affidavits, but he said they were all denials by the police in connection with the incident.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon kag ginahulat ang resulta sang evaluation sang Napolcom.
english: The investigation is ongoing and the results of Napolcom's evaluation are awaited.

text: Arestado sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy bust operation sang Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit (RPDEU) 6 ang apat ka ginaalegar nga durugista sa Fatima Subdivision, Barangay Sta Cruz, Arevalo, Iloilo City.
english: Four alleged drug pushers were arrested in a drug buy bust operation conducted by the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit (RPDEU) 6 in Fatima Subdivision, Barangay Sta Cruz, Arevalo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang main subject amo si alias Isboy, 49, residente sang amo nga barangay.
english: The main subject is alias Isboy, 49, resident of the said barangay.

text: Arestado man ang duha ka kaangay niya nga high-value individuals nga sanday Alyas Reniel, 26, kag Alyas Jerson, 27, lunsay residente sang Barangay Sooc sa amo nga distrito.
english: Two other high-value individuals, Alyas Reniel, 26, and Alyas Jerson, 27, both residents of Barangay Sooc in the same district, were also arrested.

text: Nadakpan man si Alyas Sherwin, 45-anyos, street level individual, kag residente sang Zone 13, Brgy.
english: Also arrested was Sherwin, 45, street level individual, and resident of Zone 13, Brgy.

text: Calaparan sa amo gihapon nga district.
english: Calaparan in the same district.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Glenn Soliman, officer-in-charge sang RPDEU 6, iya ginpahayag nga naglab-ot sa malapit isa ka bulan ang monitoring sa mga subject.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Glenn Soliman, officer-in-charge of RPDEU 6, said the monitoring of the subjects lasted for nearly a month.

text: May ginpang-buyagyag naman ang mga ini nga pangalan sang ila ginakuhaan sang illegal nga droga apang gina-verify pa ini sang mga kapulisan.
english: They have revealed the names of their sources of illegal drugs but the police are still verifying them.

text: Base naman sa imbestigasyon sang kapulisan nakaagi na preso si Alyas Isboy bangud man sa involvement sa iligal nga droga.
english: According to police investigation, Isboy has been jailed for involvement in illegal drugs.

text: Natigayon makuha sa ila posisyon ang 225 grams sang suspected shabu nga may standard drug price nga P1,530,000.
english: Recovered from their possession were 225 grams of suspected shabu with a standard drug price of P1,530,000.

text: Yara na sila sa kustodiya sang Iloilo City Police Station 6 kag possible nga magapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: They are now in the custody of Iloilo City Police Station 6 and may face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)
english: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)

text: ILOILO CITY – Yara sa steady trajectory ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas sa pihak sang pagpanghangkat nga ginpangatubang sang pungsod subong nga 2019.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Philippine economy is on a steady trajectory despite the challenges the country faced in 2019.

text: Sa Good Morning Philippines Program, ginpahayag ni Rey Emmanuel Echaveria, economic specialist, nga nagnubo ang inflation rate kag madamu ang mga proyekto nga ginapatuman.
english: In the Good Morning Philippines Program, Rey Emmanuel Echaveria, economic specialist, said that the inflation rate has decreased and many projects are being implemented.

text: Suno kay Echaveria, nagdamu man ang pamilya nga nakatibawas sa kapigaduhon apang kinahanglan nga mapabilin sang gobyerno nga manubo ang poverty rate kag ang inflation rate agud nga mapa-uswag ang ekonomiya.
english: According to Echaveria, the number of families who have escaped poverty has also increased but the government needs to keep the poverty rate and inflation rate low in order to improve the economy.

text: Ginpahayag ni Echaveria nga isa man sa dapat tun-an amo ang mga ginapatuman nga programa kasubong sang modernization program nga may yara sang bentaha kag disbentaha.
english: Echaveria said that one of the things that should be studied is the implementation of programs such as the modernization program which has advantages and disadvantages.

text: Sa pihak sini, indi lamang ang mga problema sa pungsod ang nagaapekto sa ekonomiya kundi lakip man ang nagakatabo sa iban nga pungsod ilabi na sa patag sang trading kasubong sang economic war sa tunga sang Estados Unidos kag China lakip man ang Brexit ukon ang pagbulag sang United Kingdom sa European Union.
english: Meanwhile, not only the problems in the country are affecting the economy but also what is happening in other countries especially in the field of trade such as the economic war between the United States and China as well as Brexit or the separation of the United Kingdom from the European Union.

text: Wala man ini sang direkta nga epekto apang mahimo nga mangin colateral ang pungsod ilabi pa kun ang economic war ang nagakatabo sa ally country sang Pilipinas.
english: This does not have a direct impact but the country can become a collateral especially if the economic war is happening with the ally country of the Philippines.

text: Sa 2020, ginpahayag ni Echaveria nga matapos na ang mga ongoing projects apang lauman man nga yara sa gihapon ang mga problema.
english: By 2020, Echaveria said the ongoing projects will be completed but it is expected that there will still be problems.

text: Agud nga mapasigurado nga estable ang ekonomiya sang pungsod, mas makapaayo nga may yara sang perfectionist government kag tutukan ang domestic trading.
english: In order to ensure the country's economy is stable, it is better to have a perfectionist government and focus on domestic trade.

text: Magluwas diri, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga indi man pagkalimtan ang pag-angkon sang business relations sa iban nga pungsod.
english: Besides, he said that he should not forget to have business relations with other countries.

text: Ginkakas sang Meta ang 20 ka mga facebook pages sang mga Filipino influencer nga ginapahayag naga-promote sang illegal online gambling, matapos ang ginhinyo nga aksyon sang Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC).
english: Meta has removed 20 facebook pages of Filipino influencers allegedly promoting illegal online gambling, following the requested action of the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC).

text: Ginkumpirma sang grupo nga pang-advocacy nga Digital Pinoys, nga nag-flag sa mga pages nga ini sa CICC, ang pagkakas diri.
english: The advocacy group Digital Pinoys, which flagged these pages to the CICC, confirmed the removal.

text: Kalakip sa mga apektado ang mga influencer nga sanday Sachzna Laparan nga may 9.7 ka milyon nga followers, Boy Tapang nga may 5.5 ka milyon nga followers, aktor nga si Mark Anthony Fernandez nga may 242,000 followers, kag Kuya Lex TV nga may 100,000 followers.
english: Among those affected are influencers Sachzna Laparan with 9.7 million followers, Boy Tapang with 5.5 million followers, actor Mark Anthony Fernandez with 242,000 followers, and Kuya Lex TV with 100,000 followers.

text: Ginsiling ni Ronald Gustilo, ang National Campaigner sang Digital Pinoys, nga ang amo nga tikang ang nagapadala sang matibang nga mensahe sa mga naglapas.
english: Ronald Gustilo, the National Campaigner of Digital Pinoys, said the move sends a strong message to violators.

text: Wala pa sang pahayag nagikan sa Meta hanungod diri.
english: There is no statement from Meta on this.

text: Ang pagtanggal sang mga pages ang kabahin sang mga pagtinguha nga tapnaon ang mga iligal nga aktibidad online, labi na ang mga operasyon sang pagsugal nga nagalapas sa layi sang Pilipinas.
english: The removal of the pages is part of efforts to curb illegal activities online, especially gambling operations that violate Philippine law.

text: Ginpahayag sang CICC kag Digital Pinoys nga ini ang una nga batch sang mga pagkakas, kag nagpaandam nga may mga masunod pa nga aksyon batok sa mga violators.
english: CICC and Digital Pinoys said this is the first batch of removals, and warned that there will be more actions against violators.

text: Gindugang ang 37 ka Chinese entities sa trade blacklist sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika bangud sa national security concerns.
english: Thirty-seven Chinese entities have been added to the trade blacklist of the United States of America due to national security concerns.

text: 11 sa sini nga numero ang gin-akusahan nga naangot sa ginasuspetsahan nga spy balloon nga ginpalupad sa sensitive areas sang United States sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: 11 of this number were accused of being linked to a suspected spy balloon flown over sensitive areas of the United States last year.

text: Ginadumilian sila nga makig-negosyo sa iban nga US firms kag dapat anay nga magkuha sang Commerce Department approval antes makabaton sang goods kag technologies halin sa amo nga nasyon.
english: They are prohibited from doing business with other US firms and must first obtain Commerce Department approval before receiving goods and technologies from that country.

text: Ini nga entities ang nagalakip sa mga kumpaniya kag research institutions.
english: These entities include companies and research institutions.

text: Sa 37 entities, 22 ang naangot sa tikang sang China nga i-improve ang quantum technology kag pag-angkon sang US-origin items agud mapasangkad pa ang quantum capabilities sang ila pungsod.
english: Of the 37 entities, 22 are linked to China's move to improve quantum technology and acquire US-origin items to further expand its country's quantum capabilities.

text: Ang iban sa ila ang naangot man sa advancements sa nuclear programs sang China ukon na-involve sa export sang controlled items sa Russia kasunod sang gyera sa Ukraine.
english: Some of them are also linked to advancements in China's nuclear programs or involved in the export of controlled items to Russia following the war in Ukraine.

text: “Today’s action is another decisive step in addressing challenges posed by the People’s Republic of China and its military modernization,” suno sa statement ni Undersecretary of Commerce for Industry and Security Alan Estevez.
english: “Today’s action is another decisive step in addressing challenges posed by the People’s Republic of China and its military modernization,” according to the statement by Undersecretary of Commerce for Industry and Security Alan Estevez.

text: Dapat suno sa iya nga magpabilin nga vigilante ang Amerika kag balabagan ang mga entities nga maka-access sa teknolohiya sang US nga pwede man magamit kontra sa ila nga national security.
english: He said the United States should remain vigilant and prevent entities from accessing US technology that could be used against their national security.

text: Matandaan nga Pebrero sang nagligad nga tuig sang na-detect sa teritoryo sang Amerika ang isa ka daku nga balloon nga gindudahan nga espiya.
english: It can be recalled that in February last year, a large balloon suspected of being a spy was detected on American territory.

text: Ang amo nga insidente ang nangin flashpoint sa tunga sang US kag China rason nga sang amo nga tion, gin-postpone gid ang byahe kuntani ni US Secretary of State Antony Blinken sa Beijing.#
english: The incident became a flashpoint between the US and China, which led to the postponement of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's trip to Beijing.

text: Nagapati si Most Rev.
english: Most Rev. Fr.

text: Midyphil B. Billones D.D., Archbishop sang Archdiocese of Jaro nga ang Espirito Santo ukon Holy Spirit gid lang ang makapili sang masunod nga Santo Papa kag mangin masunod nga Spiritual Leader.
english: Midyphil B. Billones D.D., Archbishop of the Archdiocese of Jaro said that only the Holy Spirit can choose the next Pope and become the next Spiritual Leader.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Most Rev.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Most Rev.

text: Billones, iya ginpahayag nga gabuylog sila sa kasubo sang Universal Church sang Roman Catholic, sa dalayon nga kapahuwayan ni Pope Francis, apang nagapati ini nga ang ini nga kasubo ang buslan sang Easter Hope.
english: Billones, he said they join the grief of the Universal Church of the Roman Catholic Church, in the eternal rest of Pope Francis, but he believes that this grief will be replaced by Easter Hope.

text: Suno pa sa iya, may yara sang kasubo apang may pagpasalamat kay mabalik na ang Santo Papa sa kaharian sang Ginoo.
english: He said there is sadness but gratitude because the Pope will return to the kingdom of God.

text: Dugang ni Billones nga kun istoryahan ang legasiya nga ginbilin sang Santo Papa, madamo ini sang ginbilin.
english: Billones added that when it comes to the legacy left by the Pope, he left a lot.

text: Ginlaraway sini nga “It rings the bell” ang tinaga kag aktwasyon sang “Mercy” nga ginpakita ni Pope Francis.
english: He described the word and action of “Mercy” shown by Pope Francis as “It rings the bell”.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga isa sa dako nga ginhimo sang Santo Papa amo ang mapalapit sa tawo ang Simbahan Katolika.
english: He also said that one of the great things that the Pope has done is to bring the Catholic Church closer to the people.

text: Samtang, dako naman nga pagpanghangkat sa mga Ilonggo nga tumuluo nga ipabilin sa ila kinabuhi ang espritwal nga koneksyon nga ginbilin ni Pope Francis nga mahimo ikabuhi tubtob sa walay-kataposan.
english: Meanwhile, it is a great challenge for Ilonggo believers to maintain in their lives the spiritual connection left by Pope Francis that can be lived forever.

text: Naghatag man sang mensahe ang Arsobispo para sa palaabuton nga May 2025 National and Local Election, nga indi lang bilang botante, bilang Pilipino nga magboto sang may prinsipyo, act of faith, kag righteousness.
english: The Archbishop also gave a message for the upcoming May 2025 National and Local Election, not only as voters, but as Filipinos to vote with principle, act of faith, and righteousness.

text: Suno sa iya, madamo sang pagpanghangkat apang magboto santo sa konsensya.
english: He said there are many challenges but vote according to conscience.

text: Samtang mensahe sini sa mga kandidato, magsunod sa espirito sang kalinong kag hustisya.
english: Meanwhile, his message to the candidates is to follow the spirit of peace and justice.

text: Ginpabutyag ni Senador Sherwin Gatchalian nga ang nagadamo nga online lending apps sa Pilipinas amo pa ang nagapalala sang problema sa online gambling sa pungsod.
english: Senator Sherwin Gatchalian said the increasing number of online lending apps in the Philippines is exacerbating the problem of online gambling in the country.

text: Suno sa senador, madamo na nga mga Pilipino ang nalulong sa online gambling, kag ginapangabuso pa sang pila ka mga lending apps.
english: According to the senator, many Filipinos are already addicted to online gambling, and are still being abused by some lending apps.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga ang mabug-at kag masami mapang-abuso nga mga kondisyon sang pautang amo ang nagaduso sa mga tawo nga magpadayon sa utang agud lamang may magamit sa pagsugal.
english: He stated that onerous and often abusive loan terms are pushing people to persist in debt just to have something to gamble with.

text: Dugang pa niya, pagpang-harass nga pagpanukot sang pila ka lending apps nagadugang pa gid sang emosyonal kag mental nga kabudlayan sang mga nalulong na sa bisyo sang online gambling.
english: He added that harassing charges by some lending apps add to the emotional and mental difficulties of those who are already addicted to online gambling.

text: Ginapanawagan sang senador nga dapat tutukan ini nga isyu agud maprotektahan ang mga Pilipino batok sa doble nga problema ang sugal kag ang abusado nga pangutang online.
english: The senator called for a focus on this issue to protect Filipinos against the double problem of gambling and abusive online lending.

text: PAVIA, ILOILO- Ginpanginbulahan sang mga opisyal sang Probinsya sang Iloilo ang Florete Group of Companies sa pagpatukod sang Plazuela Tres sa Pavia Iloilo.
english: PAVIA, ILOILO- Officials of the Province of Iloilo congratulated the Florete Group of Companies for the construction of Plazuela Tres in Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Suno kay Pavia Iloilo Mayor Luigi Gorriceta, pinaagi sa Plazuela Tres, madamo sang mahatagan sang trabaho ilabi na nga mataas subong ang unemployment rate.
english: According to Pavia Iloilo Mayor Luigi Gorriceta, through Plazuela Tres, many people will be given jobs especially now that the unemployment rate is high.

text: Ginpahayag ni Gorriceta nga magahatag sang discounts kag incentives ang local government sang Pavia sa Plazuela Tres.
english: Gorriceta said the local government of Pavia will provide discounts and incentives in Plazuela Tres.

text: Ginpasigurado man ni Gorriceta nga nga mapabilin ang kalinong sa Pavia ilabi na nga nagadamo na subong ang negosyo.
english: Gorriceta also assured that peace will be maintained in Pavia especially as business is increasing.

text: Magluwas sini, tinguhaan man sini nga mapa semento ang tanan nga mga dalan sa nasambit nga banwa agud nga mas mangin mahapos ang paglabay sang mga salakyan padulong sa Plazuela Tres.
english: Besides, he will also try to cement all the roads in the said town so that it will be easier for vehicles to pass to Plazuela Tres.

text: Samtang suno naman kay Iloilo Gov Arthur Defensor Jr., ang investment sang Florete Group of Companies ang dako nga bulig sa Probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Meanwhile, Iloilo Gov. Arthur Defensor Jr. said the investment of the Florete Group of Companies is a big help to the Province of Iloilo.

text: Suno kay Defensor, duha lang ka sahi sang mga pumuluyo ang masami nga nagapadulong sa iya opisina.
english: According to Defensor, only two types of residents often come to his office.

text: Una ang mga barangay officials nga nagapangayo sang proyekto kag mga nagapangayo sang trabaho.
english: First are the barangay officials who are asking for projects and those who are asking for jobs.

text: Pinaagi sa pagbukas sang Plazuela Tres suno kay Defensor, mahatagan sang trabaho ang mga pumuluyo.
english: By opening Plazuela Tres, Defensor said, the residents will be given jobs.

text: Samtang suno sa gobernador, isa ka patimaan nga naga uswag ang ekonomiya amo ang pagdamo sang mga bangko kaangay na lang sang Queen City Rural Bank.
english: Meanwhile, the governor said a sign that the economy is growing is the increase in the number of banks such as the Queen City Rural Bank.

text: Kun ang tawo halos mapatay sa kakulba sa tion nga ma-trap sa balay kun may baha, amo man sini ang nabatyagan sang mga sapat.
english: If humans almost die of shock when trapped in a house during a flood, animals feel the same way.

text: Amo ini ang sitwasyon sa Brazil kun sa diin pila ka adlaw na nga lapnagon ang baha, linibo ang nagbakwit, masobra 100 ka tawo ang patay, kag masobra man 100 ang missing.
english: This is the situation in Brazil where floods have been raging for days, thousands have been evacuated, more than 100 people have died, and more than 100 are missing.

text: Isa sa nakaagaw sang atensyon sang tanan amo ang isa ka kabayo nga makaluluoy ang sitwasyon bangud isahanon ini nga nagatindog sa atop kun sa diin nagalumapaw ang tubig-baha.
english: One of the things that caught everyone's attention was a horse that was in a miserable condition because it was standing alone on the roof where the flood waters were overflowing.

text: Ginpahayag nga duha ka adlaw na nga amo sini ang iya posisyon sa rooftop sang farmhouse sa Canoas sa southern Brazil.
english: He had reportedly been in this position on the rooftop of a farmhouse in Canoas in southern Brazil for two days.

text: Mangin ang mayor sang banwa ang nagpanawagan man sa otoridad nga luwason ang sapat antes ini mahulog sa iya ginatindugan.
english: Even the mayor of the town called on the authorities to rescue the animal before it fell from his stand.

text: Sa pagbuligay sang volunteer rescuers kag army vets, nabuligan ang kabayo kag nasaylo sa Zodiac inflatable boat agud nga madala ini sa hilway nga lugar.
english: With the help of volunteer rescuers and army vets, the horse was rescued and transferred to a Zodiac inflatable boat to be taken to safety.

text: Nahibaluan nga halos suba na subong ang sitwasyon sa mga dalan sa Rio Grande do Sul kag masobra naman sa 164,000 ka mga residente ang na-displace bangud sa mabaskog nga pag-ulan nga gina-forecast nga magalawig pa sa masunod nga mga inadlaw.#
english: More than 164,000 residents have been displaced due to heavy rains that are forecast to last in the coming days.

text: Mahigpit na mino-monito ng Department of Science and Technology (DOST) ang dalawang low pressure area (LPA) na nasa loob ng Philippine area of responsibility (PAR).
english: The Department of Science and Technology (DOST) is closely monitoring the two low pressure areas (LPAs) within the Philippine area of ​​responsibility (PAR).

text: Ayon sa state weather bureau, namataan ang sentro ng unang LPA sa layong 1,220 km sa silangan timog silangan ng Luzon.
english: According to the state weather bureau, the center of the first LPA was located 1,220 km southeast of Luzon.

text: Habang ang pangalawa ay nasa 405 km sa silangan ng Calayan, Cagayan.
english: The second is located 405 km east of Calayan, Cagayan.

text: Ang dalawang ito ay may malaking tyansa na lumakas bilang ganap na bagyo.
english: These two have a high chance of intensifying as a full-fledged hurricane.

text: Kung sakaling aabot sa tropical depression category, tatawagin itong “Dante” at “Emong” na magiging ika-apat at ikalimang sama ng panahon para sa taong 2025.
english: If it reaches the tropical depression category, it will be called “Dante” and “Emong” which will be the fourth and fifth extreme weather for the year 2025.

text: Maliban dito, asahan din ang patuloy na pag-iral ng hanging habagat na magdadala ng mga pag-ulan at baha sa malaking parte ng ating bansa.
english: In addition, the southerly winds are expected to continue to prevail which will bring rains and floods in most parts of our country.

text: Napuno sang mga tawo ang dalan halin sa St.
english: People filled the street from St.

text: Peter’s Square sa Vatican City padulong sa St.
english: Peter’s Square in Vatican City to St.

text: Mary Major Basilica kadungan sang pagdala sang bangkay ni Pope Francis sa iya katapusan nga palahuwayan.
english: Mary Major Basilica during the funeral of Pope Francis.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Fr.

text: Gregory Gaston, Rector sang Pontificio Collegio Filippino, iya ginpahayag nga linibo ka mga tawo ang naghatag sang katapusan nga pagtahod sa nagtaliwan nga lider sang Simbahan Katoliko nga si Pope Francis sa sulod sang tatlo ka adlaw nga public viewing sa St.
english: Gregory Gaston, Rector of the Pontifical Collegio Filippino, said thousands of people paid their last respects to the late Catholic Church leader Pope Francis during a three-day public viewing at St.

text: Peter’s Basilica sa Vatican City sa Rome, Italy.
english: Peter’s Basilica in Vatican City in Rome, Italy.

text: Suno kay Fr.
english: According to Fr.

text: Gaston, halin sa mga katoliko nga tumuluo gikan sa nagkalain-lain nga pungsod tubtob sa mga lideres sang simbahan kag pulitika, nagtambong sa pinakaulihi nga misa para sa Santo Papa.
english: Gaston, from catholic faithful from various countries to church and political leaders, attended the latest mass for the Pope.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga opisyal nga ginsirado ang lungon sang Santo Papa sa liturgical rites antes ginpatigayon ang state funeral sa St.
english: He also officially said that the Pope's coffin was closed in liturgical rites before the state funeral was held at St.

text: Peter’s Square kag paglubong sa bangkay sini sa basilica saguwa sang Vatican.
english: Peter's Square and burial of his body in the basilica outside the Vatican.

text: Nahibaluan nga yara sa 200,000 ka tawo ang nagtipon sa St.
english: It is known that about 200,000 people gathered in St.

text: Peter’s Square kag tubtob sa 300,000 pa gid sa ruta nga gin-agyan sang bangkay sang nagtaliwan nga Santo Papa.
english: Peter's Square and up to 300,000 more along the route taken by the late Pope's body.

text: Ginapaminsaran na ni Atty. Harry Roque nga magpauli na lamang sa Pilipinas kag atubangon ang kaso.
english: Atty. is already considering. Harry Roque to return to the Philippines and face the case.

text: Ginsiling sini nga handa na siya nga atubangon kag batuan si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: He said he is ready to face and fight President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: apisar ini ang nakapreso.
english: despite being in prison.

text: Suno sa iya, indi na niya makaya ang nagapanghinitabo nga anomaliya sa administrasyong Marcos.
english: He said he can no longer tolerate the anomalies in the Marcos administration.

text: Matandaan nga yara sagihapon si Roques sa The Netherlands kun sa diin nag-file ini sang asylum.
english: Roques is still in The Netherlands where he has filed for asylum.

text: Ginkalaro ma niya nga wala ini sang sala nga may kaantanan sa Offshore gaming sa Pampanga.
english: He also claimed that he had nothing to do with offshore gaming in Pampanga.

text:
Lalaki, nagpangsulod sa 1,000 ka mga balay agud makuha ang iya ‘stress’

Samtang kita naga-amat-amat edad, amat-amat man nga nagasalampaw ang aton mga katungdanan, problema, balayran, kalain sang buot, kag iban pa gid rason nga masami man kita nga nagaka-kapoy kag nagainit ang ulo.
english:
Man breaks into 1,000 homes to relieve stress

As we get older, our responsibilities, problems, bills, resentment, and other factors gradually increase, causing us to become tired and irritable.

text: Lain-lain man ang aton paagi nga maka-cope.
english: We also have different ways of coping.

text: Importante gid ang pag-destress bangud para man ina sa pagpabilin sang maayo nga mental health.
english: Destressing is very important because it is also for maintaining good mental health.

text: Ikaw, ano bala ang imo ginahimo sa tion nga stressed ikaw?
english: What do you do when you're stressed?

text: Sa Japan, may isa ka 37-anyos nga lalaki nga gin-aresto ang mga pulis bangud sa trespassing sa propiedad sa Dazaifu sa southern part sang pungsod.
english: In Japan, a 37-year-old man was arrested by police for trespassing on property in Dazaifu in the southern part of the country.

text: Sang yara na ini sa kustodiya sang otoridad kag sa dalayon nga pagpamangkot, nag-ako ang lalaki nga indi ini ang una nga propiedad nga iya ginsulod.
english: Once in law enforcement custody and upon constant questioning, the man admitted this was not the first property he had entered.

text: Pahayag sini, nagalab-ot na siguro sa 1,000 ka mga balay ang iya ginpangsulod-sulod kag ginhimo na niya ini nga hobby.
english: He said he has probably broken into 1,000 houses and has made it a hobby.

text: Suno pa sa lalaki, nagabatyag siya sang tuman nga thrill ukon excitement sa tion nga panumdumon niya kun madakpan ayhan siya ukon indi.
english: According to the man, he feels a lot of thrill or excitement when he thinks about whether he will be caught or not.

text: Sa sobra niya ka-excited, nagapalmahas gid ang iya nga palad, kag amo gid ini suno sa iya ang manami nga feeling.
english: He was so excited that his palm was sweating, and he said that was the best feeling.

text: Amo man ini suno sa iya ang iya paagi agud ma-relieve ang iya stress!
english: He said it was also his way to relieve his stress!

text: Bangud sini nga hobby, nagtupa siya sa kamot sang otoridad kag ginahulat pa kun ano nga mga kaso ang posible sini pangatubangon.
english: Because of this hobby, he fell into the hands of the authorities and is still waiting for what cases he may face.

text: Masobra na sa 2,000 ka mga tawo ang nagkalamatay sa tunga sang lapnagon nga hublag-protesta sa Iran.
english: More than 2,000 people have been killed amid widespread protests in Iran.

text: Sandig ini sa US-based nga Human Rights Activists News Agency.
english: This is according to the US-based Human Rights Activists News Agency.

text: Sa numero nga ini suno sa grupo, 1,850 ang protesters, 135 ang affiliated sa gobyerno, kag siyam ang mga nadalahig lang nga mga sibilyan.
english: Of these, the group said, 1,850 were protesters, 135 were affiliated with the government, and nine were civilians involved.

text:
Ginkumpirma man sang isa ka Iranian official nga 2,000 ka mga tawo ang napatay, apang iya ini ginbasol sa mga “terorista.”

Nagpanawagan naman si US President Donald Trump sa mga taga-Iran nga magpadayon sa pag-protesta.
english:
An Iranian official also confirmed that 2,000 people were killed, but he blamed it on “terrorists.”

US President Donald Trump has called on Iranians to continue protesting.

text: Sa iya latest social media post, nagpahayag si Trump nga manug-abot na ang bulig sang Estados Unidos.
english: In his latest social media post, Trump said US aid is on the way.

text: Una na ini nga nagpaandam nga magabayad ang Iranian authorities sa ila pagpamatay.
english: He had previously warned that the Iranian authorities would pay for their killings.

text: Magasapol ang iya national security team sa White House agud nga ma-istoryahan ang iya mga opsyon agud nga intrahan ang daku nga gamo sa amo nga Islamic Republic.
english: His national security team will meet at the White House to discuss his options to intervene in the massive conflict in the Islamic Republic.

text: Una naman nga nag-anunsyo ang US president sang 25% nga taripa sa mga pungsod nga may trading sa Iran.
english: Earlier, the US president announced a 25% tariff on countries that trade with Iran.

text: Na-mensyonar man sini nga posibilidad sang military action — gyera nga suno sa Iran, handa sila kag indi nila pag-atrasan.
english: It also mentioned the possibility of military action — a war that Iran says it is ready for and will not back down from.

text: Nagsugod ang protesta sa Iran sang Disyembre 28 sang naakig ang mga tawo bangud sang pagluya sang balor sang Iranian currency nga rial batok sa US Dollar sa Open Market.
english: The protests in Iran began on December 28 when people were angered by the depreciation of the Iranian currency the rial against the US Dollar on the Open Market.

text: Nagsarurot ang rial sa record low sang nagligad nga tuig, kag nagpanglakaak naman ang inflation sa 40% nga nagresulta sa pagsaka sang presyo sa adlaw-adlaw nga kinahanglanon kaangay sang cooking oil kag karne.
english: The rial fell to a record low last year, and inflation soared to 40%, resulting in rising prices for daily necessities such as cooking oil and meat.

text: Sunod man nga nag-intra ang mga estudyante sa demonstrasyon.
english: Students also joined the demonstration next.

text: Madamo ang nagpanawagan sa pagbag-o sa pulitika.
english: Many called for political change.

text: Lakip sa ginasinggit sang iban amo ang pagpamatok sa Supreme Leader sang pungsod.
english: Among the slogans of others is opposition to the country's Supreme Leader.

text: Sandig sa US-based Iranian Human Rights Activists News Agency, naglapta na ang demonstrasyon sa 186 ka mga syudad kag banwa sa 31 ka mga probinsya sang pungsod.#
english: According to the US-based Iranian Human Rights Activists News Agency, the demonstrations have spread to 186 cities and towns in 31 provinces of the country.

text: Muling pinahanga ng batang Pinay triathlete na si Kira Ellis ang mundo ng sports matapos niyang dominahin ang Junior Women’s category ng 2025 Europe Triathlon Cup sa Riga, Latvia nitong weekend.
english: Young Filipino triathlete Kira Ellis once again impressed the world of sports after dominating the Junior Women's category of the 2025 Europe Triathlon Cup in Riga, Latvia this weekend.

text: Sa kabila ng pagiging kaisa-isang Pilipina at Asyana sa kompetisyon, ipinamalas ni Ellis, 18, ang kanyang husay matapos magtala ng kabuuang oras na 1:05:07 sa 750-meter swim, 22-kilometer bike, at 5.1-kilometer run, sapat upang talunin ang 15 iba pang international contenders.
english: Despite being the only Filipina and Asian in the competition, Ellis, 18, showed off her performance after recording a total time of 1:05:07 in the 750-meter swim, 22-kilometer bike, and 5.1-kilometer run, enough to beat 15 other international contenders.

text: Naitala si Ellis ng 12:09 sa swim, 34:27 sa bike, at 17:36 sa run, na nagpatibay ng kanyang panalo sa isa sa pinakamalaking triathlon meet sa Europa para sa junior level.
english: Ellis recorded 12:09 in the swim, 34:27 in the bike, and 17:36 in the run, which solidified his victory in one of the biggest triathlon meets in Europe for the junior level.

text: Lalong kahanga-hanga ang tagumpay na ito lalo’t kagagaling lamang niya sa anim na buwang pahinga dahil sa shin splints o medial tibial stress syndrome.
