english: This achievement is especially impressive especially since he has only recovered from a six-month break due to shin splints or medial tibial stress syndrome.

text: Dagdag ang panalo sa kanyang koleksyon ng mga titulo gaya ng 2024 Asia Triathlon Junior Cup gold medal sa Malaysia at SEA Games gold medal noong 2023 sa Cambodia bilang bahagi ng mixed team relay.
english: The victory added to his collection of titles such as the 2024 Asia Triathlon Junior Cup gold medal in Malaysia and the SEA Games gold medal in 2023 in Cambodia as part of the mixed team relay.

text: Kasalukuyang freshman si Ellis sa Queens University of Charlotte sa Amerika, at inaasahang magiging pangunahing pambato ng Pilipinas sa darating na 2025 SEA Games sa Thailand ngayong Disyembre.
english: Ellis is currently a freshman at Queens University of Charlotte in the United States, and is expected to be the Philippines' main competitor in the upcoming 2025 SEA Games in Thailand this December.

text: Samantala, pumangalawa si Germany’s Walter Sarah sa oras na 1:05:22, habang pumangatlo naman si Belgium’s Luca Vanderbruggen na nagtala ng 1:05:17.
english: Meanwhile, Germany's Walter Sarah finished second in 1:05:22, while Belgium's Luca Vanderbruggen came third with a time of 1:05:17.

text: Ginakabig nga ‘alarming’ sang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) ang nakumpiskar nga P74.87 million nga balor sang ilegal nga droga sa bug-os nga Western Visayas sa bulan lang sang Pebrero subong nga 2026.
english: The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) considers the seizure of P74.87 million worth of illegal drugs in Western Visayas in February 2026 alone as 'alarming'

text: Base sa datos sang PRO6, ang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) amo ang nakarecord sang pinakadako nga nakumpiskar nga droga, matapos nga naglab-ot sa P46.1 million nga balor sang illegal drugs ang narecover sang ila nga mga kapulisan.
english: Based on PRO6 data, the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) recorded the largest drug seizure, after their police recovered P46.1 million worth of illegal drugs.

text: Suno kay PBGEN.
english: According to PBGEN.

text: Josefino Ligan, Regional Director sang PRO6, bangud sa mataas nga numero sang nakumpiskar nga droga kun sa diin may ara man sang mga involved nga mga barangay officials, ginkabig gid nila ini nga seryoso nga sitwasyon.
english: Josefino Ligan, Regional Director of PRO6, said that due to the high number of drugs seized where there are also involved barangay officials, they considered this a serious situation.

text: Pahayag niya, base sa mga ginpatigayon nga imbestigasyon, halin mismo sa National Capital Region ang mga nagaabot nga droga sa Western Visayas.
english: He said based on the investigation conducted, the drugs coming to Western Visayas come from the National Capital Region.

text: Dugang pa ni Ligan agud nga masiguro nga wala sang magalab-ot pa nga droga sa rehiyon, magapadayun ang ila hugot nga pagbantay sa bulig man sang ila partner agencies sa mga area sang Western Visayasagud nga matumod ang mga posible ginaagyan ukon mga pamaagi nga makasulod ang illegal nga droga.
english: Ligan added that in order to ensure that no more drugs reach the region, they will continue their strict surveillance with the help of their partner agencies in the areas of Western Visayas to identify possible routes or ways for illegal drugs to enter.

text: Madamo sa aton ang indi katulog kun wala sang electric fan.
english: Many of us can't sleep without an electric fan.

text: Iban gusto nga nakasteady pa sa ila ang electric fan kun sila ang nagakatulog.
english: Others like to have the electric fan steady on them when they are sleeping.

text: Apang, base sa mga eksperto may pila ka mga indi manami nga epekto ang ‘steady’ nga pagpaandar sang electric fan kun nagatulog ang isa ka tawo.
english: However, according to experts, there are some negative effects of steady operation of an electric fan while a person is sleeping.

text: Suno kay Dr. Raj Dasgupta, physician specializing sa internal medicine, pulmonology, critical care, kag sleep medicine sa Southern California, wala sang seryoso nga risgo ang paggamit sang electric fan apang pila ka mga tawo ang maka-eksperyensya sang mga ginakabig ‘irritating symptoms’.
english: According to Dr. Raj Dasgupta, physician specializing in internal medicine, pulmonology, critical care, and sleep medicine in Southern California, there are no serious risks to using an electric fan but a few people can experience what are considered ‘irritating symptoms’.

text:
Yari ang pila sa indi manami nga epekto sa paggamit sang fan kada gab-i;

Nagakadapat nga ibutang ang electric fan 2 to 3 feet away agud nga maprotektahan kamo sa concentrated airflow.
english:
Here are some of the unpleasant side effects of using a fan every night;

It is advisable to place the electric fan 2 to 3 feet away so that you are protected from concentrated airflow.

text: Importante man nga regular nga tinluan ang fan blades agud masigurado nga indi ini pagtiniran sang yab-uk.
english: It is also important to clean the fan blades regularly to ensure that they do not collect dust.

text: Apat na katao ang naiulat na nasawi habang higit tatlong iba pa ang sugatan sa pananalasa ng Severe Tropical Storm Crising at pag-iral ng Southwest Monsoon o Habagat, ayon sa ulat ng National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC).
english: Four people were reported missing while more than three others were injured in the Severe Tropical Storm Crising and Southwest Monsoon, according to the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC).

text: Dalawa sa mga nasawi ay mula sa Northern Mindanao habang isa naman ay nagmula sa Davao Region.
english: Two of the victims are from Northern Mindanao while one is from Davao Region.

text: Lahat ng naiulat na nasugatan ay nagmula sa rehiyon ng SOCCSKSARGEN.
english: All reported injuries are from the region of SOCCSKSARGEN.

text: Samantala, tatlong katao ang naiulat na nawawala sa Western Visayas.
english: Meanwhile, three people were reported missing in Western Visayas.

text: Patuloy pang bineberipika ng NDRRMC ang mga nasabing ulat.
english: The NDRRMC is still verifying the reports.

text: Batay sa pinakahuling datos ng ahensya, umabot na sa 132,835 pamilya o katumbas ng 420,355 indibidwal ang apektado ng kalamidad.
english: According to the agency's latest data, 132,835 families or 420,355 individuals have been affected by the disaster.

text: Sa bilang na ito, nasa 6,720 pamilya o 22,623 indibidwal ang kasalukuyang nasa mga evacuation center, habang 5,287 pamilya naman ang pansamantalang nanunuluyan sa labas ng mga evacuation center.
english: Of this number, 6,720 families or 22,623 individuals are currently in evacuation centers, while 5,287 families are temporarily living outside evacuation centers.

text: Ayon sa Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), bagama’t nakalabas na sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ang Bagyong Crising, asahan pa rin ang mga pag-ulan sa ilang bahagi ng bansa dulot ng Habagat.
english: According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), although Typhoon Crising has passed the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR), rains are still expected in some parts of the country due to the Southwest.

text: Naka-display subong sa side altar sang simbahan sang Alimodian ang isa ka rosarito nga halin mismo kay Pope Francis.
english: A rosary from Pope Francis is now on display on the side altar of the Alimodian church.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mark Rhian Caigoy, altar server sa Parish of Saint Thomas of Villanova, iya ginpahayag nga isa ka residente sang ila banwa ang ginpadal-an sang santo papa sang rosarito.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mark Rhian Caigoy, altar server at the Parish of Saint Thomas of Villanova, said a resident of his town was sent a rosary by the pope.

text: Suno kay Caigoy, nagsulat ang amo nga lalaki sa Vatican para maghingyo kay Pope Francis nga pangamuyuan ang iya iloy nga may balatian nga spine cancer.
english: According to Caigoy, the man wrote to the Vatican to ask Pope Francis to pray for his mother who suffers from spine cancer.

text: Pahayag ni Caigoy, matapos mabaton sang santo papa ang sulat, nagpadala ini sang sulat nga may upod nga anom ka mga rosarito.
english: Caigoy said that after the pope received the letter, he sent a letter with six rosaries.

text: Ang isa ka rosarito ang ginhatag niya sa simbahan nga amo subong ang makit-an sang mga tawo.
english: He donated a rosary to the church that is now visible to the public.

text: Ginapasiguro sang Metro Pacific Iloilo Water (MPIW) nga maka-provide pa sila sang 80 million liters kada adlaw nga tubig sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo apisar nga summer season.
english: Metro Pacific Iloilo Water (MPIW) assures that they can still provide 80 million liters of water per day to the city and province of Iloilo despite the summer season.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jerry Guillergan, Head sang MPIW Engineering Department, iya ginpahayag nga yara pa sa 80 million liters ang ginahatag nga tubig kada adlaw, kun sa diin makabig pa ini nga normal nga water level nga gina-provide nila sa consumers.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jerry Guillergan, Head of the MPIW Engineering Department, said the water supply is still 80 million liters per day, which is still considered the normal water level they provide to consumers.

text: Suno kay Guillergan, may yara pa sang 40% nga non- revenue water nga bangud sa mga guba nga tubo sang MPIW.
english: According to Guillergan, there is still 40% non-revenue water due to broken MPIW pipes.

text: Dugang pa niya, padayon na sila sa pag-ilis sang mga tubo partikular sa Barrio Obrero, Lapuz kag City Proper agud nga amat-amat nga mabuhinan ang non- revenue water.
english: He added that they are already replacing pipes particularly in Barrio Obrero, Lapuz and City Proper to gradually reduce non-revenue water.

text: Gin-athag man ni Guillergan nga wala sila nagdugang ukon nagbuhin sa deployment sang ila mga water tankers kag padayon ang pag-deploy sang 15 ka tankers kada adlaw.
english: Guillergan also clarified that they have not increased or decreased the deployment of their water tankers and continue to deploy 15 tankers per day.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang natungdan nga nagakuha sila sang tubig sa mga areas nga may mataas nga pressure kaangay sang Lanit, Jaro kag ini ang ginadala sa mga lugar nga kalabanan indi na malab-ot sang supply sang tubig.
english: He also confirmed that they are taking water from areas with high pressure such as Lanit, Jaro and it is being brought to areas that are mostly inaccessible to the water supply.

text: Apat na ang na-record patay samtang masobra sa tatlo ka mga indibiwal ang pilason kasunod sang paglaslas sang Severe Tropical Storm Crising kag sang Southwest Monsoon (Habagat), suno sa report sang National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC).
english: Four people have been recorded dead while more than three individuals were injured following the outbreak of Severe Tropical Storm Crising and the Southwest Monsoon (Habagat), according to a report by the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC).

text: Duha sa mga napatay ang nagikan sa Northern Mindanao, kag isa sa Davao Region.
english: Two of the dead were from Northern Mindanao, and one from the Davao Region.

text: Samtang, ang tanan nga napilasan ang nagikan sa rehiyon sang SOCCSKSARGEN.
english: Meanwhile, all the injured are from the SOCCSKSARGEN region.

text: Tatlo man ka indibidwal ang na-record nga missing sa Western Visayas.
english: Three individuals were also recorded missing in Western Visayas.

text: Suno sa NDRRMC, ginpaidalom pa sa beripikasyon ang mga report.
english: According to the NDRRMC, the reports are still undergoing verification.

text: Base sa data sang ahensya naglab-ot na sa 132,835 ka pamilya ang apektado nga ginabug-usan sang 420,355 ka mga indibidwal.
english: Based on the agency's data, 132,835 families have been affected, comprising 420,355 individuals.

text: Sa sini nga numero, 6,720 ka pamilya ukon 22,623 ka indibidwal ang yara sa evacuation centers samtang 5,287 ka pamilya ang temporaryo nga nagatinir sa guwa sang mga evacuation center.
english: Of this number, 6,720 families or 22,623 individuals are in evacuation centers while 5,287 families are temporarily staying outside evacuation centers.

text: Ginkumpirma sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) nga apisar nakaguwa na sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ang Bagyo Crising, padayon sagihapon nga makaeksperyensya sang pag ulan-ulan ang pila ka bahin sang pungsod nga dala sang Habagat.
english: The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) confirmed that although Typhoon Crising has left the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR), some parts of the country will continue to experience rains brought by the Habagat.

text: Gin-akusaran ni Vice President Sara Duterte ang Marcos administration nga nagkuntsaba sa International Criminal Court (ICC) agud ipapreso ang iya amay nga si anay President Rodrigo Duterte, bangud sa ginapangatubang sini nga kaso sang crime against humanity may kaangtanan sa war on drugs.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte has accused the Marcos administration of conspiring with the International Criminal Court (ICC) to imprison her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, for crimes against humanity in connection with the war on drugs.

text: Sa iya pahayag sa “Free Duterte Now” rally sa The Hague, ginbuyagyag ni VP Sara nga ginabuligan sang Marcos administration ang ICC sa pag-usisa kag posible nga pag-aresto sa anay presidente, sa baylo nga protektahan ini.
english: Speaking at the “Free Duterte Now” rally in The Hague, VP Sara revealed that the Marcos administration is helping the ICC investigate and potentially arrest the former president, rather than protecting him.

text: Ginklaro man ni Sara nga apisar may kakulang sang ebidensya, ginapilit sang ICC nga dakpon si Duterte.
english: Sara also clarified that despite the lack of evidence, the ICC is insisting on Duterte's arrest.

text: Suno sa iya, ginagamit lamang ang kaso agud mapalayo sa politika si ang iya amay.
english: He said the case was only being used to keep his father away from politics.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagpaathag ang spokesperson sang ICC nga si Fadi El Abdallah nga indi sila magahatag sang komento sa mga political statements.
english: Meanwhile, ICC spokesperson Fadi El Abdallah explained that they will not comment on political statements.

text: Nagapadayon ang imbestigasyon sang ICC sa posible nga paglapas sang tawhanon nga kinamatarong sa idalum sang administrasyon ni Rodrigo Duterte, apisar sang padayon nga pagpamalibad sang Pilipinas sa hurisdiksyon sang korte.
english: The ICC continues its investigation into possible human rights violations under the Rodrigo Duterte administration, despite the Philippines' continued refusal of the court's jurisdiction.

text: Nagbiyahe na padulong sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. has left for the United States of America.

text: para sa official visit nga magalawig tubtub sa Hulyo 22.
english: for the official visit that will last until July 22.

text: Natalana nga makigkita si Marcos kay U.S. President Donald J. Trump sa White House para nga mapabakod pa ang bilateral cooperation sa importante nga mga area kaangay sang economic growth, trade kag regional security.
english: Marcos is scheduled to meet with U.S. President Donald J. Trump at the White House to further strengthen bilateral cooperation in important areas such as economic growth, trade and regional security.

text: Suno sa Presidential Communication Office (PCO), ang nagapanguna sa prayoridad sa byahe ni Marcos amo ang gin-anunsyo sang US nga 20% nga taripa sa mga exports sang Pilipinas.
english: According to the Presidential Communication Office (PCO), the top priority of Marcos' trip is the US-announced 20% tariff on Philippine exports.

text: Sa iya departure speech, ginpahayag sang presidente nga ang iya high-level meeting kay Trump amo ang una nga pagbisita sang head of state nagikan sa Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) sa Estados Unidos.
english: In his departure speech, the president said his high-level meeting with Trump was the first visit by a head of state from the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) to the United States.

text: “My meeting with President Trump is essential to continuing and to advance our national interest and strengthening our alliance,” pahayag sang chief executive.
english: “My meeting with President Trump is essential to continuing and to advancing our national interest and strengthening our alliance,” the chief executive said.

text: Dugang sini, siya kag ang iya team ang magatinguha nga makig-negosyar agud mahagan-hagan ang epekto sang taripa sa Pilipinas.
english: He added that he and his team will try to negotiate to mitigate the impact of the tariff in the Philippines.

text: “I intend to convey to President Trump and his Cabinet officials that the Philippines is ready to negotiate a bilateral trade deal that will ensure strong, mutually beneficial and future-oriented collaborations,” kabahin pa sang iya nga departure statement.
english: “I intend to convey to President Trump and his Cabinet officials that the Philippines is ready to negotiate a bilateral trade deal that will ensure strong, mutually beneficial and future-oriented collaborations,” his departure statement said.

text: Ginpahayag man sang punong ehekutibo nga didto na sa Estados Unidos ang mga miyembro sang Philippine defense and economic teams para nga magpreparar sa mga diskusyon nga ini.
english: The chief executive also said that members of the Philippine defense and economic teams are already in the United States to prepare for these discussions.

text: Magluwas kay Trump, makigkita man si Marcos sa American business leaders agud maganyat sila nga mag-invest diri sa pungsod.
english: Besides Trump, Marcos will also meet with American business leaders to attract them to invest in the country.

text: Samtang yara sa luwas sang pungsod ang chief executive, mangin caretaker sa Pilipinas sanday Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla kag Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado Estrella III.#
english: While the chief executive is abroad, Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla and Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado Estrella III will be caretakers in the Philippines.

text: Napasaka na sa high alert ang status sang duha ka mga opisina sang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) sa Taiwan kasunod sang duha ka magkasunod nga linog nga nagtay-og sa isla, Mayo 6.
english: The status of two offices of the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) in Taiwan has been raised to high alert following two consecutive earthquakes that shook the island on May 6.

text: Suno sa ahensya, gina-verify sa leaders, communities, employers, kag trade associations agud ma-check ang kondisyon sang mga Pinoy kag agud hibaluon kun may yara sang nasamaran.
english: According to the agency, it is verifying with leaders, communities, employers, and trade associations to check the condition of the Filipinos and to find out if anyone was injured.

text: Nagapakig-angot man ini sa Manila Economic and Cultural Office (MECO) agud masiguro ang ila nga safety.
english: He is also liaising with the Manila Economic and Cultural Office (MECO) to ensure their safety.

text: Base sa reports sang local media sa Taiwan, una nga nag-igu ang magnitude 5.9 nga linog 5:45 p.m. kag pito ka minutos lamang ang nagligad ukon 5:52 p.m., nagsunod man ang magnitude 5.9 quake.
english: According to local media reports in Taiwan, the magnitude 5.9 quake first struck at 5:45 p.m. and just seven minutes later or 5:52 p.m., a magnitude 5.9 quake followed.

text: Suno pa sa Central Weather Administration, ang epicenter sang una nga linog ang 26 km south sang Hualien County Hall, samtang 27.8 km south sang Hualien County Hall naman sa ikaduha nga pagtay-og.
english: According to the Central Weather Administration, the epicenter of the first quake was 26 km south of Hualien County Hall, while the second quake was 27.8 km south of Hualien County Hall.

text: Wala pa sang reported damage ukon injured as of press time.
english: No damage or injured have been reported as of press time.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga bulan, na-rekord man ang magnitude 7.2 nga linog sa Taiwan nga amo ang pinakamabaskog nga pagtay-og sa maragtas sang isla sa sulod sang 25 ka tuig.#
english: Last month, a magnitude 7.2 earthquake was also recorded in Taiwan, the strongest earthquake in the island's history in 25 years.

text: ILOILO – Apektado ang swine industry sa probinsya sang Iloilo bangud sa African Swine Fever sa Luzon.
english: ILOILO – The swine industry in Iloilo province is affected by the African Swine Fever in Luzon.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Ildefonso Toledo, Provincial Agriculturist, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong, naghina ang negosyo sang baboy bangud man sa African Swine Fever.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Ildefonso Toledo, Provincial Agriculturist, said that at present, the pig business has slowed down due to the African Swine Fever.

text: Suno kay Toledo, bisan pa nga may yara sang gintukod nga Task Force on African Swine Fever si Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., apang indi man sa gihapon madula ang kahangawa sang publiko.
english: Toledo said that although Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. has established a Task Force on African Swine Fever, the public's concerns will not disappear.

text: Sila sa Provincial Agricultures Office suno kay Toledo ang magabulig sa nasambit nga Task Force sa pag-monitor agud nga indi makalab-ot sa Iloilo ang nasambit nga balati-an.
english: The Provincial Agricultures Office, Toledo said, will assist the Task Force in monitoring so that the disease does not reach Iloilo.

text: Kun animal health naman ang pagahambalan, ang Provincial Veterinary Office suno kay Toledo ang nakatuon diri samtang ang Provincial Agricultures Office naman ang nakatuon sa pag-inventory sang meat production.
english: When it comes to animal health, Toledo said the Provincial Veterinary Office is focused on this while the Provincial Agricultures Office is focused on inventorying meat production.

text: ILOILO- Ginpadayaw ni Iloilo 2nd District Representative Michael Gorriceta ang sunod- sunod nga dalagko nga mga proyekto nga nagasulod sa iya distrito.
english: ILOILO- Iloilo 2nd District Representative Michael Gorriceta praised the successive major projects entering his district.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo
kay Rep.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo
to Rep.

text:
Gorriceta, iya ginpahayag nga ang pag-invest sang negosyante
nga si Ramon Ang, presidente kag Chief Executive Officer sang  San
Miguel Corporation agud magtukod sang P6.7 beer plant sa Leganes,
Iloilo kag iban pa nga mga investors ang pamatuod sang
pagka-investor- friendly sang 2nd district.
english:
Gorriceta, he said that the investment of the entrepreneur
Ramon Ang, president and Chief Executive Officer of San
Miguel Corporation to build a P6.7 beer plant in Leganes,
Iloilo and other investors are proof of
investor- friendliness of the 2nd district.

text:
Suno kay Gorriceta, maayo man ang
pagdumala sang mga opisyal sa mga banwa sa nasambit nga distrito
rason kun ngaa positibo ang imahe sini para sa mga negosyante.
english:
According to Gorriceta, the
supervision of officers in townships in the said district
reason why it has a positive image for businessmen.

text:
Gindugang man sang mamalidha nga ang
social order sa nasambit nga mga banwa, ang may dako man nga  papel
kun ngaa nagasinulod lang ang mga investors sa 2nd district sang
Iloilo.
english:
The lawmaker also added that the
social order in these towns, also plays a major role
why investors are only entering the 2nd district of
Iloilo.

text: Nasamaran ang duha ka overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) kadungan sang mabaskog nga pag-ulan kag pagkatiphag sang duta sa Hong Kong.
english: Two overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) were injured during heavy rains and landslides in Hong Kong.

text: Suno sa Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), mag-asawa ang involved sa amo nga insidente kag naga-trabaho sa Sai Kung, New Territories.
english: According to the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), the couple involved in the incident were working in Sai Kung, New Territories.

text: Ginpahayag sang ahensya nga nagakuha ang duha sang pictures kag videos sa damage nga natuga sang mabaskog nga pag-ulan sa pasilidad sang resort sang hinali nga natabo ang landslide.
english: The agency said the two were taking pictures and videos of the damage caused by heavy rains to the resort facility when the landslide suddenly occurred.

text: Nakaangkon sang injury sa ulo ang babaye apang estable na subong ang kondisyon; samtang ang bana naman ang nagsuprer sang leg injuries kag gin-operahan.
english: The woman sustained head injuries but is now in stable condition; while the husband suffered leg injuries and underwent surgery.

text: Ginpasalig sang ahensya ang close monitoring sa kondisyon sang mag-asawa paagi sa Migrant Workers Office (MWO) kag Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) Office sa Hong Kong.
english: The agency assured close monitoring of the couple's condition through the Migrant Workers Office (MWO) and Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) Office in Hong Kong.

text: Una naman nga may nahatag nga financial assistance sa mag-asawa.
english: Earlier, financial assistance was provided to the couple.

text:
Matandaan nga nag-isyu ang weather forecaster sang “possible black rainstorm alert” sa Hong Kong bangud sa thunderstorms nga rason man sang pagbinaha sa mga dalanon, pagsirado sang pila ka negosyo, kag pagka-atrasar sang pila ka hikers nga na-trap sa trails sa Sai Kung.#

(Photo is from South China Morning Post)
english:
It can be recalled that the weather forecaster issued a “possible black rainstorm alert” in Hong Kong due to thunderstorms that also caused flooding of roads, closure of some businesses, and delay of some hikers trapped on trails in Sai Kung.

(Photo is from South China Morning Post)

text: Nag-file sang hagna sanday Senador Loren Legarda kag Sen.
english: Senators Loren Legarda and Sen.

text: Raffy Tulfo agud lubos nga i-ban ang online gambling sa pungsod.
english: Raffy Tulfo to completely ban online gambling in the country.

text: Ang nasambit nga hagna ang kasunod sang nagadamo nga panawagan bangud sa negatibo sini nga epekto sa komunidad.
english: The bill follows growing calls for its negative impact on the community.

text: Ginpahayag ni Sen.Legarda nga ang iya gin-file ang nagasakop sang tanan nga sahi sang online gambling kaangay sang online casino, e-sabong, digital lotteries, virtual slots kag sports betting.
english: Sen. Legarda said his filing covers all types of online gambling such as online casinos, e-sabong, digital lotteries, virtual slots and sports betting.

text: Natigayon sini nga ma-file ang hagna bangud madali na ini nga ma-access sang bisan sin-o sa diin madamo na ang nangin adik sa sugal kag nagaguba sang ila kabuhi.
english: He was able to file the bill because it is easily accessible to anyone where many have become addicted to gambling and are ruining their lives.

text: Ang mga kumpaniya nga maglapas sini ang magapangatubang sang multa nga nagalab-ot sa P500,000 tubtub isa ka milyon ka pesos.
english: Companies that violate this will face fines ranging from P500,000 to one million pesos.

text: Ginpahayag ni Sen.Tulfo nga dapat dumilian ang tanan nga sahi sang online gambling.
english: Sen. Tulfo said all forms of online gambling should be banned.

text: Ini man ang ikatlo nga prayoridad nga hagna nga gin-file ni Tulfo para sa ika-20 nga Kongreso, ang una amo ang libre nga medical assistance for seniors, anti-aid abuse, barangay CCTV surveillance act kag istrikto nga guidelines sa delayed birth certificates.
english: This is also the third priority bill Tulfo filed for the 20th Congress, the first being free medical assistance for seniors, anti-aid abuse, barangay CCTV surveillance act and strict guidelines on delayed birth certificates.

text: By: Bombo Ray Gerald Badiang
english: By: Bombo Ray Gerald Badiang

text: Justifiable ang ginhatag nga rason sang 34 ka mga kapulisan sang Iloilo City Police Office, matapos ginpangayuan sang paathag kun ngaa wala sila nakapaidalom sa mandatory drug test.
english: The reason given by the 34 policemen of the Iloilo City Police Office is justifiable, after being asked to explain why they did not undergo the mandatory drug test.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMAJ.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PMAJ.

text: Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang ICPO, iya ginpahayag nga sa inisyal nga evaluation sa ginsumiter nga explanation letter sang nasambit nga mga kapulisan, mayorya sa ila ang nakahatag sang balido nga rason.
english: Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the ICPO, said that in the initial evaluation of the explanation letter submitted by the said policemen, the majority of them gave valid reasons.

text: Suno kay Sangrines, ginpaidalom na ang mga ini sa drug test kahapon, Marso 12, apang magaguwa pa ang resulta matapos ang pila ka adlaw.
english: According to Sangrines, they were already subjected to drug test yesterday, March 12, but the results will be released after a few days.

text: Dugang pa niya nga dapat gid ang mga ini nga magpaidalom sa ginapatuman nga mandatory drug test agud masiguro nga wala sila nagagamit sang ilegal nga droga agud man nga magserbe sila nga ehemplo sa publiko.
english: He added that they should undergo the mandatory drug test to ensure that they are not using illegal drugs so that they can serve as an example to the public.

text: KINULBAAN ang aton abyan nga si Pedro sa pagdaug ni Robin Padilla nga nagapanguna gid sa 12 ka senator-elect.
english: OUR friend Pedro is shocked by the victory of Robin Padilla who is leading the 12 senator-elect.

text: Siling niya basi ipahambog ni Padilla ini sing wala sa lugar kag gamiton agud mag-demanda sing wala nagakaigu para sa kawsa sang mga Muslim, nga kabahin na siya bilang Muslim-convert halin sa pagka-Kristiyano.
english: He said Padilla might brag about it out of place and use it to demand unfairly for the cause of Muslims, which he is part of as a Muslim-convert from Christianity.

text: Indi  man seguro.
english: Probably not.

text: Indi dapat malipat si Padilla nga mga 20 ka milyon sang mga Kristiyano, lakip kami ni Pedro, ang nagboto sa iya kag indi lang ang mga Muslim, nga wala pa 3 ka milyon diri sa pungsod.
english: Padilla should not forget that some 20 million Christians, Pedro and I included, voted for him and not just Muslims, who are less than 3 million here in the country.

text: Ginboto namon si Padilla tungod sa pagpati nga bukas (indi cerrado) ang iya panghuna-huna sa pagpasanyog sang pag-respetuhay sang mga Kristiyano kag mga Muslim sa iya iduso nga mga kasuguan kag mga hilikuton sa Senado.
english: We voted for Padilla because we believe that he is open-minded (not closed) in promoting mutual respect between Christians and Muslims in his proposed legislation and activities in the Senate.

text: By the way, indi kulto ang pagtuohan nga Islam sang mga Muslim nga sa isa lang ka sugo kag hingyo sang ila lider, katulad ni Padilla sa karon, dayon man sunod sang tanan.
english: By the way, the Islamic faith of Muslims is not a cult that, on the one order and request of their leader, like Padilla today, immediately follows everyone.

text: Katulad man sang mga 85% sang mga pumuluyo sa pungsod nga mga Katoliko, indi man gani mapasunod sang mga pari sa ila luyag ang mga sumulunod nila.
english: Like about 85% of the country's population who are Catholics, the priests cannot even make their followers follow their wishes.

text: Ina tungod man sa ila pagtudlo nga gintuga sang Diyos ang tanan nga tawo nga may kahilwayan sing panghuna-huna.
english: This is also because of their teaching that God created all humans with free will.

text: Gani segurado naton nga indi man tanan nga mga Muslim bilib sa kay Padilla kag ang iban sa ila wala man gani nagboto sa iya.
english: So we are sure that not all Muslims are impressed with Padilla and some of them did not even vote for him.

text: Kon may kahadlukan kita nga pagtuluohan, ina ang isa ka kulto katulad sang People’s Temple nga cerrado ang  utok.
english: If we have a fearful belief, it is a closed-minded cult like the People's Temple.

text: Sang maghingyo ang ila lider nga magpakamatay sila tanan dayon man nila tanan nagpakamatay.
english: When their leader asked them to commit suicide, they all committed suicide.

text: Sus, ginpainom man nila sing hilo ang mga inosente nga mga kabataan agud makaupod sa kamatayon sang ila mga ginikanan!
english: Sus, they also made innocent children drink poison to join the death of their parents!

text: Kongrats Mr. Padilla.
english: Congrats Mr. Padilla.

text: Kag gasalig kami nga mangin ka-ugyon ka sa pagpati sang nagboto sa imo nga mga Kriatiyano nga ang dalhon mo amo ang kawsa sang kalinong kag pag-ululutod sang mga Filipino regardless kon ano man ang relihiyon sang isa kag isa.
english: And we hope that you will agree with the belief of the Christians who voted for you that what you will bring is the cause of peace and brotherhood of Filipinos regardless of each other's religion.

text:
***

Ginapaabot naton nga ma-organize formal na ang mga Kakampinks nga nag-upod sa kay Bise Presidente Leni Robredo sa iya “People’s Campaign” agud mangin isa na ka NGO, pagkatapos nga napierde siya sa eleksyon, although nakakuha man siya sang mga 15 ka milyon ka boto.
english:
***

We expect the Kakampinks who joined Vice President Leni Robredo in her “People’s Campaign” to become an NGO, after she lost the election, although she also got about 15 million votes, to be formally organized.

text: Ginatapuan ining mga Kakampinks sang mga volunteers nga nagbulig sa iya kampanya nga wala gapaabot sang bisan ano man nga suhol kag nagbulig pa gasto sa kinahanglanon sang iya kampanya tungod nagapati sila sa iya maabi-abihon nga liderato.
english: These Kakampinks are made up of volunteers who helped his campaign without expecting any remuneration and even helped with the expenses of his campaign because they believe in his welcoming leadership.

text: Agud formal na nga ma-organisa ining mga Kakampinks, maayo seguro nga card-bearing gid ini sila.
english: In order to formally organize these Kakampinks, it's probably good that they're card-bearing.

text: Paagi sini madale ma-identify sila kag mapahulag kon kinahanglan ang ila pagbuylog sa Angat Buhay nga programa ni VP Leni, nga luyag niya gihapon ipatuman sa mga kubos naton nga mga pumuluyo.
english: This will make it easier for them to be identified and mobilized if necessary to join VP Leni's Angat Buhay program, which she still wants to implement to our poor people.

text: Kag agud indi gid malipatan ang katuyuan sining Angat Buhay nga programa mas maayo seguro nga tawgon na lang naton ining mga Kakampinks nga mga “Angat Buhay Volunteers” nga may core group sa kada barangay ukon banwa agud manguna sa pag-coordinate kon ano ang ipatuman nga Angat Buhay nga programa.
english: And in order not to forget the purpose of this Angat Buhay program, it is better to call these Kakampinks “Angat Buhay Volunteers” with a core group in each barangay or town to take the lead in coordinating what the Angat Buhay program will be implemented.

text: Pwede ining Angat BuhayVolunteers ma-categorize sa duha ka grupo.
english: These Challenge LifeVolunteers can be categorized into two groups.

text: Isa sini ang “Angat Buhay Volunteer-Worker” nga kaya lang maghatag sang ila serbisyo.
english: One of these is the “Angat Buhay Volunteer-Worker” who can only provide their services.

text: Ang isa pa amo ang “Angat Buhay Volunteer-Contributor” nga pwede makahatag financial nga bulig, ukon libre nga talento para sa mga palagwaon sang grupo ukon bagay nga ihibalo sa publiko.
english: Another is the “Angat Buhay Volunteer-Contributor” who can provide financial assistance, or free talent for group shows or public awareness.

text: Sa bahin sang pamunuan sang Angat Buhay NGO, nga pangunahan ni Robredo, mayor nga obligasyon sini ang magplano kag magpanguna sa pagpatuman sang ano man nga proyekto kag programa.
english: On the part of the leadership of Angat Buhay NGO, which will be led by Robredo, its main obligation is to plan and lead the implementation of any project and program.

text: Manguna man ini sa pagpanikasug nga makabaton sing bulig halin sa mga pribado kag humanitarian nga mga grupo nga ang handom lang amo ang makabulig sa aton mga kubos nga mga pumuluyo, labi na gid karon nga nagaatubang kita sing dalagku nga problema sa pangabuhian tungod sining pandemic.
english: It will also lead the effort to receive assistance from private and humanitarian groups whose sole desire is to help our poor citizens, especially now that we are facing major livelihood problems due to this pandemic.

text: Ining inyo kubos nga kolumnista luyag man gani mag-upod diri bilang “Angat-Buhay Volunteer-Contributor” kon diin makaamot kita sang aton talento bilang mamahayag nga makadala sing balita kag panugdaon parte sa kaayuhan sini.
english: This poor columnist of yours also wants to join here as an “Angat-Buhay Volunteer-Contributor” where we can contribute our talent as journalists who can bring news and suggestions about its welfare.

text: Sa ining aton luyag nga mag-upod bilang card-bearing nga katapo sang “Angat Buhay Volunteers” pwede ako ma-contact sang headquarters sining Angat Buhay NGO sa akon email address.
english: For those of us who wish to join as card-bearing members of “Angat Buhay Volunteers” I can be contacted by the headquarters of this Angat Buhay NGO at my email address.

text: Thank you!/PN
english: Thank you!/PN

text: Patigayunon na ang launching sang COVID-19 vaccination sa mga kabataan edad 5-11 anyos sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo subong nga adlaw, Pebrero 14.
english: The launching of the COVID-19 vaccination for children aged 5-11 years old in Iloilo City and province will be held today, February 14.

text: Ang cultural center sang West Visayas State University (WVSU) ang isa sa napili nga venues sang probinsya nga mangin simultaneous man sa Aleosan District Hospital sa Alimodian, Iloilo kag sa isa ka mall sa banwa sang Pavia.
english: The cultural center of West Visayas State University (WVSU) is one of the selected venues of the province that will also be simultaneously at the Aleosan District Hospital in Alimodian, Iloilo and at a mall in Pavia town.

text: Ang syudad sang Iloilo ang may yara man sang simultaneous activities sa separado nga venue.
english: Iloilo City will also have simultaneous activities at a separate venue.

text: Kaupod sang syudad ang Philippine Pediatric Society.
english: The city is accompanied by the Philippine Pediatric Society.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Joselito Villaruz, presidente sang WVSU, iya ginpahayag nga preparado ang unibersidad bangud may yara sang dugang nga volunteer doctors magluwas pa nga nagamit naman ini bilang vaccination site sa lain nga age group.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Joselito Villaruz, president of WVSU, said the university is prepared because there are additional volunteer doctors besides being used as a vaccination site for other age groups.

text: Pfizer vaccine lang ang gamiton sa pagbakuna sa mga bata bangud ini lang ang naka-secure sang emergency use approval nagikan sa Philippine Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
english: Only Pfizer vaccine will be used to vaccinate children because it is the only one that has secured emergency use approval from the Philippine Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

text: Mas matahaw ini ukon may lower dosage kag lower concentration ipaanggid sa mga ginahatag nga dose sa mga naga-edad 12-17 anyos.
english: It is higher or has a lower dosage and lower concentration compared to the doses given to those aged 12-17 years old.

text: Gin-reformulate ini agud nga masarangan sang lawas sang bata sa age group nga 5-11.
english: It has been reformulated so that the body of a child in the age group of 5-11 can handle it.

text: Ginpaathag ni Villaruz nga gintun-an sang maayo ang ini nga mga bakuna, wala ukon minimal lang ang na-note nga adverse reactions, kag makabulig man agud nga makabalik na sa face-to-face classes ang mga kabataan.
english: Villaruz explained that these vaccines have been thoroughly studied, no or minimal adverse reactions have been noted, and will also help children to return to face-to-face classes.

text: Nagtaas ang ranking sang Pilipinas sa katapusan sang 2025 FIBA Asia Cup nga ginhiwat sa Saudi Arabia.
english: The Philippines rose in ranking at the end of the 2025 FIBA ​​Asia Cup held in Saudi Arabia.

text: Base sa ginpagwa nga rankings sang FIBA, ang Pilipinas ang yara subong sa ika-pito nga pwesto.
english: Based on the FIBA ​​rankings, the Philippines is currently in seventh place.

text: Mas mataas ini kun ipaanggid sa ika siyam nga pwesto sang pungsod sa 2022 FIBA Asia Cup nga ginpatigayon sa Jakarta, Indonesia.
english: This is higher compared to the country's ninth place in the 2022 FIBA ​​Asia Cup held in Jakarta, Indonesia.

text: Kun balikan ang performance sang Gilas Pilipinas sa nakaligad nga paindis-indis, natigayon sini nga makalab-ot sa quarterfinals sa pihak sang duha ka sunod-sunod nga kapierdihan sa elimination stage.
english: Looking back at the performance of Gilas Pilipinas in the last competition, it managed to reach the quarterfinals despite two consecutive losses in the elimination stage.

text: Sa katapusan nalutos ini sang 2025 nga kampeon nga Australia sa quarterfinals, 84-60, nga nagdul-ong sa 2-3 nga rekord sa Asian meet.
english: It was ultimately defeated by 2025 champions Australia in the quarterfinals, 84-60, leading to a 2-3 record at the Asian meet.

text: Sang 2022 Asia Cup, napaslawan ang Gilas nga makalab-ot sa quarterfinals matapos nalutos sa Japan, 102-81.
english: In the 2022 Asia Cup, the Gilas failed to reach the quarterfinals after losing to Japan, 102-81.

text: Katapusan nga gin-uyatan sang national team ang FIBA Asia Cup trophy sang 1985.
english: The national team last held the FIBA ​​Asia Cup trophy in 1985.

text: Sang 2013 Cup, nagbalik sa finals ang Team Philippines apang nadulaan sang swerte matapos nalutos sang China, 67-78.
english: In the 2013 Cup, Team Philippines returned to the finals but lost their luck after losing to China, 67-78.

text: Samtang, liwat nga magapasakop ang national team sa FIBA World Cup Qualifiers nga magasugod sa Nobyembre 2025.
english: Meanwhile, the national team will once again participate in the FIBA ​​World Cup Qualifiers starting in November 2025.

text: Nangin maduguon ang inaway sang mag-live in partner sa Davao del Sur matapos ginlabo sang 34-anyos nga babaye ang 19-anyos nga lalaki.
english: A 34-year-old woman stabbed a 19-year-old man in a bloody fight between a live-in partner in Davao del Sur.

text: Ginpahayag nga balos ini sang babaye matapos ginbasyahan siya sang mainit nga kape sang lalaki sa tunga sang ila pagbaisay.
english: The woman allegedly retaliated after the man poured her hot coffee in the middle of their argument.

text: Depensa sang suspek, wala na ini nakapugong bangud masami siya ginasakit sang biktima.
english: The suspect said he could not control himself because the victim often hurt him.

text: Ginabulong na sa ospital ang lalaki samtang napreso naman ang babaye.
english: The man is being treated at the hospital while the woman is in jail.

text: Ginapaabot nga indi na maabot sang Pilipinas ang target sini sa pagpasanyog sang ekonomiya sa ikatatlo nga sunod nga tuig sa 2025 matapos ang mas mahina sini nga performance sa ikatatlo nga quarter.
english: The Philippines is expected to miss its economic growth target for the third consecutive year in 2025 after its weaker performance in the third quarter.

text: Ini bangud sang mga isyu nga gina-atubang sa korapsyon nga naga-apekto sa kumpiyansa sang mga konsumidor kag mga mamumugon.
english: This is due to the issues faced with corruption affecting the confidence of consumers and workers.

text: Suno kay Department of Economy, Planning, and Development (DepDev) Secretary Arsenio Balisacan, nga malab-ot gid sini ang pinakanubo nga target nga 5.5% tubtob 6.5% nga ginhatag sang inter-agency Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC).
english: According to Department of Economy, Planning, and Development (DepDev) Secretary Arsenio Balisacan, it will certainly exceed the minimum target of 5.5% to 6.5% given by the inter-agency Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC).

text: Nahibaluan nga ang paghinay sang ekonomiya nagakatabo samtang ang pungsod nagaatubang sang mga isyu sa korapsyon.
english: It is known that the economic slowdown comes as the country is facing corruption issues.

text: Sa karon nagahimo na sang nagkalain-lain nga imbestigasyon ang duha ka kapulungan sang Kongreso kaangot sa irregularidad sa paggasto sang pondo sa public works, kaupod ang imbestigasyon sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI), nga may mandato nga usisahon ang posibleng anomalya sa flood control projects.
english: The two houses of Congress are currently conducting various investigations into irregularities in the spending of public works funds, along with the investigation of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI), which has a mandate to investigate possible anomalies in flood control projects.

text: Ginhingyo sang special prosecutor sa South Korea nga dagdagan sang death penalty si anay President Yoon Suk Yeol bangud sa pagpanguna sini sa insurrection paagi sa pag-implementar anay sang martial law.
english: The special prosecutor in South Korea has asked for an increase in the death penalty for former President Yoon Suk Yeol for leading the insurrection by first implementing martial law.

text: Suno sa prosecutor sa Seoul Central District Court, nagplano sanday Yoon kag ang iya former defense minister sang military rule agud nga makapabilin ang former president sa pwesto.
english: According to the prosecutor at the Seoul Central District Court, Yoon and his former defense minister planned military rule to keep the former president in office.

text: Nag-ugat ang kaso sang gintuyo ni Yoon nga magpatuman sang martial law sang Disyembre 2024 sa South Korea.
english: The case stemmed from Yoon’s attempt to impose martial law in December 2024 on South Korea.

text: Inoras lang ang ginlawig sang martial law bangud nagguwa ang mga tawo kag nagprotesta, samtang naghulag naman ang parliament, gin-impeach si Yoon, kag gin-detain para sa trial sang kaso.
english: Martial law lasted only hours as people came out and protested, while parliament acted, impeached Yoon, and detained him for trial.

text: Ginpanginwala man anay sang former president ang akusasyon batok sa iya.
english: The former president also previously denied the charges against him.

text: Suno kay Yoon, ang martial law amo ang sabat agud nga matalupangdan sang publiko kun ano nga sala ang ginahimo sang opposition party.
english: According to Yoon, martial law is the answer so that the public will notice what the opposition party is doing wrong.

text: Ang pagpanguna sang insurrection ang mahimo masilutan sang death penalty ukon bilog nga kabuhi nga pagka-preso.
english: Leading an insurrection is punishable by the death penalty or life imprisonment.

text: Sa idalom sang layi sang South Korea, dapat nga mag-request ang piskalya sa judge nga idagdag ang isa sa duha ka nasambit nga sentensya.
english: Under South Korean law, the prosecution must request the judge to add one of the two sentences.

text: Nahibaluan nga halos tatlo ka dekada na halin sang may ginsilutan sang kamatayon sa amo nga pungsod.
english: It is known that it has been almost three decades since anyone was executed in that country.

text: Natalana nga magpaguwa sang desisyon ang korte sa Pebrero subong nga tuig.
english: The court is scheduled to issue its decision in February this year.

text: ILOILO CITY- Pagpabaya sa mga konsumidor kag paglapas sa  layi ang nangin basehan sang Committee on Legislative Franchises agud i-deny ang franchise re-application sang Panay Electric Company agud mapadayon ang pagserbi bilang power distributor sa Syudad sang Iloilo.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Committee on Legislative Franchises has denied the franchise re-application of the Panay Electric Company to continue serving as a power distributor in Iloilo City.

text: Sa exclusive interview  sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Surigao del Sur-2nd District Representative Johnny Pimentel, deputy speaker sang House of Representatives, iya ginpahayag nga sa sulod sang 97 ka tuig sang Panay Electric Company sa patag sang power distribution, madamo ini sang nakumiter nga violation.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Surigao del Sur-2nd District Representative Johnny Pimentel, deputy speaker of the House of Representatives, said that in the 97 years of the Panay Electric Company in the field of power distribution, it has committed many violations.

text: Suno kay Pimentel, ginlapas sang Panay Electric Company ang  Magna Carta for electric consumers sa diin nag-overcharge ini sang 631 million pesos sa bills sang mga konsumidor.
english: According to Pimentel, Panay Electric Company violated the Magna Carta for electric consumers where it overcharged 631 million pesos on consumers' bills.

text: Magluwas diri, napaslawan man ang Panay Electric Company sa nagligad ng lima ka tuig nga mag-apply para sa capital expenditure sa Energy Regulatory Commission agud mapa- improve kag ipaidalom sa modernisasyon ang ila pasilidad.
english: In addition, Panay Electric Company has also failed in the past five years to apply for capital expenditure to the Energy Regulatory Commission to improve and modernize its facility.

text: Suno pa sa mamalidha, mas gin-una pa sang Panay Electric Company ang paghatag sang 200 million pesos nga dividend sa ila mga stockholders sa baylo nga talupangdon ang mga konsumidor.
english: According to the lawmaker, Panay Electric Company prioritized giving 200 million pesos dividend to its stockholders instead of paying attention to consumers.

text: Gindugang pa niya, nangin mabakod man nga basehan ang kapin 200 ka mga kaso nga gin-file batok sa Panay Electric Company bangud sa indi maayo nga serbisyo sa Syudad sang Iloilo.
english: He added that the more than 200 cases filed against Panay Electric Company for poor service in Iloilo City have also become a strong basis.

text: Si Pimentel ang nag-move sa pag-deny sang franchise application sang Panay Electric Company kag wala sang bisan isa ang nagpamatok sa diin isa si Iloilo City Lone District Representative Juliene Jam Baronda ang nagboto pabor sa pagbasura sang application  sang Panay Electric Company.
english: Pimentel moved to deny the franchise application of Panay Electric Company and no one objected where one Iloilo City Lone District Representative Juliene Jam Baronda voted in favor of rejecting the application of Panay Electric Company.

text: Apektado ang tinatayang 4,229 pasahero matapos kanselahin ang ilang mga biyahe sa himpapawid ngayong araw ng Biyernes, Hulyo 18, bunsod ng masamang lagay ng panahon na dulot ng bagyong Crising.
english: An estimated 4,229 passengers were affected after their flights were canceled on Friday, July 18, due to bad weather conditions caused by Typhoon Crising.

text: Ayon sa Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP), kabuuang 18 domestic flights ang kinansela habang dalawang biyahe naman ang na-divert kahapon, Hulyo 17, upang maiwasan ang peligro dulot ng sama ng panahon.
english: According to the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP), a total of 18 domestic flights were canceled while two flights were diverted yesterday, July 17, to avoid the danger caused by the same weather.

text: Batay sa pinakabagong advisory ng CAAP, kanselado ngayong araw ang ilang domestic flights ng iba’t ibang airline companies.
english: According to the latest advisory of CAAP, some domestic flights of various airline companies are canceled today.

text: Kabilang dito ang mga biyahe ng Cebu Pacific patungong at paalis ng Manila – San Jose, Manila – Virac, Manila – Tuguegarao, at Manila – Cauayan.
english: This includes Cebu Pacific flights to and from Manila – San Jose, Manila – Virac, Manila – Tuguegarao, and Manila – Cauayan.

text: Sa PAL Express naman, apektado rin ang flights mula Busuanga – Manila, Manila – Cauayan, Manila – Basco (Batanes), at Clark – Basco.
english: On PAL Express, flights from Busuanga – Manila, Manila – Cauayan, Manila – Basco (Batanes), and Clark – Basco are also affected.

text: Kinansela rin ng Cebgo ang mga biyaheng Cebu – Masbate at Manila – Naga.
english: Cebgo also canceled Cebu-Masbate and Manila-Naga flights.

text: Bukod sa mga kanselasyon, iniulat din ng CAAP na may mga flights na na-divert, kabilang ang biyahe mula Manila patungong Busuanga na kinailangang bumalik sa Maynila dahil sa hindi ligtas na kondisyon ng panahon.
english: Aside from the cancellations, CAAP also reported that some flights were diverted, including the trip from Manila to Busuanga that had to return to Manila due to unsafe weather conditions.

text: Pinapayuhan ng CAAP ang mga apektadong pasahero na makipag-ugnayan sa kanilang airline companies para sa rebooking ng flight o refund ng kanilang ticket.
english: CAAP advises affected passengers to contact their airline companies for flight rebooking or refund of their tickets.

text: Patuloy ang paalala ng mga awtoridad na mag-ingat at sundin ang mga abiso para sa kaligtasan ng lahat.
english: Authorities continue to remind people to be careful and follow the warnings for the safety of all.

text: Ginbuksan sang Russia ang kaso-kriminal batok kay Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky kag ginbutang man ini sang Interior Ministry sa wanted list.
english: Russia has opened a criminal case against Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and the Interior Ministry has also placed him on a wanted list.

text: Ini base sa online database sang gina-alegar nga mga kriminal nga ginalagas sang otoridad.
english: This is based on an online database of alleged criminals being pursued by the authorities.

text: Suno pa sa database, wanted ang Ukrainian leader sa idalom sang criminal code, apang wala na sang dugang nga mga detalye.
english: According to the database, the Ukrainian leader is wanted under the criminal code, but there are no further details.

text: Gintawag naman sang Ukraine nga wala sang pulos ang Russian announcement kag sa pagkamatuod si Russian President Vladimir Putin ang na-isyuhan sang warrant halin sa International Criminal Court (ICC) kag subject sa implementasyon sang 123 ka mga pungsod.
english: Ukraine has called the Russian announcement useless and in fact Russian President Vladimir Putin has been issued a warrant by the International Criminal Court (ICC) and is subject to implementation by 123 countries.

text: “We would like to remind you that unlike the worthless Russian announcements, an International Criminal Court warrant for the arrest of Russian dictator Vladimir Putin on suspicion of war crimes is quite real, and subject to implementation in 123 countries,” suno sa Ukrainian foreign ministry sa ila nga statement.
english: “We would like to remind you that unlike the worthless Russian announcements, an International Criminal Court warrant for the arrest of Russian dictator Vladimir Putin on suspicion of war crimes is quite real, and subject to implementation in 123 countries,” the Ukrainian foreign ministry said in a statement.

text: Dugang pa sang Kyiv, ang anunsyo sang Russia amo ang nagapakita kun ano ka-desperado ang Russian state machine kag propaganda kag wala na sang iban nga mapinsaran kun paano maka-agaw sang atensyon.
english: Kyiv added that Russia's announcement shows how desperate the Russian state machine and propaganda are and that no one else can think of how to attract attention.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang Pebrero 2022, pila ka beses na nga nakapaguwa ang Russia sang arrest warrants sa Ukrainian kag iban pa nga European politicians.
english: It is known that since February 2022, Russia has issued several arrest warrants for Ukrainian and other European politicians.

text: Sang Pebrero, ginbutang man sang Russian police si Estonian Prime Minister Kaja Kallas, ang culture minister sang Lithuania kag members sang previous Latvian Parliament sa wanted list bangud sa pagguba sang Soviet-era monuments.#
english: In February, Russian police also placed Estonian Prime Minister Kaja Kallas, the culture minister of Lithuania and members of the previous Latvian Parliament on a wanted list for destroying Soviet-era monuments.#

text: Na-rescue ang isa ka lalaki nga nagtuyo nga maglumpat halin sa flyover sa porsyon sang General Luna St., Iloilo City Proper kaina sang kaagahon.
english: A man who tried to jump from the flyover in the portion of General Luna St., Iloilo City Proper was rescued this morning.

text: Ini amo si Alyas John, 24, ginapahayag nga temporaryo nga nagatinir sa Rizal Palapala II, apang tumandok sang Barangay Dalipe, Lemery, Iloilo.
english: This is Alyas John, 24, allegedly temporarily staying in Rizal Palapala II, but a native of Barangay Dalipe, Lemery, Iloilo.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alyas John, iya ginpahayag nga napanumdom sini nga magsaka bangud wala na ini sang dangpan kag ginpahayag nga “indi na ini palangga sang iya pamilya.”

Pahayag niya, sang yara ini sa ibabaw, ginatawgan sini ang iya utod apang wala nagasabat.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, John said he decided to climb because he had no shelter and said he was “no longer loved by his family.”

He said that when he was upstairs, he called his brother but he did not answer.

english: He added that he arrived in the city about four years ago by running his former job as a scallops seller in Estancia, and now helps at the Iloilo Terminal Market.

text: Magahiwat ang Archdiocese of Jaro sang misa alas kuwatro buwas sang hapon, Abril 26, nga kadungan sa Funeral Mass sa Saint Peter’s Basilica sa Vatican para kay Pope Francis.
english: The Archdiocese of Jaro will hold a mass at 4 pm tomorrow, April 26, to coincide with the Funeral Mass at Saint Peter's Basilica in the Vatican for Pope Francis.

english: In a pastoral announcement, Jaro Archbishop Most Reverend Midyphil Billones, D.D., said the mass will be held at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral for the “eternal repose” of the Pope.

text:
Gina-request ang clergy, religious, kag lay faithful ilabi na sa syudad nga mag-upod sa Holy Mass samtang ginahaylo naman ang mga parokya sa idalom sang archdiocese nga magpatigayon man sang misa para nga makapangamuyo sang tingob para sa “spiritual solidarity.”

“For those who may not be able to join this due to previously accepted schedules, kindly do it at the soonest pastorally suitable time.
english:
Clergy, religious, and lay faithful especially in the city are requested to join the Holy Mass while parishes under the archdiocese are encouraged to hold masses so that they can pray together for “spiritual solidarity.”

“For those who may not be able to join this due to previously accepted schedules, kindly do it at the soonest pastorally suitable time.

text: In line with this, the Commission on Liturgy is tasked to facilitate the liturgical celebration and guidelines,” suno sa Archdiocese.
english: In line with this, the Commission on Liturgy is tasked to facilitate the liturgical celebration and guidelines,” according to the Archdiocese.

text: “In this period of mourning, let us unite in faith and love as we commend our beloved Pope Francis to the mercy of the Risen Lord,” dugang pa sa pastoral announcement.
english: “In this period of mourning, let us unite in faith and love as we commend our beloved Pope Francis to the mercy of the Risen Lord,” the pastoral announcement added.

english: Jose Marie Amado Delgado, Parish Team Ministry Moderator, it began on Monday night where before the vigil, the lectors and the commentators ministry led the prayer of the Holy Rosary which is a petition for the intentions of Pope Francis.

text: Magabyahe padulong Amerika si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will travel to the United States.

text: sa Domingo, Hulyo 20, agud pagatun-an ang mga isyu nga may kaangtanan sa Pilipinas kag iduso ang interes sang mga Pilipino.
english: on Sunday, July 20, to study issues related to the Philippines and promote the interests of Filipinos.

text: Suno kay Foreign Affairs Assistant Secretary Raquel Solano, una sa agenda ni Pres.
english: According to Foreign Affairs Assistant Secretary Raquel Solano, first on the agenda of Pres.

text: Marcos sa iya pagpakigsapol kay U.S. President Donald Trump amo ang pag-istoryahanay angot sa 20% nga reciprocal tariff nga ginpatuman sang Amerika sa mga produkto sang Pilipinas.
english: Marcos in his meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump was to discuss the 20% reciprocal tariff imposed by the United States on Philippine products.

text: Ginpahayag ni Solano nga may mga opisyal na sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas ang yara na sa Washington D.C. subong, kag nagapadayon ang negosasyon bahin sa nasambit nga isyu.
english: Solano said some Philippine government officials are already in Washington D.C. now, and negotiations are ongoing on the said issue.

english: Marcos, it is possible to reach a bilateral trade agreement or agreement on reciprocal trade that will benefit both countries.

text: Sa bahin naman sang seguridad kag depensa, ginpaathag ni Solano nga posible man maestoryahan sang duha ka lider ang mga developments sa West Philippine Sea.
english: On security and defense, Solano explained that the two leaders may also discuss developments in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Ginalauman man nga pinaagi sa sining pagbisita, makakuha liwat ang Pilipinas sang dugang nga suporta halin sa Amerika para sa pagpakusog sang kapasidad kag kagamitan sang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) kag Philippine Coast Guard (PCG).
english: It is also hoped that through this visit, the Philippines will again get additional support from the United States for strengthening the capacity and equipment of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and Philippine Coast Guard (PCG).

text: Ginpatung-an na sang pwersa sang kapulisan ang ginamo nga natabo sa University of California in Los Angeles (UCLA) campus sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika matapos nga gin-atake sang Israeli supporters ang kampo nga gintukod sang pro-Palestinian protesters.
english: Police forces have intervened in the riots that occurred on the University of California in Los Angeles (UCLA) campus in the United States of America after Israeli supporters attacked a camp set up by pro-Palestinian protesters.

text: Sa footages nga nagguwa, makit-an nga may bitbit nga mga stick kag tubo ang iban nga tawo agud nga gub-on ang nga boards nga amo naman ang ginhimo sang pro-Palestinian protesters nga makeshift barricade.
english: In the footage that came out, some people were seen carrying sticks and pipes to destroy the boards that the pro-Palestinian protesters made into a makeshift barricade.

text: May mga lalaki naman nga counter-demonstrators nga naka-maskara kag maathag nga mas tigulang sangsa mga estudyante.
english: There were male counter-demonstrators wearing masks and clearly older than the students.

text: Sila ang nagpanghaboy sang mga gamit agud nga gub-on man ang barikada nga ginhimo sang pro-Palestinians.
english: They threw objects to destroy the barricade built by the pro-Palestinians.

text: Sa New York, ginkakas ang protest encampment kag gin-aresto ang yara sa 300 ka mga pro-Palestinian demonstrators nga nagtinir sa building sa Columbia University.
english: In New York, a protest encampment was dismantled and about 300 pro-Palestinian demonstrators staying in a building at Columbia University were arrested.

text: Nagsaka pa ang police officers sa bintana sa ikaduha nga panalgan sang Hamilton Building nga amo ang gina-okupar sang mga nagaprotesta halin pa sang Martes.
english: Police officers even climbed out of a window on the second floor of the Hamilton Building, which has been occupied by protesters since Tuesday.

text: Samtang nga ginakarga ang detainees sa bus, padayon sa pagsinggit ang protesters sang “Free, free, free Palestine!” samtang may iban naman nga nagasinggitan nga hilwayon ang mga estudyante.
english: As the detainees were loaded onto the bus, protesters continued to shout “Free, free, free Palestine!” while others were shouting for the students to be released.

text: Naghingyo man ang university president nga patiniron ang pulis tubtub sa Mayo 17 ukon duha ka adlaw matapos ang graduation agud nga mapabilin man ang kalinong sa eskwelahan kag masigurado nga indi na masulit ang pagtukod sang protesters sang kampo sa sulod sang unibersidad.
english: The university president also requested that the police be deployed until May 17 or two days after graduation in order to maintain peace in the school and ensure that protesters will not repeat the establishment of a camp inside the university.

text:
Ini nga masangkad ang protesta sang mga estudyante sa Amerika ang kasunod sang mas nagasangkad man nga Israel-Hamas war sa Middle East kun sa diin linibo na ka mga sibilyan ang napatay sa Gaza kag mas ginakahangaw-an nga magdamo pa kun padayunon sang Israel ang ground offensive sa syudad sang Rafah nga amo ang ginatiniran sang kalabanan nga mga pumuluyo.#

(Photo: WDET)
english:
The protest by the students in the United States follows the escalating Israel-Hamas war in the Middle East where thousands of civilians have been killed in Gaza and are feared to increase if Israel continues its ground offensive in the city of Rafah, where most of the population lives.

(Photo: WDET)

text: Patay ang 24 ka mga tawo matapos nga nag-collapse ang parte sang highway sa probinsya sang Guangdong sa China kasunod sang mabaskog nga pag-ulan.
english: At least 24 people have been killed after part of a highway in China's Guangdong province collapsed following heavy rains.

text: Bangud naghumok ang duta kag natiphag, 20 ka mga salakyan ang na-trap kun sa diin 54 tanan ka mga tawo ang involved.
english: Because the ground softened and collapsed, 20 vehicles were trapped with 54 people involved.

text: Magluwas sa mga napatay, 30 ka iban pa nga mga tawo ang gindala sa ospital apang subong estable naman ang mga kondisyon.
english: Besides the dead, 30 other people were taken to hospital but are now in stable condition.

text: Nagbuligay naman ang malapit 500 ka mga tawo sa site nga nag-collapse para makapatigayon sang rescue operation.
english: Nearly 500 people at the collapsed site worked together to conduct a rescue operation.

text: Ini nga insidente amo ang pinakaulihi sa sunod-sunod nga natabo nga naangot sa malain nga tyempo sa Guangdong sa sulod na sang pila ka sinemana.
english: The incident is the latest in a series of bad weather-related incidents in Guangdong for several weeks.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, apat man ka mga tawo ang patay sa pagbaha samtang sang nagligad nga semana, lima ka tawo ang patay sa buhawi sa Guangzhou.
english: Last month, four people were also killed in flooding while last week, five people were killed in a typhoon in Guangzhou.

text: Indi normal ang pagbubo sang ulan sini nga tyempo sa China kag ginaangot man sa nagalala man nga climate change.
english: The rainfall is abnormal in China and is also linked to the worsening climate change.

text: Indi makaupod si First Lady Liza Marcos sa official visit ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa masunod nga semana.

text: Matandaan nga sa nauna nga kumpirmasyon sang Malacañang, magabisita ang punong ehekutibo sa Washington kag makigkita kay US President Donald Trump halin sa Hulyo 20-22.
english: It can be recalled that according to earlier confirmation by Malacañang, the chief executive will visit Washington and meet with US President Donald Trump from July 20-22.

text: Natalana pa nga magpaguwa ang Palasyo sang dugang nga detalye sa amo nga byahe.
english: The Palace is scheduled to release more details on the trip.

english: Among the initial information is that part of the delegation this year are Trade Secretary Cristina Roque and Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic Affairs Frederick D. Go to push for a reduction in the 20 percent US tariff on Philippine goods.

english: This is Marcos' fifth visit to the US since taking office in 2022; and first official visit since Trump’s election in November 2024.

text: Matandaan nga sang Abril sang nagligad nga tuig, sang nagbisita si Marcos sa US para sa trilateral meeting kaupod ang US kag Japan, wala man ang First Lady.
english: It can be recalled that in April last year, when Marcos visited the US for a trilateral meeting with the US and Japan, the First Lady was also absent.

text: Napalibutan sang kontrobersiya ang iya pag-absent subong nga tuig bangud sang mga espekulasyon nga nagaangot sa iya sa kamatayon sang Rustan’s executive nga si Paolo Tantoco nga napatay sa Beverly Hills sang Marso isa ka adlaw matapos ginpatigayon ang Manila International Film Festival (MIFF) gala sa amo man nga hotel.
english: His absence this year was surrounded by controversy due to speculation linking him to the death of Rustan’s executive Paolo Tantoco who died in Beverly Hills in March a day after holding the Manila International Film Festival (MIFF) gala at the same hotel.

text: Ginbaha bangud sa mabaskog nga pag-ulan ang northern parts sang Kingdom of Saudi Arabia nga nagresulta sa road closures kag kanselasyon sang klase sa mga eskwelahan.
english: Ginbaha bangud sa mabaskog nga pag-ulan ang northern parts sang Kingdom of Saudi Arabia nga nagresulta sa road closures kag kanselasyon sang klase sa mga eskwelahan.

text: May nagluntad nga flash floods sa probinsiya sang Al-Ula kag Al-Madinah, nga ang puluy-an sang Al-Masjid Al-Nabawi,ang ikaduha nga holiest site sang Islam kag amo ang lugar kun sa diin ginlubong ang Propeta nga si Muhammad.
english: There were flash floods in the provinces of Al-Ula and Al-Madinah, which is home to Al-Masjid Al-Nabawi,the second holiest site of Islam and is the place where the Prophet Muhammad was buried.

text: Ini natabo pila ka adlaw matapos gin-igo man sang flash floods ang kaiping nga United Arab Emirates kag Oman.
english: This comes days after flash floods also hit the neighboring United Arab Emirates and Oman.

text: Sang Nobyembre 2022, gin – igo man ang Saudi Arabia sang coastal flooding bilang result sang mamunog nga ulan nga naghalit gid sa syudad sang Jeddah kun sa diin duha ka tawo ang patay.
english: In November 2022, Saudi Arabia was also hit by coastal flooding as a result of heavy rains that severely damaged the city of Jeddah, killing two people.

text: Ang pagbaha sa Jeddah ang naangot sa kakulang sa drainage system sa lugar.
english: The flooding in Jeddah is linked to the lack of drainage system in the area.

text: Nagpasa naman sang courtesy resignation si Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro.
english: Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro.

text: Ini ang kasuod sang mando ni Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Acting Secretary Dave Gomez nga dapat magpasa sang courtesy resignations ang tanan nga political appointees sa idalom sang amo nga opisina.
english: This is in line with the order of Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Acting Secretary Dave Gomez that all political appointees under the office must submit courtesy resignations.

text:
Naghatag si Gomez sang deadline nga Hulyo 18 agud nga makasumite sang unqualified courtesy resignations ang tanan nga appointees nga subject sa “pertinent civil service laws, rules and regulations.”

“This will give [Gomez] the leeway to choose the people he wants to work with at the PCO.
english:
Gomez gave a deadline of July 18 for all appointees to submit unqualified courtesy resignations subject to “pertinent civil service laws, rules and regulations.”

“This will give [Gomez] the leeway to choose the people he wants to work with at the PCO.

text: Of course, it is better if he is familiar with the people with whom he will be working with,” suno kay Atty. Castro.
english: Of course, it is better if he is familiar with the people with whom he will be working with,” according to Atty. Castro.

text: Pahayag pa sini, wala man siya sang nabatian nga reklamo sang Palasyo batok sa iya, ukon panawagan nga ipakakas siya sa posisyon.
english: He said he has not heard any complaints from the Palace against him, or calls for his removal.

text: Nagpanginwala man ini nga may mga panawagan nga hagan-haganon niya ang mga ginapanghambal sa daily briefings ukon ang iya pagsabat sa press.
english: He also denied that there were calls for him to tone down what was said in daily briefings or his response to the press.

text: “I think all they expect of me is to deliver the truth.
english: “I think all they expect of me is to deliver the truth.

text: Whatever I know and hold to be true, that is what I will stand for,” suno kay Castro.
english: Whatever I know and hold to be true, that is what I will stand for,” Castro said.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag si Gomez nga ini nga tikang ang kabahin sang “standard transition process.” Ginpahayag man sini nga himuon niya nga prayoridad ang performance audit sa ahensya para mangin patas kag mangin tampad ang serbisyo.
english: Earlier, Gomez said the move is part of the “standard transition process.” He also said he will make the performance audit in the agency a priority to ensure fairness and transparency in the service.

text: “Until any action is taken by the Undersigned on such courtesy resignations, all Undersecretaries, Assistant Secretaries and Directors of the PCO-Central Office and Heads and other Presidential Appointees of Attached Agencies shall continue to report for work and perform their usual duties and responsibilities, subject to any modification that the new leadership of PCO may deem proper to adopt in the meantime,” kabahin sang memorandum nga gin-isyu sang opisyal.
english: “Until any action is taken by the Undersigned on such courtesy resignations, all Undersecretaries, Assistant Secretaries and Directors of the PCO-Central Office and Heads and other Presidential Appointees of Attached Agencies shall continue to report for work and perform their usual duties and responsibilities, subject to any modification that may be proposed by the new PCO adopt in the meantime,” was part of the memorandum issued by the official.

text: Nagakahulugan ini nga magapabilin si Castro nga PCO undersecretary magluwas lang kun batunon ni Gomez ang iya paghalin sa pwesto.#
english: This means that Castro will remain PCO undersecretary unless Gomez accepts his resignation.
