text: ILOILO CITY – Ipatawag ni Iloilo City Councilor Ely Estante ang tanan nga concerned parties agud istoryahan ang reklamo sang mga fish vendors sa mga merkado publiko sa syudad batok sa mga naga-retail sang isda sa sulod mismo sang Iloilo Fishing Port rason nga diutay nalang ang nagabakal sa mga merkado publiko.
english: ILOILO CITY – Iloilo City Councilor Ely Estante will summon all concerned parties to discuss the complaint of fish vendors in public markets in the city against those who retail fish inside the Iloilo Fishing Port.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Councilor Ely Estante, chairman sang Committee on Market and Slaughterhouse  sa City Council, iya ginpahayag nga sapulon niya ang manager sang Fishing port, mga fish brokers, mga asosasyon sang mga fish vendors, kag mga opisyal sang Barangay Tanza Baybay, Iloilo City Proper sa diin nahamtang ang Fishing port.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Councilor Ely Estante, chairman of the Committee on Market and Slaughterhouse in the City Council, said he will meet with the manager of the fishing port, fish brokers, associations of fish vendors, and officials of Barangay Tanza Baybay, Iloilo City Proper where the fishing port is located.

text: Suno kay Estante, ini agud maistoryahan kag masolusyunan ang problema sang mga vendors.
english: According to Estante, this is to discuss and solve the problems of the vendors.

text: Ginpahayag man niya nga katuyuan man sang pagsinapol ang posibilidad nga ma-regulate ang baligyaanay sang isda ilabi na nga sakop sang syudad sang Iloilo ang Fishing port.
english: He also said that the purpose of the meeting was the possibility of regulating the sale of fish especially since the fishing port is part of Iloilo City.

text: Nagpasar ang Iloilo City Council sang resolution nga nagahatag sang otoridad kay Mayor Jerry Treñas nga iplastar sang mga abogado sang City Legal Office ang pag-rescind sang kontrata sa tunga sang syudad kag Double Dragon Properties  Corporation nga naga- manage sang Iloilo Ferry Terminal.
english: The Iloilo City Council passed a resolution authorizing Mayor Jerry Treñas to have the lawyers of the City Legal Office file the rescission of the contract between the city and Double Dragon Properties Corporation that manages the Iloilo Ferry Terminal.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Rex Sarabia, chairman sang Committee on Appropriations sa konseho, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang ginatan-aw nga nagakaigo nga tikang sang syudad bangud sa pagpakatig-a sang Double Dragon nga liwaton ukon bag-uhon ang kaundan sang agreement nga indi bentaha para sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Rex Sarabia, chairman of the Committee on Appropriations in the council, said that this is seen as an appropriate step by the city due to the insistence of Double Dragon to revise or change the contents of the agreement which is not advantageous for the city.

text: Suno kay Sarabia, pila ka beses na nga ginatinguhaan sang syudad nga makignegosyar sa amo nga kompaniya apang wala man nagapakita ang sin-o man nga tiglawas sang Double Dragon.
english: Sarabia said the city has tried several times to negotiate with the company but no Double Dragon representative has shown up.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa sa ginaduso sang syudad amo ang equitable revenue-sharing agud mas makabenepisyo ang syudad sa operasyon sang terminal.
english: It is known that one of the proposals of the city is equitable revenue-sharing so that the city can benefit more from the operation of the terminal.

text: Base sa existing contract, may yara lamang sang 1-5% sang gross terminal revenues kag 1 percent halin sa iban nga sources kaangay sang berthing fees, cargo fees, kag mall rentals ang nagakadto sa syudad.
english: Based on the existing contract, only 1-5% of gross terminal revenues and 1 percent from other sources such as berthing fees, cargo fees, and mall rentals go to the city.

text: Nasaad man sa agreement nga kinahanglan magpasa ang Double Dragon sang annual operations kag maintenance reports sa city mayor apang ini nga reports ang kulang sa transparency kag public accessibility.
english: The agreement also states that Double Dragon must submit annual operations and maintenance reports to the city mayor but these reports lack transparency and public accessibility.

text: Madumduman nga napirmahan ang agreement sang tion ni anay Mayor Jed Mabilog sang 2012 kag ini ang may 25-year term kag may optional renewal nga 25 ka tuig depende sa desisyon sang Double Dragon.
english: The agreement was signed during the tenure of former Mayor Jed Mabilog in 2012 and has a 25-year term and an optional renewal of 25 years depending on the decision of the Double Dragon.

text: ILOILO CITY- Tatlo ka dalagko nga mga infrastructure projects ang ginalauman nga magasulod sa Syudad sang Iloilo subong nga tuig 2019 kag 2020.
english: ILOILO CITY- Three major infrastructure projects are expected to enter Iloilo City this year 2019 and 2020.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Councilor Ely Estante, chairman sang Committee on Infrastructure sa Iloilo City Council, iya ginpahayag nga bilyones pesos ang balor sang nasambit nga mga proyekto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Councilor Ely Estante, chairman of the Committee on Infrastructure in the Iloilo City Council, said the projects are worth billions of pesos.

text: Suno kay Estante, una diri ang construction sang dalan nga nagalapad sang 20 metros nga magaumpisa sa entrance sang Iloilo Fishing Port pasulod sa fishing port,kag maagi sa likod sang North Baluarte, Boulevard, kag Calumpang sa Molo pakadto sa Calaparan, Sto Niño Sur kag Norte sa Arevalo tubtob sa Alegre, Oton.
english: According to Estante, the first is the construction of a 20-meter-wide road that will start from the entrance of the Iloilo Fishing Port into the fishing port, and pass behind North Baluarte, Boulevard, and Calumpang in Molo to Calaparan, Sto Niño Sur and Norte in Arevalo to Alegre, Oton.

text: Ini nga proyekto nga nagabalor P1.2 billion pesos ang may component nga drainage, elevated nga karsada kag dike.
english: The project, which is worth P1.2 billion pesos, has a component of drainage, elevated road and dike.

text: Ikaduha, ang construction sang railway road nga nagalapad sang 20 metros kag nagalaba sang 20 metros.
english: Second, the construction of a railway road that is 20 meters wide and 20 meters long.

text: Ini nga proyekto nga nagabalor sang P20 million ang magasugod sa eskina sang McArthur padulong sa Rizal, Lapaz.
english: This project worth P20 million will start from the corner of McArthur to Rizal, Lapaz.

text: Ang ikatatlo amo ang conversion sang local road kag himuon nga national road sa Donato Pison Avenue sa Mandurriao, Iloilo City sa diin pagabutangan ini sang 20 metros ka laba nga  dalan kag may apat man ka lanes.
english: The third is the conversion of the local road into a national road on Donato Pison Avenue in Mandurriao, Iloilo City where it will be equipped with a 20 meter long road and four lanes.

text: Suno kay Estante, sa subong proposal pa lang ini nga mga proyekto kag kinahanglan pa nga mapangitaan sang pondo.
english: According to Estante, these projects are still proposals and need to be funded.

text: Namurag-muragan ang mga residente sang Taiwan bangud sa pagtay-og na naman sang magkasunod nga linog kaina sang kaagahon.
english: Taiwan residents were shocked by another series of earthquakes this morning.

text: Ang una nga may magnitude 6.1 ang nag-igu sa eastern county sang Hualien.
english: The first one with a magnitude of 6.1 hit the eastern county of Hualien.

text: Ang ikaduha naman nga magnitude 5.8 ang nag-igu man sa kaangay nga lokasyon kag nag-uyog man sang mga building pati sa kapital sang Taiwan nga Taipei.
english: A second magnitude 5.8 earthquake struck the same location and shook buildings including the Taiwanese capital Taipei.

text: Nahibaluan nga masobra na sa 1,000 ang aftershocks halin sang natabo ang 7.2 magnitude nga linog sa Hualien sa temprano nga bahin subong nga bulan kun sa diin 17 ka mga tawo ang napatay.
english: More than 1,000 aftershocks have been felt since the 7.2 magnitude earthquake in Hualien earlier this month that killed 17 people.

text: Wala pa subong sang na-report nga damage kaangot sa ulihi natabo nga linog.
english: No damage has been reported in connection with the later quake.

text: Ano bala kalawig ang date kun bag-o lang kamo nagkitaay sang isa ka tawo nga posible mo maka-relasyon?
english: How long is a date if you just met someone you might have a relationship with?

text:
Para sa isa ka babaye sa Auburn, Alabama, USA, gina-uyatan niya ang record sang “shortest first date — ever!”

Gin-istorya ni Maggie Smith, 32, nga may yara siya sang nakilala nga lalaki sa isa ka dating app tubtub nga nag-sugtanay sila nga magkitaay sang personal.
english:
For one woman in Auburn, Alabama, USA, she holds the record of “shortest first date — ever!”

Maggie Smith, 32, recounted how she met a man on a dating app until they agreed to meet in person.

text: Sa guwa sang isa ka restaurant, nagtabuay si Maggie kag ang iya ka-date, ginkup-an pa siya sini, kag ginpamangkot kun nagutom na siya.
english: Outside a restaurant, Maggie and her date met, he hugged her, and asked if she was hungry.

text: Ginhagad siya sini nga magsulod sa restaurant para magkaon, kag nauna pa gani si Maggie sa paglakat kag sa iya naman likod ang lalaki.
english: He invited her into the restaurant for dinner, and Maggie even walked ahead of him with the man behind her.

text: Wala pa gani sila nakapungko, ginpapundo siya anay sang lalaki kag naghingyo kun pwede sila maka-istoryahanay.
english: Before they could even sit down, the man stopped her and asked if they could talk.

text: Sang nakaguwa na sila sa restaurant, nagprangka ang lalaki kag nagsiling, “I’m sorry.
english: Once they were out of the restaurant, the man candidly said, “I’m sorry.

text:
I’m just not feeling it.”

Na-shock ang babaye kag basta-basta na lang nga naglakat ang lalaki kag nagmato-mato na man lang drive pauli si Maggie.
english:
I’m just not feeling it.”

The woman was shocked and the man just walked away and Maggie drove home.

text: Indi sini mahangpan kun ano ang rason kun nga 45 seconds lang gid ang kalawigon sang iya first date.
english: He doesn't understand why his first date is only 45 seconds long.

text: Pahayag pa sini, todo-make up pa siya antes naglakat.
english: She said she was still wearing make up before leaving.

text: Suspetsa pa sini, matuod nga daku ang iya lawas apang wala man niya ini ginatago sa dating profiles bangud may pictures siya nga yara ang tanan nga angle kag wala man sang filters.
english: He suspected that it is true that he has a big body but he does not hide it in his dating profiles because he has pictures with all the angles and no filters.

text: Nagapati man siya nga indi weight factor ang rason bangud sa gab-i antes ang ila date, nagsiling pa ang lalaki nga nagaka-impress gid siya sa personality, intelligence, kag drive ni Maggie.
english: He also believes that the weight factor is not the reason because the night before their date, the man said that he was very impressed with Maggie's personality, intelligence, and drive.

text: Sigurado man ini nga wala siya naghimo sang catfishing ukon ang paghimo sang fake online identity para makapanunto kaangay sang pagkawat sang personal information para makatindog bilang fake persona.
english: He also made sure that he did not do catfishing or creating a fake online identity to cheat like stealing personal information to stand as a fake person.

text: Positibo ang reactions kag madamo ang nag-encourage kay Maggie nga indi madulaan sang self-confidence matapos nga gin-share sini online ang iya eksperyensya.
english: The reactions were positive and many encouraged Maggie not to lose her self-confidence after she shared her experience online.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga wala siya nadulaan sang kumpyansa sa kaugalingon bangud may duha siya ka trabaho, padayon ang pag-upod sa iya mga abyan, kag masami nagalantaw sang soccer games.
english: He also said that he has not lost his self-confidence because he has two jobs, continues to hang out with his friends, and often watches soccer games.

text: Labi sa tanan, open siya gihapon makipag-date, apang subong, gin-delete sini anay ang dating app sa iya smartphone bangud nagapati siya nga indi pa ini maayo subong sa iya nga mental health.
english: Above all, he is still open to dating, but now, he deleted the dating app on his smartphone because he believes it is not good for his mental health.

text: INDI naton masuay ang binubuot sang Diyos nga aton Manunuga (Creator) kag Mahal nga Ginoo.
english: We cannot go against the will of God our Creator and Lord.

text: Yara Siya sa ibabaw sang tanan sa Iya wala tupong nga kapinasahe, kag ang tanan yara sa idalom sang Iya gahum.
english: He is above all in His incomparable majesty, and all are under His power.

text: Tungod sini ang tanan nga nagakatabo either ginatugutan Niya nga hilway matabo ukon direkta Niya ginapatuman para sa Iya Divine Purposes, katulad sang paggamit sang pila Niya ka tinuga sa mga misyon nga luyag Niya patigayunon.
english: Therefore, everything that happens is either allowed to happen freely or directly implemented by Him for His Divine Purposes, such as the use of some of His creatures in the missions He wants to carry out.

text: Pero, wala kita dapat kabalak-an sa Diyos, labi na gid ang mga “mainunungon (faithful) sa Iya kag sang Iya mga kasuguan.
english: However, we should not worry about God, especially those who are “faithful to Him and His commandments.

text: Ang Diyos Maayo (good), Matarong (Just), Mahigugmaon  (loving) kag Maluluy-on (Merciful), nga indi naton dapat pangduha-duhaan pa.
english: God is Good, Just, Loving and Merciful, which we should not doubt.

text: Sa madamo nga kahigayunan, ugaling, indi naton mahangpan kon ngaa ginatugutan ukon direkta nga ginapatuman Niya ang pila ka hitabo, nga pila sini indi naton gani matul-id sa aton experyensya kag lohika (correct human reasoning).
english: In many cases, however, we do not understand why He permits or directly enacts certain events, some of which we cannot even correct with our experience and logic (correct human reasoning).

text: Well, tawo man lang kita kag indi naton malab-ut ang tayog sang panghuna-huna kag ihibalo sang Diyos sa Iya wala tupong nga kinaalam.
english: Well, we are only human and we cannot reach the height of God's thoughts and knowledge in His incomparable wisdom.

text: Katulad sang kon ngaa ang mga maayo kag matarong kag bisan ang “faithful” sa Iya kinahanglan mag-antos, mapahilayo sa ila mga hinigugma, ukon malutos bisan sa manugdaug na nga sitwasyon.
english: Like why the good and righteous and even the “faithful” to Him must suffer, be separated from their loved ones, or be defeated even in a winning situation.

text: God knows best, no doubt, kag kinahanglan lang nga magsalig kita sa Iya sa ano man nga matabo.
english: God knows best, no doubt, and we just need to trust Him with whatever happens.

text:
***

Sa madamo nga indi makapati nga mapierde sila sa nagligad nga eleksyon kon limpyo lang ang kampanyahanay, kag kon napierde gid man sila tungod lang sa fake news, patalang nga balita kag himo-himo nga pasibangod, wala na kita mahimo dira.
english:
***

For many who cannot believe that they would have lost the last election if the campaign had been clean, and if they really lost because of fake news, misleading news and fabricated excuses, there is nothing we can do about it.

text: Natapos na ang inisipay nga sa daku nga abanse sang pangontra indi na malubag pa bisan may dinayaay kag may kademonyuhan pa sila nga ginhimo.
english: The thought that the great advance of the opposition will not be broken even if they have done something deceitful and demonic is over.

text: Gintugot ina sang Diyos nga matabo, nga sa kon ano man nga rason angot sa Iya Divine purposes dapat batunon ta na kag diskubrihon lang sa aton konsyensya kon ano gid ang luyag sang Diyos matabo despues.
english: God allowed that to happen, that for whatever reason regarding His Divine purposes we must accept it and discover in our conscience what God really wants to happen next.

text: Indi ayhan natabo ining kapaslawan tungod luyag sang Diyos matungkad gid ang aton balatyagon sa ka-importante sinang mga hitabo agud mapakita sa Iya ang mas mabungahon pa nga mga hilikuton?
english: Didn't this failure happen because God wanted us to feel the importance of those events so that we could show Him more fruitful activities?

text: Kon amo, kinahanglan gid mapabakud pa ang “coalition” sang mga pumuluyo nga nasuguran na sang eleksyon pa agud lubos na mapunggan ang nagaluntad sa subong kag ang posible nga pagbalik sang authoritarian rule katulad sang martial law regime sang amay sang nagdaug na nga Presidente.
english: If so, it is necessary to strengthen the coalition of the people that was started before the elections in order to fully prevent the current situation and the possible return of authoritarian rule such as the martial law regime of the father of the winning President.

text: Pero, sa napanugyan na naton sa ibabaw, dapat batunon  na naton ang kadalag-an sang mga nagdalaug.
english: However, as we have already suggested above, we should accept the victory of the winners.

text: Kag bantayan lang dayon ang ila hulag nga makapalain sa kawsa sang aton Demokrasya kag Kahilwayan.
english: And just watch out for their actions that will harm the cause of our Democracy and Freedom.

text: Of course, kon maayo man lang ang ila ginahimo, dapat wala kita reklamo dira.
english: Of course, if they're doing a good job, we shouldn't complain about it.

text: Updan ang matarong nga hilikuton nila apang indi ang ila kademonyuhan!
english: Join their righteous work but not their demonism!

text:
***

Ginadayaw naton ang 10 ka pungsod sa ila panikasug agud maaway ang Climate Change.
english:
***

We applaud the 10 countries for their efforts to fight Climate Change.

text: Isa dira ang Denmark.
english: Denmark is one of them.

text: Nag-invest ini sa highways sa lugar nga itukod ang electrified railroads.
english: It invested in highways in the area where electrified railroads would be built.

text: Belgium, nga nagsugod na sa pagpauntat sang nabilin pa nila nga coal-powered plant.
english: Belgium, which has already begun shutting down its remaining coal-powered plants.

text: Portugal, sa pag-promote sang “low-carbon economy”sa ila “Commitment to Green growth”.
english: Portugal, to promote a “low-carbon economy” in their “Commitment to Green growth”.

text: Malta, sa pag-shift sa solar power plants sa ila energy generation.
english: Malta, to shift to solar power plants in their energy generation.

text: Luxembourg, nga nag-komiter sing 20% drop sa ila CO2 emission.
english: Luxembourg, which has committed to a 20% drop in its CO2 emission.

text: Nagsugod ini sang 4% drop sa ila CO2 emission sadtong 2015-2016.
english: This started with a 4% drop in their CO2 emission in 2015-2016.

text: Morocco, nga nag-komiter na sa pagsaylo sa wind, solar kag hydro power generation.
english: Morocco, which has already committed to moving to wind, solar and hydro power generation.

text: Cyprus, nag-drop sang ila CO2 emmission sing 3% kada tuig halin sadtong 2008.
english: Cyprus, has dropped its CO2 emissions by 3% per year since 2008.

text: United Kingdom.
english: United Kingdom.

text: Sadtong April 21, 2017 nag-celebarte ini sang ila una nga 24-hour period nga wala coal power.
english: On April 21, 2017, it celebrated its first 24-hour period without coal power.

text: Nag-komiter man ini sa pagpauntat sang ila katapusan nga coal-powered plant sa 2025.
english: It also committed to decommissioning its last coal-powered plant by 2025.

text: Sweden.
english: Sweden.

text: Naga-import sang garbage (basura) agud padalaganon ang ila recycling plant.
english: Importing garbage to run their recycling plant.

text: Nag-komiter man sa pag-shift sa renewable energy katulad sang wind, solar kag hydropower  pag-abot sang 2040.
english: It also committed to shifting to renewable energy such as wind, solar and hydropower by 2040.

text: France.
english: France.

text: Ini ang pungsod nga naga-coordinate sang Paris Agreement nga ginsugdan sadtong 2015, nga ginapilit mangin madinalag-on bisan pa sang pagpamalabag sang pila ka nasyon, lakip ang US sa panahon ni Presidente Trump.
english: It is the country that coordinates the Paris Agreement launched in 2015, which is being pushed to be successful despite the opposition of some countries, including the US during the era of President Trump.

text: Nagbalik lang ang US sa Paris Agreement sang pagpungko na ni Presidente Biden.
english: The US only rejoined the Paris Agreement when President Biden took office.

text: Samtang, wala pa man gani nila mapatuman ang kompensasyon sa mga gagmay nga mga pungsod nga nahalitan sang greenhouse gases nga ginapalapta sa bug-os nga kalibutan sang mga industrialized nations./PN
english: Meanwhile, they have not even implemented compensation to small countries damaged by greenhouse gases being emitted around the world by industrialized nations./PN

text: Handa ang Iran sa gyera batok sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika pananglitan mag-intra ini sa nagakatabo subong nga tensyon kag lapnagon nga hublag-protesta sa Tehran.
english: Iran is ready for war against the United States of America if it gets involved in the current tensions and widespread protests in Tehran.

text: “If Washington wants to test the military option it has tested before, we are ready for it,” suno kay Iran Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi.
english: “If Washington wants to test the military option it has tested before, we are ready for it,” according to Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi.

text: Apang dugang niya, nagalaum siya nga pilion man sang US ang mas maalam nga desisyon nga amo ang dayalogo.
english: But he added that he hoped the US would also choose the wiser decision, which is dialogue.

text: Nagbuya man ini sang paandam batok sa mga nagasulsol sa US nga mag-intra sa gyera agud nga makaserbe para sa interes sang Israel.
english: He also sounded a warning against those who incite the US to join the war in order to serve Israel's interests.

text: Ini nga pahayag sang foreign minister ang kasunod sang komento ni US President Donald Trump nga ginakonsider sini ang “strong options” para sa Iran — lakip na ang potensyal nga military action.
english: This statement by the foreign minister follows comments by US President Donald Trump that he is considering “strong options” for Iran — including potential military action.

text: Sang Domingo, nagpahayag man si Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf nga ang US military kag Israel ang mangin “legitimate targets” kun manghilabot ang US sa ginamo subong sa Iran.
english: On Sunday, Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf also said the US military and Israel would be “legitimate targets” if the US intervened in the current unrest in Iran.

text: As of press time, nagdangat na sa 648 ang numero sang protesters nga napatay.
english: As of press time, the number of protesters killed has risen to 648.

text: Nagpaandam man ang Norway-based human rights group nga magsaka pa ang death toll, apang mabudlay ang pagtipon sang beripikado nga impormasyon bangud sang nationwide communications blackout nga apat na subong ka adlaw.
english: The Norway-based human rights group also warned that the death toll could rise, but it was difficult to gather verified information due to the nationwide communications blackout that has been in place for four days.

text: Magluwas sa mga napatay, may 10,700 man nga ginpang-aresto.
english: In addition to the dead, 10,700 were arrested.

text: Nagsabat naman una ang Iranian leaders nga ginasuportahan sang iban nga mga pungsod ang anti-government demonstrations.
english: Iranian leaders first responded that other countries support the anti-government demonstrations.

text:
Gin-akusahan naman ni Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei ang US politicians sang “deception.”

Nagsugod ang protesta sa Iran sang Disyembre 28 sang naakig ang mga tawo bangud sang pagluya sang balor sang Iranian currency nga rial batok sa US Dollar sa Open Market.
english:
Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei accused US politicians of “deception.”

The protests in Iran began on December 28 when people were angered by the depreciation of the Iranian currency the rial against the US Dollar on the Open Market.

text: Nagsarurot ang rial sa record low sang nagligad nga tuig, kag nagpanglakaak naman ang inflation sa 40% nga nagresulta sa pagsaka sang presyo sa adlaw-adlaw nga kinahanglanon kaangay sang cooking oil kag karne.
english: The rial fell to a record low last year, and inflation soared to 40%, resulting in rising prices for daily necessities such as cooking oil and meat.

text: Sunod man nga nag-intra ang mga estudyante sa demonstrasyon.
english: Students also joined the demonstration next.

text: Madamo ang nagpanawagan sa pagbag-o sa pulitika.
english: Many called for political change.

text: Lakip sa ginasinggit sang iban amo ang pagpamatok sa Supreme Leader sang pungsod.
english: Among the slogans of others is opposition to the country's Supreme Leader.

text: Sandig sa US-based Iranian Human Rights Activists News Agency, naglapta na ang demonstrasyon sa 186 ka mga syudad kag banwa sa 31 ka mga probinsya sang pungsod.#
english: According to the US-based Iranian Human Rights Activists News Agency, the demonstrations have spread to 186 cities and towns in 31 provinces of the country.

text: Nahiligan mo naman bala nga maggamit sang chopsticks kun ikaw ang magkaon?
english: Do you like to use chopsticks when you eat?

text: Madamo na sa aton ang na impluwensyahan sang Koreans ukon Japanese nga maggamit naman sang chopsticks.
english: Many of us have been influenced by the Koreans or Japanese to use chopsticks.

text: Apang, magluwas nga makalimit ini sa amount sang pagkaon saimo nga baba, ang chopsticks ang may maayo man nga epekto sa aton nga utok.
english: However, besides limiting the amount of food in your mouth, chopsticks also have a positive effect on our brain.

text: Suno kay Lijuan Sun, nutritionist sa Clinical Nutrition Research Centre sa Singapore kag base man sa pagtuon nga ginpublish sa Physiology & Behavior, ang chopstick ang maayo para sa coordination training.
english: According to Lijuan Sun, nutritionist at the Clinical Nutrition Research Center in Singapore and also based on a study published in Physiology & Behavior, chopsticks are good for coordination training.

text: Ang pagkaon man sang rice gamit ang chopsticks ang makapanubo sang glycemic response kag makabulig sa weight loss.
english: Eating rice with chopsticks can also reduce the glycemic response and help with weight loss.

text: Ang paggamit sang chopsticks ang important training para sa lawas kag utok.
english: Using chopsticks is important training for the body and brain.

text: Ini nga utensil ang beneficial para sa mga kabataan kag mga tawo nga naga suprir sang neurological trauma.
english: This utensil is beneficial for children and people who suffer from neurological trauma.

text: Samtang, indi lang ang lawas sang tawo ang makabenepisyo sa paggamit sang chopsticks, amu man ang aton nga palibot bangud madamo sa mga ini ang himo sa eco-friendly materials.
english: Meanwhile, not only the human body can benefit from using chopsticks, but also our environment because many of them are made of eco-friendly materials.

text: Ang mga disposable chopsticks ang human sa 100% biodegradable bamboo.
english: The disposable chopsticks are made of 100% biodegradable bamboo.

text: Nagnegatibo sa iligal nga druga ang mga personnel sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) nga nagpadaidalom sa mandatory drug testing sang nagligad nga Marso 3, 2026.
english: The personnel of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) who underwent mandatory drug testing last March 3, 2026 tested negative for illegal drugs.

text: 269 ka mga personnel ang nagpaidalom sa amo nga test.
english: 269 ​​personnel underwent the test.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang ICPO, iya ginpahayag nga importante ang mandatory drug test bangud kabahin ini sang internal cleansing program sang mga kapulisan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the ICPO, said the mandatory drug test is important because it is part of the internal cleansing program of the police.

text: Suno pa sa iya, ang nasambit nga programa amo may tinutuyo nga mapabilin ang integridad, disiplina, kag propesyonalismo sa mga police personnel.
english: He said the program aims to maintain integrity, discipline, and professionalism among police personnel.

text: Ang nasambit nga mandatory drug testing amo ang regular nga ginapatigayon sa mga kapulisan kada bulan.
english: The said mandatory drug testing is regularly conducted among the police every month.

text: Nagapati si 1-Tahanan Partylist Rep.
english: 1-Tahanan Partylist Rep.

text: Nathaniel Oducado nga temporaryo lang nga solusyon ang fuel subsidy sang gobyerno kag ang pagduso nga mapasar ang pagsuspend sang excise tax.
english: Nathaniel Oducado said the government's fuel subsidy and the proposal to pass the suspension of the excise tax are only temporary solutions.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Congressman Oducado, iya ginpahayag nga dako gid ang epekto sang gyera sa Middle East sa mga produktong petrolyo kun sa diin ang Pilipinas amo ang isa ka import laden country ukon dependent sa mga oil products sang iban nga pungsod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Congressman Oducado said the war in the Middle East has had a huge impact on petroleum products where the Philippines is an import laden country or dependent on oil products from other countries.

text: Suno sa kongresista, kinahanglan nga may ara gid sang mas mayo nga mapinsaran nga solusyon ang gobyerno agud indi na mabudlayan ang mga Pilipino kun magalawig pa ang gyera sa Middle East.
english: The congressman said the government must come up with a better solution so that Filipinos will not suffer if the war in the Middle East continues.

text: Dugang pa niya nga luyag man niya mahibal-an kun ano ang stratehiya sang pungsod subong nga padayun ang tension sa Middle East nga nagapanguna nga source sang produktong petrolyo.
english: He added that he also wants to know what the country's strategy is now that tensions in the Middle East, the main source of petroleum products, continue.

text: Nagpanginwala si Sunshine Cruz nga ginasakit siya sang bilyonaryo nga negosyante nga iya partner nga si Atong Ang.
english: Sunshine Cruz denied that she was being harassed by her billionaire businessman partner Atong Ang.

text: Sa iya latest post, ginpakita sang aktres ang screenshots sang mga post nga may “malisyoso” nga mga claim.
english: In her latest post, the actress showed screenshots of posts with “malicious” claims.

text: Iya ini gintawag nga “fake news” kag halin sa kwestyonable nga mga site.
english: He called it “fake news” and from questionable sites.

text: Lakip sa mga post ang nagasiling nga nagapangayo si Sunshine sang hustisya bangud ginasakit siya sang pisikal ni Atong.
english: Among the posts is that Sunshine is seeking justice because she is being physically abused by Atong.

text: Nagdugang pa si Sunshine nga indi dapat basta-basta nga mag-pati sa mga nakabutang sa internet bisan pa nga may picture kag may quote nga nakahimo-himo sa tupad sini.
english: Sunshine added that one should not just believe what is posted on the internet even if there is a picture and a quote that is made up next to it.

text: Matandaan nga 2024 sang ginkumpirma ni Atong ang relasyon nila sang aktres matapos nga nakit-an sila nga naga-kiss.
english: It can be recalled that Atong confirmed his relationship with the actress in 2024 after they were seen kissing.

text: Wala sang opisyal nga kumpirmasyon halin kay Sunshine apang pila ka beses sila ng nakit-an nga magkaupod.
english: There is no official confirmation from Sunshine but they have been spotted together several times.

text: Ka-long-term relationship anay ni Sunshine si Macky Mathay.
english: Sunshine was in a long-term relationship with Macky Mathay.

text: Kasado man siya anay kay Cesar Montano, apang gin-annul ang ila kasal sang 2018.
english: She was also previously married to Cesar Montano, but their marriage was annulled in 2018.

text: Si Atong naman ang na-link anay kay Gretchen Barretto.
english: Atong was previously linked to Gretchen Barretto.

text: Nabutang subong sa sentro sang kontrobersiya ang amo nga negosyante matapos siya ang ginatudlo sang isa sa mga akusado nga mastermind sa pagkadula sang mga manugbulang sang 2021.
english: The businessman is now at the center of controversy after he was identified by one of the accused as the mastermind behind the disappearance of the fishermen in 2021.

text: Gintudlo man si Gretchen nga may ihibalo sa amo nga krimen.#
english: Gretchen was also identified as having knowledge of the crime.#

text: Wala ginbaton sang Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) ang cease and desist order nga gin-isyu sang city government batok sa drainage project sa Barangay San Pedro, Jaro, Iloilo City..Gin-isyu ni Mayor Jerry Treñas ang stoppage order sang Abril 22 matapos matukiban nga ginpatigayon ang proyekto bisan wala sang excavation permit, mayor’s permit, barangay clearance, ukon legal nga ordinansa para sa road closure.
english: The Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) has rejected the cease and desist order issued by the city government against the drainage project in Barangay San Pedro, Jaro, Iloilo City. or legal ordinance for road closure.

text: Suno sa Iloilo City District Engineering Office, wala nila ginbaton ang order bangud sa technicalit kun sa diin naka-address ini kay Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 director Sonny Boy Oropel, kag indi direkta kay ICDEO officer-in-charge Engr.
english: According to the Iloilo City District Engineering Office, they did not accept the order due to technicality where it was addressed to Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 director Sonny Boy Oropel, and not directly to ICDEO officer-in-charge Engr.

text: Roy Pacanan.
english: Roy Pacanan.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Chester Duane Jover, ang Construction and Maintenance Foreman sang City Engineer’s Office, bangud wala ginbaton sang ICDEO ang letter, ibalik ini sa mga abogado sang syudad para sa masunod nga mga tikang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Chester Duane Jover, Construction and Maintenance Foreman of the City Engineer's Office, said that since the ICDEO did not accept the letter, it will be returned to the city lawyers for next steps.

text: Suno kay Jover, magluwas nga wala sang nagakaigo nga permits, wala man sang may nabutang nga transparency board angot sa proyekto.
english: According to Jover, besides the lack of proper permits, there is no transparency board regarding the project.

text: Magatambong si Pope Francis sa summit sang Group of Seven (G7) leaders agud pangunahan ang diskusyon kaangot sa mga pagpanghangkat dala sang Artificial Intelligence (AI).
english: Pope Francis will attend the summit of Group of Seven (G7) leaders to lead a discussion on the challenges posed by Artificial Intelligence (AI).

text: Ang G7 meeting ang pagahiwaton sa southern Italian region sang Puglia sa Hunyo 13-15 kun sa diin magatipon ang mga lideres sang United States, Germany, Britain, France, Italy, Canada kag Japan amo man ang pila ka espesyal nga invited guests.
english: The G7 meeting will be held in the southern Italian region of Puglia on June 13-15 where the leaders of the United States, Germany, Britain, France, Italy, Canada and Japan will gather as well as some special invited guests.

text: Suno kay Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, ini ang una nga bes nga magapasakop ang isa ka Santo Papa sa kaangay nga aktibidad sang G7.
english: According to Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, this is the first time that a Pope will participate in such an activity of the G7.

text: Antes sini, matandaan nga una na nga nagpaandam ang Santo Papa sa mga halit nga posible dal-on sang AI kag nagpanawagan man ini sang mga regulasyon sa bilog nga kalibutan agud nga magamit ini para sa ikaayo sang tanan.
english: Earlier, it can be recalled that the Pope had earlier warned of the harms that AI could bring and also called for regulations around the world so that it can be used for the benefit of all.

text: Ang “legally binding international treaty” agud ma-regulate ang AI amo ang kinahanglan suno kay Pope Francis kag dapat siguraduhon nga indi ma-islan ang human values.
english: A “legally binding international treaty” to regulate AI is what Pope Francis needs and must ensure that human values ​​are not replaced.

text: Nagpaandam man ini sa posible matabo nga “technological dictatorship” nga may daku nga pagpamahog sa human existence.
english: It also warned of a possible “technological dictatorship” that poses a serious threat to human existence.

text: Imagine kun ikaw nagalakat-lakat lang ukon indi gani naga-tambay lang sa kilid sang dalan, apang may nag-wild kag nagakuyampad na ang tanan.
english: Imagine if you were just walking or not even just hanging out on the side of the road, but something went wild and everything was shaking.

text: Didto sa London, natabo ini apang indi tawo ang nag-amok kundi ang mga kabayo!
english: In London, it happened but it wasn’t man who ran amok but horses!

text: Ini nga mga elite nga kabayo sang military ang nakabuhi gikan sa prestihiyoso nga Household Cavalry ukon ang official bodyguard sang Hari kag amo ang nagapakigbahin sa mga ceremonial duties.
english: These elite military horses earned their living from the prestigious Household Cavalry or the King’s official bodyguard and were the ones who took part in ceremonial duties.

text: Naka-base ini sa Hyde Park barracks nga malapit gid lamang sa Buckingham Palace.
english: It is based in Hyde Park barracks which is very close to Buckingham Palace.

text: Myerkules sang aga oras sa London sang ginhimo ang routine exercise sa Belgravia area.
english: It was Wednesday morning London time when the routine exercise was conducted in the Belgravia area.

text: Suno sa army, pito ka mga kabayo kag anum ka mga soldado gikan sa Household Cavalry ang yara sa amo nga exercise sang gulpi lang nga naggamo.
english: According to the army, seven horses and six soldiers from the Household Cavalry were on the exercise when the commotion suddenly broke out.

text: Apat ka service personnel ang nagtabog bangud sa pagkabuhi sang mga kabayo.
english: Four service personnel fired because of the liveliness of the horses.

text: Isa ka puti nga kabayo ang nakuhaan pa sang video nga nagdugo ang lawas matapos nga nakabunggo ini sa taxi samtang ang isa naman ang nakabunggo sa windscreen sang naka-park nga bus.
english: One white horse was caught on video bleeding after it hit a taxi while another hit the windscreen of a parked bus.

text: Suno pa sa British Army, nakibot ang mga kabayo sang may nahulog nga semento malapit sa construction work sa ila nga lugar, gani nga nagpalalagyo ang mga ini kag nagtuga sang gamo.
english: According to the British Army, the horses were surprised when cement fell near the construction work in their area, so they ran away and caused trouble.

text: Bangud sini, tatlo man ka mga soldado ang napilsan kag subong ginabulong man sa ospital apang estable an ang kondisyon.
english: As a result, three soldiers were also injured and are being treated at the hospital but are in stable condition.

text: Suno sa Army spokesperson: “A number of military working horses became loose during routine exercise this morning.
english: According to the Army spokesperson: “A number of military working horses became loose during routine exercise this morning.

text: All of the horses have now been recovered and returned to camp.
english: All of the horses have now been recovered and returned to camp.

text:
A number of personnel and horses have been injured and are receiving the appropriate medical attention.”

Mangin ang City of London Police ang nahaw-asan man nga nakabalik na ang mga military horses.
english:
A number of personnel and horses have been injured and are receiving the appropriate medical attention.”

Even the City of London Police is relieved that the military horses have returned.

text: Kabahin sang statement sini, ” We are pleased to confirm that all of the horses have been accounted for.
english: Part of its statement, ” We are pleased to confirm that all of the horses have been accounted for.

text: We are continuing to liaise with the Army.”#
english: We are continuing to liaise with the Army.”#

text: ILOILO CITY– Nagpasalig ang Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office nga magapadayon ang ila paghatag sang bulig-pinansyal sa mga pigado nga may yara sang problema sa ikaayong lawas.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office has assured that it will continue to provide financial assistance to the poor who have health problems.

text: Ini sa pihak sang pagpauntat ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa tanan nga gaming activities sa idalom sang Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office kaangay sang Lotto kag Keno sa diin ginakuha sang ahensya ang kwarta nga ginapain para sa paghatag sang bulig-pinansyal sa mga pigado.
english: This is despite President Rodrigo Duterte's suspension of all gaming activities under the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office such as Lotto and Keno where the agency takes the money set aside for providing financial assistance to the poor.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jeanette Lloyd, Branch Manager sang Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office-Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga may yara sang savings ang Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office nga sarang mag-augment agud mahatagan sang bulig -pinansyal ang mga pigado nga may balayran sa ospital ukon may kondisyon nga medikal nga nagadangop sa ila opisina.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jeanette Lloyd, Branch Manager of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office-Iloilo, said the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office has savings that can be augmented to provide financial assistance to the poor with hospital bills or medical conditions who come to their office.

text: Suno kay Lloyd, may yara sang daily budget ang Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office nga 400,000 apang mas manubo ini sa 800,000 nga daily budget sadto bangud nagnubo man ang income sang ahensya.
english: According to Lloyd, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office has a daily budget of P400,000 but it is lower than the P800,000 daily budget because the agency's income has also decreased.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga sa isa ka adlaw, may yara sang kapin 100  nga nagapangayo sang  pinansiyal nga bulig sa  Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office-Iloilo.
english: He also said that in one day, there are more than 100 people seeking financial assistance from the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office-Iloilo.

text: Walo ka mga lugar sa Iloilo ang ginrekomendar sang Provincial Joint Security Command Center nga ipaidalom sa election areas of concern may kaangtanan sa nagahilapit nga Mayo 12 nga midterm elections.
english: Eight areas in Iloilo have been recommended by the Provincial Joint Security Command Center to be placed under election areas of concern in connection with the upcoming May 12 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCol.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCol.

text: Bayani Razalan, director sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), iya ginpahayag nga ini nga mga lugar ang may yara sang armed threat kag may intense political rivalry.
english: Bayani Razalan, director of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), said these areas have an armed threat and intense political rivalry.

text: Suno kay Razalan, may i-deploy sila nga Quick Reaction Team sa sini nga walo ka lugar para bantayan ang posible pagluntad sang ano man nga gamo antes ukon sa mismo adlaw sang eleksyon.
english: Razalan said they will deploy a Quick Reaction Team in these eight areas to monitor any possible violence before or on election day.

text: Gin-athag naman ni Razalan nga indi pa mabuyagyag ang walo ka ginatumod nga mga lugar.
english: Razalan explained that the eight targeted areas have not yet been revealed.

text: Nahibaluan ang Commission on Elections, Philippine National Police, kag Armed Forces of the Philippines ang nagsugtanay nga ipasaka ang amo nga rekomendasyon sa Regional Joint Security Command Center nga amo naman ang nag-forward sini sa national committee.
english: The Commission on Elections, Philippine National Police, and Armed Forces of the Philippines agreed to submit the recommendation to the Regional Joint Security Command Center which forwarded it to the national committee.

text: Hulaton pa nga ang COMELEC Central Office ang magpagwa sang nasambit nga listahan sang walo ka mga lugar sa Iloilo.
english: The COMELEC Central Office is still waiting to release the list of eight areas in Iloilo.

text: Naglab-ot sa 35,949 ang mga manunudlo nga magaserbe bilang myembro sang electoral board sa Western Visayas para sa national and local elections sa Mayo 12, 2025.
english: A total of 35,949 teachers will serve as members of the electoral board in Western Visayas for the national and local elections on May 12, 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Hernani Escullar, Jr., spokesperson sang Department of Education Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga kabug-usan nga 2,801 ka mga eskwelahan kag 7,337 ka mga classrooms ang gamiton para sa eleksyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Hernani Escullar, Jr., spokesperson of the Department of Education Region 6, said a total of 2,801 schools and 7,337 classrooms will be used for the election.

text: Samtang may yara naman sang 2,875 ka mga non-teching personnel nga amo ang maga-assist sa mga manunudlo kag dugang nga 2,217 ka iban pa nga mga personnel.
english: Meanwhile, there are 2,875 non-teching personnel who will assist the teachers and an additional 2,217 other personnel.

text: Una na nagpasalig ang Department of Education (DepEd) nga tumanon ang commitment nga siguruhon nga maproteksyunan ang kinamatarung kag kaayuhan sang mga teachers nga magaserbe bilang poll workers.
english: Earlier, the Department of Education (DepEd) pledged to fulfill its commitment to ensure that the rights and welfare of teachers who will serve as poll workers are protected.

text: Suno kay Education Secretary Sonny Angara, sigurohon sang ahensya nga mabayluhan sang pagpasalamat, preparasyon kag paghatag seguridad sa serbisyo sang mga manunudlo para pangapinan ang demokrasya.
english: According to Education Secretary Sonny Angara, the agency will ensure that there is an exchange of gratitude, preparation and security for the service of teachers to defend democracy.

text: Nagdangat sa P1,088,000 nga balor sang suspected shabu ang nakumpiskar sa isa ka lalaki sa drug buy bust nga ginpatigayon sa Barangay Bakhawan Sur, Concepcion, Iloilo.
english: P1,088,000 worth of suspected shabu was seized from a man in a drug buy bust conducted in Barangay Bakhawan Sur, Concepcion, Iloilo.

text: Ang nadakpan amo si alias Nonoy ukon si alias Lamok, 55, residente sang amo nga barangay, nagatrabaho man bilang isa ka panday, kag ginakabig nga high value individual (HVI).
english: The suspect was identified as Nonoy or alias Lamok, 55, resident of the same barangay, also working as a carpenter, and considered a high value individual (HVI).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Dadje de Lima, chief sang Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU), iya ginpahayag nga nakuha sa suspek ang 160 grams sang ginapasuni iligal nga droga.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Dadje de Lima, chief of the Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU), said 160 grams of suspected illegal drugs were recovered from the suspect.

text: Suno kay de Lima, nadakpan naman anay si alias Lamok sadtong 2019 bangud man sa illegal drugs, nakaguwa sang 2024, apang na-monitor nga nagbalik sa iya iligal nga aktibidad.
english: According to de Lima, alias Lamok was arrested in 2019 for illegal drugs, released in 2024, but was monitored to have returned to his illegal activities.

text: Sandig pa sa pag-monitor sang pulis, sa guwa sang Western Visayas nagahalin ang suplay sini, kag ang areas naman nga ginabaligyaan sini amo ang northern Iloilo partikular sa Sara, Concepcion, kag San Dionisio.
english: According to police monitoring, the supply comes from outside Western Visayas, and the areas where it is sold are northern Iloilo particularly in Sara, Concepcion, and San Dionisio.

text: Detained na ini subong sa custodial facility sang Concepcion Municipal Police Station.
english: He is now detained in the custodial facility of the Concepcion Municipal Police Station.

text: Pataasan ang buwis sa mga e-cigarettes, vaping products lakip man ang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: Increase taxes on e-cigarettes, vaping products as well as alcoholic beverages.

text: Suno kay Karl Chua, undersecretary sang Department of Finance, ang pagpataas sang buwis sa mga nasambit nga produkto isa ka paagi agud madugangan ang pondo sang universal healthcare.
english: According to Karl Chua, undersecretary of the Department of Finance, raising taxes on these products is a way to increase universal healthcare funding.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, indi bastante ang pagtaas sang buwis sa tobacco sang nagligad agud madugangan ang pondo sang universal healthcare.
english: He added that the increase in tobacco taxes in the past was not enough to increase universal healthcare funds.

text: Magataas sang P45 kada 10 mililiters humalin sa P10 per mililiters nga gin aprubahan sang Kongreso ang buwis sa e-cigarettes kag  vaping products.
english: The tax on e-cigarettes and vaping products will increase by P45 per 10 milliliters from the P10 per milliliter approved by Congress.

text: Samtang ang beer humalin sa P24 mangin P34 kada litro kag magataas pa gid sa P45 kada litro sa tuig 2021.
english: Meanwhile, beer will go from P24 to P34 per liter and will increase to P45 per liter in 2021.

text: Ini ang magataas sang P5 sa mga masunod nga tuig tubtub makalab-ot ini sang P60.50 sa tuig 2024 kag pataasan pa sang 10% kada tuig.
english: It will increase by P5 in the coming years until it reaches P60.50 in 2024 and will increase by 10% per year.

text: Magataas man ang buwis sa makahulubog nga ilimnon kaangay sang distilled spirits ukon hard liqours.
english: Taxes on alcoholic beverages such as distilled spirits or hard liquors will also increase.

text: Ang ad valorem tax sang mga nasambit nga ilimnon ang magataas humalin sa 20% pakadto sa 25% samtang ang specific tax rate naman ang magataas halin sa P23 nga mangin P40 kada litro.
english: The ad valorem tax on these beverages will increase from 20% to 25% while the specific tax rate will increase from P23 to P40 per litre.

text: Ang pag-amyenda sang sin tax law ang gin pasar sang 17th Congress kag nagahulat nalang nga pirmahan ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The amendment to the sin tax law was passed by the 17th Congress and is awaiting signature by President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ang nasambit nga layi ang magapataas sang buwis sang sigarilyo sang P45 kada pakete sa tuig 2020, P50 kada pakete sa tuig 2021, P55 kada pakete sa tuig 2022 kag P60 kada pakete sa tuig 2023.
english: The bill will increase the tax on cigarettes by P45 per pack in 2020, P50 per pack in 2021, P55 per pack in 2022 and P60 per pack in 2023.

text: Madumduman nga naglahog ang presidente sa iya ikaapat nga State of the Nation Address nga luyag niya kakason kag dulaon ang mga naga panigarilyo.
english: It can be recalled that the president promised in his fourth State of the Nation Address that he wants to eradicate smoking.

text: Ibinunyag ng Department of Justice (DOJ) na may posibilidad na ang mga natagpuang labi sa Taal Lake ay hindi lamang kaugnay ng kaso ng mga nawawalang sabungero kundi maaaring may kinalaman din sa iba pang krimen gaya ng ‘war on drugs’.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) revealed that there is a possibility that the remains found in Taal Lake are not only related to the case of missing sabungero but may also be involved in other crimes such as the war on drugs.

text: Sa isang pahayag, sinabi ni Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla na may natanggap silang impormasyon hinggil sa iba pang mga lugar sa paligid ng Taal Lake na posibleng ginamit sa pagtatapon ng mga labi ng mga biktima.
english: In a statement, Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla said they have received information about other areas around Taal Lake that may have been used to dispose of the remains of the victims.

text: “Meron pa tayong ibang lugar na tinitingnan na hindi para sa e-sabong kundi maaaring may kinalaman sa war on drugs.
english: “We have other areas that are being looked at that are not for e-sabong but may be related to the war on drugs.

text: Somewhere there in Taal din, malapit lang,” pahayag ni Secretary Remulla.
english: Somewhere there in Taal din, nearby,” Secretary Remulla said.

text: Ibinunyag din ng kalihim na isa sa mga palaisdaan sa lugar na may fish pond lease agreement ay pagmamay-ari umano ng isang operative na kabilang sa mga contractor na responsable sa pagtatapon ng mga bangkay.
english: The secretary also revealed that one of the fisheries in the area with a fish pond lease agreement is allegedly owned by an operative who is one of the contractors responsible for the disposal of the bodies.

text: Dahil dito, iniutos ni Remulla ang paghuhukay sa ilang bahagi ng Batangas upang masuri ang mga bangkay na natagpuan pa noong 2020, ngunit hindi kailanman kinuha ng anumang kaanak o pamilya.
english: Because of this, Remulla ordered an excavation in some parts of Batangas to examine the bodies that were found in 2020, but never taken by any relatives or family.

text: “Nais naming malinawan ang mga kasong ito, hindi lang ang pagkawala ng mga sabungero kundi pati na rin ang ibang kaso ng pagkawala na maaaring konektado sa war on drugs,” ani Remulla.
english: “We want to clarify these cases, not only the disappearance of the sabungero but also other cases of disappearance that may be connected to the war on drugs,” Remulla said.

text: Tatlong bangkay na ang ipinahuhukay ng DOJ para sa pagsusuri.
english: Three bodies are being exhumed by the DOJ for examination.

text: Sinabi ni Remulla na bahagi ito ng mas malawak na imbestigasyon ng kagawaran sa mga kasong “disappearances” na matagal nang hindi nareresolba.
english: Remulla said this is part of the department's broader investigation into cases of disappearances that have been unresolved for a long time.

text: Bagama’t nakatuon pa rin ang DOJ sa kaso ng nawawalang mga sabungero, tiniyak ni Remulla na hindi nila isinasantabi ang posibilidad na may koneksyon ito sa mga insidente ng karahasan na nag-ugat sa kampanya kontra ilegal na droga.
english: Although the DOJ is still focused on the case of the missing sabungero, Remulla assured that they do not rule out the possibility that it is connected to incidents of violence rooted in the campaign against illegal drugs.

text: ILOILO CITY- Pulo ka mga military personnel sang Malaysia nga sakay sa duha ka naval helicopters ang patay matapos nagbungguanay ang duha ka choppers samtang nagalupad sa naval base sa Lumut, Perak.
english: ILOILO CITY – Ten Malaysian military personnel aboard two naval helicopters were killed after two choppers collided while flying at the naval base in Lumut, Perak.

text: Suno sa Royal Malaysian Navy, ang involved sa aksidente amo ang Maritime Operations Helicopter kag Fennec helicopter.
english: According to the Royal Malaysian Navy, the Maritime Operations Helicopter and Fennec helicopter were involved in the accident.

text: Ang Maritime Operations Helicopter ang nagtupa sa isa ka stadium samtang ang Fennec helicopter ang nagtupa sa isa ka pool.
english: The Maritime Operations Helicopter landed in a stadium while the Fennec helicopter landed in a pool.

text: Nagapatigayon sang rehearsals ang mga helicopter para sa 90th Navy Day parade kag ikatatlo na nga hugnat sang rehearsals sang nagluntad ang insidente.
english: The helicopters were conducting rehearsals for the 90th Navy Day parade and were in the third phase of rehearsals when the incident occurred.

text: Nagtukod naman sang investigation board ang otoridad agud matumod gid ang kabangdanan sang amo nga trahedya.
english: The authorities have set up an investigation board to determine the cause of the tragedy.

text: Tumalagsahon kag makatalandog-balatyagon ang natabo sa Gaza bangud natigayon pa nga masalbar sang mga doktor ang isa ka lapsag gikan sa taguangkan sang isa ka iloy nga napatay bangud sa pagpang-atake sang Israel sa syudad sang Rafah.
english: What happened in Gaza is unusual and emotional because doctors were able to save a baby from the womb of a mother who died as a result of Israeli attacks on the city of Rafah.

text:
Ang iloy ang ginkilala nga si Sabreen al-Sakani kag nagabusong sang 30 na ka semana sang natabo ang airstrike sang nagligad nga gab-i.

Sa amo nga insidente, patay man ang iya nga bana nga si Shoukri kag ang ila isa pa ka tatlo ka tuig nga anak nga babaye nga si Malak.
english:
The mother was identified as Sabreen al-Sakani and was 30 weeks pregnant when the airstrike took place last night.

Her husband, Shoukri, and their three-year-old daughter, Malak, were also killed in the incident.

text: Matapos nahibaluan sang responders nga nagabusong ang iloy, dali-dali ini nga gindala sa Kuwaiti hospital sa Rafah kag bangud kritikal na ang kondisyon sang iloy bangud naigu pati ang utok sini, kinahanglan nga isa lang sa ila sang bata ang luwason.
english: After responders learned that the mother was pregnant, she was rushed to the Kuwaiti hospital in Rafah and because the mother's condition was critical because she was also hit in the brain, only one of them had to be rescued.

text: Nasalbar ang bata paagi sa ginpatigayon nga emergency caesarean sa iloy.
english: The child was saved by an emergency caesarean section on the mother.

text: Nagapabilin ini subong sa incubator sa neonatal unit sang amo nga Emirati hospital samtang ginsunod naman ang iya pangalan sa iya nga iloy.
english: He is currently in the incubator at the neonatal unit of the Emirati hospital while he was named after his mother.

text: Tatlo tubtub apat ka semana ang itinir sini sa ospital bangud sa respiratory distress syndrome nga tuga sang premature birth.
english: She spent three to four weeks in the hospital due to respiratory distress syndrome caused by premature birth.

text: Bangud ilo na ini kag nawad-an pa sang utod, magapabilin ini sa pagtatap sang iya nga Lola nga si Mirvat al-Sakani.
english: Because he is an orphan and has lost a brother, he will remain in the care of his grandmother, Mirvat al-Sakani.

text:
Nahibaluan nga ang overnight airstrike sang Israel sa Rafah sang nagligad nga Sabado kag Domingo ang nagbilin sang 19 ka mga patay, lakip na dira ang 13 ka kabataan gikan lamang sa isa ka pamilya.#

Source: AAP / Mohammad Jahjouh
english:
Israeli overnight airstrikes in Rafah last Saturday and Sunday left 19 dead, including 13 children from just one family.

Source: AAP / Mohammad Jahjouh

text:
Nagapati ang Tourism Congress of the Philippines nga may malain nga epekto sa industriya sang turismo ang pagduso ni Presidente Duterte sang hagna nga pagpasarado sang mga establisyemento paglab-ot sa tungang gab-i.

Suno kay Jojo Clemente, presidente sang Tourism Congress of the Philippines madamo nga mga negosyo kaangay sang hotels, restaurants kag bars ang maapektuhan sang nasambit nga hagna.
english:
The Tourism Congress of the Philippines believes that President Duterte's proposal to close establishments after midnight will have a negative impact on the tourism industry.

According to Jojo Clemente, president of the Tourism Congress of the Philippines, many businesses such as hotels, restaurants and bars will be affected by the bill.

text: Dugang pa ni Clemente, apektado man ang mga may yara sang ubra sa gab-i kaangay sang mga call center agents kag mga food service.industry workers bangud posible nga ipasarado ang mga gina ubrahan sini kun ini ang mapatuman.
english: Clemente added that those who have jobs at night such as call center agents and food service industry workers will also be affected because their workplaces may be closed if this is implemented.

text: Suno pa gid sa natungdan, ang nightlife sa Manila ang isa sa mga naga engganyo sa turista nga magkadto sa Pilipinas kag dako ang mabulig sini sa turismo sang pungsod.
english: He added that the nightlife in Manila is one of the factors that encourage tourists to come to the Philippines and it will greatly contribute to the country's tourism.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginpahayag ni Presidente Duterte nga luyag nya nga iduso ang pagpasarado sang mga establisyemento paglab-ot sang tungang gab-i sang iya State of the Nation Address sang tinalikdan nga Lunes.
english: President Duterte said he wants to push for the closure of establishments by midnight during his State of the Nation Address last Monday.

text: Nagapakita sang suporta ang pila ka mga senador nga suguran ang impeachment trial batok kay VP Sara Duterte sa Agosto 4, isa ka semana matapos ang State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Some senators are showing support to start the impeachment trial against VP Sara Duterte on August 4, a week after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s State of the Nation Address (SONA).

text: Suno kay Senador Joel Villanueva, may yara na sang informal nga mga paghisugot ang pila ka senador upod kay Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero parte sa posibilidad nga mag-convene ang Senado bilang impeachment court sa nasambit nga petsa.
english: According to Senator Joel Villanueva, some senators have already had informal discussions with Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero regarding the possibility of the Senate convening as an impeachment court on the said date.

text: Ginpahayag ni Villanueva nga kabahin ini sang preparasyon sang Senado kag Kamara para sa 20th Congress, lakip na ang pagpili sang mga lider kag mga committee chairmanships.
english: Villanueva said this is part of the Senate and House's preparations for the 20th Congress, including the election of leaders and committee chairmanships.

text: Ginpahayag man niya nga kumbinsido siya nga mas maayo nga hatagan anay sang husto nga oras ang mga lawmakers antes magsugod ang trial.
english: He also said he was convinced it would be better to give lawmakers the right amount of time before the trial begins.

text: Apang ginklaro niya nga wala pa sang pinal nga desisyon, apisar pa man may apat tubtob anom na ka senador nga nagapakita sang pagsugot nga sa Agosto 4 magatipon ang Senado bilang impeachment court.
english: However, he clarified that there is no final decision, although there are already four to six senators who have shown agreement that on August 4 the Senate will meet as an impeachment court.

text: Madumduman nga una na nga ginpresentar ni Senate President Escudero ang isa ka proposed calendar para sa impeachment proceedings.
english: Senate President Escudero earlier presented a proposed calendar for the impeachment proceedings.

text: Suno sa kalendaryo, maga-panumpa ang mga bag-o nga senator-judges sa Hulyo 29, kag ang opisyal nga pagsugod sang impeachment trial amo ang Hulyo 30.
english: According to the calendar, the new senator-judges will be sworn in on July 29, and the official start of the impeachment trial is July 30.

text: Napanatili ng tropical depression Crising ang taglay nitong lakas ng hangin sa mga nakalipas na oras.
english: Tropical depression Crising has maintained its wind speed in the past few hours.

text:
Ang bagyong ito ay namataan sa layong 625 km silangan ng Virac, Catanduanes, at kumikilos pakanluran-hilagang kanluran sa bilis na 20 km/h.

May hangin itong 45 km/h at pagbugso ng hangin hanggang 55 km/h at may malawak na epekto sa hangin hanggang 280 km mula sa gitna.
english:
This typhoon was located 625 km east of Virac, Catanduanes, and was moving northwest at 20 km/h.

It has winds of 45 km/h and gusts of up to 55 km/h and has a widespread effect of winds up to 280 km from the center.

text: Sa ngayon, wala pang wind signals na naka-taas, ngunit posible itong ideklara sa Cagayan Valley ngayong gabi o bukas ng umaga.
english: Currently, there are no wind signals raised, but it is possible to declare in the Cagayan Valley tonight or tomorrow morning.

text: Nagbabala ang mga eksperto sa posibleng malakas na ulan dulot ni Crising at ng habagat, lalo na sa mga rehiyon sa timog at silangang Luzon.
english: Experts are warning of possible heavy rains caused by Crising and the southwest, especially in the regions of southern and eastern Luzon.

text: Ang pinakamataas na maaaring itaas na wind signal ay Signal No.
english: The highest achievable upper wind signal is Signal No.

text: 3 o 4 kung titindi pa ang bagyo.
english: 3 or 4 if the typhoon is still strong.

text: Inaasahang mararanasan ang malalakas na hangin sa Palawan, Visayas, at ilang parte ng Mindanao mula ngayon hanggang Biyernes.
english: Strong winds are expected to be experienced in Palawan, Visayas, and some parts of Mindanao from today until Friday.

text: May babala rin sa mga mangingisda hinggil sa maalon na karagatan (hanggang 2.5 metro ang taas), kaya’t pinapayuhang umiwas muna sa paglalayag.
english: There is also a warning to fishermen about the rough seas (up to 2.5 meters high), so it is advised to avoid sailing.

text:
Nagdepensa ang Social
Security System matapos ginhingadlan ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte
bilang isa sa mga ahensya sang gobyerno nga masami nga ginareklamo
bangud sa lawlaw nga serbisyo kag madugay nga transaksyon.
english:
Social defended
Security System after President Rodrigo Duterte named
as one of the most frequently complained about government agencies
due to slow service and long transactions.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo
Radyo kay Mr. Amiel Genova, Acting Senior Communications Officer sang
Social Security System- Iloilo Central Branch, iya ginpahayag nga
madugay na sila nakapatigayon sang pagpa-improve sang ila serbisyo.
english:

text: Ginaduso ni Senador Alan Peter Cayetano ang Senate Bill No.
english: Senator Alan Peter Cayetano is proposing Senate Bill No.

text: 418 ukon Enhanced Batas Kasambahay Act nga nagatuyo maghatag sang dugang nga benepisyo kag proteksyon sa mga kabulig sa pungsod.
english: 418 or Enhanced Batas Kasambahay Act which aims to provide additional benefits and protections to maids in the country.

text: Sa idalom sang nasambit nga hagna, igahatag sa mga kabulig ang libre nga bulong, access sa edukasyon, kag mas istrikto nga pagpapatuman sang ila mga katungdanan kag kinamatarong.
english: Under the bill, maids will be given free medicine, access to education, and stricter enforcement of their duties and rights.

text: Gina-rekomendar man sang hagna nga ang mga kabulig hatagan sang indi magnubo sa isa ka oras kada adlaw ukon anom ka oras kada semana para sa skills training ukon alternative learning, nga kabahin sang ila bayaran nga oras sa trabaho.
english: The bill also recommends that aides be given at least one hour a day or six hours a week for skills training or alternative learning, as part of their paid work time.

text: Sa pagpalig-on sang online learning, ginamanduan ang Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) nga maglunsar sang programa para maghatag sang internet-enabled nga mga device sa mga kabulig.
english: To encourage online learning, the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) is directed to launch a program to provide internet-enabled devices to maids.

text: Ginaduso man ang pagpatukod sang Kasambahay Education Inter-Agency Committee nga pagabug-usan sang DOLE, TESDA, DepEd, kag CHED.
english: The establishment of a Kasambahay Education Inter-Agency Committee comprising DOLE, TESDA, DepEd, and CHED is also proposed.

text: Ang komitiba amo ang magadihon sang mga practical nga modules, siguruhon nga may access apisar pa may teknikal nga kabudlayan, kag balansehon ang katungdanan sang amo kag kabulig.
english: The committee will develop practical modules, ensure access despite technical difficulties, and balance the roles of employer and assistant.

text: Dugang pa, ginapabakod sang hagna ang obligasyon sang mga amo nga irehistro ang ila kabulig sa SSS, PhilHealth, kag Pag-IBIG.
english: In addition, the bill strengthens the obligation of employers to register their assistant with SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG.

text: May yara man sang dugang nga suporta para sa mga kabulig nga naga-experyensya sang abuso ukon pagpang-abuso.
english: There is also more support for helpers who experience abuse or harassment.

text: Napilian sang Malacañang ang award-winning tenor nga si Sofronio Vasquez agud magkanta sang Lupang Hinirang sa ika-apat nga State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Malacañang has selected award-winning tenor Sofronio Vasquez to sing Lupang Hinirang at President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA).

text: Matandaan nga si Vasquez ang labing una nga Filipino kag pinakauna nga lalaki nga nagikan sa Asya nga nagdaog sa The Voice US Season 26, isa sa pinaka-popular nga singing competitions sa kalibutan.
english: Vasquez is the first Filipino and the first Asian man to win The Voice US Season 26, one of the most popular singing competitions in the world.

text: Suno sa pahayag sang Malacañang, ang pagpili kay Vasquez base sa handum sang administrasyon nga itingob ang tradisyon kag talento sang mga Filipino, kag ipabutyag sa publiko ang kadalag-an sang mga Pinoy sa international nga entablado.
english: According to a Malacañang statement, the selection of Vasquez is based on the administration's desire to combine the traditions and talents of Filipinos, and to publicly express the victories of Filipinos on the international stage.

text: Ang pambansang awit ang ginakanta bilang opisyal nga pagsugod sang SONA antes mag-umpisa ang speech sang Presidente.
english: The national anthem is sung as the official opening of the SONA before the President's speech begins.

text: Ginapaabot nga mangin highlight sang SONA ang pag-perform ni Vasquez, nga ginalauman magahatag sang inspirasyon sa mga tumalan-aw kag tagpalamati.
english: Vasquez's performance is expected to be the highlight of the SONA, which is expected to inspire viewers and listeners.

text: Dagdagan sang Land Transportation (LTO) Office Region 6 sang show cause order ang driver sang SUV nga nag-hit and run sa magpakaisa sa Commission Civil Street, Barangay Fatima, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: The Land Transportation (LTO) Office Region 6 has issued a show cause order to the driver of the SUV that hit and run the couple in Commission Civil Street, Barangay Fatima, Jaro, Iloilo City.
