text: Samtang, ang backrider naman amo si Eric Paul Gacita, 23, kag residente sang nasambit nga Barangay.
english: Meanwhile, the backrider was identified as Eric Paul Gacita, 23, resident of the said Barangay.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang suspek isa ka family driver sang Chinese National nga amo nagapanag-iya sang SUV nga ginamaneho sini.
english: The suspect is a family driver of the Chinese national who owns the SUV he was driving.

text: Nag-file naman sang kaso nga reckless imprudence resulting to multiple serious physical injuries and damage to property ang Traffic Enforcement Unit batok sa nasambit nga driver.
english: The Traffic Enforcement Unit filed a case of reckless imprudence resulting to multiple serious physical injuries and damage to property against the said driver.

text: Matandaan nga sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), iya ginpahayag nga may naghatag sang impormasyon sa mga kapulisan natuhoy sa driver nga luyag niya nga mag-surrender kaupod ang iya abogado sa mga kapulisan kag handa nga mag-atubang sa mga biktima.
english: Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), said that someone gave information to the police about the driver who wanted to surrender with his lawyer to the police and was ready to face the victims.

text: Nagtuad ang driver nga bangud sa tuman nga kakulba, nahimo niya nga magpalagyo sa tion sang pagkabunggo sini.
english: The driver confessed that due to extreme panic, he managed to flee during the collision.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagaguwa sa imbestigasyon sang otoridad nga nang-agaw sang linya ang isa ka Sports Utility Vehicle ukon SUV rason nga nabungguan sini ang motorsiklo.
english: It was learned that the investigation of the authorities revealed that a Sports Utility Vehicle or SUV took the lane and hit the motorcycle.

text: ANG masami nga pagbaylo-baylo sang lakat sang panahon normal lang ini nga hitabo sa aton ordinaryo nga mga pumuluyo.
english: THE frequent changes in the weather are normal for our ordinary citizens.

text: In fact, tungod masami dulot ini sang naturalisa wala sing reklamo ang kadam-an luas sa atubangon ini kag mangabuhi upod sini sing may paglaum.
english: In fact, because it is often a gift of naturalization, most people have no complaints except to face it and live with it with hope.

text: Ang “usual” nga mga hitabo sang lakat sang panahon nga  adlaw-adlaw  naton ginabantayan agud mahibal-an ang dapat naton himuon man sa matag-adlaw, “Weather” kon tawgon sang aton mga mangin-alamon sa siyensya.
english: The “usual” weather events that we watch every day to know what we should do every day, “Weather” as our scientists call it.

text: Upod naton diri sa masami ang “weather forecast” nga ginahimo sang Pag-asa sa sulod sang kada apat ka oras.
english: We usually have the weather forecast that Pag-asa produces every four hours.

text: “Climate” naman ang tawag sa “long-term pattern” sang “Weather”, nga ang pagtakos sini paagi sa “average weather”, katulad sang “average temperature”, nga makuha naton sa  indi magnubo sa 30 ka tuig nga kalawigon.
english: Climate is the long-term pattern of weather, which is measured by average weather, such as average temperature, which we get for at least 30 years.

text: Tungod sa sining paghangop sa “climate”, indi kinahanglan nga makahalalit (“disastrous”) gid ang epekto sini.
english: Given this understanding of climate, its effects are not necessarily disastrous.

text: In fact, wala nagakatabo ang “drastic changes” sa kasaysayan sang aton planeta.
english: In fact, drastic changes have not occurred in the history of our planet.

text: Ang pagbag-o, lakip ang padayon nga “evolution” sang tawo tubtub sa karon, naga-amat-amat significante lang pagkatapos sang linibu kag minilyon ka tuig despues.
english: Change, including the continued “evolution” of man to the present day, only becomes gradually significant after thousands and millions of years later.

text: Gani, kon may dapat gid kita kulbaan angot sa “Climate Change” amo ina ang isa ka “Climate Emergency” nga nagapamahog na sang “disastrous effects” sa katauhan kag sa aton mismo planeta nga Earth.
english: Therefore, if there is anything we should be afraid of about Climate Change, it is a Climate Emergency that is already threatening disastrous effects on humanity and our own planet Earth.

text: Masubo ugaling kay ang daku nga balasulon diri ang mismo ginahimo sang tawo, labi na gid sadtong pagpamayagpag sang Industrial Revolution halin pa sa mga 20 ka tuig nga nagligad.
english: Sadly, however, the biggest culprit here is man himself, especially during the Industrial Revolution about 20 years ago.

text: Ugaling kay daw halos wala man ini ginasapak sang mga pulitiko bisan sang mga dalagku nga mga pungsod, katulad sang Estados Unidos, China, Russia kag iban pa.
english: However, it seems that politicians almost ignore it even in the big countries, such as the United States, China, Russia and others.

text: Padayon gani ang pagsulong nila sang progreso sang ila mga pungsod paagi sa paggamit sang fossil fuels bisan pa sa peligro nga ginadala sini sa katauhan kag sa mismo aton kalibutan.
english: They continue to advance the progress of their countries through the use of fossil fuels despite the danger it brings to humanity and our world itself.

text: Kag bisan pa sa paandam sang mga mangin-alamon sang mga makatulublag na nga mga hitabo.
english: And despite the warnings of wise men of already disturbing events.

text: Katulad sang pamahog sang pagtaas sang temperatura sang kalibutan (Global Warming) lapaw sa 2 degrees Celsius.
english: Like the threat of global warming above 2 degrees Celsius.

text: Subong man ang madasig nga pagluntad sang “Climate Change” nga ang kahalitan indi na malagas sang ikasarang sang tawo sa sige pagluntad sang mas makahalalit nga mga bagyo, masami nga paglinupok sang mga bulkan, makakululba nga pagbinaha, pagdamo sang kaso sang cancer kag iban pa nga balatian, madasig nga pagkatunaw sang yelo sa Antartika nga naga-amat-amat palugdang sang mga isla, kag iban pa.
english: As well as the rapid occurrence of “Climate Change” whose damage is beyond human ability to continue to occur more destructive typhoons, frequent volcanic eruptions, devastating floods, increased cases of cancer and other diseases, rapid melting of ice in Antarctica that causes meltdowns, and other disasters.

text:
***

Mabasol diri ang padayon nga paggamit sang fossil fuels nga ginagamit bilang gatong sa transportasyon, pag-provide sang elektrisidad, kag agud mag-producir sang mga madamo nga produkto katulad sang steel kag plastics.
english:
***

This is to blame for the continued use of fossil fuels used as fuel for transportation, provision of electricity, and to produce many products such as steel and plastics.

text: Lakip sa fossil fuels nga ini ang coal, oil kag natural gas nga sa karon naga-provide sang mga 80% sang enerhiya sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: These fossil fuels include coal, oil and natural gas which currently provide about 80% of the world's energy.

text: Ang halit sang mga ini dala sang sobra-sobra nga pagbuga sang mga makinarya sing carbon dioxide kag iban pa nga greenhouse gases (methane kag nitrous oxide) nga nagapugong sa paggwa sang init sa atrmospera sang kalibutan nga nagapalala sang kahimtangan sini.
english: The damage is caused by the excessive emission of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases (methane and nitrous oxide) by machinery that prevent heat from escaping the earth's atmosphere and worsen its condition.

text: Of course, may ginahimo ang mga pungsod – mga 196 ini sila – sa ila paghugpong para sa Paris Agreement of 2015 agud mapanubo ang panghalit sang greenhouse gases kag mabuligan ang mga gagmay nga mga pungsod nga nahalitan sang ila aktibidades.
english: Of course, the countries – about 196 of them – are doing something in their commitment to the Paris Agreement of 2015 to reduce the damage of greenhouse gases and help small countries affected by their activities.

text: May problema ugaling kay ang mga myembro sini indi gihapon maghilituhog kon ano gid ang himuon para ma-mitigate ining halit sang mga greenhouse gases.
english: There is a problem, however, that its members still do not agree on what to do to mitigate the damage caused by greenhouse gases.

text:
***

Tungod sini, sunu sa aton abyan nga si Pedro, about time na seguro nga i-deklarar naton ang pagsulong sang programa para sa pagpaluntad sang “Garden of Eden on Earth”.
english:
***

Therefore, according to our friend Pedro, it is about time that we declare the advancement of the program for the establishment of the “Garden of Eden on Earth”.

text: Ang garden of Eden, sunu sa Christian Bible kag sa pagtuo man sang mga Muslim kag tumuluo sang Jewish Faith,  modelo ini sang matahum kag mabungahon nga palibut nga sadto ginapuy-an nanday Adan kag Eba, ang una nga mga tawo sa kalibutan nga sang ulihi ginpalayas sang Diyos tungod sang ila pagpakasala.
english: The garden of Eden, according to the Christian Bible and also to Muslims and believers of the Jewish Faith, is a model of the beautiful and fruitful environment in which Adam and Eve, the first humans on earth, were later expelled by God because of their sin.

text: Ini na lang seguro ang solusyon agud maluwas naton ang katauhan kag ang aton kalibutan sa panghalit sang fossil fuels.
english: This is probably the only solution to save humanity and our planet from the destruction of fossil fuels.

text: Pwede naton suguran ini sa pagpasanyog sang mga hardin naton sa aton mga lagwerta kag diin pa sa aton palibut tubtub sa aton mga kaumhan, kabukiran kag mga sapa nga indi mahalitan sang makahililo nga buga sang greenhouse gases.
english: We can start by promoting our gardens in our yards and elsewhere around us to our fields, mountains and rivers that are not harmed by the toxic emissions of greenhouse gases.

text: Pwede, indi bala?/PN
english: You can, can't you?/PN

english: They needed to win after they lost to Australia 1-0 on Sunday.

text: Dahil dito ang ranked 39 na Filipinas ay nagtapos sa ikatlong puwesto sa Group B na mayroong apat na puntos sa +6 goal difference.
english: As a result, the ranked 39 Philippines finished third in Group B with four points on +6 goal difference.

text: Habang ang Myanmar at Australia ay abanse na sa semifinals laban sa top teams ng Group A na Vietnam at Thailand.
english: Meanwhile, Myanmar and Australia are ahead in the semifinals against Group A top teams Vietnam and Thailand.

text: Magabisita ang Korean superstar sa Pilipinas nga si Hyun Bin para sa iya labing una nga fan meet sa pungsod sa Agosto 8, 2025.
english: Korean superstar Hyun Bin will visit the Philippines for his first fan meet in the country on August 8, 2025.

text: Si Hyun Bin ang nagsikat sa bilog nga kalibutan bangud sa iya papel sa hit Netflix series nga “Crash Landing on You” kaupod ang iya co-star nga sa subong asawa na niya nga si Son Ye-jin.
english: Hyun Bin became world famous for his role in the hit Netflix series “Crash Landing on You” alongside his co-star who is now his wife Son Ye-jin.

text: Magabisita ang actor sa Pilipinas sa imbitasyon sang isa ka kilala nga hotel resort chain.
english: The actor will visit the Philippines at the invitation of a well-known hotel resort chain.

text: Makakuha sang ticket sa fan meet ang mga fans paagi sa isa ka raffle promo halin Hulyo 1 tubtob 31.
english: Fans will be able to get tickets to the fan meet through a raffle promo from July 1st to 31st.

text: Kada P2,000 nga single receipt sa mga dining outlets sang nasambit nga hotel sa Parañaque kag Quezon City, makahatag sang isa ka raffle entry.
english: Every P2,000 single receipt at the hotel's dining outlets in Parañaque and Quezon City will provide one raffle entry.

text: Ini ang pinakauna nga pagbisita ni Hyun Bin sa Pilipinas para sa isa ka meet and greet.
english: This is Hyun Bin’s first visit to the Philippines for a meet and greet.

text: Sang una pa, endorser na siya sang isa ka telecommunication company.
english: In the past, he was an endorser of a telecommunications company.

text: Kilala si Hyun Bin bilang isa sa mga pinaka-prominente nga aktor sa Korean Wave.
english: Hyun Bin is known as one of the most prominent actors in the Korean Wave.

text: Nagsikat siya sa mga teleserye pareho sang “My Lovely Sam Soon,” “Secret Garden,” kag “Crash Landing on You,”.
english: She rose to fame in teleseryes such as “My Lovely Sam Soon,” “Secret Garden,” and “Crash Landing on You,”.

text: Ginpakaslan niya si Son Ye-jin sang Marso 2022, kag may isa na sila ka anak.
english: He married Son Ye-jin in March 2022, and they already have one child together.

text: Sa subong, ginahulat sang iya mga fans ang iya pagbalik sa telebisyon sa upcoming nga serye nga “Made in Korea” upod kay Jung Woo-sung.
english: For now, her fans are eagerly awaiting her return to television in the upcoming series “Made in Korea” with Jung Woo-sung.

text: Ginpromote man niya ang iya action movie nga “Harbin.”
english: He also promoted his action movie “Harbin.”

text: Masobra 116 ka tawo ang napatay dala na ang mga kabataan sa nagapadayon nga protesta sang mga tawo sa Iran batok sa ila nga gobyerno.
english: More than 116 people, including children, have been killed in Iran's ongoing protests against the government.

text: Base sa report nga ginpaguwa sang Human Rights Activists Agency masobra duwa ka libo na ang ginpang-aresto.
english: According to a report released by the Human Rights Activists Agency, more than 2,000 people have been arrested.

text: Nagsugod ang ini nga mga protesta halin sang Disyembre 2025 bangud sa nagataas nga inflation kag ang paghina sang balor sang kwarta rason sang panawagan batok sa gobyerno sang pungsod.
english: These protests started from December 2025 due to the rising inflation and the depreciation of the currency reason for the call against the government of the country.

text: Naka-experiensya man sang lapnagon nga pagkadula sang internet blackout ang iban nga bahin sang lugar sa masobra 60 ka oras.
english: Some parts of the area also experienced widespread internet blackouts for more than 60 hours.

text: Suno sa Supreme Leader sang theocratic government sa Tehran nga si Ayatollah Ali Khamene nagamit sang teargas kag bala ang mga opisyal nga nagapamuno agud buwagon ang mga nagaprotesta.
english: According to the Supreme Leader of the theocratic government in Tehran, Ayatollah Ali Khamene, the officials in charge used teargas and bullets to disperse the protesters.

text: Suno pa sa ila nga handa ang mga ini nga hatagan sang solusyon ang problema sang pungsod apang indi lang ini magprotesta nga suno sa ila ginasuportahan man sang mga pungsod nga Estados Unidos kag Israel.
english: They said they are ready to provide a solution to the country's problems but not just protest which they say is also supported by the United States and Israel.

text: Nahibaluan nga naghatag sang pahayag si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga hugot sang mga ini nga ginabantayan ang nagakatabo sa Israel.
english: It is known that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu gave a statement that they are closely monitoring what is happening in Israel.

text: Dugang pa diri, liwat-liwat man nga nagpaandam si US President Donald Trump sa nagapatigayon sang bayolente nga mga tikang agud pauntaton ang mga nagaprotesta kag handa nga magbulig ang Estados Unidos kun kinahanglan.
english: In addition, US President Donald Trump has repeatedly warned against violent measures to stop the protesters and the United States is ready to help if necessary.

text: Samtang, nagpaandam man ang Tehran batok sa mga pungsod nga nagapasilabot sa ila.
english: Meanwhile, Tehran also warned against interfering countries.

text: Suno kay Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf, spokesperson sang Iranian parliament, ang militar sang US kag ang Israel ang mangin lehitimo nga target kung mag-atake ang Amerika sa Iran.
english: According to Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf, spokesperson of the Iranian parliament, the US military and Israel would be legitimate targets if America attacked Iran.

text: Nagresulta sa makangilidlis nga krimen ang pagpakigbulag sang asawa sa iya bana sa Sitio Enverga, Barangay Liwayway, Mauban, ­Quezon.
english: A wife's separation from her husband in Sitio Enverga, Barangay Liwayway, Mauban, Quezon resulted in a heinous crime.

text: Ini matapos nga gin-gulgulan sang bana sa liog ang iya asawa.
english: This was after the husband stabbed his wife in the neck.

text: Ang biktima amo si Jovy, 44, samtang ang nakapalagyo nga suspek amo si Al, 47.
english: The victim was identified as Jovy, 44, while the fleeing suspect was identified as Al, 47.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, isa ka tuig na nga wala nagaupdanay ang mag-asawa matapos ginreklamo sang biktima ang suspek sa paglapas sa RA 9262 (Anti-Violence Against Women and their Children Act of 2004).
english: According to the investigation, the couple had not been together for a year after the victim complained to the suspect for violating RA 9262 (Anti-Violence Against Women and their Children Act of 2004).

text: Sang nagdesisyon ang duha nga magkitaay sa ila balay agud opisyal sila nga magbulagay kag magtungaay sang propedad, didto na natabo ang krimen.
english: When the two decided to meet at his house so they could officially break up and split the property, that’s when the crime happened.

text: Nagbaisay ang duha tubtob nga gin-gulgulan sang liog ang biktima.
english: The two argued until the victim was stabbed in the neck.

text: Madasig nga nalagyo ang suspek apang nagpabutyag man nga magasungka ini sa otoridad.
english: The suspect quickly fled the scene but said he would surrender to the authorities.

text: Ginakabig sang grupo nga “No to PUV Phaseout Coalition Panay” nga tama gid ka kulang para sa mga Public Utility Vehicle (PUV) drivers ang P5,000 fuel subsidy nga igahatag sang gobyerno.
english: The group “No to PUV Phaseout Coalition Panay” considers the P5,000 fuel subsidy to be given by the government to be too insufficient for Public Utility Vehicle (PUV) drivers.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elmer Forro, Lead Convenor sang nasambit nga grupo, iya ginpahayag nga ang subsidiya ang magahatag lang sang bulig sa mga PUV drivers bisan pa nga apektado ang tanan sa krisis sang produktong petrolyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Elmer Forro, Lead Convenor of the group, said the subsidy will only provide assistance to PUV drivers even though everyone is affected by the crisis of petroleum products.

text: Suno sa iya, mas makabulig sa publiko ang gobyerno kun matigayon na nga masuspende ang excise tax kag E-Vat sa gatong.
english: He said the government would be more helpful to the public if the excise tax and E-Vat on fuel were suspended.

text: Ang paghatag sang subsidy sang gobyerno ang sa tunga sang nagapadayon nga kinagamo sa Middle East nga nag-patimbuok sang presyo sang gatong.
english: The government's subsidy comes amid ongoing unrest in the Middle East that has pushed up fuel prices.

text: Attention sa mga motorista!
english: Attention to motorists!

text: May yara sang mixed adjustment sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo subong semana.
english: There was a mixed adjustment in petroleum product prices this week.

text:
Sa gasoline magataas sang P0.20 kada litro

Sa Diesel maganubo sang P2.90 kada litro

Samtang, sa Kerosene maganubo sang P3.20 kada litro.
english:
Gasoline will increase by P0.20 per liter

Diesel will drop by P2.90 per liter

Meanwhile, kerosene will be reduced by P3.20 per liter.

text: Ang ini nga presyo ipatuman epektibo buwas sa aga, Disyembre 2
english: This price will be implemented effective tomorrow morning, December 2

text: Nagbulig ang mga pulis sa pagbun-ag sang isa ka iloy samtang nagalaslas ang anay Super Typhoon Pepito sa Barangay Datag, San Andres, Catanduanes.
english: Police helped a mother give birth while former Super Typhoon Pepito was striking in Barangay Datag, San Andres, Catanduanes.

text: Base sa report sang San Andres Municipal Police Station, natabo ini sang nagalibot ang mga personnel sa barangay para sa ocular inspection ukon pag-check sa sitwasyon sa lugar agud malantaw kun may naguba nga mga balay, imprastraktura, dalan, kag iban pa.
english: According to the report of the San Andres Municipal Police Station, the incident occurred when the personnel were patrolling the barangay for ocular inspection or checking the situation in the area to see if there are damaged houses, infrastructure, roads, and others.

text: Samtang padayon ang inspeksyon, may nagpalapit sa pulis agud magpangayo sang bulig nga madala sa ospital ang babaye nga manugbata.
english: While the inspection was ongoing, someone approached the police to ask for help to take the woman who was about to give birth to the hospital.

text: Nag-responde ang otoridad kag ginkadtuan ang balay nga indi man tuman ka layo sa highway.
english: Authorities responded and went to the house, which is not too far from the highway.

text: Pag-abot sa balay, nagaguwa na sang gamay ang bata kag wala nagduha-duha si Patrolwoman Cahriel Ann Tabirara nga magbulig ilabi na bangud isa man ini ka registered midwife kag nurse.
english: Upon arrival at the house, the child was already coming out a little and Patrolwoman Cahriel Ann Tabirara did not hesitate to help especially since she is also a registered midwife and nurse.

text: Sang nakaguwa na ang healthy baby boy, gindala ang mag-iloy sa Juan M. Alberto Memorial District Hospital (JMAMDH) kaupod ang Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO).
english: When the healthy baby boy was discharged, the mother and daughter were taken to the Juan M. Alberto Memorial District Hospital (JMAMDH) together with the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO).

text: Isa sa pinakaapektado ang Catanduanes sa pag-abot ni Pepito sa Pilipinas.
english: Catanduanes is one of the most affected by Pepito's arrival in the Philippines.

text: Sa Panganiban, Catanduanes ini nag-landfall sang nagligad nga Sabado sang gab-i kag lima pa sa anum ka isolated areas sa probinsya ang nagapabilin nga isolated (as of press time).
english: In Panganiban, Catanduanes it made landfall last Saturday night and five of the six isolated areas in the province remain isolated (as of press time).

text: Gina-imbestigahan na sang National Privacy Commision ang masobra 90 ka mga mobile lending apps nga nagapakahuya sa mga tawo nga indi makabayad sang utang.
english: The National Privacy Commission is already investigating more than 90 mobile lending apps that trick people into defaulting on debt.

text: Ini matapos nga may mga reklamo sang pila ka mga nangutang sa app nga ginapakahuy-an sila sa ila mga contacts.
english: This comes after complaints from some borrowers on the app that they are being shamed into their contacts.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes makahulam sang kwarta sa mobile lending apps, kinahanglan nga ihatag ang iban nga mga contacts ukon mga cellphone numbers sang imo ka kilala kag iban pa nga detalye.
english: It is known that before borrowing money from mobile lending apps, it is necessary to provide other contacts or cellphone numbers of your acquaintances and other details.

text: Suno kay National Privacy Commision Raymund Liboro, lihok sang mobile lending apps nga pakahuy-an ang tawo nga nangutang agud nga makabayad.
english: According to National Privacy Commission Raymund Liboro, the move of mobile lending apps is to embarrass the borrower in order to pay.

text: Dugang pa ni Liboro, usisaon sang talatapan kun bala insakto ang nangin paggamit sang mga pribado nga datos sang mga nangutang sa lending apps.
english: Liboro said the office will investigate whether the private data of borrowers in lending apps was used correctly.

text: Sa subong, gina-imbestigahan na ang 93 ka mga mobile lending apps nga ginareklamo.
english: So far, 93 mobile lending apps are being investigated for complaints.

text: Nalakip ang isa ka obispo sa apat ka mga tawo nga nabun-an kadungan sang isa ka sermon sa simbahan nga gina-stream online sa Australia.
english: A bishop was among four people stabbed during a church sermon streamed online in Australia.

text: Natabo ini nga insidente pasado ‘las syete Lunes sang gab-i sa Christ The Good Shepherd Church sa Wakeley, western Sydney.
english: The incident occurred around 7pm on Monday at Christ The Good Shepherd Church in Wakeley, western Sydney.

text: Ang gin-atake nga obispo ang ginpangalanan sang local media nga si Mar Mari Emmanuel kag ini nga identity ang ginkumpirma man sang simbahan nga Eastern Orthodox.
english: The attacked bishop was named by local media as Mar Mari Emmanuel and this identity was also confirmed by the Eastern Orthodox Church.

text: Gindugang man sang simbahan sa isa ka statement nga may isa pa ka pari nga si “Father Isaac” nga nasamaran man kag gindala na sa ospital.
english: The church also added in a statement that another priest, Father Isaac, was also injured and taken to hospital.

text: Suno pa sa pulis, wala sang seryoso nga samad nga naangkon ang mga mga biktima.
english: Police said the victims were not seriously injured.

text: Arestado man ang wala pa nahingadlan nga 15-anyos nga suspek apang ginahibalo pa kun ano ang motibo sini kag kun ano nga patalom ang iya gingamit sa krimen.
english: An unnamed 15-year-old suspect was also arrested but his motive and the knife he used in the crime are still unknown.

text: Pagkatapos sang atake, nagtipon ang ginabanta 2,000 ka akig nga mga tawo malapit sa simbahan kag nabudlayan naman ang mga pulis nga mapabilin ang kalinong.
english: After the attack, about 2,000 angry people gathered near the church and police found it difficult to maintain peace.

text: Ang lugar nga natabuan sang krimen ang nahamtangan man sang gamay nga Christian Assyrian community sa Sydney kun sa diin kadam-an sa ila ang nagpalagyo gikan sa persecution kag gyera sa Iraq kag Syria.
english: The crime scene is also home to a small Christian Assyrian community in Sydney, many of whom have fled persecution and war in Iraq and Syria.

text: Madamo ang naalarma sa sini nga hitabo ilabi na bangud natabo ini pila ka adlaw kasunod sang mass stabbing sa isa ka shopping mall sa amo man nga syudad sa Australia kun sa diin anum ka tawo ang napatay.
english: Many were alarmed by this incident especially since it happened a few days after the mass stabbing in a shopping mall in the same city in Australia where six people were killed.

text: Patay man ang suspek sa amo nga hitabo.
english: The suspect was also killed in the incident.

text: Wala pa sang kaathagan kun magkaangot ang duha ka nasambit nga mga insidente.
english: It is not clear whether the two incidents are related.

text: Totally burned ang duha sa tatlo ka mga pamalay sa nagluntad nga sunog sa Barangay Cadagmayan Norte, Sta.
english: Two of three houses were totally burned in a fire that broke out in Barangay Cadagmayan Norte, Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo.
english: Barbara, Iloilo.

text: Ang totally burned nga mga balay ang ginapag-iyahan nanday Rhea Faustino, kag Raymundo Garcia.
english: The totally burned houses are owned by Rhea Faustino, and Raymundo Garcia.

text: Samtang ang partially burned naman ang ginapanag-iyahan ni Abner Garcia.
english: The partially burned one was owned by Abner Garcia.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fire Officer Michael Gallego, imbestigador sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP)-Sta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fire Officer Michael Gallego, investigator of the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP)-Sta.

text: Barbara, iya ginpahayag nga nakabaton sila sang kaina sang kaagahon.
english: Barbara, he said they received it yesterday morning.

text: Suno kay Gallego, madasig nga naglapta ang kalayo nga nagtupok sang tatlo ka panimalay sang magparentihanay.
english: According to Gallego, the fire spread quickly and burned down three houses of relatives.

text: Ginkumpirmar man ni Gallego nga may yara sang gamay nga porsyon sang Chapel sang nasambit nga Barangay ang nalab-ot sang kalayo.
english: Gallego also confirmed that a small portion of the Chapel of the said Barangay was affected by the fire.

text: Base sa initial nga imbestigasyon, posible nga naghalin ang kalayo sa kusina sang isa sa mga nasunogan nga balay.
english: Based on initial investigation, the fire may have started in the kitchen of one of the burned houses.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara sang 21 tanan ka mga indibidwal ang apektado sa nasambit nga sunog nga sa subong, temporaryo nga nagatiner sa chapel sang barangay.
english: It was learned that there are 21 individuals affected by the fire who are currently temporarily staying in the barangay chapel.

text: Wala naman sang may nasamaran sa nasambit nga insidente.
english: No one was injured in the incident.

text: Luwas na sa katalagman ang walo sa 21 ka Filipino nga seafarers sang MV Eternity C matapos ini maglugdang sa Red Sea sang gin-atake sang Houthi rebels sang Hunyo 7.
english: Eight of the 21 Filipino seafarers of the MV Eternity C are safe after it sank in the Red Sea when it was attacked by Houthi rebels on June 7.

text: Suno sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), naka-abot na sa Kingdom of Saudi Arabia ang mga na-rescue nga tripulante kag yara na sa joint custody sang Philippine Consulate General sa Jeddah, Migrant Workers’ Office – Jeddah, kag sang ila shipping agency.
english: According to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), the rescued crew have arrived in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and are in the joint custody of the Philippine Consulate General in Jeddah, Migrant Workers’ Office – Jeddah, and their shipping agency.

text: Ginpaathag sang DFA nga ipaidalum anay sa mandatory medical assistance ang mga na-rescue antes ipaidalum sa natalana nga repatriation program pauli sa Pilipinas.
english: The DFA explained that the rescued will be subjected to mandatory medical assistance before being subjected to the scheduled repatriation program back to the Philippines.

text: Nagpasiguro man ang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) nga nagahugpong sila sang pwersa kaupod ang DFA kag Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) agud mapadasig ang pagpauli sang mga tripulante kag masiguro ang ila kahimtangan.
english: The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) also assured that they are joining forces with the DFA and Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) to expedite the return of the crew and ensure their condition.

text: Matandaan nga sang Hunyo 7, gin-atake sang Houthi militants ang MV Eternity C gamit ang sea drones kag rocket-propelled grenades samtang naga-navigate ini sa Red Sea, isa sa mga delikado nga ruta sang international shipping bangud sa armado nga tensyon sa rehiyon.
english: It can be recalled that on June 7, Houthi militants attacked the MV Eternity C with sea drones and rocket-propelled grenades while it was navigating the Red Sea, one of the most dangerous international shipping routes due to armed tensions in the region.

text: Padayon nga ginapangitaan sang paagi sang gobyerno ang iban pa nga mga tripulante kag ginapangabay ang kooperasyon sang international community para sa seguridad sang mga Filipino seafarers sa Middle East.
english: The government continues to seek ways for the rest of the crew and seeks the cooperation of the international community for the safety of Filipino seafarers in the Middle East.

text: Gintawag ni IBON Foundation executive director Sonny Africa nga ‘fairytale economy’ ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas.
english: IBON Foundation executive director Sonny Africa called the Philippine economy a ‘fairytale economy’.

text: Suno kay Africa indi matuod nga mabaskog ang ekonomiya sang pungsod sa subong hindi pareho sa ginapahayag sang economic manager sang Duterte Administration.
english: Africa said it is not true that the country's economy is strong at the moment unlike the economic manager of the Duterte Administration.

text: Suno kay Africa, nagluya ang  gross domestic product sa 11 quarters humalin sang nagsugod ang Duterte administration sang 2016.
english: According to Africa, the gross domestic product has weakened in 11 quarters since the Duterte administration began in 2016.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga santo sa data gikan  sa Philippine Statistics Authority,ang GDP growth ang nagsarurot sa pinakamanubo sa sulod sang apat ka tuig sa 5.6% sa  first quarter sang 2019.
english: He said that based on data from the Philippine Statistics Authority, GDP growth fell to the lowest in four years at 5.6% in the first quarter of 2019.

text: Gindugang pa sang executive director nga apisar may increase nga 7.2% sa third quarter sang  2017,apang ini ang ginsundan sang madasig man nga pagsarurot.
english: The executive director added that although there was an increase of 7.2% in the third quarter of 2017, it was followed by a rapid decline.

text: Matandaan nga ginpahayag ni Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Benjamin Diokno  nga ginakabig niya nga yara sa ‘goldilocks’ period ang ekonomiya subong ukon may yara sang high economic growth kag low inflation.
english: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Benjamin Diokno said he considers the economy to be in a goldilocks period with high economic growth and low inflation.

text: Tatlo na ang napatay bangud sa tuman ka init nga panahon sa Iloilo City, santo sa data sang Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) nga na-record sugod sang Abril 16 tubtob Abril 21, 2025.
english: Three people have died due to the extremely hot weather in Iloilo City, according to data from the Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) recorded from April 16 to April 21, 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Mischelle Tanteo-Cayongcat, Medical Officer IV sang Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, iya ginpahayag nga may kabug-usan nga walo ka kaso sang heat related incident ang narekord sa syudad kon sa diin, lima ang lalaki kag tatlo ang babaye.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Mischelle Tanteo-Cayongcat, Medical Officer IV of the Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, said a total of eight cases of heat related incidents were recorded in the city, five of which were males and three were females.

text: Suno kay Cayongcat, naga-edad sang pulo ka tuig ang pinakabata, samtang 61-anyos pataas naman ang pinakatigulang.
english: According to Cayongcat, the youngest is 10 years old, while the oldest is 61 years old.

text: Gintuad man sini nga kalabanan sa complaint sang mga biktima amo ang tuman nga exposure sa init, apang may yara man nga nasapwan mismo sa ila puluy-an.
english: He also admitted that most of the complaints of the victims were excessive exposure to the heat, but some were found in their homes.

text: Lakip sa ginreklamo sang mga natungdan amo ang paglingin sang ulo, chest pain, pagtaas sang blood pressure, pag-blurred sang panan-awan, kag pagkalipong.
english: Among the complaints were dizziness, chest pain, increased blood pressure, blurred vision, and dizziness.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa publiko nga mag-inom sang madamo nga tubig, maglikaw magpainit saguwa, kag magsuksok sang light colored nga panapton agud makalikaw sa mga nasambit nga risgo.
english: He also advised the public to drink plenty of water, avoid overheating, and wear light colored clothing to avoid these risks.

text: Nag-request si US President Joe Biden sang dugang nga $128 million ukon P7.24-billion para sa infrastructure projects sa 2025 kun sa diin nalakip ang Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement (EDCA) sites sa Pilipinas.
english: US President Joe Biden has requested an additional $128 million or P7.24-billion for infrastructure projects by 2025 which includes Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement (EDCA) sites in the Philippines.

text: Nakasaad ini sa Budget Request sang presidente sa Kongreso para sa Fiscal Year 2025.
english: This is stated in the president's Budget Request to Congress for Fiscal Year 2025.

text: Suno sa fact sheet nga ginpaguwa sang White House, magalunsar ang US Agency for International Development (USAID) sang bag-o nga inisyatibo para sa masunod nga tuig kun sa diin may iga-preposition nga humanitarian relief commodities sa EDCA site.
english: According to a fact sheet released by the White House, the US Agency for International Development (USAID) will launch a new initiative for next year where humanitarian relief commodities will be prepositioned at the EDCA site.

text: Ang EDCA ang napirmahan sang 2014 kag nakasaad diri nga mahimo makahanas sang tingob ang militar sang Amerika kag Pilipinas.
english: The EDCA was signed in 2014 and states that the US and Philippine militaries can train together.

text: Halin sa lima ka sites, nahimo naman nga siyam ang EDCA sites diri sa Pilipinas sang 2023 nga ginkaakig naman sang China.
english: From five sites, there will be nine EDCA sites in the Philippines in 2023, which has angered China.

text: Suno sa White House, ang USAID nga maga-partner sa US Department of Defense ang magapasangkad pa sang civilian-military disaster response training para nga mapauswag pa ang response systems sa tunga sang civilian kag military agencies sang Pilipinas kag Amerika amo man ang international humanitarian organizations.
english: According to the White House, USAID, which will partner with the US Department of Defense, will further expand civilian-military disaster response training to further improve response systems between civilian and military agencies of the Philippines and the United States as well as international humanitarian organizations.

text: Ini nga development ang ginpakigbahin man ni US Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin III kay President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: This development was also shared by US Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin III with President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: kadungan sang pagbisita sini sa Pentagon.
english: during his visit to the Pentagon.

text: Ini nga pagbisita sa Pentagon ang kasunod man sang Trilateral Leaders Summit kahapon sang aga (oras sa Pilipinas) sa tunga nanday President Marcos Jr., US President Biden, kag Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida.#
english: The visit to the Pentagon also follows the Trilateral Leaders Summit yesterday morning (Philippine time) between President Marcos Jr., US President Biden, and Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida.

text:
Gin-grant
sang RTC branch 2019 sa Mandaluyong City ang  ginfile sang  Panay
Electric Company (PECO) nga petition for declaratory relief.
english:
Granted
of RTC branch 2019 in Mandaluyong City filed by Panay
Electric Company (PECO) petition for declaratory relief.

text:
Ang
petisyon nagahingyo sang preliminary injunction agud untaton ang 
expropriation sang More Electric and Power Corporation (More Power)
sang distribution assets sang PECO  kag pagpugong  sa pag- isyu sang
licenses kag permits para maka -operate ang More Power.
english:
The
petition seeks preliminary injunction to stop the 
expropriation of More Electric and Power Corporation (More Power)
of PECO's distribution assets and preventing the issuance of
licenses and permits for More Power to operate.

text:
Sa
interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Mr. Marcelo Cacho, Admin
Manager sang PECO, iya ginpahayag nga ang ginpapanaug nga desisyon
sang korte nagasiling nga indi maka-partisipar ang More Power sa
expropriation proceedings.
english:
In
interview of Bombo Radyo Iloilo to Mr. Marcelo Cacho, Admin
Manager of PECO, he said that the decision issued
of court says More Power cannot participate in
expropriation proceedings.

text: Suno kay Cacho, nasaad sa desisyon nga void kag unconstitutional ang Sections 10 kag 17 sang Republic Act 11212 nga naga-grant sang franchise sa More Power bilang power distributor sa Syudad sang Iloilo.
english: According to Cacho, the decision states that Sections 10 and 17 of Republic Act 11212 which grant a franchise to More Power as a power distributor in Iloilo City are void and unconstitutional.

text:
Ginpahayag
sang natungdan, nagakahulugan ini nga magapabilin sa PECO ang mga
assets sini.
english:
Declared
of the concerned, this means that the
its assets.

text:
Handa
naman ang PECO suno kay Cacho nga depensahan ang kompaniya para sa
ginalauman nga pag-apela sang More Power sa nasambit nga desisyon sa
Court of Appeals.
english:
Handa
PECO, Cacho said, will defend the company for
More Power is expected to appeal the said decision to
Court of Appeals.

text: Samtang,wala nalingkang ang More Electric and Power Corporation (More Power) sa ginpapanaog nga desisyon sang  Mandaluyong RTC.
english: Meanwhile, More Power did not deviate from the decision of the Mandaluyong RTC.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Atty. Hector Teodosio, legal counsel sang More Power, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang seryoso nga epekto sa ila ang nasambit nga desisyon sang korte.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Atty. Hector Teodosio, legal counsel of More Power, said the court's decision has no serious impact on them.

text:
Suno
pa sa iya, indi pa pinal ang desisyon sang korte kag ila pa ini
mahimo i-apelar sa Court of Appeals ukon sa Korte Suprema.
english:
Dream
he said the court's decision is not final and it is still theirs
may be appealed to the Court of Appeals or the Supreme Court.

text:
Ginpahayag
naman ni Atty. Teodosio, kun may epekto gid man ini sa ila ginahingyo
nga writ of possession nga ila gin-file batok sa PECO sa Iloilo
Regional Trial Court Branch 37,ini ang minimal lang.
english:
Declared
Atty. Teodosio, if this has any effect on their demands
writ of possession filed against PECO in Iloilo
Regional Trial Court Branch 37, this is minimal.

text: Sa subong suno kay Teodosio, ila na lang ginahulat ang desisyon sang Iloilo RTC sa application for  writ of possession nga maga-authorize sa More Power nga i- expropriate  ang  distribution assets sang PECO nga suno pa sa iya, malayo nga matabo nga indi madayon ang ila pag-expropriate sa assets sang PECO.
english: Teodosio said they are currently waiting for the decision of the Iloilo RTC on the application for writ of possession that will authorize More Power to expropriate the distribution assets of PECO.

text: Ginaplano sang Iloilo City Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) nga magdugang sang concrete barriers sa Brgy.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) plans to add concrete barriers in Brgy.

text: Tagbak, Jaro, Iloilo City apisar sang makapila na ka beses nga ma-arado sang salakyan.
english: Tagbak, Jaro, Iloilo City despite being plowed several times by a vehicle.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, ang head sang Iloilo City Traffic Transportation and Management Office, iya ginpahayag nga indi lamang sa nasambit nga lugar nakahamtang ang concrete barriers bangud may yara man sa mga ‘strategic areas’ sa syudad.
english: Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, the head of the Iloilo City Traffic Transportation and Management Office, said the concrete barriers are not only located in the area but also in strategic areas in the city.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, tuyo lamang sang amo nga barriers ang ma-manage ang traffic sa isa ka lugar.
english: According to Garbanzos, the purpose of the barriers is to manage traffic in one area.

text: Dugang sini nga mismo ang mga driver ang may kabangdanan kon ngaa nagakadisgrasya sila amo nga lugar bangud man sa wala nagalantaw sa mga signages.
english: He added that the drivers themselves are responsible for the accidents in the area because they do not look at the signages.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa mga motorista nga himuon ang ‘defensive driving’ agud nga indi masulit ang pag-arado sang mga concrete barriers.
english: He also advised motorists to practice defensive driving to avoid repeated plowing of concrete barriers.

text: Nahibaluan nga tatlo tubtob apat na ka beses nga madalasa ang mga concrete barriers kag ginareklamo sang pila ka mga motorista nga madulom ang lugar.
english: It was learned that the concrete barriers have been crossed three to four times and some motorists complain that the area is dark.

text: Ginluthang-patay sang isa ka Barangay Tanod ang delivery boy sang tubig sa Brgy.
english: A Barangay Tanod shot dead a water delivery boy in Brgy.

text: Bolilao, Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: Bolilao, Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Junel Caspillo Diel, 32-anyos, may live in partner, delivery boy sang isa ka water refilling station kag residente sang People’s Village, Barangay PD Monfort North, Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as Junel Caspillo Diel, 32, has a live-in partner, delivery boy of a water refilling station and resident of People's Village, Barangay PD Monfort North, Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Samtang, ang suspek naman amo si Barangay Tanod Cirelo Defiño Sobrevega.
english: Meanwhile, the suspect was identified as Barangay Tanod Cirelo Defiño Sobrevega.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Master Sergeant John Mark Tuazon, imbestigador sang Dumangas Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagpadulong sa amo nga barangay ang biktima kaupod ang iya upod nga delivery boy sa amo nga barangay agud magkuha kuntani sang mga gallon agud i-refill sang tubig.
english: Police Master Sergeant John Mark Tuazon, investigator of the Dumangas Municipal Police Station, said the victim went to the barangay with his delivery boy to get gallons of water to refill.

text: Sa tion sang ila pagpabalik, nasumalang nila ang barangay tanod nga nagasakay sa iya motorsiklo, ginpaypayan niya ang biktima kag ginpadulong sa higad sang dalan.
english: On their way back, they met the barangay tanod riding his motorcycle, he waved the victim and drove him to the side of the road.

text: Samtang nagapalapit ang biktima sa suspek, nagpaguwa na sang armas ang suspek kag ginpamangkot ang biktima kon mabato ini sa iya, nagsabat man ang biktima nga indi siya magbato bangud may kabataan ini, apang hinali lang nga gintiro sang suspek kag na-igo sa iya dughan kag tiyan nga gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: As the victim approached the suspect, the suspect pulled out a gun and asked the victim if he could throw stones at him. The victim replied that he would not throw stones at him because he had children, but the suspect suddenly shot him in the chest and stomach, causing his death.

text: Suno kay Tuazon, antes pa man ini matabo, may kinagamo sa amo nga barangay sa balay sang ka live in partner sang biktima sang Abril 20, kun sa diin na-involve diri ang biktima.
english: According to Tuazon, before this happened, there was a riot in the barangay at the house of the victim's live-in partner on April 20, where the victim was involved.

text: Sa amo nga tion, nagwatag sila sang mga barangay officials kag barangay tanod kon sa diin, lakip man ang suspek sa nagresponde, sa iya pag-abot, gulpi lang niya ginkuga sa likod ang biktima kag ginbalikid man sang biktima ang suspek kag ginsumbag.
english: At that time, they were shocked by the barangay officials and barangay tanods where, including the suspect who responded, when he arrived, he suddenly stabbed the victim in the back and the victim turned around and stabbed the suspect.

text: Ini man ang rason nga gindala ini sa police station apang nag-aregloghanay man ang duwa.
english: This is also the reason why he was taken to the police station but the two reconciled.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa ang hot pursuit operation sang kapulisan agud matul-id kung din nagpanago ang suspek agud maaresto kag mapasakaan sang nagakaigo nga kaso.
english: The police are still conducting a hot pursuit operation to determine where the suspect hid so that he can be arrested and charged.

text:
Gintawag
nga uyaya sang asosasyon sang mga mangunguma ang Provincial
Government bangud wala gihapon mahatag ang ayuda para sa kahalitan
nga natuga sang El Niño sa ila.
english:
Called
farmers' association urges Provincial
Government because the aid for the damage has not been given
caused by El Niño in them.

text:
Sa
interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Lucia Capadusio sang Federation
of Iloilo Farmers Association,iya ginpahayag nga dismayado sila
bangud wala sa gihapon sang klaro nga sabat ang kapitolyo kun ano nga
bulig ang ihatag sa mga mangunguma.
english:
In
interview with Lucia Capadusio of the Federation
of Iloilo Farmers Association, he said they are disappointed
because the capitol still does not have a clear answer as to what
assistance will be given to farmers.

text:
Suno
kay Capadusio, nagpadulong na sila sa provincial capitol agud manukot
sang bulig nga ginpangako sa ila.
english:
Dream
to Capadusio, they went to the provincial capitol to collect
of the help promised them.

text:
Suno
sa iya, sang ila ginpamangkot si Dr. Jerry Bionat, pinuno sang
Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office(PDRRMO),
wala ini sang pat-ud nga sabat kun san-o maaprubahan ang budget para
sa mga mangunguma  nga ginpasulod sa Annual Investment Plan nga ara
pa subong sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan.
english:
Dream
to him, when they asked Dr. Jerry Bionat, head of
Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office(PDRRMO),
it does not have a definite answer as to when the budget for
to the farmers included in the Annual Investment Plan
still in the Provincial Council.

text: Gindugang pa sang natungdan nga kun wala sila nagpadulong sa kapitolyo kahapon, wala sila nakahibalo nga ang napartiniser para sa ila ang para lang sa abono kag patubig apang wala madala ang bugas kag binhi nga ila lubos nga ginakinahanglan.
english: He added that if they had not gone to the capitol yesterday, they would not have known that the partition for them was only for fertilizer and irrigation but did not bring the rice and seeds that they desperately need.

text: Ginpangbuyagyag na sang whistleblower nga si Julie “Dondon” Patidongan ang pangalan sang mga pulis nga gin-alegar may kahilabtanan sa pag-kidnap kag pagpatay sa mga missing nga mga manugbulang sang 2021.
english: Whistleblower Julie “Dondon” Patidongan has already revealed the names of the police officers allegedly involved in the kidnapping and murder of the missing fishermen in 2021.

text:
Natabo ang pagbulgar sang mga pangalan ang nagpasaka si Patidongan kaupod ang pamilya sang missing sabungeros sang administrative complaint sa National Police Commission (Napolcom) batok sa masunod nga mga pulis:

Police Colonel Jacinto Malinao Jr.
english:
The disclosure of the names occurred when Patidongan and the family of the missing sabungeros filed an administrative complaint with the National Police Commission (Napolcom) against the following policemen:

Police Colonel Jacinto Malinao Jr.

text: (Visayas)Police Lieutenant Colonel Ryan Jay Orapa (Highway Patrol Group or HPG)Police Major Mark Philip Almedilla (Cavite HPG)Police Executive Master Sergeant Aaron Ezrah Cabillan (HPG)Police Chief Master Sergeant Arturo dela Cruz Jr.
english: (Visayas)Police Lieutenant Colonel Ryan Jay Orapa (Highway Patrol Group or HPG)Police Major Mark Philip Almedilla (Cavite HPG)Police Executive Master Sergeant Aaron Ezrah Cabillan (HPG)Police Chief Master Sergeant Arturo dela Cruz Jr.

text:
(Cavite HPG)Police Staff Master Sergeant (PSMS) Joey Encarnacion (Cavite HPG)PSMS Mark Anthony Manrique (HPG)PSMS Anderson Abale (Cavite HPG)Police Staff Sergeant Alfredo Andres (Cavite HPG, due for retirement)Police Corporal Angel Joseph Martin (Cavite HPG)

Sa iya affidavit, ginpahayag ni Patidongan nga ginpangbayaran ang mga pulis agud nga patyon ang mga manugbulang kag itagbong ang mga bangkay nila sa Taal Lake.
english:
(Cavite HPG)Police Staff Master Sergeant (PSMS) Joey Encarnacion (Cavite HPG)PSMS Mark Anthony Manrique (HPG)PSMS Anderson Abale (Cavite HPG)Police Staff Sergeant Alfredo Andres (Cavite HPG, due for retirement)Police Corporal Angel Joseph Martin (Cavite HPG)

In his affidavit, Patidongan said the police were paid to kill the hunters and dump their bodies in Taal Lake.

text: Bangud administrative complaint ini, mahimo nga ang penalidad amo lamang ang suspension ukon pagkakas sa ila sa serbisyo depende sa desisyon sang Napolcom.
english: Since this is an administrative complaint, the penalty may be suspension or removal from service depending on the decision of the Napolcom.

text: Gin-tag man ni Patidongan ang isa ka retired police major general nga si Jonnel Estomo nga amo ang former Southern Luzon commander sang Philippine National Police (PNP).
english: Patidongan also tagged a retired police major general Jonnel Estomo who is the former Southern Luzon commander of the Philippine National Police (PNP).

text: Ginpahayag sini nga ini nga anay general ang isa ka “alpha member” sang cockfighting industry, buot silingon, suod kay Atong Ang nga amo ang ginatudlo sang whistleblower nga amo ang mastermind sa krimen.
english: He said the former general is an “alpha member” of the cockfighting industry, that is, close to Atong Ang who is allegedly the mastermind of the crime by the whistleblower.

text: Ginserbehan sang show cause order sang Land Transportation Office Region 6 ang apat ka mga driver nga nagpositibo sa surprise drug test nga ginpatigayon sang ahensya kag liwat nga nagpositibo sa confirmatory test sang Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency Region 6.
english: The Land Transportation Office Region 6 served show cause orders on four drivers who tested positive in the surprise drug test conducted by the agency and again tested positive in the confirmatory test of the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency Region 6.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, ginpatigayon sang duha ka mga ahensya ang “OPLAN: HARABAS” sa Ceres Terminal sa Barangay Camalig, Jaro kag Mohon Terminal sa distrito sang Arevalo sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Last week, the two agencies conducted “OPLAN: HARABAS” at Ceres Terminal in Barangay Camalig, Jaro and Mohon Terminal in Arevalo district of Iloilo City.

text: Ang apat ka mga driver nga nagpositibo sa drug test ang ginalakipan sang taxi driver kag tricycle driver sa Ceres Terminal kag duha ka drivers sang mini bus sa Mohon Terminal.
english: The four drivers who tested positive for drugs include a taxi driver and a tricycle driver at Ceres Terminal and two mini bus drivers at Mohon Terminal.

text: Ginahatagan sang lima ka adlaw ang mga driver nga nagpositibo sa drug test nga magpaathag.
english: Drivers who test positive for drugs are given five days to explain.

text: Samtang, ginkumpirma sang Association of Taxi Operators of Panay (ATOP) nga nag-resign na ang taxi driver nga nagpositibo sa iligal nga druga.
english: Meanwhile, the Association of Taxi Operators of Panay (ATOP) confirmed that the taxi driver who tested positive for illegal drugs has resigned.

text: Ini kasunod sang ginpatigayun nga surprise drug testing sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) kag Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) sa Ceres terminal sa Jaro sang Abril 15, 2025.
english: This follows the surprise drug testing conducted by the Land Transportation Office (LTO) and Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) at the Ceres terminal in Jaro on April 15, 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Perfecto Yap, Presidente sang ATOP, iya ginpahayag nga nakaalerto na ang industriya sang mga taxi agud nga mahatagan sang igtalupangon ang kapareho nga insidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Perfecto Yap, President of ATOP, said the taxi industry is already on alert to pay attention to similar incidents.

text: Suno kay Yap, lakip sa tutokan sang talatapan amo ang mga nagasulod ukon naga-apply nga driver.
english: According to Yap, among the focus of the office are the drivers who enter or apply.

text: Gintuad man sini nga ang nagpositibo nga taxi driver ang gilayon nagpasa sang iya resignation kasunod sang nangin resulta sang drug testing.
english: He also admitted that the taxi driver who tested positive immediately submitted his resignation following the result of the drug testing.

text: Dugang niya nga wala na naglisensya ang driver sa operator sang taxi nga iya gina-ubrahan kag nagaguwa nga daw naglagyo lang ini.
english: He added that the driver did not give a license to the operator of the taxi he was working for and it appeared that he had just run away.

text: Nagpasalig man ini nga sundon sang mga taxi operators nga ipaidalom sa random drug testing ang mga drivers agud masigurado nga nagasunod sila sa pagsulundan.
english: He also assured that taxi operators will follow the random drug testing of drivers to ensure that they are following the rules.

text: ILOILO – Nag-umpisa na ang nationwide monitoring sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) agud nga masigurado nga de-kalidad nga mga produkto ang ginabakal sa mga commercial establishment.
english: ILOILO – The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) has started nationwide monitoring to ensure that quality products are purchased from commercial establishments.

text: Sa bahin sang Western Visayas, may yara sang 13 ka monitoring teams nga gintunga agud nga magpatigayon sang monitoring sa probinsya sang Aklan, Capiz, Iloilo, Iloilo City, Guimaras, Antique kag Negros Occidental.
english: In Western Visayas, there are 13 monitoring teams that have been divided to conduct monitoring in the provinces of Aklan, Capiz, Iloilo, Iloilo City, Guimaras, Antique and Negros Occidental.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo kay DTI-6 Regional Director Rebecca Rascon, iya ginpahayag nga katuyu-an sang nationwide monitoring amo nga mahibalu-an kun nakasulod sa quality standards ang mga produkto kasubong sang steel bars kag tanan nga sahi sang sanitary wares.
english: In an interview with Bombo, DTI-6 Regional Director Rebecca Rascon said the purpose of the nationwide monitoring is to determine whether products such as steel bars and all types of sanitary wares meet quality standards.

text: Ang mga negosyante nga madakpan nga magalapas sa pagsulundan suno kay Rascon ang may yara sang silot nga paga-atubangon.
english: Businessmen caught violating the rules, Rascon said, will face penalties.

text: Sa 1st offense suno kay Rascon, may yara sang P25,000 nga multa kag sa 2nd offense naman, nagalab-ot sa P32,000 ang multa.
english: For the 1st offense, Rascon said, there is a fine of P25,000 and for the 2nd offense, the fine is P32,000.

text: Ginpahayag ni Rascon nga nakadepende sa sirkumstansiya ang igahatag nga silot sa mga madakpan nga nagalapas sa nasambit nga pagsulundan.
english: Rascon said the punishment for those caught violating the rule depends on the circumstances.

text: Ginpasalig man sang natungdan nga mga pangayaw ang nagabug-os sang monitoring team agud nga malikawan nga may paboranay nga matabo.
english: The concerned foreigners also assured the monitoring team to avoid any favoritism.

text: ILOILO CITY-Ginsentensiyahan sang 18 ka bulan nga pagkapreso ang isa ka Polish priest bangud sa kaso may kaangtanan sa sex kag drug crimes.
english: ILOILO CITY – A Polish priest was sentenced to 18 months in prison for sex and drug crimes.

text: Ang pari amo si Grzegorz Kaszak nga gindagdagan sang silot bangud sang sexual offences, pag-supply sang druga kag kapaslawan nga maghatag sang assistance sa tawo nga yara sa ital- ital ang kabuhi.
english: The priest is Grzegorz Kaszak whose sentence was increased for sexual offences, drug supply and failure to provide assistance to a person in danger of death.

text: Ginapabayad man ini sang ($3,820) sa damages kag dugang nga kwarta para sa pondo nga ginagamit sa mga biktima sang krimen.
english: It is also required to pay ($3,820) in damages and additional money for the fund used for crime victims.

text: Bangud sa nature sang kaso, nangin pribado man ang trial sini.
english: Due to the nature of the case, the trial was also private.

text: Ginpahayag nga wala na sang appeal kasunod sang sentensiya sa iya.
english: He said there will be no appeal following his sentence.

text: Nahibaluan nga nabutang sa eskandalo ang Diocese of Sosnowiec sa southwest Poland kasunod sang naglupok nga balita nga may natabo nga sex party sa banwa sang Dabrowa Gornicza.
english: The Diocese of Sosnowiec in southwestern Poland has been thrown into scandal following reports of a sex party in the town of Dabrowa Gornicza.

text: Sang amo nga tion, nagpanaog sa pwesto ang bishop sang diocese nga wala sang ginplastar nga rason para sa iya resignation.
english: At that time, the bishop of the diocese stepped down without giving any reason for his resignation.

text: Si Kaszak ang ginsipa man sa simbahan sang nagligad nga tuig kasunod sang eskandalo.
english: Kaszak was also kicked out of the church last year following the scandal.

text: Suno kay Bombo Neva Intrepido-Kessler, international correspondent sa Poland, nag-ugat ang kaso sang may isa ka insidente kun sa diin may lalaki nga ginapahayag nga nag-collapse sa isa ka orgy sa balay sang pari bangud ginpainom niya ini sang erectile dysfunction pills.
english: According to Bombo Neva Intrepido-Kessler, international correspondent in Poland, the case stemmed from an incident where a man allegedly collapsed at an orgy in the priest's house because he gave him erectile dysfunction pills.

text: Nagtaas ang trust rating ni Presidente Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos suno sa survey sang Social Weather Stations (SWS) sang Hunyo.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos’ trust rating rose according to a June Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey.

text: Sa ginpagwa nga pahayag sang Stratbase Group kahapon, ginpahayag nga nagtupa sa 48% ang trust rating ni Marcos sang tinalikdan nga bulan nga mas mataas sang 10 percentage points halin sa 38% sang Mayo.
english: In a statement released by the Stratbase Group yesterday, Marcos' trust rating fell to 48% last month, 10 percentage points higher than 38% in May.

text: Samtang, halos wala man sang dako nga pagbag-o sa rating ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga nagapabilin sa 61% sang Hunyo, ikumparar sa 60% sang Mayo.
english: Meanwhile, there was almost no change in Vice President Sara Duterte's rating, which remained at 61% in June, compared to 60% in May.

text: Suno sa Stratbase, ginpatigayon sang SWS ang survey sang Hunyo 25 tubtob 29, 2025, sa 1,200 nga hamtong nga mga Pilipino sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: According to Stratbase, SWS conducted the survey from June 25 to 29, 2025, to 1,200 adult Filipinos nationwide.

text: May ±3% nga margin of error ang amo nga survey.
english: The survey has a ±3% margin of error.

text: Suno kay Stratbase Group President Prof.
english: According to Stratbase Group President Prof.

text: Victor Andres “Dindo” Manhit, importante ang resulta sang survey agud mahibaluan ang politikal nga kahimtangan sang nasyon kag balatyagon sang publiko sa mga nagapanguna nga lider sang pungsod.
english: Victor Andres “Dindo” Manhit, the results of the survey are important to determine the political situation in the country and the public's feelings towards the country's top leaders.

text: “The significant increase in President Marcos’ trust rating signals a possible renewed public confidence in his administration,” suno kay Manhit.
english: “The significant increase in President Marcos’ trust rating signals a possible renewed public confidence in his administration,” according to Manhit.

text:
“He must sustain these trust ratings since they are crucial indicators of political stability and governance performance.”

Samtang, sa amo man nga survey, nakakuha si Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero sang 55% nga trust rating sang Hunyo nga mas mataas sang 8 percentage points kumpara sang Mayo.
english:
“He must sustain these trust ratings since they are crucial indicators of political stability and governance performance.”

Meanwhile, in the same survey, Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero earned a 55% trust rating in June, up 8 percentage points compared to May.

text: Nagsaka man sang 8 puntos ang rating ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez sa 34% sang Hunyo.
english: House Speaker Martin Romualdez's rating also rose 8 points to 34% in June.

text: Ginhingyo ang respondents sa sini nga survey nga i-assess ang lebel sang ila salig sa key government officials paagi sa masunod nga kategorya: very much, somewhat much, undecided if much or little, somewhat little, kag very little.#
english: Respondents in this survey were asked to assess their level of trust in key government officials through the following categories: very much, somewhat much, undecided if much or little, somewhat little, and very little.#

text: Nagsulat ang Iran sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag ginsilingan ini nga magpahigad kag indi mag-intra samtang nga gina-preparahan subong ang pagtimalos bangud sa airstrike sang Israel sa consulate sang Iran sa Syria kun sa diin 13 ang patay lakip ang high-ranking Iranian military commanders.
english: Iran has written to the United States of America and told it to step aside and not participate while preparing revenge for Israel's airstrike on the Iranian consulate in Syria that killed 13 including high-ranking Iranian military commanders.

text: Suno kay Mohammad Jamshidi nga amo ang deputy chief of staff sang Iranian president para sa political affairs, ginpadala sini ang sulat sa Washington kag ginpaandaman pa ang Amerika nga indi mahulog sa patibong ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
english: Mohammad Jamshidi, the Iranian president's deputy chief of staff for political affairs, said he sent the letter to Washington and warned America not to fall into the trap of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

text: Suno kay Jamshidi, nagsabat ang Amerika sa Iran nga indi man pagdalahigon ang American targets.
english: According to Jamshidi, the United States responded to Iran that it would not target American targets.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes sini, naka-high alert na ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag ang Israel bangud sa posible missile kag drones nga ipalupad sang Iran bilang balos.
english: Earlier, the United States of America and Israel were on high alert for possible missile and drone launches by Iran in retaliation.

text: Nagpahayag naman ang Lebanese group nga Hezbollah nga amo ang pinakagamhanan nga militia sa Middle East nga indi sila magpahilabot apang “handa” man sila sa gyera sa Israel.
english: The Lebanese group Hezbollah, the most powerful militia in the Middle East, said it would not interfere but was also "ready" for war with Israel.

text: Pananglitan magbalos pa gid ang Israel kun mag-atake ang Iran suno sa grupo, posible gid nga matabo ang regional war.
english: If Israel retaliates further if Iran attacks, the group said, a regional war is likely.

text:
Nahibaluan nga sa Israel, kabahin sang preparasyon sa posible pag-atake sang Iran amo ang pag-suspend sang leave sang mga soldado, pagpatawag sang tanan nga reservists, pag-block sang GPS agud ma-disrupt ang GPS-navigated drones kag missiles, pagpasangkad sang air defenses, kag pagbukas sang shelters sa Tel Aviv.#

(Atta Kenare/AFP)
english:
It is known that in Israel, part of the preparation for a possible Iranian attack is the suspension of leave of soldiers, the summoning of all reservists, the blocking of GPS to disrupt GPS-navigated drones and missiles, the expansion of air defenses, and the opening of shelters in Tel Aviv.#

(Atta Kenare/AFP)
