text: Kun may makita kita nga amo, nagapundo gid kita agud nga mas mahimutadan ini, gina-istorya pa naton, kag ginahatagan sang pagkaon.
english: When we see one, we stop to get a better look at it, talk to it, and give it food.

text: May ara sang isa ka daan nga syudad kun sa diin linibo ang mga amo, kag sa una nga paglantaw, daw kaangay nga sila na ya ang tag-iya sang lugar!
english: There is an old city where there are thousands of employers, and at first glance, it seems that they already own the place!

text: Didto ini sa Lopburi, Thailand kun sa diin simbolo na sang lokal nga kultura ang mga amo sa sulod sang malawig nga dinekada… tubtub nga nagsiling ang otoridad nga tuman na gid sila ka damo, kag mabudlay pa gid bangud naga-grupo grupo man sila kag naga-ilinaway.
english: This is in Lopburi, Thailand where employers have been a symbol of local culture for decades... until the authorities said they were too many, and it was even more difficult because they were in groups and fighting.

text: Madamo na ang nasabaran sa sini nga mga sapat bangud indi lamang simple nga lumpat-lumpat ang ila ginahimo kundi nagapangagaw sang pagkaon, nagataklas sa mga shop, kag nagapamahog sang mga turista bangud sa ila ka-agresibo.
english: Many have become accustomed to these animals because they not only do simple jumping but also snatch food, climb shops, and threaten tourists because of their aggression.

text: Madamo man ang naalarma bangud sang nagligad nga bulan, isa ka babaye ang nabalian sang tiil sang gin-atake sang amo agud agawon ang iya pagkaon; samtang isa naman ka lalaki ang nahulog sa iya motorsiklo bangud man sa gutom nga amo.
english: Many are also alarmed because last month, a woman broke her leg when an employer attacked her to snatch her food; while another man fell off his motorcycle due to hunger.

text: Malapit 3,000 ini nga mga sapat kag nagtimbuok pa ang ila populasyon sang tion sang pandemya.
english: There are about 3,000 animals and their population has increased during the pandemic.

text: Bangud sini nga problema, nagtukod ang pulis sang isa ka special unit.
english: Because of this problem, the police set up a special unit.

text: Kun magkadto ikaw diri nga syudad, makit-an mo ang nagalinya nga mga pulis kag ang iban nagadalagan sa dalan samtang may dala nga tirador!
english: If you go to this city, you will see police lined up and some running down the street with snipers!

text: Apang depensa sang pulis, wala man sila nagagamit sang bato kun tiraduron nila ang mga sapat.
english: However, the police said they did not use stones when they shot the animals.

text: May yara man sang ranger ang Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation nga nagagamit sang tranquilliser gun agud nga maigu kag mapakalma ang agresibo nga amo kag isaylo ini sa temporary shelter.
english: The Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation also has a ranger using a tranquilliser gun to shoot and calm the aggressive boss and move him to a temporary shelter.

text: Ginpanindugan sang department nga makatawo man ang ila nga paagi bangud gina-sedate lamang ang amo kag ginasaylo man sa lugar kun sa diin indi ini makadala sang pamahog sa mga tawo.
english: The department insisted that their method is humane because the employer is sedated and transferred to a place where he will not pose a threat to people.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini nga mga macaques ang na-classify nga protected species sa idalom sang wildlife conservation law sang Thailand.#
english: These macaques are classified as protected species under Thailand's wildlife conservation law.

text: Nagpagwa sang mensahe si Archbishop Midyphil Billones sang Archdiocese of Jaro kasunod sang pagtaliwan sang Santo Papa nga si Pope Francis kahapon, Abril 21.
english: Archbishop Midyphil Billones of the Archdiocese of Jaro issued a message following the death of Pope Francis yesterday, April 21.

text: Sa iya mensahe, ginpabutyag ni Billones ang dako nga pagpasalamat sa 12 ka tuig nga pagserbisyo sang Santo Papa sa tion sang pagpaubos, pagpalangga, kag pagpakig-upod sa mga pumuluyo.
english: In his message, Billones expressed his gratitude for the Pope's 12 years of service in times of humility, love, and solidarity with the people.

text:
Suno kay Billones, gintapos ni Pope Francis ang iya nga pagpanglakaton sa kalibutan sa adlaw sang pagkabanhaw, kun sa diin isa ka adlaw sang paglaum kag kabuhi nga bag-o.

Dugang pa ni Billones, ginpalapit sang Santo Papa ang simbahan kag ang mga tumuluo paagi sa gugma, kaayo, kag kaluoy.
english:
According to Billones, Pope Francis ended his journey on earth on the day of the resurrection, which is a day of hope and new life.

Billones added that the Pope brought the church and the faithful closer together through love, kindness, and compassion.

text: Ginhangyo niya ang mga tumuluo nga magpangamuyo kag maghalad sang mga misa para sa kalag ni Pope Francis nga nagbilin sang kasubo sa bug-os nga Katolikong katilingban.
english: He asked the faithful to pray and offer masses for the soul of Pope Francis who left grief across the Catholic community.

text: Ginpasidunggan man niya ang kabakod sang Santo Papa sa pagserbisyo sa mga imol, sa kalibutan, kag sa mga ginapabay-an sang sosyudad.
english: He also praised the Pope's commitment to serving the poor, the world, and the marginalized of society.

text: Ginhimo siya sang Diyos nga haligi kag manugpalangga nga naghalok sang tiil sang mga priso, naghibi upod sa mga biktima sang abuso, nagbukas sang iya tagipusuon sa mga migrante, kag nag-upod sa mga masakiton kag nasamaran nga mga tumuluo.
english: God made her a pillar and lover who kissed the feet of prisoners, cried with victims of abuse, opened her heart to migrants, and accompanied sick and wounded believers.

text: Ang ginbilin nga handum sang Santo Papa amo ang pagpadayon sang iya damgo nga ang Diyos yara, naga-upod, kag naga-ugyon sa aton kabuhi.
english: The Pope's legacy is to continue his dream that God is present, with, and in harmony with our lives.

text: Gintapos ni Billones ang iya mensahe paagi sa pagpasalamat sa tanan nga ginbilin ni Pope Francis kag handa siya nga magpadayon sang damgo sang Santo Papa para sa Simbahang Katolika.
english: Billones concluded his message by thanking all that Pope Francis has left behind and that he is ready to continue the Pope's dream for the Catholic Church.

text: Ginpuhag sang 4.8 magnitude nga linog ang New York City kag ang kaiping nga mga lugar pasado 10:00 Byernes sang aga (oras sa amo nga lugar).
english: A 4.8 magnitude earthquake shook New York City and surrounding areas around 10:00 am Friday (local time).

text: Suno sa United States Geological Survey, ang sentro sini amo ang Reddington Township sa New Jersey nga 40 miles west sang New York City.
english: According to the United States Geological Survey, its epicenter is Reddington Township in New Jersey which is 40 miles west of New York City.

text: Wala sang na-report nga major disruptions sa New Jersey kag sa New York magluwas lang sa pag-uyog sa mga building lakip na sa building sang UN Security Council kun sa diin na-interrupt ang meeting sang mga opisyal.
english: No major disruptions were reported in New Jersey and New York except for shaking in buildings including the UN Security Council building where a meeting of officials was interrupted.

text: Gin-shut down man ang air traffic sa major airports sa north-east sang US apang ginpabalik naman ang flights.
english: Air traffic was also shut down at major airports in the northeast of the US but flights were resumed.

text: Suno kay New Jersey Gov.
english: According to New Jersey Gov.

text: Phil Murphy, activated na subong ang State Emergency Operations Center.
english: Phil Murphy, the State Emergency Operations Center is now activated.

text: Pahayag naman ni New York Gov.
english: New York Gov.

text: Kathy Hochul, nabatyagan ang linog sa bilog nga New York kag padayon nga gina-assess sang mga opisyal ang epekto kag halit ilabi na sa posible matabo nga aftershocks.
english: Kathy Hochul, the quake was felt throughout New York and officials are still assessing the impact and damage especially the possible aftershocks.

text: Ginpaathag sang gobernador nga 2011 pa sang ulihi nabatyagan ang amo nga magnitude sang linog sa ila lugar rason nga napuhag gid ang mga tawo.
english: The governor explained that in 2011, the last time an earthquake of this magnitude was felt in their area, people were shocked.

text:
‘Under control’ ang sitwasyon suno naman kay US President Joe Biden kag magapadayon naman ang White House sa pagmonitor sa sitwasyon.#

(AP Photo/John Minchillo)(John Minchillo / ASSOCIATED PRESS)
english:
US President Joe Biden said the situation is under control and the White House will continue to monitor the situation.

(AP Photo/John Minchillo)(John Minchillo / ASSOCIATED PRESS)

text: Halos nawas-ag gid ang lawas sang isa ka assistant detachment commander sang Philippine Army matapos ginluthang gamit ang M16 sang isa ka CAFGU member sa Rodriguez, Rizal.
english: An assistant detachment commander of the Philippine Army was shot with an M16 by a CAFGU member in Rodriguez, Rizal.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas “Mark”, 35-anyos, katapo sang 80th Infantry Battalion, 21st Division sang Philippine Army.
english: The victim was identified as Mark, 35, a member of the 80th Infantry Battalion, 21st Division of the Philippine Army.

text: Ang nagtiro nga suspek amo si alyas “Prince”, 27-anyos kag ang mga upod sini sang natabo ang insidente amo sanday alyas “Jorald”, 34 kag “Samuel”, 53, nga lunsay CAFGU Active Auxiliary (CAA) nga nakadestino sa detachment sang biktima.
english: The suspect was identified as alias “Prince”, 27-years-old and his companions at the time of the incident were alias “Jorald”, 34 and “Samuel”, 53, both CAFGU Active Auxiliary (CAA) assigned to the victim's detachment.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, antes ang krimen, ginsita sang biktima ang mga suspek nga nagapahubog.
english: According to the investigation, before the crime, the victim caught the suspects getting drunk.

text: Kasunod sini, samtang yara ang biktima kag sanday Jorald kag Samuel sa sulod sang kitchen area, nagsulod si Prince kag gintayaan sila sang pusil.
english: Subsequently, while the victim and Jorald and Samuel were inside the kitchen area, Prince entered and pointed a gun at them.

text: Ginpunggan sang biktima si Prince agud pakalmahon apang nangakig ini kag ginkuha ang M16 armalite kag gin-ubos paarak ang bilog nga magazine sa biktima.
english: The victim stopped Prince to calm him down but he became angry and took out the M16 armalite and drained the entire magazine from the victim.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara na sang daan nga dumot ang mga suspek bangud sa masami pagsita sa ila nga pagpahubog.
english: It was learned that the suspects had an old grudge because of the frequent arrests for their drunkenness.

text: Mangatubang naman ang mga arestado sang kaso nga murder kag illegal discharge of firearms.
english: The suspects will face charges of murder and illegal discharge of firearms.

text: Nakaandan gid nga istrikto ang mga paagi sa pagkumpirma sang aton nga identity — halimbawa, kun may gawadon kita nga mga dokumento ukon may kuhaon nga kuwarta.
english: It is common to have strict ways of confirming our identity — for example, if we have to redeem documents or withdraw money.

text: Para man ini sa aton nga seguridad kag proseso ini agud makalikaw sa mga criminal.
english: This is also for our security and it is a process to avoid criminals.

text: Apang sa natabo sa Shandong Province sa China, agaw-atensyon gid ang paagi agud personal nga makumpirma sang isa ka tawo ang iya identity sa bangko.
english: But in what happened in China's Shandong Province, the way to personally confirm a person's identity at a bank is very tricky.

text: Ginpaathag sang pamilya sa bank manager nga na-ospital ang account holder bangud sa malala nga balatian.
english: The family explained to the bank manager that the account holder was hospitalized due to a serious illness.

text: Apang wala gid nagpadala ang manager kag gin-insister gid sa pamilya nga ang nagaisahanon nga paagi agud ma-access ang account sang holder amo nga dal-on ini sang personal sa bangko.
english: But the manager never gave in and strongly insisted to the family that the only way to access the holder’s account was to take it personally to the bank.

text: Nagsiling pa ang bangko nga pwede man makarga sa ambulansya ang account holder, apang nagpahayag naman ang ospital nga pwede lang mapaguwa ang ila ambulansya sa mga health-related emergencies.
english: The bank said that the account holder can also be loaded into the ambulance, but the hospital said that their ambulance can only be taken out in health-related emergencies.

text: Indi man makasarang ang pamilya sang private ambulance gani ang nabilin nga solusyon amo nga dal-on kag itulod ang hospital bed nga ginahigdaan sang pasyente pakadto sa bangko.
english: The family cannot afford a private ambulance so the only solution left is to carry and push the hospital bed where the patient is lying to the bench.

text: Madasig nga naglapta ang videos kag pictures sang nag-abot ang hospital bed sa bangko kag ginatinguhaan sang bata nga makapalapit sa counter sang clerk nga wala sang may bisan isa nga mabungguan.
english: The videos and pictures quickly spread as the hospital bed arrived at the bench and the boy tried to get close to the clerk's counter without bumping into anyone.

text: Kinahanglan gid abi sang pamilya ang kuwarta para sa treatment, apang nagalain gid ang ila buot nga mabutang man gihapon sa katalagman ang kabuhi sang pasyente agud lamang nga ma-access nila ang kuwarta nila sa bangko.
english: The family really needs the money for the treatment, but they are very upset that the patient's life is still in danger just to access their money in the bank.

text: Madamo naman ang nagsita sa bangko kag nag-apelar nga kuntani may yara man sang exception sandig sa ebidensya nga ginpresentar sang pamilya nga na-ospital ang ila himata kag nabudlayan sa paghulag.#
english: Many people visited the bank and appealed for an exception based on the evidence presented by the family that their relative was hospitalized and had difficulty moving.

text: LABI na gid nagainit ang kampanyahanay sa paghilapit na gid sang May 9, 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: THE campaign is getting especially heated as the May 9, 2022, election approaches.

text: Ginapahambog na gani sang isa ka kasumpong ni VP Leni Robredo nga segurado na ang ila kadalag-an.
english: One of VP Leni Robredo's opponents is even boasting that their victory is secure.

text: Aba, kag nagapanghanda na gani ini agud bantayan ang kuno pagpangdaya sang kasumpong.
english: Well, and it is even preparing to monitor the alleged deception of the opponent.

text: Pero ano gid ang kamatuoran?
english: But what is the truth?

english: The fact is that Marcos Jr.'s lead is rapidly eroding.

text: sa ila mismo survey.
english: in their own survey.

text:
Bisan gani sa iya probinsya nga Ilocos Norte nagasinggitan na ang madamo sing “Wala sing Solid North!”

Kon parti basi madayaan siya, basi siya pa ang mangdaya!
english:
Even in his province of Ilocos Norte, many are shouting “There is no Solid North!”

As for whether he might be cheated, he might be the one to cheat!

text: Indi pa malipat ang aton mga pumuluyo kon paano ang amay ni Marcos Jr.
english: Our people will never forget how Marcos Jr.'s father.

text: nga si Diktador Makoy ginpilit gid nga magdaug sa Snap Election sadtong 1986.
english: that Dictator Makoy was forced to win the Snap Election in 1986.

text: Kontrolado niya ang Comelec, gani sang amat-amat na mag-abanse si Cory samtang nagapatapos na ang inisipay hinali lang nag-brownout.
english: He controls the Comelec, so when Cory slowly advanced as the counting was ending, there was a sudden brownout.

text: Sang magbalik ang kuryente, ano nga milagro kay abanse na si Diktador Makoy!
english: When the electricity came back, what a miracle because Dictator Makoy was ahead!

text: Wala ini maluyagi sang mga election canvasser kag nag-walkout sila.
english: The election canvassers did not like this and walked out.

text: Wala man ini naluyagan nanday sadto Chief Constabulary Fidel Ramos kag Defense Secretary Juan Ponce Enrile kag nag-deklarar na sang ila pagbulag sa liderato ni Diktador Makoy.
english: Former Chief Constabulary Fidel Ramos and Defense Secretary Juan Ponce Enrile also did not like this and declared their separation from the leadership of Dictator Makoy.

text: Gin-ugyunan ini ni Cardinal Sin.
english: Cardinal Sin agreed.

text: Nagpanawagan gid gani ini nga proteksyunan ang duha.
english: He even called for the two to be protected.

text: Dayon man gin-updan ini sang minilyon nga mga pumuluyo nga nagtipon sa palibut sang Camp Crame kon diin nagapanago ang duha.
english: It was then joined by millions of citizens who gathered around Camp Crame where the two were hiding.

text: Gin-updan man ini sang mga loyal sa ila sa Air Force nga nagpamahog na sa Malakanyang.
english: They were also accompanied by their loyalists in the Air Force who have already threatened Malakanyang.

text: Kag nagtuhaw ang Edsa Revolution, nga nagpalayas na sa pamilya ni Diktador Makoy sa Hawaii sadtong Pebrero 25, 1986.
english: And then came the Edsa Revolution, which drove the family of Dictator Makoy out of Hawaii on February 25, 1986.

text: In other words, basi sila pa gani ang nagaplano sing dinayaay sa May 2022 Election.
english: In other words, they may even be planning fraud in the May 2022 Election.

text: Kag basi liwat magtuhaw ang Edsa Revolution sang 1986, pareho sang ginakahangaw-an sang isa ka tumalambong sa isa ka forum sang mga nagadalagan Presidente.
english: And maybe the Edsa Revolution of 1986 will resurface, as one attendee at a forum of Presidential candidates feared.

text:

english:

text: sa ila survey nga may 2,000 lang ka respondents halin sa mga 65 ka milyon nga botante para sa ining eleksyon sa Mayo.
english: in their survey with only 2,000 respondents out of about 65 million voters for this May election.

text: Gin-ako nila ugaling nga madamo nga sektor ang wala nasakop sang ila pag-survey.
english: They however acknowledged that many sectors were not covered by their survey.

text: Gani indi masiling nga “representative” gid ini sang kabug-usan, luas pa sa kadiutay sang mga respondent sini.
english: So it cannot be said to be truly “representative” of the whole, except for the small number of respondents.

text: In fact, wala sing poll survey, bisan pa ang bantugon nga Gallup Polls, nga makapakot gid kon sin-o ang madaug tubtub matabo na ang eleksyon.
english: In fact, no poll survey, not even the famous Gallup Polls, can accurately predict who will win until the election.

text: Nagdaug presidente si Truman sang Estados Unidos bisan pierde sa survey.

english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's lawyer said they are no longer surprised by the evidence submitted by the International Criminal Court (ICC) in connection with the case against the former President.

text: Suno kay Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, apisar indi niya ibuyagyag ang reaksyon ni Duterte ukon ang estratehiya sang ila kampo, ginahimo nila ang maid-id nga pag-review sang masobra 2,300 ka dokumento nga ginpresentar sang prosekusyon halin Hulyo 1 tubtob Hulyo 4.
english: According to Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, although he will not reveal Duterte's reaction or the strategy of their camp, they are conducting a thorough review of more than 2,300 documents presented by the prosecution from July 1 to July 4.

text: Dugang pa ni Kaufman nga may siyam ka eksperto ang ila legal team nga nakatutok sa preparasyon para sa confirmation of charges hearing nga natalana sa Setyembre sini nga tuig.
english: Kaufman added that their legal team has nine experts focused on preparing for the confirmation of charges hearing scheduled for September this year.

english: Meanwhile, in a new document released on July 10, Duterte's camp insisted that the ICC has no jurisdiction over the case, which refers to the bloody anti-drug campaign when he was the former mayor of Davao and when he was president of the Philippines.

text: Malipayon kag puno sang paglaum nga nakapauli na sa ila kaugalingon nga puluy-an ang isa ka tawo nga amo ang labing-una nga recipient sang pig kidney transplant.
english: A person who is the first recipient of a pig kidney transplant is happy and full of hope that he has returned to his own home.

text: Ini amo si Rick Slayman, 62, nga ginpaguwa sa Massachusetts General Hospital duha ka semana matapos ang madinalag-on kag maragtason nga operasyon.
english: This is Rick Slayman, 62, released from Massachusetts General Hospital two weeks after a successful and historic surgery.

text: Suno pa sa ospital, maayo ang pag-recover ni Slayman kag padayon ini nga magapa-kondisyon sang iya nga lawas samtang ara sa ila nga balay.
english: According to the hospital, Slayman is recovering well and will continue to condition his body while at home.

text: Ginsapubliko man sang pasilidad ang statement sang pasyente: “This moment – leaving the hospital today with one of the cleanest bills of health I’ve had in a long time – is one I wished would come for many years.
english: The facility also made public the patient’s statement: “This moment – ​​leaving the hospital today with one of the cleanest bills of health I’ve had in a long time – is one I wished would come for many years.

text:
Now, it’s a reality and one of the happiest moments of my life.”

Ang amo nga pasyente ang residente sang Weymouth, Massachusetts, nga na-diagnose anay nga may end-stage kidney disease.
english:
Now, it’s a reality and one of the happiest moments of my life.”

That patient was a resident of Weymouth, Massachusetts, who had previously been diagnosed with end-stage kidney disease.

text: Ang operasyon sa iya amo ang labing-una nga tion nga wala napalpak ang pig kidney transplant sa isa ka buhi nga tawo — isa ka milestone sa patag sang xenotransplantation ukon ang animal-to-human transplant.
english: His surgery marked the first time a pig kidney transplant in a living human has failed — a milestone in the field of xenotransplantation or the animal-to-human transplant.

text: Ginsaad sang ospital nga nagpasugot ang pasyente sa amo nga transplant, bangud una, limitado na ang iya nga medical options kag ikaduha, gusto man sini nga makadala sang paglaum sa linibo ka mga pasyente nga posible mabuligan paagi sa sini nga procedure.
english: The hospital promised that the patient agreed to the transplant, because first, his medical options are limited and second, it also wants to bring hope to thousands of patients who may be helped through this procedure.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, indi ini ang una nga kidney transplant kay Slayman — sang 2018, nakabaton man siya sang kidney halin sa isa ka tawo bangud sa iya nga diabetes kag high blood pressure.
english: In fact, this isn’t Slayman’s first kidney transplant — in 2018, he also received a kidney from someone due to his diabetes and high blood pressure.

text: Samtang nagadugay kag nag-lima na ka tuig, ang amo nga kidney ang nagpakita na sang sintomas nga nagahina na ini rason nga nagbalik ang pasyente sa dialysis sang 2023.
english: As time went on and it has been five years, the kidney has shown signs of weakening, which is why the patient returned to dialysis in 2023.

text: Ang kaso ni Slayman amo ang ikatatlo nga xenotransplant kun sa diin gingamit ang organ sang baboy kag ginsaylo sa tawo.
english: Slayman's case is the third xenotransplant in which a pig organ was used and transplanted into a human.

text: Ang nauna nga duha ka procedure ang naggamit sang korason sang baboy apang pareho nga napatay ang pasyente pila ka semana matapos nga nabaton ang organs.
english: The previous two procedures used pig hearts but both patients died a few weeks after receiving the organs.

text: Nahibaluan nga kada adlaw, 17 ka mga tawo ang nagakapatay sa US samtang nga nagahulat sang organ kun sa diin ang pinakakinahanglanon amo ang kidney.
english: It is known that every day, 17 people die in the US while waiting for an organ where the most needed is the kidney.

text: Suno sa Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network, ginabanta 27,000 kidneys ang na-transplant sang 2023, apang malapit 89,000 ang yara sa waitlist para sa amo nga organs.
english: According to the Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network, an estimated 27,000 kidneys will have been transplanted in 2023, but close to 89,000 are on the waitlist for those organs.

text: Ginapatihan naman sang mga eksperto nga ang xenotransplantation ukon transplants halin sa sapat pakadto sa tawo amo ang kritikal nga parte sang pagsolbar sa kakulangan sang donor organs.#
english: Experts believe that xenotransplantation or transplants from animals to humans is a critical part of solving the shortage of donor organs.

text: Negative ang sabat ni Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) Southern Tagalog Commander Geronimo Tuvilla sang ginpamangkot angot sa posibilidad nga may nakuha sila nga ebidensya may kaangtanan sa pagkadula sang mga manugbulang sa Taal Lake.

text: Indi mahimo nga makansela ang Local Public Transport Route Plan (LPTRP) sa Iloilo bangud wala pa man ininaaprubahan sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB).
english: The Local Public Transport Route Plan (LPTRP) in Iloilo cannot be canceled because it has not yet been approved by the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB).

text: Ini kasunod man sang panawagan sang No to PUV Coalition Panay nga indi na lang pagdayunon ang Public Transport Modernization Program (PTMP) sa western Visayas.
english: This follows the call of the No to PUV Coalition Panay not to continue the Public Transport Modernization Program (PTMP) in western Visayas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ex-officio Board Member Ramon Sullano, Chairman sang Committee on Transportation sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan ng Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga nagapabilin nga myembro pa ang Iloilo sang LPTRP rason nga indi gilayon ini maaprubahan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ex-officio Board Member Ramon Sullano, Chairman of the Committee on Transportation of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Iloilo, said that Iloilo remains a member of the LPTRP and that is why it will not be approved immediately.

text: Suno kay Sullano, antes ini maaprubahan, magaagi ini sa public consultation kag hearing antes nga ma-propose ang amo nga ordinansa.
english: According to Sullano, before it is approved, it will go through public consultation and hearing before the ordinance is proposed.

text: Dugang niya may yara sang 67 existing rationalize routes sa Iloilo nga nga gin-modify.
english: He added that there are 67 existing rationalize routes in Iloilo that have been modified.

text: Samtang, may yara sang walo ka national routes nga ginagamit bilang passenger magnet kaangay sang mga pantalan.
english: Meanwhile, there are eight national routes that are used as passenger magnets like ports.

text: Nahibaluan nga Oktubre sang ginpasa ang revised nga LPTRP sa bahin sang LTFRB nga insigida man nga ginkay-o sang nasambit nga talatapan.
english: The revised LPTRP was submitted to the LTFRB in October and was immediately revised by the said office.

text: Ginkonsiderar diri ang passenger demands kag ang route alignment sang amo nga tikang.
english: Passenger demands and the route alignment of such a move were considered here.

text: Na-monitor sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) ang duha ka mga barko sang People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLA) sang China nga yara sa dagat nga sakop sang Occidental Mindoro.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) has monitored two Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy (PLA) ships in the waters of Occidental Mindoro.

text: Suno sa PCG, ini nga Chinese warships ang na-obserbahan 69.31 nautical miles halin sa Cabra Island.
english: According to the PCG, these Chinese warships were observed 69.31 nautical miles from Cabra Island.

text: Ginpahayag sang Coast Guard nga nag-radyo ang BRP Teresa Magbanua sa PLA Navy warship 793, apang wala nagsabat ang vessel.
english: The Coast Guard said BRP Teresa Magbanua radioed PLA Navy warship 793, but the vessel did not respond.

text: Ang nag-respond suno sa PCG amo ang escort sini nga amo ang China Coast Guard 4203 nga amo ang nagpanindugan nga may soberanya ang China sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The respondent, according to the PCG, was its escort, China Coast Guard 4203, who insisted that China has sovereignty over the West Philippine Sea.

text: Magluwas sa duha ka nasambit nga vessels, may nakit-an man nga PLA Navy warship 164.
english: Besides the two vessels, a PLA Navy warship 164 was also found.

text: “The movements of these vessels have necessitated several radio challenges from the PCG throughout the day, without response from the PLA Navy warships,” suno sa PCG.
english: “The movements of these vessels have necessitated several radio challenges from the PCG throughout the day, without response from the PLA Navy warships,” according to the PCG.

text:
Pahayag pa sini, “it has been observed that PLA Navy warship 164 is conducting helicopter landing exercises on its flight deck, with continuous activity recorded throughout the morning.”

Matandaan nga Hulyo 12 sang ginselebrar sang Pilipinas ang anibersaryo sang landmark ruling sang Permanent Court of Arbitration sa The Hague nga nagapabor sa Pilipinas sa isyu sa West Philippine Sea kag nagabasura naman sa nine-dash-line claim sang Beijing.#
english:
It said, “it has been observed that PLA Navy warship 164 is conducting helicopter landing exercises on its flight deck, with continuous activity recorded throughout the morning.”

The Philippines celebrated the anniversary of the landmark ruling of the Permanent Court of Arbitration in The Hague on July 12, which favored the Philippines on the West Philippine Sea issue and rejected Beijing's nine-dash-line claim.

text: Ginakabig sang Archdiocese of Jaro nga isa ka regalo ang kabuhi ni Pope Francis sa kadam-an ilabi na sa Simbahang Katolika.
english: The Archdiocese of Jaro considers the life of Pope Francis as a gift to the masses, especially to the Catholic Church.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rev.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rev.

text: Father Angelo Colada, Director sang Social Communication sang Archdiocese of Jaro, iya ginpahayag nga indi lamang basta regalo ang kabuhi ni Pope Francis kundi regalo ini nga naghalin sa Diyos.
english: Father Angelo Colada, Director of Social Communication of the Archdiocese of Jaro, said that Pope Francis' life is not just a gift but a gift from God.

text: Suno kay Colada, indi lang nagserbe nga pinakamataas nga lider sang simbahang Katolika sang Santo Papa, nagserbi man ini nga simple nga amay kag nagpahanumdom sa mga Pilipino sang pagkamalig-on sang pagtuo.
english: Colada said the Pope not only served as the highest leader of the Catholic Church, he also served as a simple father and reminded Filipinos of the strength of faith.

text: Dugang sini nga tuman ka dako ang nangin ambag sang Santo Papa sa Kristyanong katilingban.
english: He added that the Pope has made a great contribution to the Christian community.

text: Nagalaum man ini nga kasunod sang pagtaliwan ni Pope Francis, magapadayon sa gihapon ang ginbilin sini nga adbokasiya nga pagbulig sa mga ginsikway nga mga sektor sang katilingban.
english: He also hopes that following the death of Pope Francis, his legacy of advocacy to help the marginalized sectors of society will continue.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes nagtaliwan si Pope Francis, naghimo ini sang iya katapusan nga pagpakita sa publiko sang Domingo sang Pagkabanhaw, Abril 20, sa diin naghatag siya sang blessings nga kilala bilang ‘Urbi et Orbi’ sa St.
english: It is known that before Pope Francis passed away, he made his last public appearance on Easter Sunday, April 20, when he gave blessings known as ‘Urbi et Orbi’ at St.

text: Peter’s Square.
english: Peter’s Square.

text: Gin-ako sang militar sang Israel nga isa ka “sala” ang ila ginhimo nga airstrike nga rason sang kamatayon sang aid workers sang non-profit nga World Central Kitchen sa Gaza.
english: The Israeli military has admitted it was a “mistake” to carry out an airstrike that killed aid workers of the non-profit World Central Kitchen in Gaza.

text: Suno kay Israeli Defence Forces chief Herzi Halevi, isa ka “grave mistake” ang ila nahimo kag wala dapat natabo apang may yara sang “misidentification” bangud gab-i sang nagluntad ang insidente.
english: According to Israeli Defense Forces chief Herzi Halevi, they made a “grave mistake” and should not have happened but there was a “misidentification” because the incident occurred at night.

text: Sa statement ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, gin-ako man sini nga “inosente” nga mga tawo ang gin-igu sang ila nga militar kag ginlaragway man ang hitabo nga “tragic” kag indi man hungod.
english: In a statement, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu also acknowledged that "innocent" people were hit by their military and described the incident as "tragic" and unintentional.

text: Nagpasalig man ini nga gina-kontak na nila ang iban nga mga pungsod kun sa diin nagapauli ang mga biktima kag nagpasalig man nga indi na ini matabo liwat.
english: He also assured that they are already contacting other countries where the victims are returning and assured that this will not happen again.

text: Talalupangdon man nga bisan amo sini ang statement ni Netanyahu, wala ini nagpangayo sang pasaylo.
english: It is also noteworthy that despite Netanyahu’s statement, he did not apologize.

text: Pito ang patay sa amo nga airstrike lakip ang Australian, British, Palestinian, Polish kag US-Canadian staff sang nasambit nga charity.
english: Seven people were killed in the airstrike including Australian, British, Palestinian, Polish and US-Canadian staff of the charity.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang natabo ang gyera sa Gaza sang Oktubre 2023, ang amo nga charity nga naka-base sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang nagapakaon na sa mga tawo nga wala sang puluy-an.
english: It is known that since the war in Gaza broke out in October 2023, the charity, which is based in the United States of America, has been feeding homeless people.

text: Antes natabo ang pagpatay sa ila sang Lunes, bag-o lang gid nila nadiskarga ang masobra 100 ka tonelada nga pagkaon nga gindala sa Gaza paagi sa barko.
english: Before the killing took place on Monday, they had just unloaded more than 100 tons of food that had been brought to Gaza by ship.

text: Madamo nga world leaders ang nagahingyo sang imbestigasyon kasunod sang insidente — lakip si US President Joe Biden — kag nagmandu man nga pasabton ang may responsibilidad sa hitabo.
english: Many world leaders have called for an investigation following the incident — including US President Joe Biden — and have also ordered that those responsible for the incident be held accountable.

text: Ginsiling naman ni UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres sa atubang sang General Assembly nga 196 na ka humanitarian workers ang napatay halin sang nagsugod ang Israel-Hamas war.
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres told the General Assembly that 196 humanitarian workers have been killed since the Israel-Hamas war began.

text: Wala na ginapaligban ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang mga disinformation nga mga nagalapta batok sa iya kag sang Team Uswag.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas is no longer concerned about the disinformation that is spreading against him and Team Uswag.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya gintawag nga ang ‘fake news’ ang wala gid sang pulos sa sosyudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas called fake news useless in society.

text: Suno kay Treñas, indi siya threaten sa mga impormasyon nga nagapakamalot sa iya.
english: Treñas said he is not threatened by the information that criticizes him.

text: Para sa iya, dako ang role sang mga media agud batu-an ang mga peke nga impormasyon.
english: For him, the media has a big role to play in combating fake information.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa publiko nga basahon sang maayo ang mga balita nga ginakonsumo ilabi na sa social media.
english: He also advised the public to read carefully the news consumed especially on social media.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ang alkalde nga maghalong sa mga patalang nga nagalapta subong ilabi na nga inadlaw na lang kag magapili na sang bag-o nga lederes.
english: The mayor also reminded the public to be careful of the rumors that are spreading now especially that it is only a few days and will elect new leaders.

text: Ginatinguhaan pa sang kapulisan nga matumod ang isa pa ka suspek sa paglampos-patay sa isa ka panday sa Barangay Namocon, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: Police are still trying to identify another suspect in the stabbing death of a carpenter in Barangay Namocon, Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima sa amo nga insidente amo si Reymond Dilig Tuburan, 41, kag residente sang amo nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as Reymond Dilig Tuburan, 41, resident of the said barangay.

text: Una na nga na-identify ang isa ka suspek nga si Romvic Tumalaytay, residente man sang amo nga lugar, nga nadakpan sa hot pursuit operation kag positibo nga na-identify sang lima ka tuig nga bata sang biktima nga nakakita mismo sa krimen.
english: Earlier, a suspect, Romvic Tumalaytay, also a resident of the same area, was arrested in a hot pursuit operation and was positively identified by the victim's five-year-old son who witnessed the crime.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Alfred Mansoy, officer-in-charge sang Tigbauan Municipal Police Station (MPS), iya ginpahayag nga indi makilala sang bata kun sin-o ang isa pa ka suspek apang ginlaragway ini nga lalaki kag malaba ang buhok.
english: Police Captain Alfred Mansoy, officer-in-charge of the Tigbauan Municipal Police Station (MPS), said the child did not recognize the other suspect but described him as a man with long hair.

text: Gindugang ni Mansoy nga “John Doe” lang anay ang ibutang nila sa ipasaka nga panumbungon pareho man sa atubangon ni Tumalaytay.
english: Mansoy added that they will only put “John Doe” in the charges to be filed as well as Tumalaytay.

text: Pahayag ni Mansoy, todo-panginwala man ang nadakpan nga suspek sa akusasyon nga siya ang naghimo sang krimen.
english: Mansoy said the arrested suspect also denied the charges that he committed the crime.

text: Matandaan nga halin sa highway ang biktima samtang angkas ang iya lima ka tuig nga anak, kag sang malapit na sa ila nga balay, ginlambatan sila sang duha ka lalaki kag ginlampusan ang biktima sang ginabulubanta tatlo ka tapak nga kalabaon nga kahoy.
english: The victim was traveling on the highway with her five-year-old son, and when they were near their house, two men approached them and beat the victim with a three-foot-long stick.

text: Sang nalab-ot sang Bombo Radyo si Eden Tuburan, 38, asawa sang biktima, ginpahayag sini nga nagapati siya nga naangot sa iligal nga droga ang krimen.
english: When contacted by Bombo Radyo, Eden Tuburan, 38, the victim's wife, said she believes the crime was linked to illegal drugs.

text: Gintuad sini nga nagagamit sang illegal drugs ang iya bana apang wala sini makita ukon maaktuhan bangud sa kamalig ini nagagamit.
english: She admitted that her husband was using illegal drugs but she did not see or catch him because he was using it in the barn.

text: Pahayag niya, apisar nga nagagamit ang iya bana, ginatungdan ini sa gihapon ang iya responsibilidad bilang amay.
english: She said that although her husband is using, he still takes care of his responsibilities as a father.

text: Napamatud-an sang mag-asawa sa Oton, Iloilo nga may katapusan gid ang mga pagtilaw kag may paglaum gid sa kabuhi ang kada isa.
english: A couple in Oton, Iloilo proved that there is an end to trials and that each one has hope in life.

text: May kaangtanan ini sa pagselebrar sang Easter Sunday nga nagadul-ong sang mensahe sang panibag-o nga kabuhi pagkatapos sang pag-antos.
english: It is related to the celebration of Easter Sunday which brings the message of new life after suffering.

text: Ang mag-asawa amo sanday Junry Sencil kag Ancel Marie Sencil, lunsay 30 anyos ang edad kag nagapuyo sa Sta.
english: The couple were identified as Junry Sencil and Ancel Marie Sencil, both 30 years old and residents of Sta.

text: Monica, Oton.
english: Monica, Autumn.

text: Sang 2022, Si Junry ang naaksidente sa San Miguel, Iloilo kag ini ang nagbag-o gid sa iya kabuhi.
english: In 2022, Junry met with an accident in San Miguel, Iloilo and it changed his life completely.

text: Suno kay Toto, naguba gid ang iya nawong sa amo nga aksidente kag nabali ang iya tiil.
english: According to Toto, his face was badly damaged in the accident and his leg was broken.

text: Magluwas diri, wala naman siya nakatrabaho bangud sa iya sitwasyon.
english: Besides, he has not been able to work because of his situation.

text: Pahayag niya, sa sulod sang isa ka tuig nga yara lang ini sa ila balay samtang naga-recover, halos nadulaan ini sang paglaum, tubtob isa ka adlaw, may nalantaw ini nga isa ka online post nga naghatag sa iya sang bag-o nga perspektibo sa kabuhi.
english: She said that during the year she was at home while recovering, she almost lost hope, until one day, she saw an online post that gave her a new perspective on life.

text: Suno kay Junry, paagi sa amo nga post nga may tig-ulo nga “beautiful soul”, nakilala niya si Ancel Marie nga isa ka writer.
english: According to Junry, through the post titled “beautiful soul”, he met Ancel Marie who is a writer.

text: Si Ancel Marie ang naghatag sa iya sang paglaum sa kabuhi tubtob nga nahulog ang buot nila sa isa kag isa, nangin magkarelasyon kag nagpakasal sila.
english: Ancel Marie gave him hope in life until they fell in love with each other, became in a relationship and they got married.

text: Ginpahayag ni Junry nga nag-abot si Ancel sa iya kabuhi sang tion nga ginakinahanglan niya ini.
english: Junry stated that Ancel came into his life at a time when he needed him.

text: Suno naman kay Ancel Marie, malipayon siya nga nangin palaagyan ang iya mga sinulatan agud maghatag sang paglaum sa iban.
english: Ancel Marie said she is happy that her writings have become a way to give hope to others.

text: Mas nalipay man ini nga ang paglaum nga iya nahatag ang nangin palaagyan man agud mahimo ang isa ka matahum nga istorya sang ila paghigugma.
english: He is also happier that the hope he gave became a way to make a beautiful story of their love.

text: Dalawang sako ang narekober ng Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) mula sa ilalim ng Taal Lake sa bayan ng Laurel, Batangas nitong Sabado, habang nagpapatuloy ang search operation kaugnay ng kaso ng mga nawawalang sabungero.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) recovered two sacks from the bottom of Taal Lake in Laurel town, Batangas on Saturday, while continuing the search operation in connection with the case of the missing sabungero.

text: Ayon kay PCG Commodore Geronimo Tuvilla, may lamang mga bato ang naturang mga sako.
english: According to PCG Commodore Geronimo Tuvilla, the sacks contained only stones.

text: Agad itong isinurender sa PNP-SOCO at inilagay sa mga cadaver bag para sa forensic examination.
english: It was immediately surrendered to PNP-SOCO and placed in cadaver bags for forensic examination.

text: Inihayag din ni Tuvilla na pahirapan ang ginagawang search sa ilalim ng lawa dahil sa malakas na current at zero visibility.
english: Tuvilla also said that the search under the lake will be difficult due to the strong current and zero visibility.

text: Gumagamit umano ang mga diver ng mga buoy at flotation device bilang marker upang hindi sila ma-disorient at madaling mabalikan ang mga object na kanilang na-identify sa lake bed.
english: The divers use buoys and flotation devices as markers so that they are not disoriented and can easily return to the objects they identified on the lake bed.

text: Dagdag pa niya, kaagad nilang minamarkahan ang lugar kung saan may nadidiskubreng item upang masiguro ang maayos at maingat na retrieval pagdating ng SOCO, CIDG, at NBI.
english: He added that they immediately mark the area where an item is discovered to ensure a proper and careful retrieval upon the arrival of SOCO, CIDG, and NBI.

text: Noong Biyernes, dalawang sako rin ang nakita sa ilalim ng lawa na naglalaman ng mga buto, habang isang sako na may lamang sunog na buto ang nauna nang nadiskubre nitong Huwebes.
english: On Friday, two sacks of bones were also found at the bottom of the lake, while a sack of burnt bones was discovered earlier on Thursday.

text: Ayon kay DOJ Undersecretary Mico Clavano, sa kabila ng kakulangan ng visibility, nagawa ng mga diver na ma-identify ang mga sako sa pamamagitan ng pakiramdam sa lake bed.
english: According to DOJ Undersecretary Mico Clavano, despite the lack of visibility, the divers were able to identify the sacks by feeling the lake bed.

text: Bahagi ito ng imbestigasyong konektado sa kaso ng mga sabungerong dinukot mula taong 2021 hanggang 2022.
english: This is part of an investigation connected to the case of robbers kidnapped from 2021 to 2022.

text: Batay sa naunang pahayag ng whistleblower na si Julie “Dondon” Patidongan, patay na umano ang mga sabungero at itinapon ang kanilang mga katawan sa Taal Lake.
english: According to an earlier statement by whistleblower Julie “Dondon” Patidongan, the sabungero were allegedly dead and their bodies dumped in Taal Lake.

text: Gin-athag sang isa ka public law expert nga ang pagtinguha sa pag-regulate sa kinamatarong sang political dynasty members para sa public office, pareho sang ginaproponer nga Anti-Political Dynasty Bill, amo ang makatarunganon nga pagdumili sang kahilwayan sang isa ka indibidwal, agud nga mabuhinan ang ‘egoistic’ ukon kaugalingon nga interes sa pagpapili sa eleksyon.
english: A public law expert explained that the attempt to regulate the right of political dynasty members for public office, such as the proposed Anti-Political Dynasty Bill, is to reasonably restrict the freedom of an individual, so as to reduce ‘egoistic’ or self-interest in contesting elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Joenar Pueblo, Bombo Abogado, iya ginpahayag nga sa Under sa idalom sang 1987 nga Konstitusyon, ang mga dinastiya sa politika ginadumilian, apang kinahanglan ang isa ka nagapahanugot nga kasuguan sa pagpatuman sini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Joenar Pueblo, Bombo Abogado, he stated that Under under the 1987 Constitution, political dynasties are prohibited, but an enabling law is needed to enforce it.

text: Suno kay Pueblo, makapila ka bes nga pagduso ang ginhimo agud ipasar ang amo nga kasuguan, apang indi ini makatilingala bangud ang Kamara de Representantes kag ang Senado pareho nga ginapamunuan sang mga political dynasties.
english: According to Pueblo, several pushes have been made to pass the law, but this is not surprising because both the House of Representatives and the Senate are led by political dynasties.

text: Dugang sini nga halos imposible nga makumbinsi ang mga mamalidha nga magpasar sang kasuguan nga magahimo sa madamo sa ila nga mangin indi kwalipikado nga magpadalagan sa pampubliko nga posisyon.
english: He added that it would be nearly impossible to convince lawmakers to pass legislation that would make many of them ineligible to run for public office.

text: Kon padalman, ang presidente sang pungsod, si Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr., ang kabahin sang isa ka dinastiya sa politika.
english: In fact, the country's president, Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr., is part of a political dynasty.

text: Ang iya utod nga babayi isa ka senador, ang iya anak isa ka kongresista, ang iya pakaisa isa ka Speaker sang Kamara, kag may mga napilian siya nga mga himata sa Ilocos Norte kag Tacloban City.
english: His sister is a senator, his son is a congressman, his cousin is Speaker of the House of Representatives, and he has elected relatives in Ilocos Norte and Tacloban City.

text: Ang bise presidente sang pungsod, si Sara Duterte, isa man ka myembro sang political dynasty.
english: The country's vice president, Sara Duterte, is also a member of the political dynasty.

text: Ang iya mga utod amo ang alkalde kag kongresista sang Davao City.
english: His brothers are the mayor and congressman of Davao City.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mga political dynasty sa pungsod ang ginabasol sa padayon nga underdevelopment sang pungsod.
english: It is known that political dynasties in the country are blamed for the country's continued underdevelopment.

text: Masarangan mo bala mag-uyat sang bagay nga human sa panit sang iban… nga halimbawa abi… human sa panit sang tawo?
english: Can you hold something made of someone else's skin... for example... human skin?

text: Sang damlag lang, madamo gid ang interesado sa nangin anunsyo sang Harvard University nga ginkakas sini ang panit sang tawo nga amo nga cover sang isa ka 19th century nga libro nahanungod sa afterlife.
english: Recently, there was a lot of interest in Harvard University's announcement that it had removed the human skin from the cover of a 19th century book about the afterlife.

text: Ini nga libro ang yara na sa ila nga koleksyon halin pa sang 1930s.
english: This book has been in their collection since the 1930s.

text: Ang desisyon sang unibersidad ang kasunod sang review nga ginpatigayon kun sa diin may ethical concerns sa maragtas sang amo nga libro.
english: The university's decision follows a review conducted where there were ethical concerns about the history of the book.

text: Ini nga libro nga ginatawag “Des Destinées de L’âme,” ukon “Destinies of the Soul,” ang ginsulat sang French novelist kag poet nga si Arsène Houssaye 1880s.
english: This book called “Des Destinées de L’âme,” or “Destinies of the Soul,” was written by French novelist and poet Arsène Houssaye 1880s.

text: Ang printed text sini ang ginhatag sa doktor nga si Ludovic Bouland nga amo ang nag-bind sang libro gamit ang panit nga iya ginkuha halin sa bangkay sang isa ka babaye nga pasyente.
english: Its printed text was given to the doctor Ludovic Bouland who bound the book using leather he had taken from the corpse of a female patient.

text: Ginpahayag nga wala ini sang permiso nga kuhaon ang panit sa pasyente sa ospital kun sa diin siya nag-trabaho.
english: He reportedly did not have permission to remove the skin from the patient at the hospital where he worked.

text: Nalakip pa didto ang sulat sang doktor sa sulod sang libro kun sa diin iya ginsiling nga ang libro nga nahanungod sa kalag sang tawo ang nagakaangay man nga butangan sang cover sang iya sang tawo.
english: The doctor's letter was also included in the book where he said that the book about the human soul should also be covered by the human soul.

text: Didto pa nakabutang sa note ang proseso kun paano sini ginpreprar ang panit para sa binding.
english: The note also describes the process of how he prepared the leather for binding.

text: May ginhimo nga scientific analysis sang 2014 nga nagakumpirma nga human skin matuod ang cover sang amo nga libro!
english: A scientific analysis was done in 2014 that confirms that the cover of the book is real human skin!

text: Suno sa Houghton Library associate librarian, ang ginkakas nga panit ang natago subong sa storage sang library sa Harvard.
english: According to the Houghton Library associate librarian, the removed skin is now stored in library storage at Harvard.

text: Magapatigayon man ang Harvard sang dugang nga research sa libro, sa doktor, kag sa babaye nga pasyente nga amo ang ginkuhaan sang panit.
english: Harvard will also conduct further research on the book, the doctor, and the female patient from whom the skin was removed.

text: Nagapakig-angot man ang unibersidad sa French authorities agud nga matumod ang “final respectful disposition” sa amo nga human skin.#
english: The university is also liaising with the French authorities to determine the “final respectful disposition” of the human skin.

text: Hingalitan sang Panay Electric Company (PECO) ang 2 ka tuig nga extension nga ginhatag sa ila sang Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) nga magpadayon sa pag-distribute sang kuryente sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: The Panay Electric Company (PECO) will take advantage of the two-year extension given to it by the Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) to continue distributing electricity in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay  Mikel Afzelius, Corporate Communications and External Affairs Officer sang PECO,gamiton nila nga kahigayunan ang extension agud i-renew ang ila franchise nga nag-expire na sang Hunyo 18,2019.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Mikel Afzelius, Corporate Communications and External Affairs Officer of PECO, said they will use the extension as an opportunity to renew their franchise that expired on June 18, 2019.

text: Sa 13 ka pahina nga ginpagwa sang ERC, ginhatagan sang provisional certificate of public convenience and necessity (CPCN) ang PECO sa sulod sang two-year transition period tubtob makapagwa sang mando nga mahimo na nga itake over ang pag suplay sang kuryente sa syudad ang More Electric and Power Corp.
english: In the 13 pages issued by the ERC, PECO was granted a provisional certificate of public convenience and necessity (CPCN) for a two-year transition period until it issues an order that More Electric and Power Corp. can take over the supply of electricity to the city.

text: (MORE Power) nga  ginapanag-iyahan sang bilyonaryo nga si Enrique Razon Jr.
english: (MORE Power) owned by billionaire Enrique Razon Jr.

text: magapadayon man ini sa gihapon sa pag-operate bangud wala man sang ikasarang ang MORE Power nga mag-operate sa rason nga wala pa ini sang distribution asset.
english: it will continue to operate because MORE Power does not have the capacity to operate because it does not have a distribution asset.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Afzelius nga apisar indi pa magpagwa sang provision to operate ERC, Samtang sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Jonathan Cabrera, tagpamaba sang MORE, iya ginpahayag nga sa pihak sang bag-o nga evelopment,padayunon nila sa gihapon ang expropriation complaint sa korte agud i- expropriate ang assets sang PECO.
english: Afzelius also said that although the provision to operate ERC has not yet been issued, while in an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Jonathan Cabrera, spokesperson of MORE, said that despite the new development, they will continue the expropriation complaint in court to expropriate the assets of PECO.

text: Ginklaro ni Trade Secretary Cristina Roque ang iya nauna nga pahayag nga makaigu na ang P500 nga budget para sa Noche Buena.
english: Trade Secretary Cristina Roque clarified her earlier statement that the P500 budget for Noche Buena is enough.

text: Suno sa tiglikom, ang iya buot silingon nga budget ang para lamang sa simple nga handa sa Paskuwa sa gamay nga pamilya nga may apat ka miyembro ukon mas manubo pa.
english: According to the secretary, he meant that the budget is only for simple Christmas preparations for small families with four members or less.

text: Pahayag pa sini, ginbase lamang niya ang iya pahayag sa Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Noche Buena price guide.
english: He said he based his statement on the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Noche Buena price guide.

text: “Kasya ang P500 but it depends on the number of family members.
english: “P500 is enough but it depends on the number of family members.

text: Usually ang family members na kasya itong P500 is mom, dad, and two children,” pahayag sini sa atubang sang reporters.
english: Usually the family members who can afford the P500 are mom, dad, and two children,” he said in front of reporters.

text: Sandig sa price guide, ang pinakabarato suno sa iya amo ang 500g ham nga mabakal sa P170, 250g spaghetti noodles nga P30, kag spaghetti sauce nga P48.50.
english: According to the price guide, the cheapest is 500g of ham for P170, 250g of spaghetti noodles for P30, and spaghetti sauce for P48.50.

text: Pahayag niya, mahimo pa makadugang sang macaroni salad nga mayonnaise kag cheese.
english: He said you can add macaroni salad with mayonnaise and cheese.

text: Suno pa sa tiglikom, ang ham, salad kag pandesal ang mahimo naman makabig nga halos kumpleto na nga basic Noche Buena meal.
english: According to the secretary, ham, salad and pandesal can be considered almost complete basic Noche Buena meal.

text: “We can add luncheon meat, corned beef,” paathag pa sini.
english: “We can add luncheon meat, corned beef,” he explained.

text: Gindugang man ni Roque nga mahimo man makahatagay sang pagkaon ang mga maghimata kag magkasilingan nga amo man ang mahimo makahatag sang lain nga pagkaon sa lamesa.
english: Roque also added that relatives and neighbors can also provide food to each other who can also provide different food on the table.

text: Nahibaluan nga naka-post naman ang Noche Buena price guide sa DTI website kag sa ila nga social media pages.
english: The Noche Buena price guide has been posted on the DTI website and their social media pages.

text: Nalakip sa listahan ang presyo para sa ham, pasta, sandwich spread, keso de bola, cheese, fruit cocktail, kaong, kag iban pa.
english: The list includes prices for ham, pasta, sandwich spread, keso de bola, cheese, fruit cocktail, kaong, and more.

text:
Yari ang iban nga presyo:

ham, P170 to P945;fruit cocktail, P61.76 to P94.41;all-purpose cream, P36.00 to P72;“nata de coco,” P52.50 to P62.50;“kaong,” P76.50 to P84;“queso de bola,” P210 to P470;cheese, P16.50 to P310; andmayonnaise, P20.40 to P245.85.
english:
Here are the other prices:

ham, P170 to P945;fruit cocktail, P61.76 to P94.41;all-purpose cream, P36.00 to P72;“nata de coco,” P52.50 to P62.50;“kaong,” P76.50 to P84;“queso de bola,” P210 to P40, P40, to cheese. P310; andmayonnaise, P20.40 to P245.85.

text: Kasunod sang pahayag sang DTI, nagpaguwa naman sang mga statement ang pila ka mga mamalidha kaangay kanday Bicol Saro party-list Rep.
english: Following the DTI's statement, several lawmakers such as Bicol Saro party-list Rep.

text: Terry Ridon, Akbayan party-list Rep.
english: Terry Ridon, Akbayan party-list Rep.

text: Percival Cendaña, kag ACT Teachers party-list Rep.
english: Percival Cendaña, and ACT Teachers party-list Rep.

text: Antonio Tinio nga nagakwestyon sa ahensya sa basehan sang presyo sang mga item nga kinahanglan para sa Noche Buena.
english: Antonio Tinio questioning the agency on the basis of the price of the items needed for Noche Buena.

text: “That would suffice if you travel back in time.
english: “That would suffice if you traveled back in time.

text: While people are drowning in high prices, such gimmicks are very insulting.
english: While people are drowning in high prices, such gimmicks are very insulting.

text: It would be better if the government would certify as urgent the proposals for a P200 salary increase so that the workers would have something for their celebrations this Christmas,” suno kay Cendaña.
english: It would be better if the government would certify as urgent the proposals for a P200 salary increase so that the workers would have something for their celebrations this Christmas,” according to Cendaña.

text: Nainsulto naman si Tinio sa statement sang DTI.
english: Tinio was insulted by the DTI's statement.

text: “How dare the DTI insult Filipino families with this outrageous claim that P500 is enough for Noche Buena?
english: “How dare the DTI insult Filipino families with this outrageous claim that P500 is enough for Noche Buena?

text: What kind of a Christmas is that—a few noodles, egg, and water?
english: What kind of a Christmas is that—a few noodles, egg, and water?

text:
This is a slap in the face to every working Filipino struggling to make ends meet,” kabahin sang sabat sang kongresista.#

(Trade Secretary Cristina Roque/Dexter Barro II)
english:
This is a slap in the face to every working Filipino struggling to make ends meet,” the congressman said.

(Trade Secretary Cristina Roque/Dexter Barro II)

text: Paano kun ikaw isa ka iloy nga may anak nga na-addict sa druga kag sugal?
english: What if you are a mother with a child who is addicted to drugs and gambling?

text: Ano ang sarang mo himuon agud punggan siya sa tion nga siya ang mangin violent kag nagapanakit na?
english: What can you do to stop him when he becomes violent and hurtful?

text: Sa Buriram Province, Thailand, may isa ka iloy nga nag-agaw sang atensyon sang publiko bangud sa ginhimo sini para lamang protektahan ang iya kaugalingon kag mangin ang ila mga tupadbalay batok sa iya anak nga drug addict kag masami nagaagresibo ini.
english: In Buriram Province, Thailand, a mother caught the public's attention because of what she did to protect herself and her neighbors against her son who was a drug addict and often aggressive.

text: Siya ang nagpahimo sang isa ka presuhan sa sulod sang iya balay agud masulod niya diri ang iya anak.
english: He had a prison built inside his house so that he could keep his son inside.

text: Ang kwarto may yara sang bed, bathroom, kag WiFi kag may CCTV man agud ma-monitor niya ang iya anak.
english: The room has a bed, bathroom, and WiFi and also has CCTV so she can monitor her son.

text: Apang sang damlag lang, nahibaluan sang otoridad ang ginhimo sang iloy sa iya anak kag ginmanduan ini nga gub-on ang amo nga presuhan sa iya balay kag pangitaan nalang ini sang maayo nga solusyon sa iya problema sa iya anak.
english: But recently, the authorities learned what the mother had done to her son and ordered her to destroy the prison in her house and find a good solution to her problem with her son.

text: Ginkabos ang Pilipinas nga makuha ang ginahandum nga ikaduha nga Miss Supranational crown.
english: The Philippines is poor to win the coveted second Miss Supranational crown.

text: Sa koronasyon sa Poland nga nagtakop alas singko sa kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas, nakuha sang Baguio City beauty queen nga si Tarah Valencia ang third runner-up title.
english: In the coronation in Poland that ended at 5 am Philippine time, Baguio City beauty queen Tarah Valencia won the third runner-up title.

text:
Yari ang winners:

Miss Supranational: Brazil1st Runner-Up: Germany2nd Runner-Up: Curacao3rd Runner-Up: Philippines4th Runner-Up: Puerto Rico

Ginkilala man sang organisasyon ang Continental Ambassadors nga amo ang mga masunod:

Africa: ZambiaCaribbean: Dominican RepublicEurope: IcelandAsia and Oceania: IndonesiaAmericas: USA

Antes sa Top 5, nag-compete ang delegates sa Q&A round, swimsuit round sa Top 24 kag evening gown sa Top 12.
english:
Here are the winners:

Miss Supranational: Brazil1st Runner-Up: Germany2nd Runner-Up: Curacao3rd Runner-Up: Philippines4th Runner-Up: Puerto Rico

The organization also recognized Continental Ambassadors as follows:

Africa: ZambiaCaribbean: Dominican RepublicEurope: IcelandAsia and Oceania: IndonesiaAmericas: USA

Before the Top 5, the delegates competed in the Q&A round, swimsuit round for the Top 24 and evening gown for the Top 12.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa ka graduate sang tourism management si Valencia kag nahatag sa iya ang titulo nga Miss Supranational Philippines matapos nagpasakop sa Miss Universe Philippines 2024.
english: Valencia is a graduate of tourism management and was awarded the title of Miss Supranational Philippines after participating in Miss Universe Philippines 2024.

text: Ang isahanon nga Miss Supranational Queen sang Pilipinas amo si Mutya Datul nga nagdaog sang titulo sadtong 2013.#
english: The only Miss Supranational Queen of the Philippines is Mutya Datul who won the title in 2013.#

text: Nagmando ang Korte Suprema sa Kamara kag Senado nga magpasa sang mga dokumento kag impormasyon nga naangot sa impeachment proceedings batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The Supreme Court has ordered the House and Senate to submit documents and information related to the impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ang tikang nga ini sang Supreme Court ang naangot sa separado nga mga petisyon sang bise-presidente kag sang Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) lawyer nga si Atty. Israelito Torreon nga naga-kwestyon sang legalidad sang proceedings.
english: The move by the Supreme Court was linked to separate petitions filed by the vice-president and Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) lawyer Atty. Israelito Torreon questioning the legality of the proceedings.

text: Lakip sa luyag mahibaluan sang korte amo ang kun sin-o ang nagpreparar sang draft articles; kun napalibot bala ang draft kag ang ebidensya sa tanan nga myembro sang Kamara; kag kun nalakip bala ang Articles sa Order of Business para sa plenary consideration.
english: Among the things the court wants to know are who prepared the draft articles; whether the draft and the evidence have been circulated to all members of the House; and whether the Articles are included in the Order of Business for plenary consideration.

text: Ginapamangkot man sang High Court kun san-o gin-file ang nauna nga tatlo ka impeachment complaints kag ang ila status, kag kun pila ka adlaw ang naglapse halin sa endorsement pakadto sa pagpasa sa Office of House Speaker kag pagkalakip sa Order of Business.
english: The High Court also questioned when the previous three impeachment complaints were filed and their status, and how many days lapsed from endorsement to submission to the Office of House Speaker and inclusion in the Order of Business.

text: Dapat man ipaathag kun may diskresyon bala ang House Secretary General kun san-o sini ipasa ang complaints sa Office of the House Speaker, kag kun bala, mahimo ini makapamalibad.
english: It should also be clarified whether the House Secretary General has discretion when to forward complaints to the Office of the House Speaker, and whether he can refuse.

text: Ginkumpirma naman sang Kamara nga nabaton nila ang order kag maga-comply sila sa Korte Suprema.
english: The House of Representatives confirmed that they received the order and will comply with the Supreme Court.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagpaguwa naman sang statement si Atty. Regie Tongol, spokesperson sang Senate Impeachment Court, nga ang tikang sang Korte Suprema ang kaangay man sa tikang sang Senado sang Hunyo nga i-remand ukon ibalik sa Kamara ang Articles of Impeachment bangud sa mga pamangkot nga naangot sa constitutionality.
english: Meanwhile, Atty. Regie Tongol, spokesperson of the Senate Impeachment Court, said the Supreme Court's move is similar to the Senate's move in June to remand or return the Articles of Impeachment to the House because of questions related to constitutionality.

text: Gintamyaw kag ginpangamusta ni King Charles ang mga tawo kasunod sang church service nga iya gintambungan sa Windsor kadungan sang Easter Sunday.
english: King Charles greeted the people following the church service he attended in Windsor on Easter Sunday.

text: Ini ang iya labing-una nga pagpakita sa publiko sa isa ka royal event halin sang gin-anunsyo sang Buckingham Palace sang Pebrero nga na-diagnose siya nga may cancer.
english: It was his first public appearance at a royal event since Buckingham Palace announced in February that he had been diagnosed with cancer.

text: Nakit-an nga nagayuhom ang 75-anyos nga hari kag upod sini si Queen Camila samtang nagpangamusta sa mga tawo sa guwa sang St George’s Chapel nga amo man ang ulihi nga palahuwayan sang iya nagtaliwan nga iloy nga si Queen Elizabeth.
english: The 75-year-old monarch and Queen Camila were seen smiling as they greeted people outside St George’s Chapel, which was also the final resting place of his late mother Queen Elizabeth.

text: Wala naman nakaupod sa royal couple si Prince William kag iya asawa nga si Kate Middleton.
english: Prince William and his wife Kate Middleton did not join the royal couple.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, matandaan nga gin-anunsyo man sang Princess of Wales nga nagapaidalom siya sa “preventative chemotherapy” matapos nga na-diagnose man ini nga may cancer.
english: Last week, the Princess of Wales announced that she was undergoing preventive chemotherapy after she was also diagnosed with cancer.

text: Ang public appearance sang hari ang indi man makabig nga magabalik na ini sa iya nga royal duties bangud kinahanglan pa sini nga magpaidalom sa outpatient treatment.
english: The king's public appearance is not considered a return to his royal duties because he still needs to undergo outpatient treatment.

text: “We pray for her and the King in their dignified response and we pray for all those who are suffering the same way,” suno kay Archbishop of Canterbury, Reverend Justin Welby, sa iya nga Easter sermon sa Canterbury Cathedral sang amo nga adlaw.#
english: “We pray for her and the King in their dignified response and we pray for all those who are suffering the same way,” said Archbishop of Canterbury, Reverend Justin Welby, in his Easter sermon at Canterbury Cathedral that day.

text: Nagpabilin nga malinong kag matawhay ang assessment sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) sa Holy Week ukon Semana Santa subong nga tuig.
english: The assessment of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) during Holy Week this year remained peaceful and calm.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Rolando Araño, Spokesperson sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang pagpamahog nga na-record ang talatapan sa pag-obserbar sang Lenten Season sa probinsya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said the office has not recorded any threats during the observance of the Lenten Season in the province.

text: Suno kay Araño, nalab-ot ang katawhay bangud man sa mga police assistant desk nga ginpahamtang sa pila ka lugar sa probinsya ilabi na sa masami ginadugok sang mga tawo.
english: According to Araño, the calm was achieved thanks to the police assistant desks that were set up in some areas of the province especially in the areas that are often frequented by people.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga tayuyon sila nga magabantay ilabi na nga madamo subong ang mga nagapadulong sa resorts kag naga-hiking.
english: He also said that they will be constantly monitoring especially since many people are going to resorts and hiking.

text: Nagpasalig man si Araño sang mas masangkad nga police visibility sa Iloilo subong nga madamo ang nagaguwa para sa outing kadungan sang summer season.
english: Araño also assured more police visibility in Iloilo as many people go out for outings during the summer season.

text: Apisar sang kahangawa sang publiko sa kondisyon sang iya ikaayong lawas, gin-deliver ni Pope Francis ang iya nga Easter Message kag ang Urbi et Orbi blessing (To the City and the World) kun sa diin partikular nga na-mensyonar ang kinagamo sa Holy Land, Ukraine, Myanmar, Syria, Lebanon, kag Africa.
english: Despite public concern over his health condition, Pope Francis delivered his Easter Message and the Urbi et Orbi blessing (To the City and the World) which specifically mentioned the conflict in the Holy Land, Ukraine, Myanmar, Syria, Lebanon, and Africa.

text: Sa atubang sang linibo ka mga tumuluo sa St.
english: In front of thousands of believers in St.

text: Peter’s Square sa Vatican, nag-apelar man ang 87-anyos nga Santo Papa sang ceasefire sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas kag pagpalabay sa humanitarian aid para sa Palestinians sa Gaza.
english: Peter's Square in the Vatican, the 87-year-old Pope also appealed for a ceasefire between Israel and Hamas and the release of humanitarian aid for Palestinians in Gaza.

text: Naghingyo man ang Santo Papa sang pagbayluhanay sang mga preso sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine.
english: The Pope also called for a prisoner exchange between Russia and Ukraine.

text: Ginkondena man sini ang human trafficking kag sunod nga nagpangamuyo para sa banas sang kalinong para sa mga tawo nga nagasuprer sang mga kalakasan, kagutom, epekto sang climate change, kag terorismo.
english: It also condemned human trafficking and subsequently prayed for a path of peace for people suffering from atrocities, hunger, the effects of climate change, and terrorism.

text: Antes ang iya halos 12 ka minutos nga mensahe para sa Easter Sunday, madamo ang nagakahangawa nga indi ini ma-deliver sang personal sang Santo Papa bangud sa kondisyon sang iya nga ikaayong lawas nga rason man kun ngaa limitado ang iya public speaking kag pagpasakop sa iban nga aktibidad subong nga Semana Santa.
english: Before his nearly 12-minute message for Easter Sunday, many are worried that the Pope will not be able to deliver it personally due to his health condition which is also the reason why his public speaking and participation in other activities this Holy Week is limited.

text: Sa Via Crucis ceremony sang Byernes Santo, nag-atras man ang Santo Papa kag wala na lang nagpartisipar agud nga mahandaan sang maayo ang Easter Sunday.
english: During the Via Crucis ceremony on Good Friday, the Pope also withdrew and did not participate in order to prepare for Easter Sunday.

text: Sa Easter Sunday vigil service (Sabado sang kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas) nga naglawig sang duha ka oras, nagpanguna na liwat ang Santo Papa apang talalupangdon kun kaisa nga daw ginahapo ini samtang nagahambal.
english: In the Easter Sunday vigil service (Saturday morning Philippine time) which lasted two hours, the Pope led again but it was noticeable at times that he seemed tired while speaking.

text: Matandaan nga wala man nagpartisipar si Pope Francis sa “Via Crucis” sang 2023 apang napahibalo ini sang abanse bangud na-ospital ini bangud sa bronchitis kag pila ka semana ang nagligad, nagpaidalom pa ini sa hernia operation.
english: Pope Francis did not participate in the Via Crucis in 2023 but was informed in advance because he was hospitalized with bronchitis and a few weeks ago, he underwent hernia surgery.

text: Ang natabo sang nagligad nga Byernes Santo nga hinali nga pagkanselar sini sa iya nga partisipasyon sa prusisyon ang nagtuga man sa mga pamangkot sang publiko kun ano kadugay pa sini masarangan nga pamunuan ang Catholic Church kag ang 1.3 billion followers sini.#
english: Last Good Friday's sudden cancellation of his participation in the procession also raised public questions about how long he will be able to lead the Catholic Church and its 1.3 billion followers.

text: Inanunsyo ni Julie “Dondon” Patidongan alias Totoy na magsasampa siya ng complaint affidavit laban sa mga pulis na umano’y kasangkot sa pagkawala ng mga sabungero.
english: Julie “Dondon” Patidongan alias Totoy announced that she will file a complaint affidavit against the policemen who are allegedly involved in the disappearance of the sabungero.

text: Ayon kay Patidongan, sa Lunes ay pupunta siya sa National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) upang magsimula ng legal na hakbang laban sa mga nasabing pulis.
english: According to Patidongan, on Monday he will go to the National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) to initiate legal action against the said policemen.

text: Ang kanyang pahayag ay sinundan ng pahayag ni Atty. Rafael Calinisan ng NAPOLCOM na hinihikayat si Patidongan na magsampa na ng reklamo.
english: His statement was followed by the statement of Atty. Rafael Calinisan of NAPOLCOM urged Patidongan to file a complaint.

text: Ang NAPOLCOM ay may listahan ng mga pulis na sinasabing may kinalaman sa pagkawala ng 34 sabungero mula 2021 hanggang 2022.
english: NAPOLCOM has a list of police officers allegedly involved in the disappearance of 34 sabungero from 2021 to 2022.

text: Kasalukuyang iniimbestigahan ng NAPOLCOM ang mga pulis na ito para sa administratibong aspeto ng kaso.
english: NAPOLCOM is currently investigating these policemen for the administrative aspect of the case.

text: Sa ngayon, 15 pulis na ang isinailalim sa restrictive custody sa Camp Crame, Quezon City, dahil sa kanilang posibleng papel sa pagdukot sa mga sabungero.
english: Currently, 15 policemen are under restrictive custody at Camp Crame, Quezon City, for their possible role in the kidnapping of the sabungero.

text: Ayon kay Patidongan, ang ilan sa mga pulis na ito ay nakatanggap umano ng P2 milyon na buwanang payola mula kay Atong Ang, isang negosyanteng iniuugnay sa kaso ng pagkawala ng mga sabungero.
english: According to Patidongan, some of these policemen allegedly received P2 million monthly payola from Atong Ang, a businessman linked to the disappearance of the sabungero.

text: Isa pa sa mga detalye na ibinahagi ni Patidongan ay ang pag-aari ng isang aktibong pulis ng fishpond sa Taal Lake, kung saan posibleng itinago at pinatay ang mga biktima.
english: Another detail shared by Patidongan is the ownership of an active policeman of the fishpond in Taal Lake, where the victims may have been hidden and killed.

text: Nabanggit din ni Patidongan na may bagong testigo na magbibigay ng karagdagang impormasyon sa kaso.
english: Patidongan also mentioned that there is a new witness who will provide more information in the case.

text: Sinabi ni Atty. Calinisan ng NAPOLCOM na ang testigong ito ay may koneksyon kay Patidongan at posibleng magbigay liwanag sa insidente ng pagkawala ng mga sabungero.
english: Atty. NAPOLCOM clarifies that this witness is connected to Patidongan and may shed light on the incident of the disappearance of the sabungero.

text: Ayon kay Patidongan, maaaring itinapon at inilibing ang mga biktima sa ilalim ng Taal Lake.
english: According to Patidongan, the victims were probably dumped and buried under Taal Lake.

text: Sa kabila ng mga alegasyon, patuloy ang mga paghahanap ng mga awtoridad sa ilalim ng Taal Lake, kung saan nakakita na sila ng mga sako na naglalaman ng mga sunog na buto ng tao.
english: Despite the allegations, authorities continue to search the bottom of Taal Lake, where they have found sacks containing burnt human bones.

text: Pinag-aaralan pa rin ang mga bagong ebidensya at mga testigo upang malaman ang buong detalye ng nangyaring pagkidnap at pagpatay sa mga nawawalang sabungero.
english: New evidence and witnesses are still being studied to find out the full details of the kidnapping and murder of the missing sabungero.

text:

sang Panay Electric Company( PECO) nga wala sa gihapon sang ikasarang
ang MORE Electric and Power Corporation nga i-take over ang operasyon
bilang electric power provider sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english:

as an electric power provider in Iloilo City.

english:

english:

it of the appropriate facilities and technical personnel.

english:

supply sang electric power sa Iloilo City,nga makapasiga sa lima gid

english:

supply of electric power in Iloilo City, which can light up five

text: May patigayunon nga 3rd General Assembly ang Philippine Dental Association (PDA) Iloilo Chapter sa Solana Premiere, Tabucan, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: The Philippine Dental Association (PDA) Iloilo Chapter will hold its 3rd General Assembly at Solana Premiere, Tabucan, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text:
Tema sang aktibidad amo ang, “Pamilya, una kong dentista!”
