Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Sofia Castor, President sang Philippine Dental Association Iloilo Chapter, iya ginpahayag nga ang nasambit nga pagtililipon ang pasakupan sang kapin 800 ka mga dentista sa Iloilo.
english:
The theme of the activity was, “Family, my first dentist!”

In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Sofia Castor, President of the Philippine Dental Association Iloilo Chapter, said the gathering will be attended by more than 800 dentists in Iloilo.

text: Mangin dinapit man nga bisita ang nagkalain nga mga dentista sa pungsod nga magapakigbahin sang ila ihibalo.
english: Various dentists in the country will also be invited guests to share their knowledge.

text: Suno kay Castor, ginalauman nga mangin mabinungahon ang nasambit nga pagtililipon sa diin kaupod man nila ang Department of Health kag Department of Education.
english: Castor said the meeting is expected to be fruitful with the participation of the Department of Health and the Department of Education.

text: Patigayunon ang aktibidad sa Abril 25 kadungan man sang Oral Cancer Awareness month.
english: The activity will be held on April 25 in conjunction with Oral Cancer Awareness month.

text: Kinilala ng Senado ang desisyon ng Korte Suprema noong Hulyo 8 na pag-isahin ang dalawang kasong may kinalaman sa impeachment proceedings laban kay Pangalawang Pangulo Sara Duterte.
english: The Senate recognized the Supreme Court's decision on July 8 to consolidate two cases involving impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ayon sa inilabas na pahayag, inatasan ng kataas-taasang hukuman ang mga respondent na magsumite ng kinakailangang dokumento at paliwanag kaugnay sa inihaing hiling para sa karagdagang impormasyon tungkol sa impeachment process.
english: According to the statement, the high court directed the respondents to submit the necessary documents and explanations in connection with the request for more information on the impeachment process.

text: Ipinaliwanag ni Senate impeachment court spokesperson Atty. Regie Tongol na kahalintulad ito ng naging hakbang ng Senado noong Hunyo 10, kung saan pinasuri rin ang proseso ng pagpapatibay ng impeachment articles.
english: Senate impeachment court spokesperson Atty. Regie Tongol said this is similar to the step taken by the Senate on June 10, which also reviewed the process of strengthening the impeachment articles.

text: Dagdag ni Tongol, magsisimula na ang paghahanda ng Senado para sa kanilang opisyal na tugon sa Korte Suprema.
english: Tongol added that the Senate will begin preparing for its official response to the Supreme Court.

text: Gayunpaman, nilinaw niyang karamihan sa hinihinging dokumento at impormasyon ay saklaw ng proseso ng Kamara de Representante.
english: However, he clarified that most of the requested documents and information are within the scope of the House of Representatives process.

text: Sa kabila ng mga kaganapan, tiniyak ng Senado ang kanilang patuloy na paggalang sa proseso ng hudikatura at sa umiiral na sub judice rule, dahilan kung bakit hindi sila magbibigay ng karagdagang pahayag sa publiko habang bukas pa ang usapin.
english: Despite the developments, the Senate assured their continued respect for the judicial process and the prevailing sub judice rule, which is why they will not make further statements to the public while the matter is still open.

text:
Gin-atake
sang peste nga rice black bug ang pito ka mga banwa sa probinsya sang
Iloilo.
english:
Attacked
rice black bug pest in seven towns in the province of
Iloilo.

text:
Sa
exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elias Sandig Jr., assistant
department head sang Iloilo Provincial Agriculture Office (PAO), iya
ginpahayag nga ang mga banwa nga apektado sang peste amo ang Sara,
San Dionisio, Concepcion, Ajuy, Banate, Lemery kag Passi City.
english:
In
exclusive interview of Bombo Radyo with Elias Sandig Jr., assistant
department head of the Iloilo Provincial Agriculture Office (PAO), his
stated that the towns affected by the plague were Sara,
San Dionisio, Concepcion, Ajuy, Banate, Lemery and Passi City.

text:
Apang
suno sa iya, gamay lang ang tsansa nga magtuga ini sang dako nga
kahalitan sa humayan.
english:
But
he said there was little chance of it causing a major
damage to rice fields.

text:
Suno
 kay  Sandig, ini bangud nag-atake ang nasambit nga mga peste subong
nga gamay na lang ang mga standing crops sa probinsya.
english:
Dream
 to Sandig, this is because the said pests attacked now
that there are few standing crops in the province.

text:
Nagpahandumon
 naman si Sandig sa mga mangunguma ng  ipadayon  lang ang ginahimo
nga pamaagi kaangay sang light-trapping sa pagtapna sang nasambit nga
peste nga nagahalit sa mga humay.
english:
Made me wish
 Sandig urged farmers to continue what they are doing
method such as light-trapping to prevent the aforementioned
pest that damages rice crops.

text: Nagmandu ang International Court of Justice sa Israel nga maghimo sang nagakaigu kag epektibo nga tikang agud mapasiguro nga maga-abot insigida ang bastante nga pagkaon sa mga Palestinians sa Gaza.
english: The International Court of Justice has ordered Israel to take appropriate and effective measures to ensure that sufficient food reaches the Palestinians in Gaza immediately.

text: Suno sa mga huwes, indi lamang risgo sang tuman nga kagutom ang ginasuprer sang mga tawo sa Gaza kundi nagakabatygan na gid ini subong ilabi na bangud lima ka bulan na halin sang nagsugod ang gyera.
english: According to the judges, people in Gaza are not only at risk of starvation but are also feeling it now, especially since it has been five months since the war began.

text: Ini nga hulag sang World Court ang gin-request sang South Africa bilang parte sang nagapadayon sini nga akusasyon sa Israel nga nagakomiter na sang genocide sa Gaza.
english: This move by the World Court was requested by South Africa as part of its ongoing accusation of Israel already committing genocide in Gaza.

text: Una naman nga ginpahayag sang United Nations World Food Programme nga tuman na ang kagutom nga ginasuprer sa northern part sang amo nga teritoryo sa Palestine.
english: Earlier, the United Nations World Food Program said the famine in the northern part of the Palestinian territory was severe.

text:
32,000 na ka tawo ang napatay halin sang nagsugod ang Israel-Hamas war sang Oktubre 2023, samtang 20 naman ang nadulaan sang kabuhi bangud sa malnutrition suno sa Palestinian authorities.#

Abed Rahim Khatib/Anadolu via Getty Images
english:
32,000 people have been killed since the Israel-Hamas war began in October 2023, while 20 have lost their lives to malnutrition, according to the Palestinian authorities.#

Abed Rahim Khatib/Anadolu via Getty Images

text: Naniniwala si Atty. Kristina Conti, abogado ng mga biktima ng umano’y extrajudicial killings (EJKs), na malabong kilalanin ng International Criminal Court (ICC) ang resolusyong inihain sa Senado na humihiling ng house arrest para kay dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Atty. believes. Kristina Conti, lawyer for the victims of alleged extrajudicial killings (EJKs), said the International Criminal Court (ICC) is unlikely to recognize the resolution submitted to the Senate seeking house arrest for former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ang pahayag ay tugon sa Senate resolution na inihain ni Senator Alan Peter Cayetano, na naglalayong isailalim sa house arrest si Duterte habang hinihintay ang posibleng paglilitis sa kasong crimes against humanity sa darating na Setyembre 23.
english: The statement was in response to a Senate resolution filed by Senator Alan Peter Cayetano, which calls for Duterte to be placed under house arrest pending a possible trial on crimes against humanity charges on September 23.

text: Kabilang sa mga binanggit na dahilan sa resolusyon ay ang umano’y lumalalang kalagayan ng kalusugan ni Duterte bunsod ng katandaan at matagal na social isolation na maaaring makaapekto sa kanyang pisikal at emosyonal na kalusugan.
english: Among the reasons mentioned in the resolution is Duterte's allegedly deteriorating health condition due to old age and prolonged social isolation that could affect his physical and emotional health.

text: Ngunit ayon kay Atty. Conti, walang sapat na batayan ang resolusyon dahil wala umanong pruweba si Senador Cayetano ukol sa kalusugan ng dating Pangulo.
english: But according to Atty. Conti, there is no sufficient basis for the resolution because Senator Cayetano has no evidence about the health of the former President.

text: Ani Conti, walang dokumentadong medikal na ebidensiya o personal na pagbisita kay Duterte na maaring magsuporta sa naturang kahilingan.
english: According to Conti, there is no documented medical evidence or personal visit to Duterte that can support such a request.

text: “Walang facts.
english: “There are no facts.

text: Puro hearsay.
english: Pure hearsay.

text: Isa itong political posturing para makakuha ng simpatiya,” pahayag ni Atty. Conti.
english: It is a political posturing to gain sympathy,” Atty. Conti said.

text: Dagdag pa niya, hindi kikilalanin ng ICC ang resolusyon dahil ito ay tila panghihimasok sa kanilang proseso.
english: He added that the ICC will not recognize the resolution because it is an interference in their process.

text: Ipinaliwanag din ni Atty. Conti na ang anumang kahilingan para sa pansamantalang paglaya ng dating Pangulo ay dapat idulog sa korte ng ICC sa pamamagitan ng mga abogado ng depensa at hindi sa pamamagitan ng resolusyon ng isang sangay ng pamahalaan.
english: Atty. also explained. Conti said any request for the temporary release of the former President should be submitted to the ICC court through defense lawyers and not through a resolution of a branch of government.

text: Matatandaang nauna nang nagpahayag ng suporta sa house arrest si Vice President Sara Duterte, anak ng dating Pangulo, at si Senator Bong Go, na nagsabing buto’t balat na umano si Duterte habang nasa kustodiya ng ICC sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte, the daughter of the former President, and Senator Bong Go have earlier expressed support for house arrest, saying Duterte is in the custody of the ICC in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Mas masangkad nga deployment sang traffic enforcers ang ipatuman sang Iloilo City Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) kadungan sang Easter Sunday.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) will implement a wider deployment of traffic enforcers during Easter Sunday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, iya ginpahayag nga dugangan ang deployment sang enforcers sa Distrito sang Arevalo kag Molo.
english: Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, he said the deployment of enforcers in Arevalo and Molo districts will be increased.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, tutokan sang talatapan ang tagsa ka critical corners bangud ginalantaw nga mas madamo subong ang magapadulong sa mga beach.
english: Garbanzos said the office will focus on each critical corner because it is expected that more people will now go to the beaches.

text: Bantayan man sang TTMO ang mga overloaded nga salakyan ilabi na ang mga tricycle.
english: The TTMO will also monitor overloaded vehicles especially tricycles.

text: Doble naman ang pagsekyar sa mga dalan nga ginahimo nga parking areas sang pila ka mga salakyan.
english: The roads that are used as parking areas for some vehicles will be doubled.

text: Nagpasalig man si Garbanzos nga handa ang enforcement kag clearing team kon hinali may magluntad nga disgrasya sa dalan.
english: Garbanzos also assured that the enforcement and clearing team are ready in case of road accidents.

text: Nagbisita si Pope Francis sa isa ka presuhan sa Roma para sa Holy Thursday Mass amo man para sa paghugas kag paghalok sa tiil sang 12 ka mga preso kaangay sang ginhimo ni Hesus sa iya mga apostoles sa gab-i antes sang Iya kamatayon.
english: Pope Francis visited a prison in Rome for Holy Thursday Mass as well as for washing and kissing the feet of 12 prisoners as Jesus did his apostles on the night before His death.

text: Talalupangdon man nga ginhimo ini sang 87-anyos nga Santo Papa sa lunsay lamang babaye nga mga inmates.
english: It is also noteworthy that the 87-year-old Pope did this to all female inmates.

text: Ginpatigayon ni Pope Francis ang amo nga tuigan nga tradisyon samtang nga nagasakay ini sa iya nga wheelchair, nagayuhom, kag maayo ang kondisyon sang lawas.
english: Pope Francis conducted the annual tradition while riding in his wheelchair, smiling, and in good health.

text: Nakit-an man sa video sang Vatican ang kababainhan nga emosyonal samtang naga-atubang sa Santo Papa.
english: The Vatican video also showed the women emotionally facing the Pope.

text: Halin sang nangin Santo Papa si Pope Francis, ginhimo niya ini nga seremonya sa guwa sang teritoryo sang Vatican kag ang iya ginpanghugasan sang tiil amo ang mga preso, refugees kag mga tawo nga may kasablagan sa lawas.
english: Since becoming Pope, Pope Francis has performed this ceremony outside Vatican territory and washed the feet of prisoners, refugees and people with disabilities.

text: Pila ka tuig naman nga nahugasan sini ang tiil sang mga babaye kag Muslim, apang ini ang labing-una nga tion nga lunsay babaye ang ginpili para sa amo nga foot-washing ceremony.
english: She has been washing the feet of women and Muslims for several years, but this is the first time that both women have been chosen for the foot-washing ceremony.

text: Ang iya ginkadtuan nga Casa Circondariale Femminile di Rebibbia ang nahamtang siyam ka milya ang kalayuon halin sa Vatican City.
english: His destination Casa Circondariale Femminile di Rebibbia is located nine miles from Vatican City.

text: Una ini nga nagserbe bilang detention center para sa mga menor de edad sang 1950s kag ginpadalagan sang Vincentian nuns antes ini gintugyan sa penitentiary supervisors sang 1979.#
english: It first served as a detention center for minors in the 1950s and was run by Vincentian nuns before being turned over to penitentiary supervisors in 1979.#

text: Magataas na naman ang presyo sang produkto petrolyo bwas nga adlaw matapos ang pila ka mga rollback man sang presyo sang mga nakaligad nga semana.
english: The price of petroleum products will rise again tomorrow after several rollbacks in prices in recent weeks.

text: Mahimo nga magasaka sa piso ang presyo sang diesel kag gasolina nagikan sa 80 centavos kada litro.
english: The price of diesel and gasoline may rise from 80 centavos per liter.

text: Santu sa datos sang Department of Energy (DOE) mangin P46.25 kada litro nagikan sa P41.05  ang presyo sang diesel samtang ang presyo naman sang gasolina ang nagadangat na sa P59.81 kada litro nagikan sa P52.85.
english: According to the Department of Energy (DOE), the price of diesel will rise to P46.25 per liter from P41.05 while the price of gasoline will rise to P59.81 per liter from P52.85.

text: Nahibaluan nga masami nagapatuman sang fuel price adjustments ang mga local oil companies kada Martes.
english: Local oil companies often implement fuel price adjustments every Tuesday.

text: Talagsa ka lang makakita sang tawo nga maisog nga magbunggo sa ginakabig pinaka-popular kag pinamaimpluwensya nga mga persona sa iya nga palibot!
english: You rarely see a person who dares to bump into what is considered the most popular and influential persons around him!

text: Ilabi na kun ang gina-istoryahan amo ang mga presidente, pat-od nga daw makurog ang imo tuhod kag ang imo kaunuran!
english: Especially when it comes to presidents, your knees and muscles must be shaking!

text: Apang lain ang sitwasyon para sa isa ka tawo sa Texas sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga sa sobra niya ka dismayado bangud sa rematch nanday US President Joe Biden kag anay US President Donald Trump sa presidential elections subong nga tuig, naghanda man ini sang iya kaugalingon agud makasumpong ang duha!
english: But the situation is different for a man in Texas in the United States of America who was so disappointed with the rematch between US President Joe Biden and former US President Donald Trump in the presidential elections this year, he also prepared himself to meet the two!

text: Ini amo si 35 anyos nga si Dustin Ebey, isa ka Grade 7 math teacher kag isa man ka army veteran.
english: This is 35 year old Dustin Ebey, a Grade 7 math teacher and also an army veteran.

text: Nakahibalo ka bala kun ano ang iya una nga ginhimo?
english: Do you know what he did first?

text:
Una, gin-islan niya ang iya pangalan — as in legal sini nga gin-islan ang iya pangalan — kag ginhimo ini nga “Literally Anybody Else.”

Suno kay Dustin, nakahibalo siya nga indi mahapos ang iya agyan, apang amo siya sini kahanda nga himuon ang iya kaugalingon nga “option” agud may pilian ang iban nga tawo nga indi na gusto magboto kanday Biden kag Trump!
english:
First, he changed his name — as in it legally changed his name — and made it “Literally Anybody Else.”

Dustin said he knows his journey will not be easy, but he is willing to make himself an option so that other people who do not want to vote for Biden and Trump have a choice!

text: Ginsiling man sini nga indi siya delusional kag nakahibalo man siya nga indi imposible ang iya ginahimo.
english: He also said that he is not delusional and that he knows that what he is doing is not impossible.

text: Medyo imposible gid man ang kinahanglan nga agyan ni Dustin base sa statistics bangud nga kinahanglan sini nga makatipon sang 113,151 signatures halin sa non-primary voters agud nga mabutang ang iya nga pangalan sa balota bilang isa ka independent candidate.
english: It is quite impossible for Dustin to go through based on statistics because he needs to collect 113,151 signatures from non-primary voters in order to put his name on the ballot as an independent candidate.

text: Pananglitan mahimo gid man niya ini, kinahanglan niya ini ipasa antes ukon mismo sa May 13, 2024.
english: Assuming he actually does, he needs to pass it before or right on May 13, 2024.

text: Kun indi naman mahimo, mahimo siya maka-apply bilang write-in candidate sa Texas kag iban nga U.S. states.
english: If not, he can apply as a write-in candidate in Texas and other U.S. states.

text: Lakip sa ginplastar sini nga plataporma amo ang accessible healthcare providers para sa kada American, housing affordability, kag education.
english: Among the things this platform laid out were accessible healthcare providers for every American, housing affordability, and education.

text: Nagaguwa ugaling nga ang iya tuyo sa pagpadalagan ang isa ka sahi sang protesta, kag wala man sang tuyo nga magdaog.
english: It turns out, however, that his intention in running was a form of protest, and no intention of winning.

text: Para kay Dustin, ginapanan-aw na sini nga botohon lamang abi sang tawo kun sin-o ang daw indi tuman ka lain sa tunga sang duha ka presidente, bangud wala man sila sang choice kun sin-o gid kuntani ang ila gusto nga suportahan.
english: For Dustin, he expects people to vote for the one who doesn't seem too different between the two presidents, because they don't have a choice about who they want to support.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, wala nagaisahanon si Dustin nga nagaprotesta batok sa Trump-Biden rematch sa eleksyon subong nga tuig.
english: In fact, Dustin is not alone in protesting against a Trump-Biden rematch in this year’s election.

text: Sang Enero, may yara sang survey result nga ginpaguwa nga 70% ang nagasiling nga indi na dapat magpa-eleher pa liwat si Biden samtang 56% naman ang nagasiling nga indi man deserving si Trump nga magpa-eleher pa liwat sa amo nga posisyon.
english: In January, a survey result was released that 70% said Biden should not seek re-election while 56% said Trump did not deserve to seek re-election.

text: Hinamon ng whistleblower at isa sa mga akusado sa kaso ng mga nawawalang sabungero na si Julie Patidongan, na mas kilala sa alyas na “Totoy”, si retired judge at kasalukuyang chairman ng Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) na si Felix Reyes na sumailalim sa lie detector test.
english: Whistleblower and one of the accused in the missing sabungero case Julie Patidongan, better known as “Totoy”, challenged retired judge and current chairman of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) Felix Reyes to undergo a lie detector test.

text: Ito ay matapos itanggi ni Reyes ang paratang ni Totoy na sangkot umano siya sa pag-areglo ng mga kaso para sa negosyanteng si Atong Ang.
english: This is after Reyes denied Totoy's allegation that he was involved in settling cases for businessman Atong Ang.

text: Sa kabila ng paggiit ni Reyes na walang katotohanan ang akusasyon, sinabi ni Totoy na handa siyang humarap sa lie detector test upang patunayan ang kanyang mga pahayag—ngunit ipinaabot niya na kailangang kumonsulta muna siya sa kanyang abogado bago ito isakatuparan.
english: Despite Reyes' insistence that the accusation is untrue, Totoy said he is ready to face a lie detector test to prove his statements—but he said he must consult his lawyer before implementing them.

text: Kinuwestyon din ni Reyes ang timing ng paglabas ng alegasyon, lalo na’t kasabay ito ng kanyang aplikasyon sa posisyon bilang Ombudsman.
english: Reyes also questioned the timing of the allegation, especially since it coincided with his application for the position of Ombudsman.

text: Giit ng retiradong hukom, tila may layunin umanong sirain ang kanyang pangalan habang nasa gitna siya ng proseso ng aplikasyon.
english: The retired judge, apparently, has a goal to tarnish his reputation while he is in the middle of the application process.

text: Nauna nang inakusahan ni Totoy si Reyes ng umano’y pagbiyahe sa ibang bansa kasama ang ilang prosecutor at hukom, na aniya’y bahagi ng diumano’y pag-areglo sa ilang kasong may kaugnayan sa sabong.
english: Totoy earlier accused Reyes of allegedly traveling abroad with their prosecutor and judge, which was part of the alleged settlement of their sabong-related cases.

text: Patuloy ang imbestigasyon ng mga awtoridad sa kaso ng mga nawawalang sabungero, habang nananatiling mainit na usapin ang integridad ng mga personalidad na nasasangkot dito.
english: Authorities are continuing to investigate the case of the missing sabungero, while the integrity of the personalities involved remains hotly debated.

text: Pilason ang ginabulubanta 42 ka sakay sang pribado nga jeep matapos naaksidente sa Brgy.
english: At least 42 passengers of a private jeep were injured after it crashed in Brgy.

text: Maninila, Miagao, Iloilo subong nga Sabado de Gloria.
english: Manila, Miagao, Iloilo this Saturday of Glory.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Francis Donne Lomahan, Hepe sang Miagao Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga halin sa Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Francis Donne Lomahan, chief of Miagao Municipal Police Station, said the suspects were from Brgy.

text: Baong, Alimodian, Iloilo ang jeep kag padulong kuntani sa banwa sang San Joaquin, Iloilo agud mag-outing sa isa ka beach resort.
english: Baong, Alimodian, Iloilo and was heading to San Joaquin, Iloilo for an outing at a beach resort.

text: Santo sa inisyal nga impormasyon, gindala sa Guimbal District Hospital ang 42 ka pilason nga ginalakipan sang 13 ka mga menor de edad kag 19 ka legal ang pang-edaron.
english: According to initial information, 42 injured including 13 minors and 19 legal age were brought to the Guimbal District Hospital.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan nga overloading ang sakay sang amo nga jeep kun diin may nakasakay pa sa ibabaw.
english: He added that the jeep was overloaded and there were still people on top.

text: Base naman sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, posible nga naglupok ang royda sang jeep nga gintunaan sang akisidente apang padayon pa sa gihapon ang imbestigasyon sang kapulisan
english: Based on initial investigation, it is possible that the wheel of the jeep exploded which caused the accident but the police are still investigating

text:
Isa ka maragtason nga tikang ang ginhimo sang Thailand kaangot sa marriage equality matapos ginpasar na sang

lower house ang hagna nga magapahanugot sa same-sex marriage.
english:
Thailand has taken a historic step towards marriage equality after it was passed by

lower house bill that would allow same-sex marriage.

text: Kinahanglan pa sini ang approval halin sa Senado kag ang royal endorsement antes mahimo nga layi.
english: It still needs approval from the Senate and royal endorsement before it can become law.

text: Apisar sini, daku na ang paglaum nga mapasar ini antes magtakop ang 2024 — kag kun matabo, ang Thailand ang mangin labing-una nga pungsod sa Southeast Asia nga magakilala sang same-sex unions, kag ikatatlo sa bilog nga Asya kasunod sa rekord nga ginhimo sang Taiwan sang 2019 kag Nepal sang 2023.
english: However, there are high hopes that it will be passed before the end of 2024 — and if it happens, Thailand will become the first country in Southeast Asia to recognize same-sex unions, and the third in the whole of Asia following the record set by Taiwan in 2019 and Nepal in 2023.

text: Ang hagna ang nakakuha sang 400 ka boto sa 415 ka mga mamalidha.
english: The bill received 400 votes out of 415 lawmakers.

text: Nakasaad diri nga ang “marriage” amo ang partnership sa tunga sang “duha ka indibidwal” sa baylo nga “sa tunga sang babaye kag lalaki”.
english: It states that “marriage” is a partnership between “two individuals” rather than “between a woman and a man”.

text:
Paagi sa sini, mahatagan man ang LGBTQ couples sang kinamatarong sa inheritance kag adoption kaangay sang ma-enjoy sang heterosexual marriages.#

(Perawongmetha/Reuters/File)
english:
Through this, LGBTQ couples will also be given the same rights to inheritance and adoption as heterosexual marriages.

(Perawongmetha/Reuters/File)

text: DAVAO CITY – Napatay ang tatlo ka bulan nga agila nga si “Riley” bangud sang balatian sa tul-an, base sa Philippine Eagle Foundation (PEF).
english: DAVAO CITY – A three-month-old eagle named “Riley” died of a bone disease, according to the Philippine Eagle Foundation (PEF).

text: Sa ginpagwa nga pahayag sang PEF sang Huwebes sang gab-i, Abril 17, ginsaysay nila nga ang kabangdanan sang kamatayon ni Riley amo ang bone disease base sa resulta sang necropsy nga ila ginpatigayon.
english: In a statement issued by the PEF on Thursday night, April 17, they explained that the cause of Riley's death was bone disease based on the results of the necropsy they conducted.

text: Napatay si Riley sang Martes sa National Bird Breeding Sanctuary sa Davao City.
english: Riley died Tuesday at the National Bird Breeding Sanctuary in Davao City.

text: Suno sa PEF, sang Abril 12, nabantayan sang mga animal keeper nga nagaluya ang tuo nga pakpak ni Riley.
english: According to the PEF, on April 12, animal keepers noticed that Riley’s right wing was weakening.

text: Sa resulta sang X-ray, nakita nga may bali ang tul-an sang iya pakpak.
english: X-ray results revealed a broken wing bone.

text: Ginpahayag man sang PEF nga bisan pa may masami nga pagbulong kag suporta nga pag-atipan, naglala gihapon ang kahimtangan ni Riley.
english: The PEF also stated that despite frequent treatment and supportive care, Riley’s condition continued to deteriorate.

text: Nakabatyag siya sang kalisod sa pagginhawa kag inflammation antes ini napatay.
english: He experienced difficulty breathing and inflammation before he died.

text: Ang pagkapatay ni Riley nagbilin sang kasubo sa mga naga-atipa sang agila sa nasambit nga foundation.
english: Riley’s passing left the eagle-keepers at the foundation saddened.

text: Magkakaroon ng kanilang unang bilateral na pagpupulong sina Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: They will have their first bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: at Pangulong Donald Trump ng Estados Unidos sa Washington sa mga susunod na araw.
english: and US President Donald Trump in Washington in the coming days.

text: Sinabi ni US Secretary of State Marco Rubio na magaganap ang pagpupulong bilang bahagi ng pagpapatibay ng ugnayang pangdepensa at militar ng dalawang kaalyado upang hadlangan ang agresyon ng China sa South China Sea.
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the meeting will be held as part of strengthening defense and military ties between the two allies to counter China's aggression in the South China Sea.

text: Magpapadala rin ang Pilipinas ng isang delegasyon para sa kalakalan sa US sa susunod na linggo upang ipagpatuloy ang negosasyon matapos itaas ng administrasyong Trump sa 20% ang taripa sa mga produkto mula sa Pilipinas, maliban na lamang kung may kasunduang mararating.
english: The Philippines will also send a trade delegation to the US next week to continue negotiations after the Trump administration raised tariffs on products from the Philippines to 20%, unless an agreement is reached.

text: Ayon kay Philippine Ambassador to Washington Jose Manuel Romualdez, ito ay isang opisyal na working visit ni Marcos — ang kauna-unahang pinuno ng estado mula sa Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) na inanyayahan ni Trump sa White House.
english: According to Philippine Ambassador to Washington Jose Manuel Romualdez, this is an official working visit of Marcos — the first head of state from the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) to be invited by Trump to the White House.

text: Hindi ibinunyag ni Romualdez ang eksaktong petsa ng pagbisita, ngunit ayon sa dalawang opisyal ng pamahalaan ng Pilipinas na tumangging magpakilala dahil wala silang awtorisasyong magsalita sa isyu, nakatakdang ganapin ang pagpupulong sa pagitan ng Hulyo 21 at 22.
english: Romualdez did not disclose the exact date of the visit, but according to two Philippine government officials who declined to be identified because they were not authorized to speak on the issue, the meeting is scheduled to be held between July 21 and 22.

text: Kumpirmado ni Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro ang pagbisita, ngunit tumanggi siyang magbigay ng detalye at ipinasa ang usapin sa Department of Foreign Affairs.
english: Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro confirmed the visit, but declined to give details and referred the matter to the Department of Foreign Affairs.

text: Nakatakda ang pagpupulong mula Hulyo 20 hanggang 22.
english: The meeting is scheduled for July 20 to 22.

text: Nagresulta sa trahedya ang prusisyon sang mga tumuluo nga Katoliko sa Barangay Alangilan, Bacolod City kadungan sang Byernes Santo, Abril 18.
english: The procession of Catholic believers in Barangay Alangilan, Bacolod City during Good Friday, April 18, resulted in tragedy.

text: Pasado alas siyete sang gab-i, samtang nagapabalik na ang prusisyon sa simbahan, hinali nga gin-arado sang isa ka pribado nga salakyan ang mga tawo kag nag-dalahig pa pati sa police patrol vehicle.
english: Around 7 pm, while the procession was returning to the church, a private vehicle suddenly plowed into the crowd and even involved the police patrol vehicle.

text: Duha ang patay sa amo nga insidente — isa sa area, kag isa ang dead on arrival sa ospital.
english: Two people were killed in the incident — one in the area, and one dead on arrival at the hospital.

text: Base sa interviews kag reports halin sa Bombo Radyo Bacolod, tuman ka dasig ang pula nga Toyota nga Inova sang nagapadulhog sa Barangay Granada kun sa diin ginbungguan sini ang tricycle nga nagtabog kaupod ang mga sakay sini kag nagtupa sa police patrol car sang Bacolod City Police Station 5.
english: According to interviews and reports from Bombo Radyo Bacolod, the red Toyota Inova was heading towards Barangay Granada when it hit a tricycle that fled with its passengers and fell into the police patrol car of Bacolod City Police Station 5.

text: Bangud sa mabaskog nga impact, ginpahayag nga nawasak gid ang wind shield sang patrol car kag nadunot man ang tricycle.
english: Due to the strong impact, the wind shield of the patrol car was reportedly damaged and the tricycle was also damaged.

text: Nagtuyo pa nga magpalagyo ang pribado nga salakyan apang ini ang nadakpan man.
english: The private vehicle tried to flee but was also arrested.

text: Natukiban nga sakay sini ang lima ka Indian nationals.
english: It was discovered that five Indian nationals were on board.

text: Ang driver kag ang nagapungko sa passenger seat ang gindala sa Doctors Hospital bangud sa naangkon nga samad, samtang ang tatlo ka iban pa ang yara sa karon sa paghinakop sang Bacolod Police Station 5.
english: The driver and the passenger seat passenger were brought to the Doctors Hospital for injuries sustained, while the three others are currently under the custody of Bacolod Police Station 5.

text: Magluwas sa duha nga napatay bangud sa insidente, siyam ka iban pa nga tawo nga yara sa lugar ang nasamaran nga subong ginadapatan naman sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: Besides the two killed in the incident, nine other people in the area were injured and are now receiving proper treatment.

text: (with reports from Bombo Radyo Bacolod)
english: (with reports from Bombo Radyo Bacolod)

text: Puno sang lagob kag kaangay nga bag-o lang nakaagi-sapote ang apat ka mga suspek nga ginatudlo nangamot sa pag-atake sa concert sa Crocus City Hall sa Russia nga nagbilin sang 139 na ka mga patay.
english: Four suspects are believed to have been involved in the attack on a concert at Crocus City Hall in Russia that left 139 dead.

text: Base ini sa mga laragway kag videos nga ginpaguwa sang korte kun sa diin tatlo sa kalalakinhan ang nagapamalanog ang nawong kag isa ang may tabon sa dulunggan.
english: This is based on pictures and videos released by the court where three of the men had their faces covered and one had his ears covered.

text: Ang ikaapat naman ang haluson na makahulag kag makamuklat samtang nagapungko sa prisoner’s box, nagasuksok sang hospital gown, kag nakasakay pa sa stretcher.
english: The fourth was almost able to move and open his eyes while sitting in the prisoner's box, wearing a hospital gown, and still riding on a stretcher.

text: Ginpangalanan sila sang Basmanny District Court of Moscow nga sanday Dalerdzhon Mirzoyev, Saidakrami Rachabalizoda, Shamsidin Fariduni kag Mukhammadsobir Faizov — nga suno sa Tass state news agency, pareho nga mga citizens sang ex-Soviet state nga Tajikistan.
english: The Basmanny District Court of Moscow named them Dalerdzhon Mirzoyev, Saidakrami Rachabalizoda, Shamsidin Fariduni and Mukhammadsobir Faizov — who, according to the Tass state news agency, are both citizens of the ex-Soviet state of Tajikistan.

text: Antes ginpasulod sa courtroom, naglapta na ang mga laragway sang mga suspek kun sa diin bayolente ang pagtratar sa ila sa custodial facility.
english: Before being admitted to the courtroom, pictures of the suspects were circulated where they were violently treated in the custodial facility.

text: Palareho sila nga ginpasakaan sang kaso nga terror act nga posible madagdagan sang penalidad nga bilog nga kabuhi nga pagkapreso.
english: Both were charged with terror act which carries a possible penalty of life imprisonment.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, tatlo sa apat ka defendants ang nag-plead nga guilty sa akusasyon.
english: According to initial information, three of the four defendants pleaded guilty to the charges.

text: Una na nga gin-claim sang Islamic State group ukon ISIS nga sila ang may kahimuan sa amo nga terror attack nga gindungan sa concert sang popular nga banda nga “Picnic”.
english: Earlier, the Islamic State group (ISIS) claimed responsibility for the terror attack, which coincided with a concert by the popular band “Picnic”.

text:
Sang nagligad nga Domingo, nag-obserbar ang Russia sang national day of mourning agud nga magpakita sang kasubo kag simpatiya sa pamilya sang masobra 100 ka mga biktima.#



AP; AFP via Getty Images
english:
Last Sunday, Russia observed a national day of mourning to express grief and sympathy to the families of more than 100 victims.



AP; AFP via Getty Images

text: Balik ensayo na si Pinay tennis star Alex Eala bilang pagpanghanda sa pag-atubang niya sa US Open.
english: Pinay tennis star Alex Eala is back to practice in preparation for his US Open appearance.

text: Sa iya social media account makita ang pila ka kuha nga mga litrato samtang ini ang naga-ensayo sa hard courts sang Rafa Nadal Academy sa Mallorca, Spain.
english: His social media account shows several photos taken while he was practicing on the hard courts of the Rafa Nadal Academy in Mallorca, Spain.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-atras na ini sa pag-intra sa Cincinnatti tournament sini nga semana bangud sa shoulder injury.
english: He has already withdrawn from this week’s Cincinnatti tournament due to a shoulder injury.

text: Sang Hulyo 28, napaslawan nga magdaog si Eala kay Marketa Vondrousova sang Czech Republic sa Canada Open.
english: On July 28, Eala failed to beat Marketa Vondrousova of the Czech Republic at the Canada Open.

text: Bangud sini, nagnubo man ang ranking ni eala sa Womens Tennis Association nga humalin sa ranked 65 ang nangin ranked 68 na lamang ini.
english: As a result, Eala's ranking in the Women's Tennis Association also dropped from ranked 65 to ranked 68.

text: MADAMO pa ang wala nagapati sa siling ni Presidente Duterte nga indi gid niya iga-endorso si Marcos Jr.
english: MANY still do not believe President Duterte's claim that he will never endorse Marcos Jr.

text: sa pagka-Presidente.
english: to the Presidency.

text: Kita ugaling nagapati nga “Never na!” nga maga-endorso pa si Presidente Duterte kay Marcos Jr.
english: We however believe that “Never!” that President Duterte will endorse Marcos Jr.

text: Kag ina bisan pa sa pagkilala naton sa iya pagka-“unpredictable”.
english: And that’s despite our recognition of its “unpredictability”.

text: Ngaa man?
english: Why else?

text: Tungod ina sa daku gid nga kasal-anan ni Marcos Jr.
english: That's because of the great sin of Marcos Jr.

text: sa kay Presidente, nga wala gid niya maisip upod sa iya mga trolls.
english: to the President, whom he never counted with his trolls.

text: Ginapakalain niya gali ang administrasyon ni Duterte sa sining tagline, ukon political slogan, nga Bayan Bangon Muli (BBM).
english: He is actually criticizing the Duterte administration with this tagline, or political slogan, Bayan Bangon Muli (BBM).

text: In fact, kon ginpaligban gid nila ang buot silingon sini, pang-“opposition” pa gani ining political slogan!
english: In fact, if they really thought about what it meant, they would even use this political slogan as an opposition!

text: Sa ining tagline ginapahayag ni Marcos Jr.
english: In this tagline, Marcos Jr.

text: nga wala nangin madinalag-on  ang administrasyon ni Presidente Duterte tungod ginapabangon ini ni Marcos Jr.
english: that President Duterte's administration was not successful because Marcos Jr.

text: sa iya katulogon, ukon kapaslawan.
english: in his sleep, or failure.

text: Nga matuod naman!
english: Which is true!

text: In fact, gapati kita nga ina gid man ang paghangop ni Presidente sining tagline ni Marcos Jr.
english: In fact, we believe that this is the President's understanding of Marcos Jr.'s tagline.

text: bisan gahipos lang siya parti sini.
english: even if he's silent about it.

text: Ti, maluyag bala sini si Presidente mamati, labi na gid sa sige pagliwat-liwat sining tagline ni Marcos Jr.
english: Well, does the President want to listen, especially to the constant repetition of this tagline of Marcos Jr.

text: sa iya kampanya?
english: in his campaign?

text: Kon ikaw si Presidente Duterte, may gana ka pa ayhan mag-endorso kay Marcos Jr.
english: If you were President Duterte, would you still be willing to endorse Marcos Jr.

text: nga sige libak niya – kag sang naga-upod sa iya – sa  imo sa kada singgit nila sang Bayan Bangon Muli?
english: that he – and those who accompany him – keep teasing you every time they shout Bayan Bangon Muli?

text: Kag wala gid mabasol si Marcos Jr., kon mabisto na ini sang mga maka-Duterte, kundi ang iya makitid nga panghuna-huna.
english: And Marcos Jr. is not to blame, when the Duterte supporters recognize him, but his narrow-mindedness.

text: Ina ang luyag naton mangin Presidente ang may makitid sing panghuna-huna?
english: That's what we want to be President who has a narrow mind?

text: Indi na!
english: Unable!

text:
***

Mahuyog si Presidente Duterte maghampang  “unpredictable” paagi sa paghatag sang halog nga mga desisyon ukon binutig nga ginabawi-bawi niya.
english:
***

President Duterte tends to play “unpredictable” by giving soft decisions or lies that he repeats.

text: Tungod sining iya “unpredictability” indi makahulag ukon maka-desisyon sing dale-dale ang iya mga kontra sa pulitika sang kon ano ang ipangontra sa iya.
english: Because of his unpredictability, his political opponents cannot act or decide quickly what to oppose him.

text: In fact, ginhimo niya ini sa pinakamasakit gid nga mga paagi – katulad sang pag-atake sa Papa sa Roma sa isyu sang trapiko sa pag-abot sini sa Filipinas kag sa Diyos mismo nga sang ulihi ginbawi-bawi niya.
english: In fact, he did it in the most painful ways – such as attacking the Pope in Rome on the issue of traffic on its arrival in the Philippines and God himself whom he later recanted.

text: Nagtulod ini sa pagbahin-bahin sang mga halog sa pagtuo nga mga katoliko sa kon ano gid ang pagtan-aw sa iya.
english: This has led to a division among the faithful catholics on what it is to see him.

text: Karon gani ginahimo man ini nga mga taktika sang pila ka kandidato paagi sa mga fake news kag malimbungon nga mga propaganda agud pakalainon ang mga kasumpong.
english: Now even some candidates are using these tactics through fake news and deceptive propaganda to discredit the opponents.

text: Kaluluoy gani si VP Leni Robredo sa iya pagdalagan sa pagka-Presidente, tungod sa ginahimo nila nga mga fake news kag malim bungon nga mga propaganda.
english: VP Leni Robredo is a pity in her run for President, because of their fake news and malicious propaganda.

text: Katulad abe sa ila akusasyon nga kuno komunista si VP Leni.
english: Like their accusation that VP Leni is a communist.

text: Amo man ini ang gin-isyu ni Diktador Marcos sadto batok kay Senador Ninoy Aquino.
english: This is also what Dictator Marcos issued against Senator Ninoy Aquino.

text: Imagine, si VP Leni nangin asawa pa kuno sang isa ka 15 anyos nga komunista.
english: Imagine, VP Leni even allegedly became the wife of a 15 year old communist.

text: Sus, sobra-sobra na ina ya!
english: Sus, that's too much!

text: Ang matuod gali kay luyag lang ni Marcos Sr.
english: The truth is that Marcos Sr. just wants to.

text: magtener sa poder.
english: stay in power.

text: Ugaling indi bilang alagad sang Demokrasya kundi sang isa ka “pasista” nga luyag dulaon sa iya dalanon ang tanan nga nagapamatok sa iya pagginahum.
english: However not as a servant of Democracy but of a “fascist” who wants to eliminate in his path all who oppose his rule.

text: Si Ninoy Aquino kag ang iya asawa nga si Cory ang matuod gid gali nga maki-Demokrasya, nga sang nangin Presidente ginbalik ang Demokrasya halin sa “pasista” nga pagginahom ni Marcos Sr.
english: Ninoy Aquino and his wife Cory are true democrats, who when they became President restored democracy from the “fascist” rule of Marcos Sr.

text: As always, “Truth shall set us free”, amo gani nga napatumba gid man ang “pasista” nga rehimen ni Marcos Sr.
english: As always, “Truth shall set us free”, that's why the “fascist” regime of Marcos Sr. was overthrown.

text: Segurado, amo man ina ang matabo sa mga butigon kag sungayan nga mga kandidato!
english: Surely, the same will happen to the lying and horny candidates!

text:
***

Tungod sini, luyag ta diri ipahanumdum sa sining Semana Santa, labi na gid sa pagkabanhaw ni Kristo (Domingo, Abril 17)  kon ano ka importante ang Kamatuoran.
english:
***

Therefore, we would like to remind you here in this Holy Week, especially in the resurrection of Christ (Sunday, April 17) how important the Truth is.

text: Sa pagkit-anay ni Santo Tomas kag nabanhaw nga Kristo, ginpakita diri kon ano ka importante ang Kamatuoran – sa personal nga pagkakita kag nabatian ang masaligan nga pag-testigo mismo ni Kristo.
english: In the encounter between St. Thomas and the risen Christ, it is shown how important the Truth is – to personally see and hear the reliable testimony of Christ himself.

text: Gani Indi lang kita magpati sa sugid sang kon sin-o lang nga kandidato.
english: So let's not just believe the story of any candidate.

text: Ang dapat patihan kag updan naton amo ang masaligan kag indi ang malimbungon – ang maka-Diyos, may matuod nga ikasarang sa kinaalam kag experyensya, may matuod-tuod nga pagkabalaka, kag may “resibo” sang iya hinimuan.
english: The one we should believe and associate with is the one who is trustworthy and not the one who is deceitful – the one who is godly, has a true capacity for wisdom and experience, has genuine concern, and has a “receipt” of his work.

text: Indi ang puro pangako lang kag mahuyog magpalupad sing sugilanon!
english: Not the one who just makes promises and tends to fly stories!

text: Indi ta man pag-ibaligya ang aton boto kay indi naton masaligan inang nagabaligya sing boto.
english: Let's not sell our votes because we can't trust those who sell votes.

text: Bawion nila inang ila ginasto sa pagpangawat sa gobyerno nga sa bulsa lang nila makadto kag indi sa kaayuhan sang mga pumuluyo.
english: They will recover the money they spent on stealing from the government that will only go to their pockets and not to the benefit of the people.

text: God bless!/PN
english: God bless!/PN

text: Lauman ang daku nga rollback sa presyo sang diesel kag kerosene sa una nga semana sang Disyembre.
english: Expect a big rollback in diesel and kerosene prices in the first week of December.

text:
Suno sa Department of Energy Oil Industry Management Bureau, sandig sa apat ka adlaw nga trade monitoring sang Means of Platts Singapore, yari ang posible pagnubo sa presyo:

Gasoline – P0.30 / liter

Diesel – P3.00 / liter

Kerosene – P3.00 / liter

Ini nga big-time rollback ang ginaangot sa forecasted oversupply sang produktong petrolyo sa global market nga mahimo makalab-ot sa duha ka milyon nga barrels sang oil production kada adlaw sa masunod nga tuig.
english:
According to the Department of Energy Oil Industry Management Bureau, based on four days of trade monitoring by Means of Platts Singapore, here are the possible falls in prices:

Gasoline – P0.30 / liter

Diesel – P3.00 / liter

Kerosene – P3.00 / liter

This big-time rollback is linked to a forecasted oversupply of petroleum products in the global market that could reach two million barrels of oil production per day next year.

text: Lakip man sa nakonsiderar nga rason amo ang posible nga peace deal sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine nga amo ang mahimo makabawi sang Western sanctions sa Russian oil.
english: Also considered is a possible peace deal between Russia and Ukraine that could lift Western sanctions on Russian oil.

text: Apang minimal lamang ang epekto sini bangud wala pa na-materialize ang amo nga negosasyon.
english: However, the impact is minimal because the negotiations have not yet materialized.

text: Gina-anunsyo sang oil companies ang pinal nga price adjustment sa kada Lunes kag ginapatuman naman epektibo sa kada Martes sang aga.
english: Oil companies announce the final price adjustment every Monday and implement it effective every Tuesday morning.

text: Nagapati man bala ikaw sa second chances?
english: Do you believe in second chances?

text: Willing ka bala nga magbalik liwat sa imo anay kahagugma pagkatapos sang inyo breakup?
english: Are you willing to go back to your ex-boyfriend after your breakup?

text: Ano man ang imo nga sabat, may ginasiling sa kanta nga “love moves in mysterious ways” kag siling nila, kun para kamo sa isa kag isa, magatabuay gid liwat ang inyo banas.
english: Whatever your answer, there is a song that says “love moves in mysterious ways” and they say, if you are for each other, your paths will cross again.

text: Pareho gid ina sa natabo sa mag-asawa didto sa Utah, USA nga sanday Jenna kag Mitchell Brotherson nga may indi kinaandan nga love story.
english: That's exactly what happened to a couple in Utah, USA, Jenna and Mitchell Brotherson, who had an unusual love story.

text: Malawig man ang relasyon sang duha, apang sadtong Pebrero 2020, nagsugtanay sila nga mag-break kag indi na lang pagpadayunon ang ila pag-updanay.
english: The two have been in a relationship for a long time, but in February 2020, they agreed to break up and not continue their relationship.

text: Sang nagpauli si Jenna, puerte ang iya hibi bangud daw nagatalang-talang siya nga wala na sang nobyo.
english: When Jenna came home, she was crying because she felt like she was lost without a boyfriend.

text: Pagkaaga naman, naglakat naman si Mitchell kag nag-ski.
english: The next morning, Mitchell went skiing again.

text: Samtang naga-enjoy sa skiing, gintinguhaan sini nga mag-flip, apang sala ang iya landing, nag-una gid ang iya ulo, kag naangkon sang bad concussion.
english: While enjoying skiing, he tried to do a flip, but he landed wrong, his head went too far forward, and he suffered a bad concussion.

text: Ang concussion amo ang mild traumatic brain injury nga nagaapekto sa pag-function sang utok kag bangud sini nagalingin ang ulo sang pasyente kag may mga hitabo nga indi niya madumduman ukon ang ginatawag nga amnesia.
english: Concussion is a mild traumatic brain injury that affects the functioning of the brain and due to which the patient feels dizzy and has events that he does not remember or the so-called amnesia.

text: Istorya pa ni Jenna, matapos ang aksidente, nakabaton siya sang text message kag tawag halin kay Mitchell nga nagapasugat ini sa ospital.
english: Jenna said that after the accident, she received a text message and a call from Mitchell saying that he was picking her up at the hospital.

text: Bisan nagalibog ang ulo ni Jenna, ginsugat niya ini apang natingala pa gid siya nga pagkasunod nga inadlaw, sige-sige ang chat ni Mitchell kag ginahagad siya nga mag-date sila.
english: Although Jenna was confused, she met him but was even more surprised that the next day, Mitchell kept chatting with her and asking her out on a date.

text: Tubtub sa spring break, adlaw-adlaw siya nga ginapangita ni Mitchell kag didto nga nakit-an liwat ni Jenna kun ano ini ka-thoughtful kag na-realize niya nga palangga pa niya ini.
english: Until spring break, Mitchell looked for her every day and that's when Jenna saw again how thoughtful he was and realized that he still loved her.

text: Sang siya na ang nagprangka nga gusto sini nga magbalikanay sila, nakibot man si Mitchell nga break na gali sila.
english: When he opened up that he wanted to get back together, Mitchell was surprised that they were breaking up.

text: Didto naathagan nga ang ila breakup ang parte gali sang mga hitabo nga nalipatan sang lalaki bangud sa iya naangkon nga brain injury.
english: It was revealed that their breakup was part of the events that the man forgot because of his brain injury.

text: Nagbalikanay sila kag Agusto sang amo man nga tuig, nag-propose si Mitchell kay Jenah sa Salt Lake City sa Utah.
english: They got back together and in August of the same year, Mitchell proposed to Jenah in Salt Lake City in Utah.

text: Pagka-Septyembre, didto na kag nagpakasal sila sa amo man nga state.
english: In September, they were there and married in the same state.

text: Apat ka tuig na ang ila malipayon nga kabuhi bilang mag-asawa kag subong isa naman ka mommy si Jenna.#
english: They have been happily married for four years and now Jenna is a mommy.

text: Sa tunga sang pandemya, nangin conscious na ang kadam-an sa ila nga ikaayong lawas kag kun paano malikawan ang nanuhay-tuhay nga balatian.
english: In the midst of the pandemic, many have become conscious of their health and how to avoid various diseases.

text: Suno sa mga eksperto, simple lang ang pamaagi agud mapabilin nga healthy ang lawas.
english: According to experts, the way to keep the body healthy is simple.

text: Magkaon ka lang adlaw-adlaw sang prutas nga guyabano ukon babana.
english: Just eat guyabano or babana fruit daily.

text: Suno kay Rachael Link, registered dietician sa Estados Unidos, ang prutas sang babana, mangin ang dahon sini kag stems ang manggaranon sa fiber, vitamin C, niacin, riboflavin, folate kag iron.
english: According to Rachael Link, registered dietician in the United States, banana fruit, both its leaves and stems are rich in fiber, vitamin C, niacin, riboflavin, folate and iron.

text: Ini nga mga nutrients ang natukiban nga nagapahinay sa cancer growth kag nagabato sa mga bacteria nga ginatunaan sang mga balatian.
english: These nutrients have been found to slow cancer growth and fight bacteria that cause diseases.

text: Ang babana ang puno man sang antioxidant properties kag potent antibacterial properties nga nagapalikaw sa oral diseases kag nagapatay sang mga bacteria nga nagatuga sang balatian nga gingivitis, tooth decay kag cholera.
english: Banana is also full of antioxidant properties and potent antibacterial properties that prevent oral diseases and kill bacteria that cause gingivitis, tooth decay and cholera.

text: Ginkansela ni United States President Donald Trump ang ginalauman nga ikaduha nga hugnat sa pag-atake sini sa Venezuela bangud sa kooperasyon sang pungsod sa Estados Unidos.
english: United States President Donald Trump has canceled the expected second round of his attack on Venezuela because of the country's cooperation with the United States.

text: Ini matapos ang isa ka semana nga military operation sini sa pagpahalin kay President Nicolas Maduro nga subong yara na sa kustodiya sang Estados Unidos kaupod ang asawa sini.
english: This follows its week-long military operation to oust President Nicolas Maduro who is now in US custody along with his wife.

text: Una nga ginpahayag ni Trump nga handa ini nga magpatigayon sang mas daku nga ikaduha nga pag-atake kun kinahanglanon.
english: Trump initially said he was prepared to conduct a larger second strike if necessary.

text: Suno kay Trump, nagapakig-angut ini sa Venezuela kag nagabuligay sila para sa pagpatukod sang imprastruktura sang krudo kag petrolyo.
english: According to Trump, he is in contact with Venezuela and they are working together for the construction of crude oil and petroleum infrastructure.

text: Bangud sini suno sa iya, indi na kinahanglan ang ikaduha nga pag-atake apang magapabilin ang barko nga nagabantay sa kadagatan sang Venezuela para sa seguridad.
english: Because of this, he said, there is no need for a second attack but the ship will remain patrolling Venezuelan waters for security.

text: Nagpaguwa man ang Venezuela sang high-profile prisoners nga ginalantaw nga tanda sang ila paghingyo sang kalinong.
english: Venezuela has also released high-profile prisoners in what is seen as a sign of its demand for peace.

text: Suno pa kay Trump, plano sang Estados Unidos nga epektibo sini nga pamunuan ang pungsod kag indi pag-itakop ang posibilidad nga magapasilabot ini sa militar.
english: Trump said the United States plans to govern the country effectively and not rule out the possibility of military intervention.

text: Dako gid ang pagpasalamat ni Iloilo City Vice Mayor Lady Julie Grace “Love-Love” Baronda sa pagkilala sa iya sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sang Iloilo nahanungod sa pag-eleher sa iya bilang Chairman sang National Movement of Young Legislators (NMYL).
english: Iloilo City Vice Mayor Lady Julie Grace “Love-Love” Baronda is very grateful for the recognition of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Iloilo regarding her election as Chairman of the National Movement of Young Legislators (NMYL).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Baronda, iya ginpahayag nga dako nga butang para sa iya nga ginhatagan importansya ang nasambit nga achievement niya nga makaangkon sang mataas nga posisyon sa amo nga organisasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Baronda said it was a big thing for him that his achievement was given importance to get a high position in the organization.

text: Nahibaluan nga mangin ang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sang Antique ang nagkilala man kay Baronda bangud sa amo nga achievement.
english: It is known that even the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Antique also recognized Baronda for this achievement.

text: Ang NMYL amo ang isa ka organisasyon nga may adbokasiya nga good governance, responsive legislation, kag policy development kag ginabug-usan sang elected local government officials nga nagaedad 40 panubo kalakip ang mga city kag municipal councilors, vice mayors, kag provincial board members sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: NMYL is an organization that advocates for good governance, responsive legislation, and policy development and is composed of elected local government officials under the age of 40 including city and municipal councilors, vice mayors, and provincial board members nationwide.

text: Patay ang 59-anyos nga lalaki matapos nalumos sa dagat sa Sitio Tuburan, Barangay San Salvador, Banate, Iloilo kadungan sang Byernes Santo, Abril 18.
english: A 59-year-old man drowned in the sea in Sitio Tuburan, Barangay San Salvador, Banate, Iloilo on Good Friday, April 18.

text: Ang biktima amo si Rene, residente sang Barangay Cawayan, Pototan, apang nagbisita sa iya bata sa San Salvador, Banate.
english: The victim was identified as Rene, resident of Barangay Cawayan, Pototan, but was visiting his son in San Salvador, Banate.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Randy Lambungan, hepe sang Banate Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga naka-inum-inom ang biktima antes ang insidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Randy Lambungan, chief of Banate Municipal Police Station, said the victim was under the influence of alcohol before the incident.

text: Suno kay Lambungan, naligo ang biktima, apang natalupangdan sang ulihi nga nagalutaw na kag nagakulob ang lawas sini kag nagabula ang baba.
english: According to Lambungan, the victim was taking a bath, but later noticed that his body was floating and twisting and his mouth was foaming.

text: Gilayon nga gindala ang biktima sa Barotac Viejo District Hospital, apang gindeklarar nga dead on arrival.
english: The victim was rushed to the Barotac Viejo District Hospital, but was declared dead on arrival.

text:
Magluwas sa sini nga insidente sa Banate, may isa man ka 13-anyos nga bata nga lalaki nga nalumos sa busay sa Barangay Cahigon, Calinog, Iloilo kadungan man sang sini nga balaan nga adlaw.#

(*Not the actual photo)
english:
Besides this incident in Banate, there is also a 13-year-old boy who drowned in a stream in Barangay Cahigon, Calinog, Iloilo during this holy day.

(*Not the actual photo)

text: Ginkilala sang Malacañang nga isa ka positibo nga ‘development’ ang pinakaulihi nga resulta sang survey nga nagapakita sang pagsaka sang approval rating ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Malacañang acknowledged as a positive development the latest survey results showing an increase in the approval rating of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, nagakahulugan ini nga nakita sang pumuluyo ang pagpangabudlay sang Presidente sa iya mga obligasyon sa nasyon.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, this means that the people have seen the President's hard work in his obligations to the country.

text: Apang ginpahayag man sang Palasyo nga indi magpa-apekto si Presidente Marcos Jr.
english: But the Palace also said that President Marcos Jr. will not be affected.

text: sa resulta sang survey ukon mga numero; sa baylo, magapadayon siya sa pagtuman sang iya mga katungdanan bilang lider sang pungsod.
english: on survey results or numbers; instead, he will continue to fulfill his duties as the leader of the country.

text: Suno kay Castro, indi dapat magsalig gid sa survey bilang basehan sang performance.
english: Castro said the survey should not be relied upon heavily as a basis for performance.

text: Sa survey nga ginpatigayon halin Hunyo 27 tubtob 30, nalab-ot ni Marcos ang 25% approval rating sa ikaduha nga quarter sang tuig , mas mataas sang 19% kumparar sa nauna nga quarter, samtang ang disapproval rating niya nagnubo sa 47% halin sa 57%.
english: In the survey conducted from June 27 to 30, Marcos achieved a 25% approval rating in the second quarter of the year, up 19% from the previous quarter, while his disapproval rating fell to 47% from 57%.

text: Ginpahayag pa gid ni Castro nga bisan ano pa man ang resulta , manubo man ukon mataas padayon lang ang trabaho ni Presidente Marcos Jr.
english: Castro said that no matter what the result, low or high, President Marcos Jr. will continue his work.

text: para sa ikaayo sang banwa.
english: for the good of the town.

text: Talalupangdon ang paglaktaw ni Pope Francis sa pagbasa sang iya homily kadungan sang Palm Sunday Mass sa atubang sang linibo ka mga tumuluo sa St.
english: Pope Francis' omission to read his homily during the Palm Sunday Mass in front of thousands of faithful at St.

text: Peter’s Square sa Vatican.
english: Peter’s Square in the Vatican.

text: Isa ini ka indi kinaandan nga hitabo kun sa diin wala gindayon sang Santo Papa ang homily sa isa ka daku nga event kaangay sang Domingo de Ramos.
english: This is an unusual occurrence where the Pope did not continue the homily at a major event such as Palm Sunday.

text: Last minute na ang desisyon sang 87-anyos nga Santo Papa bangud antes pa man ang misa, may preparado na nga kopya sang homily nga napanagtag sa journalists.
english: The 87-year-old Pope's decision was last minute because even before the mass, a copy of the homily was prepared and distributed to journalists.

text: Sang ginpresentar naman sang aide si Pope Francis agud magsugod na sa pagbasa, ginklaro sini nga indi siya mag-deliver sang homily rason sang paghipos sang mga tawo.
english: When the aide presented Pope Francis to begin reading, he clarified that he would not deliver a homily causing silence.

text:
Wala gilayon ginpaathag sang Vatican kun ano ang natabo apang sang ulihi, nagsiling ang Vatican press office nga ang homily ang gin-islan sang “moment of silence and prayer.”

Wala man nagpartisipar ang Santo Papa sa prusisyon sang mga cardinals sa palibot sang obelisk sa piazza sang nagsugod ang misa kundi nagbendisyon lamang samng mga ramos samtang nga yara siya sa altar.
english:
The Vatican did not immediately explain what happened but later, the Vatican press office said the homily was replaced with a “moment of silence and prayer.”

The Pope did not participate in the procession of cardinals around the obelisk in the piazza when the mass began but only blessed the branches while he was at the altar.

text: Sa hingapusan sang misa, gin-deliver man sini ang iya nga Sunday Angelus message kag blessing.May ginhalad man nga pangamuyo si Pope Francis kag nag-apelar man sang kalinong kun sa diin na-mensyonar sini ang pagpang-atake sa concert hall sa Russia.
english: At the end of the mass, he also delivered his Sunday Angelus message and blessing. Pope Francis also offered a prayer and appealed for peace where he mentioned the attack on a concert hall in Russia.

text: Naghingyo man ini sang pangamuyo para sa Ukraine kag sa mga tawo sa Gaza.
english: It also asked for prayers for Ukraine and the people of Gaza.

text: Ang Palm Sunday amo man ang panugod sang masako nga semana para sa Santo Papa nga magalawig tubtub sa Easter Sunday ukon sa Adlaw sang Pagkabanhaw.
english: Palm Sunday also marks the beginning of a busy week for the Pope that will last until Easter Sunday or Easter Sunday.

text: Sa Huwebes, magabyahe ang Santo Papa sa presuhan sang mga babaye sa Roma para sa tradisyonal nga paghugas sang tiil.
english: On Thursday, the Pope will travel to the women’s prison in Rome for the traditional foot washing.

text: Sa Byernes, natalana man ini nga mag-preside sa Way of the Cross procession sa Colosseum sa Roma kun sa diin iga-reenact ang paglansang kay Hesus sa Krus.
english: On Friday, he is also scheduled to preside over the Way of the Cross procession at the Colosseum in Rome where the crucifixion of Jesus will be reenacted.

text: Sa Sabado, magapanguna man ang Santo Papa sa nighttime service sa basilica kag pagasundan sang Easter Sunday Mass sa St.
english: On Saturday, the Pope will also lead a nighttime service at the basilica followed by an Easter Sunday Mass at St.

text: Peter’s Square kag ang iya blessing sa udto.
english: Peter’s Square and his blessing at noon.

text:
Ini nga masako nga semana ang ginalantaw man nga isa ka daku nga pagtilaw sa ikaayong lawas ni Pope Francis na una na nagsuprer sang bronchitis kag influenza.#

AP Photo/Alessandra Tarantino
english:
This busy week is also seen as a major test for the health of Pope Francis who has previously suffered from bronchitis and influenza.

AP Photo/Alessandra Tarantino

text: Patay ang 13-anyos nga bata nga lalaki matapos malumos sa Malagumpit Falls sa Barangay Cahigon, Calinog, Iloilo kadungan sang Biyernes Santo.
english: A 13-year-old boy died after drowning in Malagumpit Falls in Barangay Cahigon, Calinog, Iloilo during Good Friday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Rodolfo Valencia, head sang Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office (MDRRMO) sang Calinog, iya ginpahayag nga may okasyon nga ginhiwat sila kaupod ang iya tiyo kag iban pa nga myembro sa pamilya rason nga nagpaligo kag naglangoy sila sa amo nga busay apang samtang nagalangoy ini sila natalupangdan nila nga wala na makabutwa ang amo nga 13-anyos.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Rodolfo Valencia, head of the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office (MDRRMO) of Calinog, said they had an occasion with his uncle and other family members so they took a bath and swam in the stream but while they were swimming they noticed that the 13-year-old did not come out.

text: Gilayon man nga gin-radyohan nila ang punong barangay kag ang taga MDRRMO agud magpangayo sang bulig.
english: They immediately radioed the barangay captain and the MDRRMO for help.

text: Suno kay Valencia, nadugayan pa ini nga marespondehan bangud malayo ang amo nga falls sa banwa nga may ginabulubanta 13-kilometros ang distansya.
english: According to Valencia, it took a long time to respond because the falls are far from the town, about 13 kilometers away.

text: Magluwas diri, suludlon ang falls kag layo sa karsada.
english: Besides, the falls are easy to access and away from the road.

text: Ginhingagaw pa ini dala sa hospital apang ginbawian man gilayon sang kabuhi.
english: He was rushed to the hospital but died on the spot.

text: (Article: Bombo Hanna Andasa), (Photo:  Smit Chua)
english: (Article: Bombo Hanna Andasa), (Photo:  Smit Chua)

text: Ginklaro sang International Criminal Court (ICC) nga ginasiguro sang korte ang ikaayong lawas sang mga indibidwal nga yara sa ila nga detention center sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has clarified that the court ensures the health of individuals in its detention center in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Kabahin ini sang statement ni ICC spokesperson Fadi el Abdallah matapos nagguwa ang impormasyon halin sa pamilya ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga tuman na gid ini ka niwang subong.
english: This is part of the statement of ICC spokesperson Fadi el Abdallah after information came out from the family of former President Rodrigo Duterte that he is very thin now.

text: Pahayag naman ni Abdallah, magluwas sa pagpasiguro nga may mga tikang sila para sa ikaayong lawas sang tanan nga yara sa detention center, indi na sila mahimo maka-komento sa lawas ukon anuman nga bagay kaangot sa mga suspek agud nga respetuhon man ang ila pribado nga kabuhi.
english: Abdallah said that besides ensuring that they have measures for the health of all those in the detention center, they cannot comment on the body or anything related to the suspects in order to respect their privacy.

text: “The ICC adopts all necessary measures to take care of the health and well-being of suspects who are in the ICC detention center,” pahayag ni el Abdallah.
english: “The ICC adopts all necessary measures to take care of the health and well-being of suspects who are in the ICC detention center,” stated el Abdallah.

text:
“We do not provide further comments on these matters in order to fully respect their private life.”

Matandaan nga ang anay asawa ni Duterte nga si Elizabeth Zimmerman ang nagsiling nga daw panit kag tul-an na lang ang anay punong ehekutibo subong.
english:
“We do not provide further comments on these matters in order to fully respect their private life.”

Duterte's ex-wife, Elizabeth Zimmerman, said the former chief executive is now like skin and bones.

text: Mangin si Vice President Sara Duterte nga nagbisita man sa The Hague sang nagligad nga adlaw ang nagsiling man nga daw may sakit ang itsura sang iya amay, apang wala man sang ginahambal ang medical officer nga urgent ang iya kondisyon.
english: Even Vice President Sara Duterte, who also visited The Hague yesterday, said her father looked sick, but the medical officer did not say that his condition was urgent.

text: Matandaan nga gin-aresto si Duterte sang Marso 11 sa kaso sini nga crimes against humanity.
english: Duterte was arrested on March 11 on charges of crimes against humanity.

text: Natalana ang confirmation of charges sa Septyembre 23, 2025.
english: Confirmation of charges is scheduled for September 23, 2025.

text: Nag-report ang head sang Federal Security Bureau kay Russian President Vladimir Putin nga naaresto na ang apat ka armado nga kalalakinhan nga amo ang ginatudlo nangamot sa pagpang-atake sa isa ka concert sa Crocus City Hall malapit sa Moscow kun sa diin masobra na sa 130 ang nagkalamatay.
english: The head of the Federal Security Bureau has reported to Russian President Vladimir Putin that four armed men have been arrested in connection with the attack on a concert at Crocus City Hall near Moscow that killed more than 130 people.

text: Ginpahayag nga nadakop ang apat sa western border sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: The four were reportedly arrested on Russia's western border with Ukraine.

text: Pito ka iban pa ang nadetain kag ginapadayon naman ang pagpangita sa iban pa nila nga kahimbon.
english: Seven others were detained and the search for their other accomplices is ongoing.

text: Antes sini, nauna na ang Islamic State of Iraq and Syria ukon ang ISIS sa pag-ako nga sila nga responsable sa amo nga insidente kun sa diin nag-open fire ang armado nga kalalakinhan sa amo nga concert hall gamit ang automatic weapons kag sunod nga may ginhaboy nga granada kag bomba nga amo ang rason sang sunog sa complex nga rason man kun nagpanglakaak ang numero sang patay.
english: Earlier, the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria or ISIS claimed responsibility for the incident where armed men opened fire on the concert hall using automatic weapons and then threw grenades and bombs that caused the fire in the complex.

text: Sa latest nga data, nagdangat na sa 133 ang patay apang padayon ang pagpangita sang Russian authorities sa iban pa nga parte sang complex kun sa diin posible may natabunan nga mga lawas sang tawo.
english: According to the latest data, the death toll has risen to 133 but Russian authorities are still searching for other parts of the complex where there may be buried human bodies.

text: May local governor man nga nagkumpirma nga 121 pa ang nagapabilin nga ginabulong sa ospital.
english: A local governor also confirmed that 121 people are still being treated at the hospital.

text: Gintawag naman ni President Putin nga isa ka “barbaric terrorist act” ang natabo nga gindungan pa sa concert sang isa ka Soviet-era rock band.
english: President Putin called the incident a “barbaric terrorist act” that coincided with a concert by a Soviet-era rock band.

text: May na-mensyonar man ini nga pagkatapos sang krimen, nagpalagyo ang mga suspek pakadto sa Ukraine kun sa diin santo sa preliminary data, may napreparar na nga bintana sa Ukrainian side agud nga makatabok sila sa border.
english: He also mentioned that after the crime, the suspects fled to Ukraine where according to preliminary data, a window has been prepared on the Ukrainian side so that they can cross the border.

text: Sunod man nga nagpanginwa ang Defense Intelligence sang Ukraine nga may kahilabtanan sila sa natabo sa concert hall.
english: Ukraine's Defense Intelligence subsequently denied any involvement in the concert hall incident.

text: Gintawag man sini nga lunsay sala ang mga akusasyon ni Putin nga wala man sang napakita nga ebidensya.#
english: He also called Putin's accusations false without any evidence.

text: Nag-file sang resolution si Senator Alan Peter Cayetano nga nagapanawagan sa gobyerno sang Pilipinas nga iduso ang interim release para kay former President Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Senator Alan Peter Cayetano filed a resolution calling on the Philippine government to push the interim release for former President Rodrigo Duterte to the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Sa iya nga resolution nga “Sense of the Senate to Urge the Philippines to Advocate before the International Criminal Court for the Interim Release of Former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte”, gin-suhestyon man ni Cayetano nga magsulod sa isa ka kasugtanan nga ipaidalom na lang si Duterte sa house arrest sa Philippine Embassy sa Netherlands samtang nagahulat sang trial.
english: In his resolution “Sense of the Senate to Urge the Philippines to Advocate before the International Criminal Court for the Interim Release of Former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte”, Cayetano also suggested entering into an agreement to place Duterte under house arrest at the Philippine Embassy while awaiting trial in the Netherlands.

text: Ginrason sang senador nga importante ini para sa ikaayong lawas sang anay presidente samtang ginasiguro man nga wala ini sang dala nga risgo sa integridad sang trial sang korte.
english: The senator argued that this is important for the health of the former president while also ensuring that it does not pose a risk to the integrity of the court trial.

text: Sa proposal sang senador nga isaylo ang kustodiya kay Duterte sa embahada sang Pilipinas, ginsiling sini nga anuman nga makasugtan nga arrangement ang magasunod man sa kondisyon nga i-set sang Pre-Trial Chamber kaangay sang limitasyon sa hulag, pagtinir sa partikular lamang nga address, pagdumili sa pagpakig-angot sa mga biktima kag mga testigo, kag pag-comply sa summons sang international tribunal.
english: On the senator's proposal to transfer Duterte's custody to the Philippine embassy, he said any agreed arrangement will also follow conditions set by the Pre-Trial Chamber such as limitations on movement, staying at a particular address, prohibiting contact with victims and international witnesses, and summoning international witnesses. court.

text: Sa iya apelar, ginpahayag pa sang senador nga nagaluya na ang 80-anyos nga anay punong ehekutibo bangud sa iya edad kag bangud sa kadugayon sang isolation, kag ang padayon nga pag-detain sa iya ang mahimo nga mag-epekto sa iya nga emotional kag physical health.
english: In his appeal, the senator said the 80-year-old former chief executive is getting weaker due to his age and the length of isolation, and his continued detention could affect his emotional and physical health.

text: Pahayag pa sini, may kinamatarong ang anay presidente nga i-presume nga inosente samtang wala pa man napamatud-an nga guilty ini sa krimen sa idalom sang domestic kag international law.
english: He said the former president has the right to be presumed innocent while he has not been proven guilty of a crime under domestic and international law.

text: “[T]o grant the former President interim release in the form of a house arrest or modified house arrest or any other appropriate arrangement, subject to conditions restricting liberty to be imposed by the ICC would be beneficial to his health, all while presenting no risk to the integrity of the ongoing trial,” kabahin sang resolution.
english: “[T]o grant the former President interim release in the form of a house arrest or modified house arrest or any other appropriate arrangement, subject to conditions restricting liberty to be imposed by the ICC would be beneficial to his health, all while presenting no risk to the integrity of the ongoing trial,” part of the resolution.

text:
Dugang sini: “[T]o allow the former President – who has worked tirelessly and selflessly for the welfare of the Filipino people – to spend his twilight years far from not only home, but also his family and friends, would be the height of injustice.”

Ginrason man sang senador nga apisar nag-withdraw ang Pilipinas sa Rome Statute, mahimo sa gihapon makasulod ang Philippine Embassy sa kasugtanan agud nga makustodiya sini si Duterte pananglitan pasugtan sang korte ang petisyon sini para sa temporaryo nga kahilwayan.
english:
It added: “[T]o allow the former President – ​​who has worked tirelessly and selflessly for the welfare of the Filipino people – to spend his twilight years far from not only home, but also his family and friends, would be the height of injustice.”

The senator also argued that although the Philippines withdrew from the Rome Statute, the Philippine Embassy can still enter into an agreement to take Duterte into custody if the court grants his petition for temporary release.

text: Nahibaluan nga didto gihapon si Duterte sa ICC detention facility matapos nga gin-aresto ini sang Marso 11 sa kaso sini nga crimes against humanity.
english: Duterte is still in the ICC detention facility after being arrested on March 11 for crimes against humanity.

text: Natalana ang confirmation of charges sa Septyembre 23, 2025.
english: Confirmation of charges is scheduled for September 23, 2025.

text: Wala napasar ang resolution nga ginduso sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa United Nations Security Council agud magpanawagan sang immediate ceasefire sa gyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas sa Gaza.
english: The resolution proposed by the United States of America to the United Nations Security Council to call for an immediate ceasefire in the war between Israel and Hamas in Gaza failed.

text: Ini matapos nga ginlababagan ini sang duha ka permanent members sang council nga amo ang China kag Russia, kag nagpamatok man pati ang Algeria nga amo ang Arab representative sa amo nga organisasyon.
english: This was after the two permanent members of the council, China and Russia, opposed it, and Algeria, which is the Arab representative in the organization, also opposed it.

text: 11 naman ang nagboto-pabor halin sa 15-member na security council samtang nag-abstain naman ang Guyana.
english: 11 of the 15-member security council voted in favor while Guyana abstained.
